articleTitle: Crop Vigil: Automated Wheat Bunt Disease Multi-Classification with a CNN-RNN Hybrid Model and Attention Block
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wheat harvests are seriously threatened by wheat bunt disease, which lowers productivity and grain quality. For efficient illness management, disease intensity levels must be accurately and promptly classified. In this study, the proposed study presents a novel method for categorizing the intensity of wheat bunt disease into six stages by combining recurrent neural networks (RNN) and convolutional neural networks (CNN), together with an attention block. The goal is to create a dependable and understandable model that supports disease management choices and increases crop output. To capture spatial and temporal relationships in illness development, the proposed hybrid model makes use of the strengths of CNNs and RNNs. While the RNN component detects sequential patterns, the CNN component extracts picture features. Furthermore, an attention block method is included to draw attention to instructive areas of the pictures, improving interpretability and classification precision. Several criteria, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, were used to evaluate the model. The model's overall accuracy on the testing set was determined to be 0.9225, meaning that it was successful in accurately categorizing 92.25% of the photos of wheat bunt disease across all intensities. A comparative study with cutting-edge methods showed the poposed hybrid model to be superior. Its results outperformed current models, demonstrating its potential for useful application in the categorization of wheat bunt disease. The attention block's inclusion improved interpretability and allowed for the focus on important illness symptoms.

articleTitle: Advanced Regression Models for Accurate House Price Prediction: An Analysis of Performance and Interpretability
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The accurate prediction of house prices has important implications for the real estate industry, investors, and policymakers. In this study, we aimed to compare the performance of various regression models, including basic and advanced techniques, in predicting house prices using a public dataset containing 79 features. Our analysis included extensive feature engineering and data preprocessing to ensure the best possible performance of each model. Our findings suggest that advanced models, such as Bayesian regression and kernel regression having mean cross_val_score 0.9046 and 0.9058 respectively, outperformed basic models, such as multiple linear regression and polynomial regression. We also identified the importance of addressing issues such as multi-collinearity and outliers in the data to ensure the accuracy of the models. Our study contributes to the development of more precise and reliable methods for predicting house prices, providing insights into the strengths and limitations of different regression models. The implications of our work extend to the real estate industry, policymakers, and investors who rely on accurate real estate valuations for informed decision-making. Our results can be used to guide the selection of appropriate regression models and improve the accuracy of house price predictions.

articleTitle: Discovering Informative Data from Catastrophe Tweets Using Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Most of the social media platforms especially Twitter aims at connecting the users and helps in communicating their thoughts and feelings. During times of crisis, whether they involve immediate calamities or longer-term occurrences like floods and earthquakes, social media messages could be a vital origin of information. There is a probability that a tweet will contain both situational and non-situational information. Majority of previous efforts concentrated on recognizing tweets that contained a particular piece of information, such as situational, relevant, or actionable information. It can be difficult to distinguish between tweets that contain situational and non-situational information. Situational tweets include details that the concerned authorities may find useful, such as the count of impacted people in a certain area or contact information. Non-situational tweets can include sentimental information and personal viewpoints that may not be helpful to the authorities in question. Even after classifying the tweets, it is more important to give the information in short and efficient way. So that the tweets have to be summarized for quicker consumption without even losing a vital information. In data mining, clustering analysis is used to group similar data points together. In this paper, we are proposing Hierarsort framework that clusters and summarizes the data. The summarization is performed by pulling tweets out of different clusters.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of AOMDV Intelligent Decision Routing Algorithm for VANETs
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: VANET is one of the most challenging areas of research based on speedy communication services. However, these networks are suffered with some congestion, security issues and routing especially in metropolitan areas and basis of delay and computational complexities issues and pilot to delay packet delivery or data overcrowding. The Internet of Vehicles (IoV) and Unmanned Ariel Vehicles (UAV) or drones are facilitating VANET by collecting the data from mobile nodes and forward to the backbone architecture or to the Road Side Units (RSU) for decision making. VANET is based on multi-hop wireless access network where nodes can act both as a router as well as a host. One of the factors that control the concert of VANET is the core routing protocol used. Therefore, numbers of diverse multipath routing protocols are projected in recent years. This paper addresses the necessity of instantaneous transfer and self healing under high speed movement or route breakage in multipath routing in VANET. In this perspective we propose an intelligent decision based AOMDV protocol (AOMDVID), aiming to exploit the benefit of multipath routing algorithm to attain improved performance. The proposed protocol is tested in terms of packet loss ratio, routing overhead and packet delivery ratio in the presence of different number of nodes and velocities. The proposed AOMDV-ID achieved the high performance in certain scenarios as compared to existing AOMDV.

articleTitle: Predicting User Perception Regarding Usefulness of Google Classroom Through Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: To investigate the attitudes of the students at the tertiary level of different institutes towards using google classroom as a convenient online platform for learning the English Language, especially contemplating reading and writing skills have been performed. A survey had been conducted including 448 EFL students at the tertiary level in Bangladesh from four different institutes to figure out the result of this research. Data collection through a series of questionnaires had been posited based on learning reading and writing skills of the English Language. Finally, analyzing the data using machine learning algorithms, we concluded that google classroom is useful and effective in terms of learning the English language by elevating reading and writing skills of the students in Bangladesh based on the overall findings of both the survey and analyzing the data. Students' positive responses had been found towards using google classroom through this study.

articleTitle: Efficient Data Searching and Management with Search Desk: A Customizable Search Engine for Accurate and Timely Results
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Modern businesses depend heavily on data, and companies are always seeking new and better methods to use data to guide their choices. Though, looking through big data may be challenging, time-consuming, and even error-prone. This is effectively dealt with via the application Search Desk. Search Desk is a powerful search engine platform that can search text (numerical, alphanumeric, and alphabetic, for example) or words across all forms of data/files, including .txt, .doc, .docx, .pdf, .jpeg, .png, .jpg, .tiff, .jfif, .xls, .xlsx, and other file formats. The more comprehensive the input text given by the user, the more accurate the search results can be. The user may be able to manage data more effectively and efficiently with its aid. Additionally, it is simple to use and can be tailored to the needs of the user. Besides, the application is built using open-source technologies to ensure speed and flexibility, thus allowing all businesses and enterprises to benefit from it regardless of their size. Moreover, this application also provides secure management for your data to ensure that nobody can access or save the information, which makes it more reliable and secure.

articleTitle: Autism Spectrum Disorder detection in children by calculating the distances between facial landmarks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Currently, the Machine Learning models that are being used in autism detection have high computational requirements, which in turn makes the detection time consuming. This paper proposes a model that will detect whether a person has ASD (Autism Spectrum Disorder) or is TD (Typically Developing) based on the distances between specific facial landmarks. Haar Cascade algorithm was used for the detection of eyes and MediaPipe framework was used for detection of facial landmarks on the face. There are four hundred and sixty-eight facial landmarks detected by MediaPipe out of which the detection of right landmarks was done. Six relevant distances were calculated. The Euclidean distance was calculated between these detected landmarks for autistic faces as well as Typically Developing faces. The extracted distances were then passed through various classifiers such as Random Forest, KNN, XGBoost, SVM, Logistic Regression and Decision Tree, after which a machine learning model was trained. The maximum accuracy was achieved by making use of XGBoost classifier. The final model obtained an accuracy of 83.5% which was given by XGBoost classifier.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis: Current Status and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The medical field and public health care has achieved radical progress in the last age, the original reasons behind abundant conditions were disclosed, novel symptomatic forms were devised, and new cures were developed. The second leading cause of death is cancer. worldwide afflicting approximately six out of every ten people. Variants of the lungs and colon of all cancers are those that prevalent and most fatal. However, detecting the disease in its infancy increases the odds of survival dramatically. Over the last three decades, the number of cancer victims and the scope of cancer survivability research has increased. This chapter provides a review of all types of cancer prediction with interventional and observational cancer survivorship research efforts. The treatment of cancer type is increasingly required in early cancer research. The advancement of healthcare research has been boosted by artificial intelligence. Researchers have developed program to help cancer identification and prognosis due to the availability of open-source healthcare statistics. In these conditions, DL and ML models give a dependable, quick, and effective method for dealing with such difficult diseases. Cancer categorization is a contentious issue in medicine since it allows for precise and effective diagnosis and promotes a favorable outcome in medical therapies.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Swin Transformers and Graph Convolutional Nets for Iris Antispoofing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Iris recognition is widely employed as a biometric authentication technique. It is valued for its high precision and user-friendliness. However, these systems are susceptible to spoofing attacks, wherein fraudulent irises or photographs of genuine irises are presented to deceive the system. To address this vulnerability, iris antispoofing techniques are utilized to differentiate between authentic and fake iris samples. In order to tackle the subtle distinctions between real and fake iris images, our research incorporates fine-grained vision classification. Fine-grained vision classification is a method employed to discern genuine iris images from spoofed ones, given the minute differences in their characteristics. We employ Swin-Transformaer backbone and attention mechanism to focus on pertinent areas within an image. By limiting self-attention computations to cross-window connections while allowing for non-overlapping local windows, this option offers increased efficiency. Furthermore, the backbone network was upgraded with the feature pyramid network (FPN), enabling effective fusion of features at different scales using graph convolution network, ultimately to produce more accurate recognition results. Our proposed approach aims to strengthen the iris antispoofing systems, thereby enhancing the overall security and reliability of iris recognition technology. Moreover, the proposed approach yields superior outcomes compared to other state-of-the-art results.

articleTitle: Android application for food label recognition to ensure safe food consumption based on user allergen information leveraging OCR
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The increase in the prevalence of food allergies is a concerning issue in today’s world. According to some estimates, 3 percent of Indians may already have food allergies, the majority under 40 years of age. Food allergies cause roughly 30,000 emergency treatments and 100 to 200 deaths per year in the nation. Additionally, there is a lack of awareness and understanding of food allergies in India, which can lead to delayed diagnosis and treatment. This brings in a need for technology-based solutions to help individuals who have food allergies to identify allergens in their food and to make conscious and informed decisions in their day-to-day consumption of food. This research paper presents an application that helps people with food allergies and intolerances identify potential allergens in packaged foods. The scope of the project involves the integration of multiple technologies wherein the app utilizes optical character recognition (OCR) from the Firebase API to extract the name of the food from a picture taken by the user, and then cross-references the name with a dataset of allergen information. The application provides a user-friendly interface that is easy to navigate and provides clear alerts, Our application is specifically designed to ensure that the user is thoroughly informed of the contents of their food. This brings a revolutionary aspect to dietary consumption by allowing users to have the freedom of consuming their food of choice without having to worry about their allergies and other side effects. In conclusion, this paper demonstrates the successful development and implementation of an Android application that can help in improving the lives of millions of people worldwide who suffer from food allergies and intolerances and can be further developed and customized to meet specific user needs.

articleTitle: Multiple Nail-Disease Classification Based on Machine Vision Using Transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Human nails can be an early indicator of severe diseases. This technique is very common in the medical sector. However, the only shortcoming is the low human-eye capability to analyze vast colors and detect slight differences. Therefore, we have combined image processing techniques and deep learning algorithms to generalize models which can provide a high accuracy rate and speed up the process of detecting diseases. In our paper, we have chosen three types of nail diseases which are- Bluish Fingernails, Red Puffy Nails, and Yellow Fungal Nails. These are the most common nail abnormalities indicating medical severity. We used three CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) models, then compared the training and testing rate to find out the most efficient model. The models are MobileNetV2, VGG16, and VGG19 and the achieved accuracy rates were 92%, 72%, and 89% respectively. These accuracy rates were acquired from testing on previously unseen images.

articleTitle: Analysis of Movie Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper presents a comprehensive literature review of various movie recommendation systems, including techniques such as sentiment analysis of comments, movie trailer data, facial expressions, browsing history, and view percentage. The paper also compares various recommenders based on deep learning and swarm algorithms. Furthermore, this paper provides a novel approach for movie recommender system that uses a hybrid model combining content-based and collaborative filtering approaches. Specifically, the proposed approach involves creating a matrix factorization-based model and providing certain custom-designed features, such as averages of all movies and users, top similar movies, and top similar users, to produce the final model. The proposed approach is evaluated on the MovieLens dataset and achieves a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 19.868316 and a root mean squared error (RMSE) of 0.672788. These outcomes illustrate the potency of the suggested strategy and its potential to enhance movie recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Vader protocol based sentiment analysis technique using LSTM for Stock Trend prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Stock prediction has always been a difficult task, and numerous strategies for predicting stock market behavior have been offered. Researchers have recently begun to investigate the use of sentimental analysis and deep learning models such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) to predict stock prices. We offer a stock prediction model that integrates sentimental analysis and LSTM in this research. The model considers the mood of stock market news items and use LSTM to forecast future stock prices. The results of our suggested model's evaluation on the S& amp; P 500 dataset reveal that it outperforms traditional stock prediction approaches.

articleTitle: RE Powered Automatic Railway Mobile Platform Without using Staircase
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Present railway stations provide escalators, elevators and staircase for passengers to move from one platform to another. It is very difficult for the elderly people or handicapped persons to use such facilities. This work proposes a mobile platform which automatically closes or opens using gear and pinion arrangement in between the two platforms. The mobile platform will help the passengers to reduce the effort in going from one platform to another. The mobile platform uses motors which require ample amount of electrical energy which can be supplied through Renewable Energy (RE) sources. Wind and solar energy attract much attention because of no pollution and durative. In the work proposed, powering up the battery and DC motor is done using hybrid wind-solar PV system. MATLAB/SIMULINK is used to model and simulate the hybrid system with the MPPT controller for solar PV. The outputs are verified for constant wind speeds and varied irradiation levels. It is observed that the proposed hybrid system will provide continuous supply as the energy sources depend on the climate. Circuit breakers are used to overcome the battery issues like over charging which will affect the battery life and efficiency in this model. Hardware prototype of the model is implemented and tested.

articleTitle: Suppressing Rain Streak Weather Noise for Recognizing Overturned Accidental Car Vehicle License Plate
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Vehicle License Plate Recognition (VLPR) system is widely used in real time gate mechanism, parking lots, toll plaza etc. Such system fails when there is an occurrence of rain weather noise over car License Plate. This paper proposes new algorithm for efficient weather noise removal incorporated along with YOLO for efficient character recognition. The RS Removal for VLPR system is named as RSRVLPR. The existing spatial RS removal scheme uses guided filter and Deep Learning (DL). However, the scheme is inefficient due to time complexity. The proposed RSRVLPR scheme uses Prelu based Detail Layer (PDL) based on Deep Learning that performs the removal of foreground rain streak by super imposing the Detail Layer over VLP. The learning process is efficient as the Prelu based activation function models the non-linearity. After the removal of rain streak, the License Plate (LP) of any orientation is detected and recognized using You Only Look Once (YOLO). The proposed RSRVLPR is implemented in Anaconda using Jupyter Notebook with co-lab. The experiment results show that the proposed PDL scheme distinguishes the rain streaks from background to get the clear de-rain image as an output to YOLO. The performance of the PDL based RSRVLPR is evaluated with the state-of-art methods in terms of recognition accuracy for both synthetic and raw data and found to give accuracy of 84% in RSR, 91% for LP detection and 93% for LP recognition.

articleTitle: A Correlation Interpolated for VANET Protocols Driving Adaptive Quality of Service in Intelligent Transportation System: A Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Internet of Things acknowledged as IoT is an epoch of heterogeneous allied devices communicating effectively to provide global solutions to their users. A smart city implementation, an IoT application, significantly emphasizes developing an Intelligent Transportation system (ITS). Whereas ITS is driven by vehicular ad-hoc networks popular as (VANETs) and is considered in current research work. The VANETs is a comprehensive wireless sensor network application thriving to provide safety and comfort to users in an environment of high mobility. This paper focuses on achieving Quality-of-service (QoS) for providing an optimum route to transfer information from one vehicular ad-hoc mobile network node to another using varied routing protocols highlighting correlation interpolated between VANET routing protocols. Further assessed the performance metrics for a realistic vehicular traffic scenario of the area around Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute Mumbai, City of India. Quality metrics parameters calculated and analyzed using a network simulator demonstrate that packet delivery ratio, goodput, along with MAC Phy overhead are vital for information exchange in a high-mobility environment with a successful data retrieval rate and reduced delay. AODV and DSR protocols indicated better performance for optimum route discovery.

articleTitle: Design of an SLA Violation identification framework via Iterative Learning under Temporary Peak loads for Cloud deployments
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are essential for seamless cloud operations but can get violated due to misconfigurations and network faults. Existing SLA violation identification mechanisms rely on static reconfiguration, which limits their scalability under high-speed scenarios. Additionally, most of these models are either highly complex or exhibit low efficiency under real-time cloud scenarios. To address these challenges, a novel SLA violation identification framework is proposed in this research paper. The framework uses iterative learning via a customized 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Q-Learning to identify SLA violations and recommend mitigation strategies via incremental learning operations. The proposed model is able to learn from previous responses and improve its performance incrementally, making it useful for a wide variety of real-time use cases. The proposed model reduces SLA violations by 8.3%, improves deadline hit ratio by 1.2%, and reduces scheduling delay by 4.5% under real-time cloud traffic scenarios

articleTitle: Advanced IoT-Based Fire and Smoke Detection System leveraging Deep Learning and TinyML
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper presents the development of an advanced IoT-based fire and smoke detection system leveraging deep learning and TinyML techniques. The objective is to create a real-time detection system optimized for deployment on resource-constrained devices like Raspberry Pi. The proposed system aims to provide accurate and timely detection of fire and smoke in indoor environments using computer vision and machine learning.To achieve this, state-of-the-art deep learning models, including MobileNet, EfficientNet, ResNet, InceptionNet, and XceptionNet, are employed, as they have demonstrated promising results in image recognition tasks. These models are optimized for real-time operation and adapted to run efficiently on low-power devices like Raspberry Pi. Techniques such as quantization, pruning, and other TinyML-specific optimizations are utilized to reduce computational cost and memory usage while maintaining high levels of accuracy.The performance of the proposed system is evaluated through extensive testing in various indoor environments. The evaluation focuses on accuracy, response time, and computational efficiency, comparing the system against existing fire and smoke detection systems. The results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of deploying state-of-the-art deep learning models on resource-constrained devices, highlighting the system's ability to provide reliable and cost-effective fire and smoke detection.

articleTitle: Review of Multiband RF Energy Harvesters
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Radio Frequency Energy Harvesting is a technique that efficiently converts electromagnetic waves into direct current (DC), offering a range of potential applications. This modern technology can supply wireless power to battery-free gadgets and Wireless sensor network (WSN) nodes, which positions it as a potentially useful alternative energy source for use in the near and distant future. Because wireless sensor network (WSN) sensor nodes need to be continuously charged, it is necessary to research effective methods of RF energy harvesting.In this review paper, we explore the latest RF energy harvesting techniques across various frequency bands, including 900 MHz and 1800 MHz (GSM band), 1575 MHz (GPS band), 2.4 GHz (ISM band), and more. Different antenna types are used like dual-band rectifier antenna, microstrip U slot antenna, compact planar prototype microstrip patch antenna, and an omnidirectional antenna. Different matching networks, such as an L-network, a pi-network, or a T network, among others, could be utilized for impedance matching. In order to achieve the desired impedance match, a lumped T-type matching network has been put into operation. Different multipliers and rectifiers are also used, such as the Villard voltage multiplier, Greinacher voltage multiplier, Series multiplier, and Parallel multiplier.

articleTitle: Exploring Pretrained Models and Transfer Learning Techniques for Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, the field of content-based image retrieval (CBIR) has witnessed significant advancements and garnered immense attention. With the increase of digital imagery across various domains, the need for effective image search and retrieval techniques has become increasingly important. Pre-trained deep neural networks have arisen as effective tools for image analysis and feature extraction due to their ability to learn complex visual representations from vast amounts of data. By harnessing the power of pre-trained deep neural networks, such as AlexNet, ResNet, VGG16, and GoogLeNet, researchers seek to enhance CBIR systems. This paper explores the significance of utilizing pre-trained networks for content-based image retrieval (CBIR). It includes a literature review discussing similar CNN architectures & their applications as well as identifying research gaps. The paper conducts a comparative study of the four pre-trained networks: AlexNet, ResNet, VGG16, and GoogLeNet, evaluating their performance and suitability for CBIR. It also demonstrates transfer learning techniques to fine tune AlexNet and VGG16 models using MNIST and Fashion MNIST dataset. Evaluation using LRAP as a metric revealed good performance for both models, with AlexNet consistently outperforming VGG16, albeit with longer execution times.

articleTitle: Early Stage Forcast of CKD Using ML Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Concurring to projections, the frequency of chronic kidney disease (CKD) is anticipated to extend over time. To facilitate rapid detection and cure, precise CKD prediction models are necessary. The classifier choice significantly influences the accuracy of these models. In this study, we highlight and assess various ML classification algorithms for CKD executed on dataset available on UCI library. Our study involved implementing six classification algorithms, including Random Forest, KNN, Decision Tree, Gradient Boosting, Xg Boost, and Ada Boost. In addition, we also employed random sampling and mean/mode sampling for the essential attribute selection method to refine the dataset. According to the findings, it was determined that Random Forest yielded an optimal accuracy of 98.33%. Together with precision, F-1 score, accuracy, and recall possess endured calculated and analyzed outcomes about different methods exhibited illustrated in the chart. After reviewing the analysis of the results, it is evident that the implementation of machine learning classification algorithms can prove advantageous for healthcare. Moreover, it can assist in the initial identification of CKD and related stages, leading to a reduction in the development of renal disease.

articleTitle: Scope of IoT in Emerging Engineering Technology during Online Education
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Physical objects with built-in sensors, processors, software, and other technologies that can communicate with one another and share data via the web are what the IoT refers to. Diverse devices that may cause security risks to your business, a new Engineering method based on IoT safeguards Internet devices & networks they connect to against assaults and breaches. The Internet of Things (IoT) can be protected against intrusion, its vulnerabilities can be monitored, and any existing holes may be patched with the help of cutting-edge engineering practises. IoT security guarantees the solution's availability, integrity, and privacy. With the help of mobile devices and the IoT, schools can better protect their campuses, keep an eye on vital resources, and improve students' access to information. In addition, teachers may use this technology to create "smart lesson plans," which are more engaging for students than the traditional lesson plans of the past. One of the strategies advocated in this study is the use of IoT to protect the educational sector against cyber threats. Existing research is being compared to proposed research in terms of safety, reliability, and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Code Commenting on Software Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

authors.preferredName: H. M. P. P. K. H. Samarasekara
authors.firstName: H. M. P. P. K. H.

abstract: One of the most efficient ways to assist developers in grasping the source code is to make use of comments, which can be found throughout the code. When working in fields such as software development, having comments in your code that are of good quality is a fundamental requirement. Tackling software problems while making use of programs that has already been built. It is essential for the intention of the source code to be made crystal apparent in the comments that are added to the code. This assists programmers in better comprehending the programs they are working on and enables them to complete software maintenance jobs in a more timely manner. In spite of the fact that comments and documentation are meant to improve readability and maintainability, the vast majority of programmers place the majority of their focus on the actual code that is being written. This study provides a complete and comprehensive overview of the prior research carried out on the topic of code comments. The study focuses on four main topics, including automated comment production, comment consistency, comment classification, and comment quality rating. One is able to get the knowledge that is more complete for use in following inquiries if they conduct an analysis of the proper approaches that were used in this study issue.

articleTitle: A Survey: Authentication Protocols & Security Analysis for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are collection of small devices equipped with sensors, microprocessors, and wireless communication capabilities. These devices are employed for the purpose of sensing, collecting, analysing, and wireless transmitting data via radio waves. WSNs are applied in various fields, including environmental surveillance, defence, healthcare, and industrial process control. However, WSNs are vulnerable to security risks, particularly in remote and hard-to-reach locations. To ensure security, multiple authentication techniques have been developed, and the present study focuses on security challenges and threats to WSNs, reviewing different authentication protocols currently used in WSNs. The survey highlights the growing interest in security and suggests several authentication methods that prioritize security, scalability, and reduced communication and computation overheads. The survey concludes that authentication protocols play a critical role in reducing the likelihood of attacks and ensuring secure data transmission in WSNs.

articleTitle: ECAPA-Based Speaker Verification of Virtual Assistants: A Transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Speaker Verification technology is crucial in identifying individuals through their unique voice characteristics. However, the increasing use of speech assistants has posed new challenges for this technology. To address this, transfer learning is employed using the ECAPA-TDNN model trained on human voices from the VoxCeleb2 dataset. This study compares intra-voice assistant variations and proceeds to inter-voice assistant comparisons. In intra-pair comparisons, text-independent samples achieved accuracies of 83.33% (iOS versions) and 66.67% (Alexa versions), while text-dependent samples achieved 50% accuracy for both versions. In inter-pair comparisons (Alexa, Siri, Google Assistant, Cortana), accuracies of 100% (text-independent) and 80% (text-dependent) were observed. These findings showcase the effectiveness of transfer learning and the ECAPA-TDNN model for secure speaker verification in different speech assistant versions. The study provides valuable insights for enhancing speaker verification in the context of speech assistants.

articleTitle: MRI Synthesis via CycleGAN-Based Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Medical imaging plays a crucial role in modern medicine by supporting illness diagnosis and therapy. However, there are difficulties in illness diagnosis using medical imaging, such as the costs and infrastructure to conduct an MRI scan, and the strenuous task of correctly interpreting an MRI scan. It is necessary to develop a method for producing MRI images with adjustable contrast levels. A cyclic Generative Adversarial Neural Network called CycleGAN, which performs well with unpaired data and is best suited for medical imagery, is used for the proposed healthcare platform to create artificial MRI scans. The results show that our method converts non-fat saturated MRI images into fat saturated images more effectively than a benchmark pix2pix approach, resulting in a PSNR (peak signal- to-noise ratio) of 12.89, structural similarity of 0.97, and KL divergence of 0.07, using the MRI dataset, a sizeable collection of freely accessible MR brain pictures.

articleTitle: e-Health: A Modern Approach to Healthcare Delivery
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: e-Health had various attributes other than doctors, patients and medicine. Some of the components are health records, prescriptions, decision support system, online consultation videos, transcripts and telemedicine. Information technology is now integral and one of the core components of eHealth. Prescriptions generated from computer and Artificial intelligent expert systems, include diagnosis, basis of diagnosis, medicine, their side-effects and drug combination and their dosages.

articleTitle: Secured Medical Record Sharing Application Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As a standard operating procedure of the healthcare industry, medical professionals always consult patients' medical histories before diagnosing and giving medications to them. Several organizations or clinics have their own database of every patient that visits them but it is observed that these organizations exchange patient medical records with businesses for research without patient approval. This threatens patient privacy. Using a centralized system to store these data might alleviate the problem, but when privacy is a concern, there are limited solutions. Thus, today's medical community needs a system to organize medical information and allow patients to securely share data with healthcare providers. This paper aims to develop a blockchain technology-based system that can store medical records on a distributed network. Two-way authentication utilizing the RSA-Encryption technique will prevent medical practitioners from tampering with or selling patients' data without consent, this chain of records will be delivered to them after verification.

articleTitle: Improved Segmentation of Retinal Vessel Pathways Using Enhanced U-Net Model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Retinal imaging is a frequently employed method in medical practice to yield valuable data regarding modifications in the retinal blood vessel architecture, that are typical of ailments such as glaucoma, hypertension, or diabetes. Their timely treatment can prevent patients from suffering from blindness. Experienced physicians find the manual decomposition of the vascular structure from fundus images to be time-intensive and susceptible to errors due to the complexity involved in capturing the details of the blood vessel pathways. Lately, deep learning techniques have been implemented because of their superior speed and precision in comparison to manual segmentation. To address the problem of reduced accuracy caused by imbalanced categories, this paper proposes an enhanced U-NET structure with a combined loss function, referred to as Dice-BCE loss that specifically caters to imbalanced data to enable the model to concentrate on target characteristics. This proposed approach is analysed on the Digital Retinal Images for Vessel Extraction (DRIVE) dataset and it achieves better results than already proposed models with an accuracy of 96.75%, F1-Score of 81.09%, Jaccard-Index of 68.23%, a sensitivity of 80.28%, specificity of 98.35% and precision of 82.52%.

articleTitle: Smoke Detection Using its Static and Dynamic Features Based on Fractional Order Optical Flow and Deep Learning Models for Fire Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As we are aware that many indoor and outdoor fires abruptly occur every day around the world, which results as a major factor to global warming, hundreds of casualties and serious threat to property safety. Thus, the early prediction of fire is particularly become our utmost priority to reduce the loss, because once the fire spreads, it is difficult to control. Generally, the early detection of fire has its association with raising smoke, which is the smoldering stage of fire. In this stage, the smoke demonstrates different textures, colors, and shapes. The novel idea of this paper is to perform the fire prediction using the statical and dynamical smoke features. The static features of smoke are considered as color, texture and shape, while the dynamic features are derived from its motion field. The smoke dynamic motion is computed in terms of optical flow field color map, and used to represent the active regions of the image sequence (video). Therefore, a fractional order based variational model is presented for optical flow determination. These estimated color maps are further divided into the three color channels. The color channels manifesting smoke motion sensitivity are segmented with the aid of binary masks. Next, the segmented color maps along with the corresponding image sequences are used in a novel CNN architecture to detect smoke. In order to validate the model performance, a thorough comparison study is also depicted with several state-of-the-art models. A diverse collection of datasets comprised of 16 and 19 smoke and non-smoke videos, respectively, is considered for experiments.

articleTitle: Optimized Machine Learning Model for Identifying and Predicting Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder(ADHD)
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) a form of neurodevelopmental disorder often manifests in young age. As per a 2016 WHO Survey for 10 countries, the ubiquity percentage of adult ADHD was determined to be 2.8% globally, showing a high percentage in countries with above average wealth and a strong correlation with male gender [1]. Inattention, impulsivity, and hyperactivity are the three main symptoms of ADHD that children and adults with the disorder often exhibit. However, these symptoms can vary widely from person to person, and some people with ADHD are classified as having inattentional, hyperactive/impulsive, or combined subtypes of the disorder. Futures seem bright for the development of systems that can use phenotypic and neuroimaging data to anticipate a diagnosis. This paper suggests a system for categorizing ADHD issues using fMRI data. The usage of 3D convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in the processing of fMRI has made numerous significant advances. The 3D spatial data of the fMRI data may be retained thanks to these cutting-edge techniques. Additionally, 3D generative adversarial neural networks (GANs) have made considerable advancements in the creation of normal MRI data. In order to predict ADHD using fMRI, this study uses multi modal 3D CNNs and employing 3D GAN for data augmentation. A time distributed single modal 3D CNN model will be compared to the improved multi modal model utilizing MRI data for classification.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Approach of CNN and SVM for Precise Classification of Sweet Corn Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study presents a method for classifying and detecting five sweet potato diseases, including Stewart's Wilt, the northern Corn the leaves Blight, Common Rust, The grain maize Dwarf Mosaic viruses (MDMV), and Southern Corn's Leaf Blight, using convolutional neural network technology (CNN) as well as support vector machine models (SVM). In the suggested methodology, a CNN architecture with three completely connected layers, three max-pooling levels, and then two more fully connected layers are used. To effectively control these diseases and increase agricultural output, the goal is to precisely forecast and categorize their existence. The photos representing both healthy sweet potato leaves and those afflicted by the aforementioned disorders make up the dataset utilized for training and evaluation. The acquired findings show how well the designed model for disease classification works. The precision scores, which vary from 93.17% and 97.21%, show that the model can reliably detect the presence of particular diseases. The recall values, which vary from 94.59% and 96.13%, show how well each disease's actual positive episodes are captured by the model. The F1 scores, which range from 94.34% to 96.67%, also support the reliability of the method for classifying diseases. The achieved accuracy, which ranges from 95% to 98%, adds to the validity and efficacy of the suggested strategy. The outcomes demonstrate the capability of the CNN and SVM techniques to reliably identify and diagnose the occurrence of the targeted illnesses in sweet potato plants. Overall, by providing a cutting-edge and effective technique for identifying and categorizing illnesses in sweet potato plants, this research study contributes to the field of agricultural control of diseases. With its particular design and parameter settings, the suggested CNN and SVM technique offers promising results and creates opportunities for practical deployment in real-world scenarios, permitting prompt interventions and improved agricultural practices.

articleTitle: The Negative Impacts of Sports Injury and Techniques Involved in Correlating EMG and EEG Signal: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Science-based medicine, which includes thorough research findings to underpin clinical judgements, has undergone a considerable transition in recent years [1]. To improve the consistency and repeatability of studies analysing the effectiveness of clinical guidelines, more reliable methodologies are required, particularly in the field of sport and muscle healthcare. Muscle spasms and tiredness are brief, painful, involuntary contractions of the skeletal muscles that can happen in a variety of circumstances [1]. While there is evidence that some cases may be linked to disturbances of water and salt balance, other cases appear to involve sustained abnormal spinal reflex activity secondary tofatigue of the affected muscles [30]. The causes and treatments for cramps that happen during or shortly after exercise or a sport activity are still unknown. It has been hypothesised that EAMC in marathonrunners is linked to high intensity, prolonged exercise, and steep terrain, all ofwhich can cause "premature muscle fatigue" in competitors with a history of cramping [30]. This paper's key subjects include the negative effects of sports on athletes, the methodology used to collect brain and muscle signals, and methods for combining these information. The association between brain activation and leg muscles is described with a complete and up-to-date examination. In conclusion, the methods of fractional dimension and entropy analysis yield better outcomes when connecting the information from the brain and muscles. Because different tasks are closely related to muscle activations.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Machine Learning Classification Methods for Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The use of Natural Language Processing and text processing along with identification and research of sentiments and emotional states from a specific set of data sets are all part of the burgeoning field of sentiment analysis. Many companies use sentiment analysis for product reviews and social media comments to assess whether content is positive, negative, or neutral. This paper investigates classifiers based on various factors and focuses on the creation of many machine learning classification algorithms as well as their performance analysis. The Weka tool will be used to illustrate sentiment analysis utilising Nave Bayes, Multilayer Perceptron, J48, Random Forest, and OneR classifiers, which are machine learning techniques. All classifiers are tested using a 10-fold cross-validation approach. When the outcomes of the five different classifiers were analysed, the J48 classifier had the best prediction accuracy of 98.59 percent.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of ‘Myopia Epidemic’ Using Image Processing and Machine Learning to Prevent Fatal Road Accidents
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Poor vision is one of the Biggest Issue faced by Indian Drivers. 80 percent of deaths on Indian roads are due to driver errors. According to NCRB reported Data Road Accidents are increased from 3,68,828 in 2020 to 4,22,659 in 2021. Individuals with poor vision are more likely to be involved in a highway road accident. Our study noted that one in three drivers needed vision correction urgently, while another safety audit found that 5% of driver were suffering from myopia cataract. Myopia is a Nearsightedness it is a condition in which nearby objects appear clearly but distant objects looks blurry. The Unaware commercial drivers are need to be monitored by traffic Departments. Hence, the traffic enforcement departments like police departments and the Road Transport Offices (RTO) need an equipment like a device being used for drunk and drive identification. By Using this device, we can identify drivers, especially truck and bus drivers with poor vision, and provide them with prompt treatment to ensure their safety. In our project the drivers eye image is captured using the 3d stereoscopy technique. Then the Images are converted into Fundus Images for a 2d representation. The provided framework includes a representation of the biopsy procedures. Tiny myopia pandemic biopsy images are in RGB design and are converted to black and white images. Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and Gray Level Run Length Matrix (GLRLM) techniques are used to segment dim scale images for surface extraction, obtaining surface characteristics for differentiation, relationship, vitality, and homogeneity highlights, respectively. Using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) calculation, images are divided into two classes: Myopic and Non-Myopic. Analysis of little sputum tests for the disease associated with the myopia epidemic and the detection of myopia epidemic malignancy protests in CT sweep. The Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and Gray Level Run Length Matrix (GLRLM) techniques have been used to demonstrate the myopia epidemic malignancy using CNN Algorithm. The ML algorithm is used to classify the level of treatments required and give advises to the enforcement departments to the kind of action remedial actions to be taken. Finally, it is decided that the person need surgery or a corrective lens, and these suggestions are made.

articleTitle: Dynamic Virtual Machine Consolidation for Energy Efficiency in OpenStack-based Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid growth of cloud computing demands efficient resource allocation to maximize performance while minimizing energy consumption. Scalability improves, and up-front expenditures for IT infrastructure are decreased due to cloud computing. As the number of virtual machines (VMs) in a cloud environment grows, guaranteeing appropriate resource allocation and utilization becomes a difficult issue. Inefficient resource allocation can result in underutilized resources, energy waste, and increased operational expenses. Our research aimed to contribute to this objective by proposing a dynamic consolidation approach. We evaluated existing consolidation methods and identified their shortcomings. Many earlier methods lacked the adaptability and flexibility necessary to optimize energy use. We presented a consolidation technique that takes the hosts’ and VMs’ computing factors into account to address these flaws. The modules in this technique generate diverse and realistic environments for hosts and VMs, allowing for comprehensive evaluation. The Energy-Efficient Consolidation module serves as the core component, utilizing algorithms to optimize migration decisions. The technique effectively migrated virtual machines (VMs) from underutilized hosts to more effective ones, resulting in energy savings of 27% and 35% in the two scenarios, respectively. These results show how our method may help create cloud computing environments that are more environmentally friendly and energy-efficient. The implementation of our strategy in a real-time Multi-Node OpenStack testbed adds practicality and relevance to our findings.

articleTitle: EMG Interface for SCI Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A significant spinal cord injury (SCI) affects between 2.5 lakhs to 5 lakhs persons annually, according to the WHO. Physical restrictions on basic movement are one of three issues that impede many persons with SCI from participating fully in society. In order to improve treatment and get around health, social, and financial obstacles, WHO advises using appropriate assistive technology to help people with SCI perform daily duties. Over the past decades, many innovations and ideas were proposed to support SCI patients to meet their daily needs. Technology advancements like electrical muscular stimulation, bionic exoskeletons, and at-home assistance devices give people with SCI hope for a much better quality of life. But not all of them gave satisfactory results as they had limitations of their own. SCI patients suffer from numbness. As a result, SCI sufferers often find it challenging to use commonplace gadgets on their own. We suggest an EMG (electromyogram)-based input interface for patients with physical impairments of the extremities using machine learning. This includes those SCI patients who are amputees. Using the dataset created from the inputs of EMG sensors, we can control various devices. In this work we are recommending an EMG based interface to control electric wheelchairs for SCI patients as a first step.

articleTitle: Solution of optimal power flow problem for hybrid power system using a novel laplacian mutual learning assisted backtracking search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The researcher uses the optimal power flow (OPF) problem primarily for the economical operation of the power system while keeping different operational aspects within safe operating limits. Due to the depletion of fossil fuels and the increasing impact of environmental pollution, renewable energy resources (RERs) have been incorporated with thermal generation systems for the past few decades. The OPF problem gets more complex when applied to a power system integrated with RERs with significant intermittencies. In the current paper, an OPF problem is used for the power production cost minimization of a hybrid power system, including thermal generator (TG), wind power (WP), photovoltaic power (PVP), and tidal power (TDP). We propose a Laplacian mutation operation with a mutual learning scheme to enhance the backtracking search algorithm's exploration, exploitation, and convergence profile. The proposed technique is called Laplacian mutual learning-assisted BSA (LMLBSA). The proposed LMLBSA is applied to minimize the power production cost of the hybrid power system. To authenticate the superiority of the proposed technique, the results are compared to BSA with specular reflection learning (BSA_SRL), orthodox BSA and two robust existing techniques : grey wolf optimizer (GWO) and particle swarm optimization (PSO). The results indicated the proposed LMLBSA outperforms the competitors in terms of highly accurate and quality solutions.

Author Keywords: Laplacian mutual learning assisted backtracking search algorithm

articleTitle: Boosting Crop Yield and Quality: Deep Learning-Based Multi-Classification of Wheat Eye Spot Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wheat eye spot disease threatens global agricultural productivity and food security. This study offers deep learning (DL) hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) and recurrent neural network (RNN) model for multi-classifying wheat eye spot illness based on five intensity levels. Accurately classifying disease intensity allows prompt treatments and reduces crop losses. A self-collected dataset of wheat photos with varied eye spot disease intensities taught the classifier. Pre-processing the dataset improved image quality and model compatibility. The DL hybrid model captures spatial and temporal data relationships using CNN and RNN architectures. The suggested approach classifies wheat eye spot disease intensity with 95.47% accuracy in experiments. The model's accuracy helps farmers and agricultural specialists make educated decisions and implement disease management methods. The model also exceeds other state-of-the-art models in accuracy and performance. The comparison shows that the developed model classifies wheat eye spot illness across intensity levels better.

articleTitle: Simulation of IoT-based Smart City of Darwin: Leading Cyber Attacks and Prevention Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Rise of the Internet of Things (IoT) technology made the world smarter as it has embedded deeply in several application areas such as manufacturing, homes, cities, and health etc. In the developed cities, millions of IoT devices are deployed to enhance the lifestyle of citizens. IoT devices increases the efficiency and productivity with time and cost efficiency in smart cities, on the other hand, also set an attractive often easy targets for cybercriminals by exposing a wide variety of vulnerabilities. Cybersecurity risks, if ignored can results as very high cost to the citizens and management as well. In this research, simulated IoT network of Darwin CBD has been used with different IoT simulation tools. The treacherous effects of vulnerable IoT environment are demonstrated in this research followed by implementation of security measures to avoid the illustrated threats.

articleTitle: Adaptive Arithmetic Coding using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s data-driven world, industries across various sectors are grappling with the enormous influx of data being generated. The sheer volume of data poses significant challenges in terms of infrastructure costs, data transfer speeds, and storage requirements. As a result, many industries are reevaluating their approach to cloud-based storage solutions. One crucial solution to mitigate the issues associated with excessive storage usage, data integrity, transfer efficiency, and improved streaming speeds is lossless data compression. Numerous compressors currently available employ prediction-based compression techniques and utilize learned models to address these challenges effectively.To tackle this problem, our research focuses on exploring and developing strategies for compressing sequential data using neural network predictors. Neural networks are well-known as universal function approximators capable of learning complex mappings, and they have demonstrated impressive performance in prediction tasks. We leverage this capability by combining an arithmetic coder with recurrent neural network predictions, enabling us to achieve lossless compression for a wide range of datasets including synthetic, text, and genomic data [1]. Through a series of experiments using both simulated and actual text and genomic datasets, we evaluate the effectiveness of our approach. The results and observations from these experiments provide valuable insights for future research and advancements in the field of lossless data compression.

articleTitle: Detection of Compromised Accounts using Machine Learning Based Boosting Algorithms- AdaBoost, XGBoost, and CatBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s digital era, Online Social Media (OSM) like Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram are used to share information. Everyone is trusted on these social network platforms for exchanging information such as personal, professional, financial, etc. Due to this implicit faith in these social platforms, users broadcast their personal information on them. By taking advantage of the same, unauthorized users use the account of legitimate users for performing malicious activities. They gain valuable information and legitimate accounts are trapped in malicious hands. These types of accounts are known as Compromised Accounts. In order to create a safe and secure social media environment, it is, therefore, essential to identify these compromised accounts. In this paper, for the detection of Compromised Accounts, we have applied machine learning-based three boosting algorithms- AdaBoost, XGBoost, and CatBoost. These algorithms are compared with the state-of-art Compromised Account Detection using the Authorship Verification (CAD-AV) approach over the real-world Twitter dataset. The results have shown that all three algorithms- AdaBoost, XGBoost, and CatBoost have performed better in comparison to CAD-AV. Among them, CatBoost has performed the best (Accuracy: 94%) in the detection of compromised accounts.

articleTitle: An interactive flood forecasting tool with ensemble-based machine learning model: A Bangladesh Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Flood is a major natural disaster that leaves a trail of destruction in its wake, destroying homes and infrastructure. In Bangladesh, frequent floods displace millions of people from their homes, disrupt their livelihoods, and cause loss of life every year. Conventionally, flood forecasting has relied on statistical analysis. Machine learning (ML) approaches have been increasingly explored for flood prediction and mapping in recent years. This paper aims to evaluate the effectiveness of several machine learning (ML) algorithms for detecting floods in Bangladesh. To achieve this, a rainfall dataset has been collected from multiple stations across Bangladesh at various periods. Besides, 11 ML algorithms have been developed to predict floods. Three metrics were used to evaluate the ML algorithms-accuracy, precision and F1 score. As a further contribution, the results obtained from the study are represented via an interactive tool to facilitate further research and analysis.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Transformer Model For Speech Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Audio constitutes an indisputably indispensable attribute of nature. The study of sound becomes an interesting endeavour in this regard to expand our knowledge of nature and its pertinent peculiarities. One such characteristic intrinsically associated with audio is the emotion or the sentiment that it relays. Emotions play a deep role in understanding the human psyche and mindset in a behavioural context and advance domains of sociology, psychology, et cetera. It is with this vision of advancement that in this paper, we explore the realm of speech emotion recognition and undertake the endeavour to a comparative study of previously extant popular deep learning algorithms like - CNN & LSTM with certain temperaments of our own, in terms of the architecture and the hyperparameters used, and take into account the performance metrics to propose a transformer model incorporating bidirectional-LSTM, encoder, decoder and scaled-dot product attention. A popular standard - the RAVDESS dataset has been used for this purpose. The model has shown promising results on a preliminary basis when subjected to different metrics of testing and validation, and can potentially be employed in high-precision requisite systems.

articleTitle: Exploring the Dynamics and Implications of Offline Peer-to-Peer Payments
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Electronic financial systems are becoming more and more common because of the development of the Internet and communication technology. Digital numbers on computers are replacing physical currency as it loses favor. However, some issues need to be resolved with electronic financial systems, which are generally managed by commercial organizations. These drawbacks include internet connectivity, astronomical fees for utilizing the system, and security issues. Many nations throughout the world are contemplating central-bank digital currency (CBDC) as a remedy. Offline peer-to-peer (P2P) payments have emerged as a viable solution for secure and convenient financial transactions that do not require an Internet connection. This research paper examines the need for offline peer-to-peer payments, the system's logical architecture, including its fundamental building elements, its primary use cases, and the difficulties involved in putting it into practice. Several cutting-edge methods and tools that help to overcome the issues associated with offline payments are discussed. These include the use of secure cryptographic protocols, tokenization, and the adoption of near-field communication (NFC) or Bluetooth technologies for device-to-device communication. By examining the key components of offline P2P payments, this study aims to provide insights and recommendations for advancing offline P2P payment systems.

articleTitle: Playing Maze using Voice Commands
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, speech recognition has become increasingly well-known as a result of the numerous applications it has in virtually every industry. These applications include wake-word, sentiment, command, and interactive game play. Interest in voice in games has increased recently. Voice-controlled interaction expanded video game accessibility. However, in order to prevent an unwelcome delay, using one's voice as a controller for a game calls for real-time processing. This research paper puts forward the idea of controlling the well-known maze game with speech commands recognized by a trained convolutional neural network (CNN). A dataset of the speech commands "Left", "Right", "Up", "Down", "Go", and "Stop" was prepared for training, validation, and testing. In order to recognize all six speech commands, an optimal bark spectrogram and the CNN-based spoken command recognition model is used. The results from this work indicated that, the proposed algorithm was able to recognize all six commands with a high recognition accuracy of 94.57% and recall, precision, F1-Score of 94.8%, 94.43%, 94.53% respectively. The proposed algorithm is incorporated into a maze game in the final step.

articleTitle: Detection and Prevention of Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) Activities in Heterogeneous Networks using SIEM and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Distributed Denial of Service (DDOS) in IOT based systems has become a vital consideration especially since the quintessential development of IOT based gadgets including small Personal Digital Assistants (PDA) to large computing systems. The stupendous and prolonged presence of such innovations have attracted potential attackers, encouraging them to carry out cyber-attacks and data theft. The key objective of this research is to detect and mitigate botnet-based distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks in IoT networks. Our proposed model addresses the issue concerning threats from bots. Multiple machine learning models such as K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), K-Means clustering, Fuzzy clustering and Deep learning models such as Conventional Neural Network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) were used to arrive at the model, wherein the model is trained by Bot-Iot dataset. Various preprocessing methods were equipped and Performance-based selection was done to choose algorithms from a collection using the reference point, (i.e) accuracy percentage. Feature selection and Synthetic minority oversampling technique (SMOTE) were also incorporated alongside Machine Learning (ML) algorithms. The results of the model indicates that the proposed architecture can effectively detect botnet-based attacks and also can be extended with corresponding architectures for unfolding attacks.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition: Current State of Knowledge and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A fast-emerging topic, Sign Language Recognition(SLR) focuses on creating technologies that allow computers to interpret sign language. In order to bridge gaps in communication between the hearing and deaf populations and to improve accessibility for those who are deaf, sign language should be acknowledged. These systems can precisely recognise sign language by detecting and tracking hand gestures, face expressions, and body language. The goal of this paper is to provide researchers with a thorough understanding of current SLR technology. To ensure a thorough and accurate analysis, the evaluation includes a number of literature sources, which are academic journals, conferences, and proceedings. The analysis underlines the need for consistent evaluation methodologies and standards and also discusses the datasets and evaluation metrics that are currently available for sign language recognition. Lastly, the report concludes the existing limitations of SLR and offers a roadmap for future possibilities in SLR.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Based Approach For Spelling Error Detection In The Assamese Language
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s modern era of digital communication, it is vital to be able to communicate information effectively, and user-generated content has a significant impact on influencing the conversation that occurs online. Misspelled words are prevalent in such user-generated content, and they can have an impact on readability, dependability, and comprehension. Therefore, making corrections to spelling is a crucial stage in improving the quality of user-generated data. This paper describes the development of a model to detect misspelled Assamese words in such digital content. While determining a word’s spelling, the suggested model takes into account its context in the phrase. It emphasizes that some Assamese words have various meanings and might not be appropriate for a particular statement’s intended context even though they are spelled correctly according to the dictionary. The proposed approach employs the use of two types of machine learning techniques: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM). The results show that the proposed approach considerably enhances spelling error detection by outperforming previous research in Assamese language. The proposed approach obtained the best accuracy of 89.52% for the BiLSTM model.

articleTitle: Inference at the Edge for Complex Deep Learning Applications with Multiple Models and Accelerators
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate the performance benefits of offloading deep learning workloads to specialized hardware accelerators using an experimental setup consisting of a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B board and two Intel Movidius Neural Compute Sticks. Our study shows that the performance of complex deep learning applications, which require a cluster of models to achieve their goals, can be improved by assigning suitable models to accelerators based on their computational requirements. We propose a two-step algorithm that analyzes the computational requirements of each model by taking their .xml and .bin files as input along with the number of accelerators interfaced with the edge device. In the first step, the algorithm calculates the computational complexity score of each model based on its number of tags and edge tags. In the second step, the algorithm allocates the models to the available accelerators based on their current load and computational complexity score. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of Intel Movidius Neural Compute Sticks in increasing frames per second while reducing latency for deep learning functions implemented on peripheral devices like the Raspberry Pi.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Elliptic Curve Point Multiplication for a 256-bit Processor on NIST Prime Field
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) has long been a prevailing technique among security researchers for developing security architectures of digital devices to their hardware levels. With the proliferation of advanced technological ecosystems, the necessity for secured information transfer has become even more pronounced. Elliptical Curve Cryptography can substantially outperform other cryptographic schemes in addressing the security concerns of such intricate digital hardware environments. An influential and inalienable part of the ECC architecture is the Group Operation part. In this work, an area & time-efficient Point Doubling and Point Addition architectures have been implemented by combining modular arithmetic units for Elliptic Curve Group Operation. Koblitz curve in Jacobian coordinates have been used to reduce the cost of group operation. Two architectures have also been proposed to compute point doubling & point addition using equations for the Koblitz Curve for 256-bits. For minimizing area and reducing time spent for computing, we have used an interleaved modular multiplier in this work. An area & time-efficient Elliptic Curve Point Multiplication (ECPM) module have been designed. The designed ECPM module for 256 bits has been observed to require 0.53 ms for execution, which is a significant improvement compared to other contemporary studies.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Machine Learning and Neural Network Algorithms for Wine Quality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The assessment of wine quality is of paramount importance to both consumers and the wine industry. Recognizing its impact on customer satisfaction and business success, companies are increasingly turning to product quality certification to enhance sales in the global beverage market. Traditionally, quality testing was conducted towards the end of the manufacturing process, resulting in time-consuming and resource-intensive procedures. This approach involved the engagement of multiple human experts to evaluate wine quality, leading to high costs. Moreover, since taste perception is subjective and varies among individuals, relying solely on human specialists for assessing wine quality presents significant challenges. Our research focuses on advancing the quality of wine prediction by leveraging diverse characteristics of wine. We applied various feature selection techniques and explored machine learning algorithms to identify the optimal combination of parameters for accurate wine quality prediction. This approach reduces the time and costs associated with traditional quality assessment methods and provides a more standardized and consistent evaluation process. Our findings contribute to the advancement of wine industry practices, enabling businesses to make informed decisions and deliver high-quality products that meet consumer expectations.

articleTitle: Fast Anomaly Detection For Multivariate Industrial Time Series Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Anomaly detection is used to identify/predict atypical patterns or outliers within datasets. It proves highly beneficial in numerous applications like industrial monitoring, healthcare and cybersecurity etc. With the advent of Industry 4.0, system automation is rapidly increasing, resulting in an exponential surge in data generation.
