In a factory setting, a sudden deviation in signal values can result in significant losses. Having a robust anomaly detection system in place becomes crucial to promptly identify and flag anomalies, thereby minimizing potential losses. In this paper, the proposal entails a down-sampling technique that offers advantages in terms of mitigating noise, reducing storage requirements, and diminishing computational demands by 88% for a representative dataset. Additionally, an anomaly interval detection algorithm designed to label data is introduced by us, thereby facilitating its application in supervised anomaly detection methods and predictive anomaly detection.

articleTitle: Image encryption using One Dimensional Chaotic Map and transmission Through OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: It is important to prevent unauthorized access to data whether it is being transferred over a wireless network or stored on a personal computer. The incorporation of secure and highly dependable digital data, required to transmit from source to destination over a communication channel, is becoming more and more important for modern wireless communications. Confidentiality is achieved in two levels, the first occurs at the data level, while the second occurs at the network level. Data-level security employs cryptographic techniques. This paper proposed a simple algorithm and 1D chaotic map have been cascaded to get a high efficiency as complex algorithms or multi-dimensional chaotic maps. n this study, a variety of encryption techniques, including a cipher and permutation algorithms, are combined with the OFDM system to establish a secure image transmission over an AWGN channel. Security analysis is performed to evaluate the quality and security of the encryption process. For image transmission evaluation, the PSNR and BER are utilized. According to the statistical results, the proposed image encryption scheme is secure and efficient. Comparison with the previous studies is taking place, which shows this system is competitive with previous works.

articleTitle: Diabetics Mellitius Caused Vision Impairment Discernment Using ML
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy affects the eyes, potentially causing partial or total damage to the retina. High blood glucose levels harm the nerves carrying blood in retina, leading to microvascular end-organ damage that is associated with diabetes. Efficient implementation of preventive measures and minimizing potential harm heavily relies on early detection. Researchers have explored computational approaches to detect this disease. Cutting-edge studies employ image processing techniques and deep learning models to facilitate the timely identification of diabetic deposits, leading to decreased retinal damage. This article recommends using CNN (such as RESNET 50, VGG, and Xception) on fundus images to identify diabetic deposits in the dataset.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction using Hybrid Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper we have focused our attention to create a hybrid approach providing optimal results than other currently working models and approaches. Our approach had r2score of 0.97 also the error values like MAE and MSE were 0.018. It is a well-known fact that stock market is volatile and dynamic in nature being influenced by many factors which are uncountable. In this era of technological advancements many machine learning models working like human brain have been developed like Artificial neural network. Here we collected data from banks listed on National Stock Exchange(NSE) spanning more than 13 years. The proposed solution in this paper is a comprehensive approach as it contains pre-processing, making use of feature engineering methods, building a customized approach of artificial neural network and principal component analysis. Stock prices are heavily depended on numerous features, among them only few ere available in our collected dataset. We generated new real-life features i.e feature expansion creating a pool of features influencing stock prices. By using PCA on the newly formed data the features were reduced resulting into dimensionality reduction. Using PCA more correlated features affecting the stock prices are identified which would eliminate the features that does not influence stock price to certain extent. These newly formed reduced features acts as an input for the artificial neural network making the model faster and making use of all the necessary features. The results of our method is finding an optimal number of Principle components and the necessary layers of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) for better price prediction. In here we did a comprehensive analysis on most used machine learning models for stock price prediction based on the error rates and our proposed hybrid approach outperforms them due to comprehensive feature engineering.

articleTitle: Weighted Adaptive Spectrum Sensing for Cognitive Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Vehicular Network is an advanced application which enables smarter management of traffic and ensures safer, and more coordinated travel. The US Federal Communication Commission (FFC) has designated 75MHz of spectrum for vehicular communications (V2V and V2I). As the number of vehicles on the road increases, the spectrum available for vehicular networks becomes congested. Spectrum scarcity is a major problem in vehicular networks which needs to be addressed for improved performance. Cognitive Radio (CR) technology is a promising solution which is used to solve the scarcity of the spectrum through Dynamic Spectrum Access (DSA). CR technology integrated with Vehicular Networks (CVN) aids in the complete exploitation of underutilized licensed spectrum. Sensing the state of the channel is a fundamental step in CR networks which is carried out by the CR/Vehicular Users (VUs). However, sensing of spectrum is a challenging issue due to the continuous movement of vehicle (mobility), which results in a dynamic network topology. These challenges make the decision made by an individual VU uncertain. In the proposed work, we introduced a weight based adaptive cooperative sensing approach to enhance channel detection probability in Cognitive Vehicular Networks. The weights are calculated by considering certain parameters which includes probability of VU being outside the protection range of the PU, probability of PU being within the sensing range of the VU, Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR), velocity of the VUs, distance between VU and PU and the time of sensing. The calculated weight for the decision made by VU indicates the reliability of the signal received. A global decision is made by combining the weighted individual decisions received from VUs by applying the majority fusion rule. In addition to this, a reward-based channel recommendation for sensing is done to make the system more viable for wideband sensing. The rewards to the channels are given based on the previous states of the channels. The computational results suggest that the proposed technique outperforms conventional spectrum sensing approaches.

articleTitle: Image Inpainting of Synthetic Images Generated from Textual Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automatic synthesis of realistic images is complex; even cutting-edge AI and machine learning systems sometimes suffer from not fulfilling this expectation. However, the development of image processing has made it possible to perform operations on an image to improve or extract information from it and synthesize images from textual descriptions, making this a prominent area of study. Based on the idea of text-guided image production, the image inpainting task is replacing the damaged parts of an image with new, appropriate features that make sense in the given context. Researchers in this area have made some encouraging advances using neural image inpainting techniques. In contrast to previously developed text-guided image production methods, inpainting models must first compare the semantic content of the provided text to the remaining portion of the image to determine the semantic information for the missing section. Providing a mask and a text prompt with the information you need to make the desired changes can alter certain parts of an image. To boost the semantic similarity between the produced image and the text, an image-text matching loss is utilised. Further research is needed to resolve the challenge of guessing the missed content with only the context pixels. We propose a computationally efficient system to perform image inpainting on synthetic images that have been generated from textual data while ensuring visual coherence and accuracy.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Content of AI-Recommended YouTube Webisodes: A Focus on Sex Education in India
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sex Education, which is seen as a taboo subject in everyday Indian culture and suffers a strong pushback for sexual and reproductive health-related education, is one of the country's biggest societal challenges. The primary reason may be the banning of the topics from curriculum by various state governments along with the loophole in policymaking. Modern Sex Education is way beyond the dissemination of hygienic menstrual practices or contraceptive methods. It is learning about their own bodies, consent, creating spaces for oppressed gender and much more. In the digital age, teenagers are compelled to explore the untold information on internet which may lead to either misinformation of partial information which is way more dangerous. Social Media plays a crucial role in terms of engagement and content consumption across all age groups. YouTube is one of the prominent platforms which heavily relies on Artificial Intelligence and recommends the content based on the user’s behavior. With the help of the study, it aims to understand and analyze the content uploaded by Indian Content Creators on YouTube which is conceptualizing Sex Education. The 30 videos are closely examined thematically and semiotically with the help of the transcripts generated from the videos with the help of NVivo 12. The study simplifies the idea of stigma associated with Sex Education and the misconceptions around the same.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fertilizer Recommendations to Improve Crop Yield Using Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: For the expanding populace, farming is crucial in supplying food and other resources. However, the pressure on farmers to maximize crop yields is rising along with the demand for food production. Giving the crops the appropriate amount of nutrients at the appropriate time can help to achieve the goal. Artificial intelligence (AI) and wireless sensor networks (WSN) are two powerful technologies which can help farmers to achieve this goal to increase crop yield. In this article, a stacking method utilizing machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) is suggested to create fertilizer recommendations for agricultural operations. The aim of this study is to develop an intelligent system that utilizes data from senso and algorithms based on machine learning to optimize fertilizer application and boost crop yields. The study includes the use of the Ensemble learning technique to develop a fertilizer recommendation. It takes the prediction of base models SVM, Decision tree, and KNN as new features, then train the meta-model which is Random Forest classifier and makes predictions using the train meta-model with optimal performance.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of Data Extraction for Qualcomm based android devices
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study focuses on the analysis of data extraction tools for Android devices using Qualcomm processors, with a specific emphasis on UFED Physical Analyzer. The study compares and evaluates the effectiveness of UFED Physical Analyzer alongside other data extraction tools, such as Oxygen FD, XRY, and Cellebrite PA. The assessment includes the speed, ease of use, accuracy, and completeness of the extracted data. The study emphasizes the importance of continuous analysis and improvement of data extraction techniques for Android devices, considering the constantly evolving mobile technology landscape. Moreover, the study also covers physical and logical extractions. By assessing the effectiveness of UFED Physical Analyzer and other tools in both physical and logical extractions, the study provides insights into the advantages and limitations of each technique, facilitating digital forensic investigators and law enforcement agencies in choosing the most appropriate extraction method for their investigations.

articleTitle: Implementation of AWS Cloud Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Using the internet, many users can access different resources as needed through the cloud computing paradigm. In a dynamic environment, these resources and the uses of heterogeneous systems are rapidly changing. But there are some scientific challenges that cloud computing must overcome. Highly scalable and accessible web hosting may be a challenging and expensiv. Traditional scalable web designs needed precise traffic forecasts in addition to complicated solutions to achieve high levels of dependability and customer service. During peak hours, there is a high volume of traffic, and there are large fluctuations in traffic patterns, which leads to low hardware utilization rates. As a consequence, keeping idle gear in operation results in high running expenses. The most demanding online applications may access a trustworthy, scalable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure with Amazon online Services (AWS). This infrastructure instantly correlates IT spending with customer traffic patterns. The cloud infrastructure architecture that we will use to deliver the web application has to be designed. Small companies may benefit from using AWS on their websites since it gives them access to a cloud where they can store their data and save time and money. The finest aspect about AWS is the free tier. Customers may get a free tier of AWS services from Amazon in order to use the platform.

articleTitle: Improving the Performance of Epileptic Seizure Prediction using Supervised Clustering of Deep Features
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Epileptic seizures impact over 65 million people worldwide. Predicting epilepsy will greatly improve patient confidence and overall quality of life by enabling timely intervention and reducing the risk of fatal injuries. While current state-of-the-art systems use electroencephalography (EEG) as their primary input, EEG is susceptible to artefacts and may not be suitable for ambulatory home care devices. In this paper, we explore the development of a seizure prediction system that utilizes electrocardiography (ECG) as its input, offering the potential for integration into ambulatory devices. In situations where a seizure cannot be avoided, having a family member or friend record a video during the seizure can provide valuable insights for refining the treatment plan. This is very important from a neurologist’s perspective to characterise the seizure.In this paper, we develop a convolutional neural network-based seizure detection system, and subsequently, we extend it for seizure prediction. The baseline detection system gave an area under the receiver operating characteristics curve (AUROC) score of 0.63 and an area under the detection error trade-off curve (AUDET) score of 0.3220. We used supervised clustering of the deep features to enhance the performance of the systems. We obtained an AUROC score of 0.7238 and an AUDET score of 0.2648 in the frequency domain based-detection system. Subsequently, we developed a baseline system for epilepsy prediction in the time domain, which showed a performance of 0.7469 in AUROC and 0.2461 in AUDET. The final frequency domain-based prediction system yielded a performance of 0.8327 in AUROC and 0.1500 in AUDET, which is an improvement of 0.0858 in AUROC and a 0.0961 reduction in AUDET.

articleTitle: A Conditional Generative Adversarial Network Model for Sketch-to-Image Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The sketch-to-image translation is a challenging task that involves generating realistic photographs from hand-drawn sketches. While Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have achieved remarkable success in generating real images, sketch-to-image translation remains difficult due to the limited information in the input sketches. Generative modeling problems can be addressed using GANs, which are a category of artificial intelligence algorithms. The objective of a generative model is to discover the probability distribution by analyzing training samples. This estimated probability distribution is then utilized by GANs to produce additional instances. In this paper, we propose a conditional GAN-based model for sketch-to-image translation tasks. By incorporating a loss function in the training process and learning mappings from input sketches to output images, these networks can handle various problems that previously required separate loss formulations. This approach allows for a versatile problem-solving technique using the same fundamental principles. Our suggested approach involves adversarial training of a generator and a discriminator, both of which are integrated into our model. The generator network takes the sketch and a textual description as input and generates a corresponding image. The discriminator network within our model is trained to distinguish between generated and authentic images. Consequently, the generator network is trained to produce images that can deceive the discriminator network into perceiving them as genuine.

articleTitle: An Indian Legal Perspective on the Use of AI in Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in robots has the potential to transform the way the various industries operate and function. Though the use of AI in robotics has its own benefits in terms of accuracy and efficiency, it raises several legal, social, and ethical concerns which need to be addressed. The primary aim of this paper was to study the legal issues in the usage of AI applications in robotics in India. It also makes a review of the relevant provisions in the existing Indian regulations. It was found that there will be several legal issues related to civil liability, accidents, human safety, product liability, cyber security and contractual relationships. To enable the adoption of AI applications in various domains, a review of existing laws must be conducted to ascertain the necessity of any modifications.

articleTitle: Tree Disease Detection Using Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Trees and plants play a significant role in maintaining the balance of ecosystem. They are crucial for the survival of all living organisms on the planet. The intention of this project is to develop an effective machine model that figures out the actual disease and most importantly to proffer a preliminary test for farmers before preforming in laboratory. This is a set out to oblige the computerized results and manually tested results look similar. This method of computerized automation works quickly and we discern that this work motivates to develop such more efficient models. Computer vision techniques and models were implemented to this problem to generate an optimal solution. Certain steps were performed in stages in this project such as Pre-processing, Data Filtering, Data Augmentation, Algorithm implementation. Methodologies such as VGG-19, Inception-v3, Mobile Net v2, LSTM Architecture, YOLOv7… were used and all the algorithms gave finer results as used with selected optimizers. A photo of leaf is given and is should be distinguished if it healthy or Bacterial leaf blight, Brown spot, or Leaf smut and with more than one disease.

articleTitle: Detection of Cyber Attacks in Smart Grid Using Optimization and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Smart Grids are complex and interconnected systems that are vulnerable to cyber-attacks, which can result in severe consequences such as equipment damage, data theft, and power outages. Therefore, developing effective cyber-attack detection techniques for smart grids is crucial to ensure their security and reliability. This research propose a novelty for cyber-attack identification in smart grids using genetic optimization algorithm and deep feed forward neural network techniques. The proposed approach consists of three main components, data preprocessing, genetic optimization, and deep feed forward neural networks technique. The data preprocessing implicates cleansing the raw input data, removing noise, and extracting relevant features from the input data obtained from various sources in smart grids. The genetic algorithm is habituated to enhance the weight function and bias signals of the deep feedforward neural network to reduce the fault rate between the estimated output and the actual output. The deep feedforward neural network is responsible for detecting cyber-attacks based on preprocessed input data. To scrutinize the effectiveness of the proposed technique, conduct experiments on a publicly available dataset of smart grids. The observational outcome exhibits that the proposed model compares the existing techniques, obtaining a higher discovery depreciate and lower false alarm depreciate.

articleTitle: Neural Network-Based Model for Osteoporosis Prediction: A Novel Approach for Enhanced Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Osteoporosis is a degenerative bone disease that has major health consequences worldwide due to decreased bone density and increased fracture risk. Diagnostic procedures such as bone mineral density (BMD) measures employing techniques such as DXA scans, QUS, or pQCT are used to detect osteoporosis. However, the cost of these testing is prohibitively expensive. While the cost of osteoporosis detection is an issue, early detection is critical for preventing fractures and lowering long-term healthcare costs connected with the illness. To address the aforementioned difficulty, we offer an osteoporosis prediction model that employs a neural network with L2 regularisation to improve prediction accuracy. This model's performance is compared to that of various major machine learning methods, such as KNN, SVM, Logistic Regression, XGBoost, and Random Forest. The NHANES dataset is used in the analysis, which takes into account demographics and living conditions. Our suggested model has an accuracy of 87.2%, proving its efficiency in the prediction of osteoporosis. These findings emphasise the ANN model's potential as a useful tool for identifying people at high risk of osteoporosis and guiding preventative efforts. By correctly identifying at-risk patients, appropriate treatments can be implemented, thereby minimising the need for costly surgeries and hospitalisations associated with fractures and sequelae.

articleTitle: An Improved Prediction of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome Using SMOTE-based Oversampling and Stacking Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: PCOS is an endocrine disorder that affects female fertility in women who are of reproductive age or who have gradually passed it. This medical condition increases the risk of complex long-term issues. Missed periods, Irregular periods, or high light periods are some of the most typical signs of this condition. It can cause infertility, cardiovascular disease, type-2 diabetes, and ovulation failure. Early detection and therapy are known to lower the threat of developing PCOS. Our objective is to identify which classification model is best in the prediction of disease. We use fourteen machine learning algorithms to compare and get the best model. To eliminate class imbalance and improve classification performance, data were re-sampled using Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Technique (SMOTE). We examined several model assumptions using assessment metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and AUC score. To compare the outcomes, classifiers include Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, K-nearest Neighbor, Support Vector Machine, Multi-layer Perceptron, Decision Tree, Gradient Boosting, AdaBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Voting and Stacking using GridSearchCV technique has been used. The stacking classifiers achieved the highest 98% of accuracy in determining PCOS from clinical data of women patients and outperformed the previous works. Our research will aid the medical community in decreasing the miscarriage rate.

articleTitle: Emerging Trends in Chatbot Development : A Recent Survey of Design, Development and Deployment
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recent years have seen a considerable breakthrough in chatbot systems, revolutionising human-machine interactions and enabling seamless communication across multiple areas. They have developed into potent conversational agents that are altering how people engage with technology. As the field of chatbot research continues to evolve rapidly, this paper presents a comprehensive review of recent research papers, aiming to identify and analyze the latest trends, innovations, and proposals in the development and deployment of chatbot systems.

articleTitle: Exploring Data Distributions using Box and Whisker Plot Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Data analysis plays a crucial role in decision-making processes in various industries. One common approach to analyzing data distributions is through the use of box and whisker plots. In this paper, we explore the use of box and whisker plot analysis as a tool for exploring data distributions. We discuss how this analysis can be used to compare and draw crucial information, determine the spread of data, and visualize the shape of the data distribution. Additionally, we describe a Windows application tool developed in VB.NET. that allows users to explore the data distributions using box and whisker plot. The application includes features such as the ability to import a CSV file, display its contents, select specific columns for analysis, scale down data values, generate box and whisker plots and draw important conclusions. We have applied the application tool in three varied datasets - salary, marks and movies and were able to draw some meaningful conclusions from the data distributions in the datasets.

articleTitle: Evaluating Multi-Core Performance of Machine Learning Models Across Different Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Machine learning algorithms are becoming more sophisticated with time, their computational capabilities and resource consumption are also increasing. And with its escalating potential, machine learning enthusiasts constantly look for better and easier ways to run complex algorithms. Often, laptops and CPUs available for personal use have memory ranging from 4/8/12 GB and have comparatively lower computation capability. In such restricted environments, there is a trade-off between the accuracy of machine learning models and resource consumption. This barrier can be overcome by using cloud CPUs offered popularly by Google Colab and Kaggle. These popular platforms provide CPUs capable of training and evaluating machine learning algorithms. In this paper, we illustrate the performance of the CPUs offered by Google Colab and Kaggle and compare it with a local device (ASUS FX505GE) using KNN, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest algorithm. We could find that multithreading provides better performance in the case of machine learning algorithms. Random Forest takes comparatively longer for evaluation and training purposes because of the numerous calculations involved in its different phases. Even though KNN has no training phase, the impact of multi-processing cores is noticeable both in training and evaluation. However, Logistic Regression has the best performance with only a single core both in the training and evaluation period because of the simplicity of the model structure and requires fewer computational resources.

articleTitle: Face Recognition From Video Using Enhanced Social Collie Optimization-based Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The face recognition system is a process which is part of computer vision as a key feature of video surveillance systems. In a face recognition system stands on two main pillar which are object recognition and authentication of object or person who present in a frame with the help of distinctive picture generation like i.e. Cameras. In this field of Computer Vision many researchers work on detection and verification of faces from frames in the subsequent part of video. It is a complex and complicated process to recognize accurate faces by the use of artificial vision algorithms. In machine learning main important concept is Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in real time system which has video process input for face recognition systems. For such complex problem effective approaches to work on by solution as CNNs have excelled capability to handle, with significant results. Which also including process based voice recognition, face localization, face recognition and picture frame selection and categorization. Recently all the top performing techniques which work on the preprocessed Labelled Face dataset for the Real Time system for convolutional neural networks (CNNs).So here in this research use of deep convolutional neural network (optimized Deep CNN) to getting generated precise outcome of face images from the input video by the Hybrid weighted texture pattern descriptor (HWTP). The help of deep CNN techniques with improved tuned featured extraction and introduce novel ideas about enhanced social collie optimization (ESCO), which result in better solutions with different combinations of strategies. The finest parameters are used to recognise the face of an individual is determined. The proposed model by deep convolutional neural network achieves 91.30% accuracy, 95.07% precision, 95.078% recall and 95.078% f-measures.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Prediction of Postoperative Survival in Lung Cancer Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The primary focus of this work is the utilization of machine learning classifiers to forecast the likelihood of survival in individuals with lung cancer who have undergone significant lung resections via thoracic surgery. Since the data is highly imbalanced, the variations in the synthetic minority oversampling technique (SMOTE), Random Oversampling, and near-miss under-sampling were used to prevent biased decisions in favor of the majority class by the machine learning classifier. Five-Fold Cross-validation is performed before and after balancing data for all the classifiers. The Random Oversampling method outperforms the majority of machine learning classifiers. Support Vector Classifier provides the highest evaluation metrics for the following data, with an accuracy of 85% for both imbalanced and balanced (B-SMOTE-SVM) data. Since the data is imbalanced, we considered the F1 score as a measure for evaluating all the classifiers while applying various data balance techniques, with the lowest score being zero and the highest being 0.34. By combining the benefits of classifiers along with Over sampling and Under-sampling and the identification and interpretation of risk factors, this proposed solution can assist medical practitioners in their diagnosis of the survival status of lung cancer patients.

articleTitle: Resource Optimization based Virtual Machine Allocation Technique in Cloud Computing Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud computing allows the clients to add or delete the dynamic resource pooling of massive capacity without adding the extra infrastructure to the client site. One of the vital challenges to delivering this feature required an efficient virtual machine allocation policy. The virtual machine allocation involves a large number of variables, and rapidly increasing the demand for resources makes it an NP-complete problem. Many heuristics and meta-heuristic-based dynamic resource allocation mechanisms are designed to generate the optimal VM allocation sequence considering the multifariousness Quality-of-Services (QoS) requirements in the cloud environment. However, most existing VM allocation policies failed to balance various Quality of Service (QoS) parameters. This work elaborated on the VM allocation problem and proposed an enhanced Genetic Algorithm (GA) to solve the optimal resource schedule to allocate requested tasks on a given number of virtual machines efficiently in cloud computing while considering various QoS parameters. By achieving the balance between the performance parameters, our developed algorithm makes ensures that the resource utilization reaches the maximum limit. Our extensive simulation experiment on the proposed algorithm is performed using the CloudSim simulation toolkit, and the comparison results prove the effectiveness against the energy and makespan parameters.

articleTitle: Stability-Boundary-Locus Based Controller Design for Zeta Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: DC-DC conversion is crucial to many power electronics applications and frequently used in power circuits. A fourth-order zeta-converter DC-DC converter has the ability to step up and step down the output voltage based on the input voltage and required output voltage. This study’s main objective is to create a stability boundary locus-based PI controller for a zeta-converter with the lowest error utilizing a model-order method. Since the zeta-converter has a fourth-order system, designing a PI controller for higher order can be fairly challenging. The higher-order system is reduced to second-order utilizing two distinct reduction methods. Then a Zeta-converter is paired with a stability boundary locus-based PI controller, which is made for reduced-order systems.

articleTitle: Optimization Techniques on Heart Failure Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this article, we want to draw attention to some of the challenges that come with using conventional optimization strategies, such as the approach that starts with the initial solution and converges to the best one after each iteration. The initial approximation used will determine the convergence. These techniques are inappropriate for objective functions with discontinuities. So, a non-traditional approach was judged to be necessary. And later we will highlight various non-traditional methods, these methods include Genetic algorithms (GA), Cuckoo search algorithm, Ant colony optimization (ACO), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Whale Algorithm, Firefly algorithm, and SA. The later section will explain each of them in great depth and implement all the above algorithms to a suitable data set and measure the factors like Precision, Recall, True Positive Rate, False Positive Rate, and Error Rate into evaluation metrics to conclude our research objective.

articleTitle: A Survey on Intrusion Detection System Based on Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The intrusion detection system (IDS) is one of the most important security solutions for a variety of security issues that are common on the internet today. Two of an intrusion detection system's primary responsibilities are to check networking data and system programmes for any strange behaviour and notify users if it is discovered. There are numerous ways to find intrusions using machine learning. The goal of this review of the literature is to find and examine emerging ML research trends, threat types, and intrusion detection techniques. This article discusses the use of machine learning techniques in intrusion detection systems as well as the advantages and disadvantages of the various approaches to attacker recognition. establishing a conceptual framework for future machine learning research.

articleTitle: Multi-Task Improve Domain Generalization in EEG-based Emotion Classification using Feature Fusion Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The use of Electroencephalography (EEG) signals for emotion identification tasks is common. However, the domain shift issue may cause EEG-based emotion detection models' performance to decline when used in new domains. In this article, we present a feature fusion learning model-based multi-task learning strategy to enhance domain generalization in EEG-based emotion classification. By simultaneously learning a shared feature extractor and numerous domain-specific classifiers, we train a single model to categorize emotions across various domains. Additionally, we present a feature fusion module that combines time-domain, frequency-domain, and wavelet-domain EEG characteristics. We run trials on the DEAP and SEED EEG emotion recognition datasets to assess our suggested methodology. The experimental findings show that our suggested strategy outperforms a number of cutting-edge techniques in terms of classification accuracy, both within- and across-domains.

articleTitle: A Study on Heuristic and Non-Heuristic Clustering Techniques for Customer Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Customer segmentation is an important part of the market activity design. It is a challenging task for decision-makers to comprehend the needs of customers in a market and strategize activities accordingly. This paper examines two broad categories of clustering techniques for customer segmentation: heuristic-based clustering and non-heuristic clustering. The research findings reveal that integrating a genetic algorithm with other clustering techniques enhances accuracy compared to traditional non-heuristic methods. To achieve accurate segmentation results, the paper proposes the utilization of a genetic algorithm to identify optimal cluster centers and extract heuristic information from customer preference patterns. However, genetic algorithms are susceptible to being trapped in local optima. To address this challenge, the approach of increasing exploration through population size and introducing mutation and crossover for diversity is advocated. Therefore, this research introduces a methodology based on the benefits of using genetic algorithm to identify optimal cluster centers for customer segmentation. By extracting heuristic information from customer preferences, it aims to achieve accurate results in dividing customers into distinct segments based on their unique characteristics. Finally, the examination of customer segments will provide valuable insights into their behavior and preferences.

articleTitle: RISET: Secure Eye-Tracking Password Authentication with Random Image Sequence
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The development of authentication systems plays a crucial role in ensuring security and user privacy across various domains. One such authentication mechanism is Transparent Image Moving (TIM), which enables users to position their password image correctly on a grid. However, TIM fails to mitigate shoulder surfing attacks, where attackers record or capture passwords for comparison. To address this issue, we propose Random Image Sequence Eye Tracking (RISET), a solution that conceals both the image's initial position and its final location by leveraging on-screen eye tracking. This approach necessitates user calibration to enable eye detection on the grid. Through trials, we demonstrate that the RISET scheme presents significant challenges for attackers. In adequate video conditions, attackers only achieve an average effectiveness of 7.01% without successfully obtaining the complete password. Experimental participants also reported a strong sense of security when employing this scheme, with a satisfaction rate of 93.75%. Overall, RISET provides users with a highly secure environment and makes it challenging to guess passwords without high-quality eye and screen videos.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis and Design Criteria of MAC, SMAC, and TMAC Protocols in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper offers an overview of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) and how they might be used in surveillance systems. With the help of WSNs, sensors may connect to one another and establish networks, enabling intelligent interactions with the physical world. In particular, the article addresses the need to solve energy efficiency issues while taking quality of service (QoS) and latency requirements into consideration. The research also emphasizes the need of energy-aware protocols in WSNs, especially for surveillance applications. The authors provide an overview of MAC protocols used in surveillance applications, looking at their presumptions, energy waste factors, and various protocols' efficacy. They go over many forms of communication, such as broadcast, converging cast, local gossip, and multicast, and they evaluate the benefits and drawbacks of MAC protocols, such as S-MAC, T-MAC, TRAMA, SIFT, and DSMAC. Collision avoidance, fair channel access, energy efficiency, support for quality of service, scalability, and adaptation to network dynamics are just a few of the characteristics of a well-defined MAC protocol that are covered. The paper also examines the uses of MAC protocols in WSNs, including asset tracking, home automation, environmental sensing, smart cities, precision agriculture, traffic monitoring, healthcare monitoring, intrusion detection systems, and environmental monitoring. An overview of the benefits and drawbacks of MAC protocols is presented in a comparison table at the end. According to the paper’s conclusion, there is no standardized MAC protocol for sensor networks because the option depends on the particular application and its specifications. Researchers working on energy-aware procedures in WSNs, particularly in surveillance, are intended to benefit from the findings of this paper.

Author Keywords: Energy-saving measures for the MAC layer

articleTitle: Movie Recommendation Chatbot Using Cosine Similarity and NLP tools
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Movie Recommendation Systems have been present since the inception of movie streaming platforms. These systems take the advantage of user’s data like watched movies, liked movies, location etc., to recommend similar movies using various algorithms. Recommendation Systems can be broadly classified into Content Based, Collaborative Filtering and Hybrid. All of these face the limitation of diversity, because of the similar data available user tends to fall in the loop of consuming similar type of content again and again. These systems do not take into account the current mood of the user, neither do they cater to multiple users using a single account. All of these limitations make the user experience dull. Our aim is to make a scalable chatbot that can cater to different needs of users without the drawback of previous data collected. Chatbot can directly recommend a diversified collection of movies by asking a few questions from users like their preferred genre, actors, directors and a few keywords. This helps with the diversity of recommendations with a ne w and interactive interface

articleTitle: Efficient Lung Cancer Classification on Multi level Convolution Neural Network using Histopathological Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Lung cancer can be detected by lung nodules, which are a key sign. An early diagnosis enhances the likelihood that the patient will survive by enabling the appropriate therapy to start. To reduce the responsibility of radiologists' difficult and time-consuming labour of finding and categorising malignancy in Computed Tomography (CT) images, researchers have created CAD (computer-assisted diagnosis) systems. The likelihood and kind of malignancy are commonly determined by pathologists using histopathological images of biopsy specimens taken from potentially sick areas of the lungs. To categorise lung nodule malignancy, we recommend employing a four-level convolutional neural network (ML-CNN). From lung nodule CT scan images, multiple scales are extracted. ML-CNN’s employs four CNNs network model structure. After the result of the last pooling layer has been flattened to a vector with a single dimension for each level, the vectors are concatenated. These four ML-CNNs will help our model perform better. The ML-CNN model can recognise and classify different forms of lung cancer with reasonable accuracy. The 25000 images employed in the ML-CNN model have been separated into three categories: training, validation, and testing. Three distinct tissue types were assessed and training and validation took up within 80% and 15% of the total time and 5% for testing, respectively. The histopathological images included the following tissue type’s 1.Benign tissue 2. Large cell carcinoma 3.squamous cell carcinoma. The proposed model demonstrated superior performance on both the training set, achieving an accuracy of 78%, and the validation set, achieving an accuracy of 89.6% by the end of the evaluation

articleTitle: Forecasting Tea Production in the Context of Bangladesh Utilizing Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the most popular drinks, second only to water, is tea. Bangladesh ranks as the world’s 10th-largest manufacturer of tea. Tea has a big impact on poverty reduction, rural development, and nutrition security. Over the past ten years, Bangladesh has increased its tea supply. According to the BTB figures, over 96.51 million kg were produced in 2021, an increase of almost 54% from that of 2012. As tea is a profitable crop from Bangladesh’s perspective, tea yield prediction can play a significant role in increasing the production of tea. In this paper, tea yield has been forecast using various machine learning algorithms based on area-based tea production and their weather data from 1968 to 2021. Necessary data has been collected from BBS, BARC, and BMD government organizations. Eight climate factors have been used for the research. The data model has been evaluated by using eight classification and regression algorithms, with the Random Forest classifier showing the best accuracy of 97%. With this approach, tea production can be increased while reducing food threats and managing it for other nations.

articleTitle: Building detection in aerial images using fusion of U-Net and ResNet architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Semantic segmentation describes the procedure of giving each pixel in an image a unique class name. With the increased accessibility of high-resolution remote sensing data, there has been a tremendous increase in interest of urban feature segmentation such as buildings, roads, bridges and railways. Detection of buildings is of great interest in the field of urban planning, disaster management and 3D modelling. Deep learning algorithms are showing positive results such as greater accuracy and are effective in building detection purpose even in challenging conditions. In this study, we have implemented building detection using a deep learning CNN architecture named as Residual Network (ResNet) as a backbone model. U-Net model has been used as base model for building detection purpose for Massachusetts Buildings Dataset. In this paper, initially the aerial image dataset has been trained on U-net model for 10 epochs having 12 batch size and binary cross-entropy-focal-dice loss as loss function. During the evaluation of the aerial image dataset, various ResNet architectures were used as backbone models. Mean Intersection over Union (MeanIoU), Intersection over Union (IoU) score, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score were the evaluation measures used. These metrics were assessed by utilizing the same loss functions across all the ResNet architectures. This finding indicates that, when compared to alternative ResNet architectures, the ResNet-101 model offers significantly better results. According to Resnet101, MeanIoU is 72.67%, and IoU score is 87.03%, while accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score is 93.06%, 86.61%, and 92.91% respectively.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Time Series Modelling for Glucose level prediction of Type-1 diabetes
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Type-1 Diabetes is a chronic autoimmune disorder where the body’s white blood cells attack the pancreatic betacells. Neither its cause nor the means to prevent it are known. Patients require external insulin to manage their blood glucose levels and prevent conditions such as Hyperglycemia and Hypoglycemia. This raises the necessity for the knowledge of real-time Glucose Reading. This study aims to predict blood glucose levels using deep learning algorithms such as Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) on the OhioT1DM dataset. The former model uses only historical blood glucose level data, while the latter includes additional information such as insulin shots and meal carbs. The prediction horizon is set to 60 minutes, and the models are evaluated using Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE). The obtained results demonstrate good accuracy for both models, with LSTM achieving RMSE = 4.208 ± 0.92 mg/dL and MAE = 3.22 ± 0.58 mg/dL, and CRNN achieving RMSE = 4.0846 ± 0.9 mg/dL and MAE = 3.0845 ± 0.52 mg/dL. These predictions could help optimize closed-loop insulin delivery systems for better management of Type-1 Diabetes.

articleTitle: Explainable Machine Learning for Crop Recommendation from Agriculture Sensor Data- a New Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The dwindling agricultural earnings and decrease in crop yield in recent years due to improper crop selection and fluctuation/ uncertainty in weather necessitate proper machine learning-based analysis. Machine learning methods can potentially alleviate the predicament caused by the lack of appropriate soil testing, consultation, and bias in manual suggestion. This work attempted to comprehend the agricultural sensor data and weather conditions and formulated the task in terms of supervised classification. The work obtained accurate suggestions in the presence of missing data, noise, etc. by using advanced machine learning methods. But recommendation alone is insufficient to convince farmers and other stakeholders to adopt this approach. Hence, this paper introduced explainable machine learning to completely comprehend the decision-making process. This work quantified the importance of features, explained individual prediction outcomes, and uncovered the rationale for decisions. The work employed state-of-the-art local interpretable model-agnostic, post-hoc explanation methods to provide in-depth insights. The insights obtained from the explanations can help the farmers develop a knowledge base and assist the farmers in choosing the appropriate sensors for the task. The human interpretable analysis enables the farmers to obtain satisfactory yields in these ever-changing and extreme weather conditions and environmental degradation.

articleTitle: Early Prediction of Sepsis using ML Algorithms on Clinical Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A poorly controlled host reaction to infection results in sepsis, a potentially fatal organ failure. If not treated early, it can cause multiple organ failure, septic shock and even death. Most of the time, it is a serious infection-related consequence, especially in low and middle-income countries where it is a significant contributor to maternal and newborn morbidity and mortality. We are building a model which will predict Sepsis well before time using only vital signs of the patients like Heart Rate, Age, BP, and o2stat level. We have proposed a system that will predict the occurrence of sepsis well before time to save a patient’s life. We will be using Physionet 2019 Challenge dataset for training our ML model to predict the desired output.

articleTitle: A Key-frame Extraction for Object Detection and Human Action Recognition in Soccer Game Videos
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In professional team games, sports analysts frequently analyze to learn tactical and strategic insights into the actions of players in these team games. The foundation of current analytic procedures is the examination of team footage. We provide a visual analytical framework that seamlessly combines abstract visualizations with team sports video recordings. It offers an exciting opportunity because several complicated, real-time occurrences are examined towards making strategic decisions. Visual object detection is a well-known and active research area. Any object, its speed, and its appearance have their level of detection difficulty in the face of numerous obstacles. Human Action Recognition (HAR) is required to carry out advanced operations in team games as there is an increase in demand for video analysis of sporting events. To strategically improve the team’s performance, the team coach may, for instance, use an automatic monitoring system to monitor the player’s movement and locations throughout a soccer match as well as the location of the football. This paper proposes a YOLOv7 model that uses the key-frame selection technique to analyze players’ actions during a soccer game. In addition to detecting the football, player, and referee, the deep learning model can recognize six of the human actions in the soccer game. The experimental results show that using the key-frame selection technique for human action recognition, the total execution time can be reduced by approximately 68% to 70%.

articleTitle: Decentralised Application for Health Insurance management using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Insurance fraud is a significant problem in the healthcare industry, with various types of fraudulent activities leading to significant financial losses for insurance providers and higher premiums for customers. Examples of insurance fraud in the healthcare industry include billing for services not rendered, falsifying medical records, and phantom billing. Centralized databases and weak security measures have made it challenging to detect and prevent fraudulent activities in the insurance industry. Blockchain technology offers a potential solution to these challenges by providing a secure and decentralized platform that can enhance transparency and reduce the risk of fraud. This research paper suggests employing blockchain technology for identifying and stopping healthcare insurance fraud. Our proposal involves a system built on blockchain that facilitates the secure exchange of patient information among healthcare and insurance providers. The objective is to enhance the protection and confidentiality of patient data while minimizing the potential for fraudulent practices.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Algorithms in Green Cloud Computing- A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Green cloud computing is becoming an increasingly popular approach for organizations aims- to decrease their environmental impact and energy costs. There are several challenges in achieving energy efficiency in green cloud and one of the important challenges are task-scheduling and resource-allocation approaches. In recent years, several energy-efficient task-scheduling and resource-allocation algorithms have been proposed to address these challenges. This work is to investigate strategies that enable energy-efficient in green cloud computing. A comprehensive study on energy efficient task-scheduling and resource-allocation algorithms is presented to identify the strengths and limitations of existing algorithms and highlight the areas for future research.

articleTitle: AssignExpert - Host and Grade Programming Assignments in Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: AssignExpert is created using Node.js and runs Docker under the hood to sandbox the execution of user-submitted programs. The platform allows faculties and students to sign up with their employee or student roll numbers. Faculties can create a class and give assignments with a deadline. Students can join a class and see the assignments. The assignment page is bundled with a code editor, using which the assignment can be submitted. Faculties have the option to reveal the points scored or defer this action to a later period of time. This paper further describes the theoretical and practical motivations for all the design and implementation decisions. The code for the platform is open-source and is available on GitHub.

articleTitle: Crime Detection System with Machine Learning using OpenCV, YOLO and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The number of crimes are rising daily in the current environment. The government has put CCTV cameras in several public locations to help identify suspects. It can be difficult to recognise offenders on the footage, though. This system has created a procedure to speed up this process and lower the rising crime rate. In comparison to conventional approaches, this technology provides superior solutions and automates the suspect detection procedure. With the aid of a distributed CCTV system, This system that records the faces, gestures, and emotions of the targeted people (criminals). Together with a time and location stamp, will keep a database containing this information. The generated database will be used to identify suspects using CCTV footage of crimes that was recorded by a number of systems situated along routes and close to the crime site. This study examines several techniques including face identification using the OpenFace algorithm, object detection using the YOLOv3 algorithm, and hand motion recognition using the CNN algorithm for locating suspects in CCTV footage and turning that data into information that may be utilised to analyse certain crime scenes in more detail. The findings of our investigation show how successful our method is at identifying suspects. For identifying the expressions of anger, happiness, and neutrality, the OpenFace algorithm obtains accuracy of 55%, 60%, and 80%, respectively. The YOLOv3 algorithm successfully and accurately identifies firearms. The CNN algorithm recognises hand movements precisely, making it possible to identify certain motions or indications. Our research shows that the distributed CCTV system that is presented, when combined with algorithms, offers greater options for suspect detection and identification. It improves the precision of suspect identification and lowers the incidence of false alarms by automating the process and using contextual information. Comprehensive analysis of CCTV video is made possible by the integration of facial recognition, object identification, and hand gesture recognition, enabling a more in-depth comprehension of crime scenes. The system sends a report to the police in the form of a database whenever a crime is discovered. The result is sent to the police through Email in this suggested approach. Simple Mail Transfer Protocol, the industry-standard protocol for internet communication and the transmission of electronic mail, is used to transmit mail. In conclusion, this study makes a significant addition to the fields of crime detection and surveillance technologies. Suspect identification is made more efficient and effective by using a distributed CCTV system using algorithms. This system provides law enforcement organisations a useful tool to fight crime and improve public safety by utilising computer vision. The ability to analyse and understand CCTV footage for criminal investigations might be revolutionised by further research and development in this field that results in ever more sophisticated systems.

articleTitle: Unmasking COVID-19 symptoms from Speech with Masked Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic, the need for swift, reliable, and scalable methods for COVID-19 like symptom detection has come into sharper focus. In response, we introduce Audio Masked Harmonic Autoencoder (AudioMHA), a novel self-supervised deep learning model designed to identify respiratory symptoms associated with COVID-19 and similar illnesses from audio signals, particularly cough sounds. Our model harnesses the strength of the transformer architecture, integrating an innovative Harmonic Attention-based decoder and a two-stage training procedure. Initially pre-trained on the rich and diverse AudioSet corpus, the model is then fine-tuned on the specific COUGHVID dataset, enabling the acquisition of robust, generalizable audio representations before honing in on detecting COVID-19-like cough signatures. Delivering an impressive F1 score of 86%, our model outperforms previous state-of-the-art baselines by a significant margin of 10% . This pioneering, non-invasive, and potentially scalable approach marks a significant stride towards enhancing preliminary symptom detection methods for respiratory illnesses. Our findings highlight the potential of sophisticated machine learning techniques in future healthcare applications, paving the way for prospective research in audio-based symptom detection.

articleTitle: Spam E-mail Classification using ML, Angular, and Flask
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Technical advancements are resulting in the development of tactics, that when used by the wrong people, can make a huge loss to society. Spammers nowadays use emails to trick common people, because of the increase in the use of emails to communicate important information. The Unwanted mail that spammers send for their benefit is termed spam mail. The increase in the cases of spam and the loss associated with it threatens people. To counter these attacks some filtering mechanism should be introduced so that the emails can be filtered into two parts that are normal mail and spam mail. This paper tries to solve this problem by using several Machine Learning algorithms, like Random Forest, AdaBoost, Baggage boosting XGBoosting, Decision Tree, Extra Tree Classification algorithm, and Support Vector Machine. The final result depends on the result of each algorithm, and hence greater accuracy to the solution of the problem, the concept of majority voting is used for evaluating the final result. The project deploys the ensembled model in the Flask server to provide the services through APIs to other developers. The user interface is created to provide the user with an interface where they can test their emails. This UI uses these APIs for spam prediction services.

articleTitle: Software Bug Count Prediction Model Based on Software Source Code
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Software bug prediction (SBP) model is a classification model that predicts buggy or non-buggy modules of software projects, while the Software bug count prediction (SBCP) model is a regression model that predicts the precise number of bugs in each module. So, SBCP model is a more useful model for a software tester to rank the software modules. Many SBP models are developed using object-oriented (OO) software metrics (PROMISE datasets) and simplified PROMISE source code (SPSC) datasets (DSs). But, no SBCP model was developed using SPSC dataset. To fill this gap, we created SPSC DSs using features extracted from the software source code’s Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs). Further, we developed SBCV models using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolution Neural Network (CNN) over 8 SPSC DSs. The experimental results are compared with the six standard machine learning (ML) algorithms and two deep learning (DL) models (LSTM and CNN) implemented over 8 PROMISE DSs. We have applied a non-parametric statistical test (Nemenyi test) to show the significance of the proposed SBCP model. The proposed improved CNN model produces a better mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.50 and a mean relative error (MRE) of 0.19 averaged over eight SPSC DSs.

articleTitle: Enhanced Lifetime with less energy consumption in WSN Using a Genetic Algorithm-based approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Enhanced lifetime means to increase or im- prove the value, quantity, desirability, or attractiveness. Energy efficiency simply refers to using less energy to complete the same task, thereby reducing energy waste. Energy efficiency protocols are used in wireless sensor networks to improve system energy conservation and lifespan. In a WSN, instead of using physical media for communication, transmission is accomplished through the deployment of nodes. The deployed nodes send data to the destination node or to the sink node. The process of gathering the nodes for improved communication is referred to as clustering. During clustering, neighboring nodes that are part of a compatible cluster send data to the cluster head, aggregating it and sending it to the sink. For the enhancement of WSN, many clustering algorithms have been created. In the case of the traditional approach, the node prefers a straight-line path hence it consumes more energy a reduction the lifetime. Hence, another genetic algorithm-based approach is VGDRA. Since the proposed method is dynamic rather than static, it has a higher energy efficiency than LEACH, because it takes the shortest path. Balanced load and optimization increase the likelihood of better results in lower loops, which other techniques cannot achieve. The proposed method's simulation results are generated using MATLAB R2022 b.

articleTitle: A Review of Inventory Management Research in Transport and Logistics
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The significant growth of the transportation and logistics industry in recent years has enhanced the importance of inventory management. The objective of this study is to review the body of knowledge on inventory management in logistics and transportation while highlighting the key developments and trends in the sector. This review is based on publications found in the Scopus database and covers the years 2010 through 2021. Inventory management is described in the paper's introduction along with its role in logistics and transportation. Following that, the major findings of the reviewed research are compiled, with a focus on supply chain management, inventory control, and inventory optimization. The paper is concluded with a discussion of the potential possibilities for future research in this area, including the need for a stronger focus on real-world applications and the development of fresh approaches to inventory management in logistics and transportation.

articleTitle: Cross-Lingual Sentiment Analysis in Deep Learning: A Comparative Study of Multilingual Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a rapidly growing field that aims to extract and analyze the opinions and emotions expressed in text. With the increasing popularity of social media and the availability of multilingual data, sentiment analysis on multilingual text has become an important research area. In this paper, we present a comprehensive review of recent advances in sentiment analysis on related languages like Hindi, English, Urdu, Punjabi text. We review the state-of-the-art research papers in this area. Our review includes a comprehensive analysis of the deep learning techniques used in these papers. Our analysis highlights the importance of considering linguistic and cultural differences when analyzing sentiment in multiple languages. Our review provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of research in sentiment analysis on multilingual text and can serve as a useful reference for researchers and practitioners in this field.

articleTitle: Low Cost Precision Farming and Remote Monitoring Using Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Precision agriculture is a rapidly growing field that has seen experienced substantial investment and adoption in recent years. The adoption of precision agriculture is driven by the need to produce more food to feed a growing global population, while minimizing the environmental impact of agriculture. Thefactors such as the increasing use of precision farming techniques, advancements in agricultural technologies, and the growing demand for food as drivers of this growth. Overall, precision farming is a promising approach it has the capacity to completely alter how we generate food. The application of IoT, artificial intelligence, and machine learning can definitely help farmers to optimize their crop yield while reducing the amount of human labour required.The implementation of using a NodeMCU, a DHT11 sensor, and a soil moisture sensor to create an unexpensive automatic watering system is a great starting point.

articleTitle: Analysis of demographic groups for different markets using machine learning techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The internet is the dominant technology of the day, and its effects have resulted in massive amounts of daily data production. It makes processing by a single individual almost impossible. The sales of stores and supermarkets should be regularly analyzed, as should customer desire in the sales demography. Market analysis serves as the sole foundation for all global output. Presently, the manufacturing of the goods is determined by the overall demand. The analysis of sales across various stores and goods reveals the profit and loss of the supply and demand chain. Moreover, consider the customer's buying power. This research paper aims to conduct a comparative sales analysis of different stores, customers, and demographics in order to determine the factors that affect sales. It will focus on identifying patterns and trends in sales performance and understanding the underlying factors that drive sales in different stores and customer segments. A machine learning model will be trained in this study and will provide the correct analysis of the data in detail. This paper will give readers the critical assurance they need to launch new businesses in their respective industries and project their future profitability.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Dockers and Virtual Machines for Hosting React.js Web Application
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Comparing the use of container technology to that of virtual machines, there has been a recent increase. This is mainly because container technology makes it possible to deploy applications more quickly and easily. However, a thorough and methodical study on the effectiveness of a Docker container over a virtual machine for the execution of ReactJS web applications is still lacking. This article compares virtual machines and Docker containers when running ReactJS web applications, taking both virtualization and containerization into account. The results suggest that using a Docker container as compared to a virtual machine is the better approach.

articleTitle: An Efficient FSR-based Approach for Self Notifying Chairs to Minimize Long Duration Sitting Postures
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The basic principle of a force sensing resistor is that the resistance decreases with increase in force. This property of the sensor can be used to find its application on many devices and circuits. In this research paper, a FSR is used to find whether a person is sitting on a chair without change in position for too long. The creation of a straightforward tool to track a user’s sitting time and issue a warning if it exceeds a predetermined time limit is described in this proposed work. To save the user the trouble of lugging it, the tool was installed on a chair. As experts say, every 20 minute a person should change his/her posture so as to maintain good health. A circuit is developed in order to acquire the change in signals from the FSR. In order to construct a user-friendly display, LabVIEW software was employed. It is anticipated that the user will be able to spend less time sitting down by using the tool.

articleTitle: An approach to finding the most suitable algorithm for noise reduction in a Neonatal cry signal
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper noise reduction in audio recording is a challenging work, especially when environment is having many other machineries. In this research hospital environment is a subject matter. The pre-processing of the cry signals with the background noise of Neonatal Intensive Care Units (NICUs) is challenging. These noises affect the accuracy of machine-learning techniques because cry recordings of healthy neonates are not from the same environment. This paper compares different techniques of noise reduction. The most inspiring techniques were Spectral subtraction and Spectral gating with Butterworth low pass filter. Experiments results show that the Spectral gating methods gives the highest SNR value of 41.19dB with Butterworth low pass filter.

articleTitle: SER analysis of the single relay cooperative model over double α - µ fading channels
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, moment generating function (MGF) based average symbol error rate (SER) closed-form expressions are derived for the single relay cooperative system over generalized double α − µ fading channels. The performance of the system has been analyzed for selective decode and forward (SDF) relaying under M-QAM and BPSK modulations with coherent detection. Maximal ratio combining (MRC) is employed at the destination. For several values of the fading and shadowing parameters, Monte Carlo simulations are performed to evaluate the correctness of the analytical results. The obtained results provide the flexibility to adapt to different propagation environments.

articleTitle: Test Automation of DCS Controller’s Communication Interface
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Modbus over TCP/IP has become one of the most utilised industrial protocols for networking critical infrastructure. It is crucial to test how the ABB 800xA DCS Controller's Modbus TCP/IP protocol functions at both the component-level and the functional-level. Whereas manual testing takes a lot of time to build up a test environment. For example connecting the hardware like end devices, launching the controller (which executes the settings and programs created in the DCS software), configuring the DCS software tool (which enables editing, compilation, testing, and downloading of the desired controller programs to the controller), developing or loading controller programs which has different configurations, modifying the application variables, and also manually providing the input values into the desired registers or coils using Modbus slaves.
