Therefore, there is a great need to automate the entire process so that it becomes less repetitious, more effective, and requires less human effort. After comparing some available tools, We decided on SpecFlow as the point of entry into the automation framework. By connecting business-readable behavioral needs to the actual implementation, this tool "seeks to narrow the interaction gap between domain-specific experts and developers," according to its description. Our approach takes an array of steps defined in the Gherkin language using the SpecFlow framework as its input and embeds them inside step definition files developed using the C# language and the.NET framework. Additionally, PyModbusTCP served as the Modbus slave in the above project, providing complete test automation. PyModbusTCP is a slave-generation library built on the Python programming language. The Modbus Client object is used to provide access to the Modbus/TCP server.

articleTitle: DASUIP: Driver Alerting System for Smart Safetyusing Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, drowsy driving has been blamed for the majority of incidents (50% of traffic accidents). One minute of carelessness can result in a problem. The technology is designed to identify driver fatigue when operating a car or any other vehicle in order to prevent traffic accidents. Therefore, care must be taken to prevent accidents on the road caused by drowsy drivers. Here, MATLAB can be usedto identify the driver's tiredness. The camera first takes a picture of the driver before detecting the face. The HOG algorithm is used to identify whether the eye is closed or not, and if it is, the system creates an alarm sound to warn the driver. If he or she is drowsy, we can wake them up by setting off the alarm. We achieved 70% output accuracy with this. In this way, we can lower the number of fatal accidents brought on by drowsy driving and prevent traffic accidents.

articleTitle: Design of SICL Fed Wideband Dipole Antenna for Endfire Applications at 5G Millimeter Wave Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, design of a Substrate Integrated Coaxial Line (SICL) fed wideband printed dipole antenna using simple technique is presented for endfire applications in millimeter wave frequencies. Having the inherent advantage of side via-wall shielding and broadband unimodal operation, SICL technology is chosen to design an efficient feeding network for the proposed dipole antenna. The design starts with a conventional half wavelength (λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf>/2) dipole that gives a bandwidth of 5 GHz, which is further modified by using slant ± 45° tilted dipole arms that helps in achieving wideband performance. The proposed design achieves a peak gain of 5.6 dBi over a bandwidth of 11 GHz. The presented antenna design is planar, simple and compact that does not require additional balun to feed the arms of the dipole antenna. This antenna is a suitable candidate for endfire 5G mmWave applications.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Consensus Algorithms for Permissioned Blockchain Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ever-evolving technological landscape demands systems that can ensure trust, security, transparency, and traceability. To meet these requirements, blockchain technology has emerged that uses decentralized ledgers to keep transaction records. It utilizes cryptography to interconnect devices, and once recorded, data stored on a blockchain cannot be altered by any unauthorized parties, thereby enhancing its security features. Consensus in blockchain refers to the process of achieving agreement among a distributed network of nodes on the current state of the blockchain ledger. No centralized body is in charge of validating and approving transactions in a decentralized blockchain network. To guarantee that every node in the network has a consistent and accurate copy of the ledger, the consensus mechanism is used. By simulating the time to attain consensus with the NS-3 network simulator, we assess the performance of the consensus algorithms Raft and PBFT in this paper. This paper considers the effectiveness of the Raft and PBFT consensus algorithms by simulating the time taken to reach consensus using the NS-3 network simulator. Based on the evaluation results, it was found that the performance of PBFT is on average 30% better than RAFT with varying message sizes, transaction speeds, and the number of nodes.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Vertical Handover based on Least Square Weighting techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Communication Services in Next Generation Wireless Networks are highly dependent on integrated wireless networks which characterize the presence of various Radio Access Technologies (RATs). Next generation networks encompass Wireless Local Area Networks (WLAN) and Wireless Wide Area Networks (WWAN). In the present scenario, smart phones have to interface with various RATs and have to switch seamlessly among the available networks. Hence the network selection algorithm gains importance in maintaining the Quality of Service (QoS) while transitioning from one network to another. The research article presents the Vertical Handover Decision Algorithm by considering a practical scenario. The input parameters taken into consideration are Received Signal Strength (RSS), bandwidth, cost and user velocity. Two networks scenario i.e.4G & WLAN have been considered in the research paper.

Author Keywords: Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution (TOPSIS)

articleTitle: Analysis of Image Processing Techniques for Retinal Fundus Images in Detection of Ophthalmic Disease Screening
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Retinal image processing is considered as the most important task in detection of ophthalmic disease screening like diabetic retinopathy, diabetic macular edema, glaucoma etc. Automatic detection of these diseases helps doctors to accelerate the process. Preprocessing of the image is the first vital step used in medical imaging due to presence of noise, poor contrast and difference in illumination. This paper focuses on different image pre-processing techniques and their comparative analysis such as Histogram Equalization, Adaptive Histogram Equalization, Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization, Median Filter, Speckle Filter and Guassian Filter used for the scanning of retinal fundus images during computer based detection of eye diseases. Performance evaluation of these techniques compared using Entropy, Peak Signal to Noise Ratio.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Power System Component by Wavelet Analysis of Current Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Power transmission network is any nation's most intricate and critical component in its energy infrastructure. Overhead transmission lines are prone to faults being exposed to the atmospheric conditions. Maintaining the power system's operational stability and reliability depends heavily on the accurate detection and diagnosis of the fault's nature. The paper presents a wavelet transform tool used in MATLAB to identify and classify the faults by extracting the characteristics of current signals. Presented simulation results of 33 kV transmission line reveals that the fault analysis approach is fairly accurate but struggles due to system dependent threshold limitations.

articleTitle: Data Extraction from a Multifunction Meter with RS-485 Support for Power Distribution System Monitoring and Control
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: It is necessary to perform data analytics on electrical factors in order to increase energy consumption effectiveness and avoid negative outcomes like power outages, short circuits, etc. Additionally, it increases the longevity and protects the electrical equipment. Typically, the multifunction meter (MFM) installed in industrial and commercial control panels is used to measure electricity consumption statistics. The initial step in the data analytics process is data extraction. These MFM’s can be used to extract data. A hardware lab setup using MFM 384-C with RS-485 communication interfaces is used to illustrate the data retrieval process. After that, control actions are implemented inside the electrical distribution network using the data that was retrieved. The authors used this approach of data extraction from MFM placed in a 5 kVA distribution transformer control metering box to extract the system parameters for the necessary control action of the static var compensator to enhance the power quality of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Establishing communication between EV – EVSE – CSMS based on IEC61851-1 and OCPP 2.0.1 Standard
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper focuses on making transportation more sustainable by promoting the growth of electric vehicles and improving EV charging infrastructure. The communication protocol between EV and EV Supply Equipment is essential for safe, fast, and affordable charging. The paper presents a system architecture that utilizes the IEC 61851-1 and Open Charge Point Protocol to enable real-time communication between EVSE, EV, and the Charging Station Management System. The EVSE system includes pilot lines for monitoring various charging states and a microcontroller capable of generating pulse width modulation signals sent to EV side resistors to communicate various states. Utilizing the OCPP protocol which establishes a TCP/IP-based connection between the EVSE in the charging station and CSMS in the server. In this paper, CSMS is developed along with which an OCPP visualizer is introduced for examining and monitoring the OCPP messages in detail

articleTitle: Vehicle Number Plate Detection System Using Image Processing Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The primary method of operation for the vehicle authorization system is the reading and processing of license plates. Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) is the name given to image processing technology that uses a vehicle's license plate to identify it. In this work, we aim to develop a reliable automatic authorized vehicle identification system that makes use of the license plate. This system is intended to be used in highly restricted military areas like the Supreme Court and Parliament as well as government administration and security control systems. The number plate region in an image is found using image segmentation, which is then used to extract the vehicle's number plate from the image. The highly trained neural network serves as the foundation for the recognition system. A database used for vehicle authorization contains the specific vehicle information.

articleTitle: Exploration and Correlation of Machine Learning Models through Option Mining of Airline Tweets
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Twitter is a well-known and widely used social media platform since it enables users to share their ideas and opinions on any topic and also submit messages or comments from anywhere in the world. These reviews and opinions are examined using Sentiment Analysis tools. An NLP approach called sentiment analysis is used to categorize positive, negative, and neutral. In this research, we used machine learning methods such as SVM, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest to perform sentiment analysis on the Twitter Airline Dataset. Positive, negative, and neutral emotions are the three ways that emotions are conveyed. The primary objective of this paper is to check which Machine learning model gives the best accuracy. The experimental results show that Random Forest models provide the best accuracy that is 99.26%

articleTitle: Using Deep Neural Nets for Flower Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the growing influence of Machine Learning, Image classification is a topic of interest for many. Flower Classification remains to be a hurdle which is yet to be crossed in this topic. The nature of flower image datasets, with indifferentiable backgrounds, high inter-class commonalities and intra-class dissimilarities makes the process complex and demanding. Our research employs the transfer learning approach by training a pre-trained ImageNet image classifier, VGG-16 using TPU. The TPU, due to its cores, speeds up the process of training and is a part of various large-scale classifiers. The epoch size and learning rate have been chosen to favour the process. The results achieved were gratifying with an accuracy rate of 94.1%. This work holds a scope in the future which include automation using an application. Our study represents a significant step forward in flower classification using machine learning, with implications for fields such as agriculture, botany, and ecology.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of machine learning algorithms for diabetes prediction using Real-time data-set
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Breakthroughs help doctors in the case of analytic on health. Generally, health care analysis helps to spot early diagnosis of diseases. It helps mainly to improve the quality of healthcare and outcomes for patients. Machine Learning algorithms are used for early predictions based on data patterns. Mostly Machine Learning-based models are implemented in applications of diabetes diagnosis, for giving treatment. With the invention of new ML algorithms, the models have been increased effectively in delivering treatments for patients. The main research objective is to develop different ML algorithms for diabetes prediction. Further, the algorithms are compared by evaluating their accuracy, with performance metrics such as precision, recall, and F1-Score. By comparing with other algorithms CNN outperformed the other methods by attaining an accuracy rate of 96.26% as well as the proposed system acts as indicators to the doctors in which abnormal cases are identified from the collected samples which stands as novelty point.

articleTitle: Rat Swarm Optimization and Machine Learning Algorithms for Accurate Leukemia Diagnosis via Gene Expression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cancer can be caused by a sharp rise in the number of cells that might damage internal organs. Leukemia is a form of cancer that affects the body's blood-forming tissues, including the lymphatic system and bone marrow. Recent technical developments have made it possible to quickly assess the cellular makeup of various cancer forms. Each properly positioned tiny dot on a microscope slide printed with a DNA microarray contains either a DNA sequence or a gene. This study aims to enhance machine learning algorithms like Passive Aggressive Algorithm, Ridge Classifier, Quadratic Discriminant Analysis, XG Boost Algorithm, Stochastic Gradient Descent algorithm, K Nearest Neighbour Classifier, Random Forest Classifier, and Perceptron Model by using Rat Swarm Optimization as a transform. In this analysis, gene expression data from 282 patients with leukemia was taken into account. To reduce the number of dimensions in a dataset, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used. Importantly, Ridge Classifier delivers the greatest Balanced Accuracy score of 94.92% for Leukemia cancer data when combined with Rat Swarm Optimization.

articleTitle: A DVR Based Scheme for Attaining LVRT Capability in DER- Interfaced Microgrid During Line Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Low voltage ride through (LVRT) is an essential requirement of microgrid during low voltage condition. In this paper a scheme is proposed to attain the LVRT capability during line faults using a dynamic voltage restorer (DVR). The DVR is a power electronic device that uses a series transformer to inject three phase power into the grid. The proposed work proposes the control algorithm to control the output voltage of DVR, so as to compensate for the voltage dip during faults. This microgrid model with LVRT capability using DVR is validated for a wide range of voltage sag scenarios during both symmetrical and unsymmetrical fault conditions. The test results of proposed method reflect its effectiveness in ensuring the LVRT capability during both type of faults.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of OYO Hotel Reviews Using NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis or opinion mining is the computational study of people’s opinions, sentiments, attitudes, and emotions expressed in written language.This study presents an aspect-based novel approach for sentiment analysis of customer reviews for OYO hotels.The sentiment analysis conducted in this study is founded on the primary amenities individuals consider when making their final decisions regarding hotels. These key factors include the quality of food offerings, the attributes of the rooms, and the service provided by the staff. By analyzing sentiments expressed in relation to these crucial aspects, we aim to gain valuable insights into the preferences and perceptions of hotel guests.This analysis holds the potential to offer significant benefits not only to customers but also to hotels themselves.It enables the identification of areas of strength and areas requiring improvement. By leveraging sentiment analysis techniques, hotels can gain valuable insights into the specific aspects of their operations that excel and those that necessitate enhancement, thus facilitating targeted efforts to elevate the overall guest experience. This analytical approach serves as a valuable tool for guiding hotels in their quest for continuous improvement and aligning their strategic initiatives with customer preferences and satisfaction.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection and Classification of Tibia Bone Fracture from X-ray Images by using Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fractures are the most frequent occurrence of bone disease and affect millions of people annually nationwide. For examining suspected fractures of the patient's internal organs, the oldest, cheap, and most widely used imaging technique is x-rays. Computerize auto fracture classification models have the prospect to minimize the time and effort required for skilled radiologists to analyze and categorize radiographic images. The computer-based approach known as computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) assists radiologists in making better diagnoses by enhancing sensitivity while saving time and cost. The effectiveness of treatment and diagnosis heavily rely on the precise classification of the fracture and the CAD system; consequently, this paper was designed and implemented for this purpose and focuses on lower leg bone Tibia automatic fracture classification. In this system, one of the texture feature extraction Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) was used for non-fracture and fracture features of the tibia bone diaphysis part, medium filtering and edge sharpening were used for image enhancement in the preprocessing step, and the KNN method was used for the classification step.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Radio over Fiber Technology for 5G Communication using Modified Walsh Code
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Radio over Fibre (RoF) technology is a viable approach for future microcell and picocell applications to construct wireless data networks. It is a hybrid version of microwave and optical networks, with optical fiber serving as the backbone technology due to its numerous benefits. However, the nonlinear effects of the channel can substantially degrade the performance of RoF devices. The paper proposes a novel adaptive radio-over-fiber system for next-generation communication to provide better Quality factors and bit error rate. A RoF link for a two-channel structure is also initiated availing the Mach-Zehnder Modulator. The proposed link is assessed for various transmission distances of 10, 20, 30, and 40 km without using an amplifier. The Q-Factor is of 10 and BER is of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-20</sup> with other existing optical code division multiple access codes at different transmission distances.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low Power NAND Gate Based Combinational Circuits Using FinFET Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Low-power design has seen significant progress as a result of the rising demand for power conservation in very large-scale integration (VLSI). Advancements in this field have been driven by the need to reduce power usage in high-density VLSI chips and the increasing usage of portable systems. The Cadence Virtuoso 6.1.7 software was used to design and test digital logic circuits in two different technologies, CMOS 180nm, and FinFET. Principles of NAND gate design were applied to create CMOS and FinFET circuits for half adder, the full adder, half subtractor, and the full subtractor. The NAND gates are used in the CMOS and FinFET designs. Reduced voltage, reduced power consumption, and improved energy efficiency are advantages of CMOS. Whereas, FinFET technology improved performance, reduced power consumption, had better control over the channel, and showed low static leakage currents than CMOS. Simulation studies confirmed the proposed scheme's effectiveness, with the FinFET technique producing more accurate results with a minimum 50% reduction in delay compared to CMOS. FinFET technology is a preferred option for digital logic circuit design due to its significant improvement in performance, although further improvements are needed to eliminate slight glitches observed in the technique.

articleTitle: Real-time Multiple object detection Network model based on YOLOV4
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Deep learning produced very good results for object detection, however, it has still many problems with photographs from real photography, like noise, blurring, etc. Object detection is significantly impacted by these issues. Using the You Only Look Once (YOLO) strategy, the main goal is to find objects. When compared with the remaining object detection method, the YOLO approach provides a number of benefits. YOLO is a two-stage detector. The algorithms, like C Neural Networks, a n d F-R Convolution Neural Network, do not fully examine the images, but YOLO does so the bounding boxes predicating The image more quickly by using a CNN, determining the probabilities of class for these boxes, and identifying images. By using this algorithm, we were able to identify various types of items. This research proposes a trainable framework used to detect real-time images and videos. We are utilizing a YOLO-based detection method. The resulting system is quick and precise, helping applications that need object detection. The proposed model performs better in object detection than other models.

articleTitle: Unraveling Women’s Involvement in the Digital Realm: An Empirical Investigation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A virtual world in which communication is done through the electronic medium using the computer. This world allows the user to gain knowledge in the form of information. Even though it has a lot of advantages, there are enormous issues when an individual exists in cyberspace. At hand are several challenges to be overcome by individuals to protectively survive cyberspace. Such as various attacks, financial risks, online crimes, and more. In cyberspace, the targeted audience is womanhood of all eons. Educating and promoting awareness about the risk in cyberspace for women in society is the need of the hour. Each individual is facing risk while they are in a digital world. Stakeholders are not given alertness of the threat and its consequences. The paper analyzes the risk and consequences of women’s society, as most victims are from that environment. In this, different risks faced and the consequences affected by women’s civilization, are discussed. Also remedial measures are taken and should be taken are also deliberated. Supporting this, an online survey is taken from various groups of common people to know the status of women’s civilization in the current era.

articleTitle: CNN Based Identification of weeds in Tomato Farm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Precision farming is a technological revolution that aims to use the latest technologies to improve productivity without compromising quality. Weedicides used to control the growth of weeds need to be judiciously applied to avoid health risks that can affect ecosystems. Further early stages of weed identification can contribute to a significant reduction in herbicide usage. The present research is to investigate the machine learning algorithms that result in a faster weed detection process with better accuracy. Further, the classification of weeds by crop is also addressed. This study has considered the YOLO detection algorithm to achieve the above objective. An accessible dataset of tomato crop (Solanum lycopersicum L) and its weed species, black nightshade (Solanum nigrum L), is used to evaluate the developed approach. The images were captured using RGB cameras at several production locations in Greece under varying natural light conditions. The number of epochs is set to 200 for training 736 images. Performance comparisons between two versions of YOLO, namely YOLOv5 and YOLOv7, are made. From the results, it is concluded that YOLOv5 outperforms YOLOv7in terms of training time (17 minutes, 22 seconds). Further, the F1 score is found to increase by 2.48% when compared to YOLOv7, which accounts for the improvement in detection performance in YOLOv5. The results revealed that YoLOv5 is better for feasible real-time extension to a crop-weed detection system, although YOLOv7 has a detection time 10 times greater than that of YoLOv5.

articleTitle: DeFy: P2P Crypto Lending
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The debt market is a substantial industry, estimated to be of significant value and projected to grow further in the near future. However, its size is marred by inefficiencies due to a lack of transparency and trust. To address these issues, DeFy, a blockchain-based system, offers loans to borrowers using their cryptocurrency assets as collateral. Leveraging smart contract technology and a decentralized network, DeFy creates a secure and transparent lending environment that operates globally without intermediaries. Empowering users with autonomy to select preferred lenders through a robust bidding system, DeFy enhances transparency in the borrowing process and empowers borrowers to make informed decisions. This user-driven lending approach provides an efficient and secure means for borrowers to access capital without liquidating their cryptocurrency holdings, while allowing lenders to earn interest on their capital through the lending process.

articleTitle: Dysarthric Speech Detection Using Hybrid Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dysarthria is a speech disorder caused by weak or poorly coordinated speech-related muscles. Dysarthria can be caused by various factors such as stroke, multiple sclerosis, or cerebral palsy, as well as brain injury or certain medications. The ultimate goal of our paper is to make a suitable and accurate tool for detecting dysarthric speech that can be used in clinical settings for early diagnosis, treatment planning for dysarthric individuals. In this work, the machine learning models namely CNN (Convolutional Neural Network), and hybrid models, such as CNN, combined with LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory), and CNN combined with GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) are trained on TORGO dataset, to classify the dysarthric speech from non-dysarthric speech. The model's performance is evaluated on the testing data and all of these models produce more than 95% accuracy rate. From this study, we understood that this methodology can be used in developing Automatic Speech Recognition(ASR) for people with dysarthria, which would become an essential technology for many applications.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Detection Through Deep learning and Comparitive analysis of different models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As covid-19 has grown a lot and have become the biggest problem of recent times. Our whole world is still suffering from this disease. This disease has taken life of lot of people therefore is the biggest curse of all time and hence we need a system which can detect this disease. The system proposed in this paper makes it easy to detect COVID-19 using deep learning models. This paper presents a comparative analysis of different models developed for COVID-19 detection. Three models were created with following architecture Resnet50, Xception and VGG16 with the accuracy rate of 98.01%, 93.04% and 95.77% respectively. Our system results have shown that the Resnet50 model is most accurate hence it can detect the disease accurately.

articleTitle: Data Security in AWS S3 Cloud Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud computing has changed the way the world works. From computing to storage, everything in between and beyond is being developed for the cloud. With corporates, enterprises and governments moving towards cloud and leveraging its benefits, it also raises questions about the security of data being stored and processed in the cloud. Due to the nature and architecture of the cloud security is the most sensitive and often the only factor which dictates the weather an organization will move towards the cloud. In this study, the aim is to address the traditional vs cloud-based scenarios particularly for AWS since it is the pioneer of the cloud revolution. The proposed method is making better use of the cloud and its strengths for storing and securing data automatically.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Property Deeds Repository System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Property deeds convey ownership of properties to parties purchasing them from the owners. They give us information regarding the property’s details like who is the owner, the worth of the property, and who has the most privileges. The traditional ways of handling and management of title deeds included the use of brokers. Brokers frequently take a long time to finish procedures as they become the middlemen. We thereby propose a solution that will allow several property owners to store the land details digitally on a decentralized platform and buyers can request the owners to buy the property as well as confirm the authenticity of the title deeds of the seller using the application. Ultimately this system will improve efficiency, reduce errors, eliminate the need of a middleman (broker) and broaden the accessibility of the system that is now more representative of the digital age.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Designing, Modelling and Simulation with different controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As electric vehicle has caught the attention of researcher due to its suitability for sustainable developments. In an initial stage of an electric vehicle to choose its applicable parameters and understanding its features. This paper presents the study of vehicle parameters based on simulation of electric vehicle. The steps for modelling an electric vehicle in MATLAB and Simulink. In this paper by describing the Motor Model, Battery Model, Power Model, and Regenerative System. The planned electric vehicle is simulated using Simulink, and a driving cycle was used to calculate several factors such vehicle speed, and battery state of charge. We have put the data 6000 rpm with different type of controller and getting different result graph and nickel cadmium battery used in this simulation model and used DC motor with permanent magnet to enhance the model, the many observed factors were examined also we have compared with the controller. The simulation shows the importance of the controller and the performance as per the parameter of electric vehicle All works is performed in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation of Optic Disc and Optic Cup using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Most serious eye disease that causes visual loss is glaucoma. The individual will benefit from getting better therapy and illness management if they are diagnosed with glaucoma early. In this context,a neural network aided medical image analysis system can serve as a decision-support tool for the ophthalmologist, lowering the potential for subjective interpretations while boosting accuracy. Consequently, the identification of glaucoma heavily relies on the optic cup and disc segmentation from fundus images. As a result, a modified U-Net model is proposed in the current study with an emphasis on the combined semantic segmentation of the optic disc and optic cup using fundus pictures. This approach makes use of a modified Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) module that captures more extensive spatial data for precise segmentation of these regions of interest. Additionally, an experiment is conducted to assess the impact of different loss functions on the effectiveness of the model. Both qualitative and quantitative analysis of the proposed method is carried out on public data set which suggests promising results.

articleTitle: Cygiene: Cyber Hygiene Score App
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Mobile devices have become an integral part of our lives, containing sensitive data and accessing critical services. However, mobile cybersecurity remains an afterthought for many users, leaving them vulnerable to attacks that compromise their privacy and security. Cygiene is a mobile app that evaluates the security of mobile devices. Cygiene generates an easy-to-understand security score based on factors like operating system updates, screen lock strength, installed risky apps, and more. It also provides actionable reports with remediation recommendations that guide users to improve their security practices. By raising awareness about vulnerabilities and helping users address security gaps, Cygiene aims to make mobile environments safer for everyone.

articleTitle: Implementation of Panoramic Image Stitching using Python
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Panoramic image stitching is a popular technique for combining numerous photographs to generate wide-angle views and high-resolution images, Image stitching entails matching the pictures, adjusting for camera location and orientation discrepancies, and mixing the images to form a smooth composite image. In this paper, we offer an implementation of panoramic image stitching using Image processing techniques in python. The suggested technique employs feature-based image alignment, which aligns pictures by utilizing feature points in the images. The detection of spatial differences between the pixels of the image is a key to detect feature points, which is resistant to changes in scale, rotation, and affine distortion. After aligning the photos, we generate a smooth composite image. The suggested approach is tested on a real-world picture collection, and the findings demonstrate that it can generate high-quality panoramic photos with good alignment and smooth blending. The suggested approach is simple and straightforward to apply, and it has applications in virtual reality, surveillance and security systems, and film and video creation.

articleTitle: A machine learning approach to control a Prosthetic arm via signals from residual limb - A boon for amputees
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Many people have lost their hand due to accidents. This leads to upper or lower arm amputation, wrist disarticulation, trans-radial amputation, commonly referred to as below-elbow or forearm amputation. People who lost their hand face a lot of problems physically, socially and also undergo mental traumas. They were also seen as people with disabilities which makes them feel even more inferior.Hence, this work aims to develop a prosthetic limb or arm for individuals who have lost their hand due to accidents. Such individuals face numerous physical, social, and mental challenges and are often perceived as disabled. To address this issue, this work proposes using s-EMG signals acquired from residual arm muscles to develop an artificial hand that can be controlled through muscle movements. To achieve this, the sEMG signal needs to be classified for different actions, as each muscle movement corresponds to a distinct pattern in the signal domain. The ultimate goal of this work is to provide individuals who have lost their hand with a prosthetic arm that functions as a natural hand and improves their quality of life.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Face Recognition Algorithms: Evaluating LBPH and FaceNet with Haar Cascade
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Facial recognition is a widely utilized technology in numerous industries, such as security, retail, delivery, and criminal detection. However, it encounters significant challenges when dealing with low-resolution images and videos. To achieve accurate facial recognition, researchers have explored various techniques, including LBPH, Face++, and ReKognition. Despite advancements, there remains considerable room for improving recognition accuracy. LBPH, a feature-based method, demonstrates remarkable proficiency in recognizing faces from diverse viewpoints. In contrast, deep learning approaches like FaceNet and Haar Cascade have emerged as prominent techniques. Haar Cascade specifically focuses on face recognition. This study evaluates the performance of LBPH face recognition system in comparison with a combined approach employing FaceNet and Haar Cascade using real-time video data.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Prediction of FGFR Kinase Inhibitors: A comparative study and implications for Targeted Cancer Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fibroblast Growth Factor receptor alterations are particularly prevalent in certain cancer types, such as breast cancer, lung cancer, and cholangiocarcinoma. In some cases, specific FGFR alterations have been identified as therapeutic targets. FGFR kinase inhibitors poses a promising role for targeted cancer therapy in patients with Fibro Blast Growth Receptor alterations, predicting ligands inhibiting receptor is a crucial task in drug discovery. In this study we present different Machine Learning techniques to screen the compounds along various databases and to predict the pIC50 values based on highly performed Machine Learning technique. The studies reveal that the usage of Random Forest gives best yield over classification and regression compared to different techniques.

articleTitle: Responsible AI for Sustainable Agriculture: Forecasting Rice Yield to Combat Global Food Insecurity
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Climate change has emerged as a significant contributor to acute hunger, and its impact is projected to worsen with the exacerbation of key climatic drivers, including temperature rise, changing precipitation patterns, increasing frequency of extreme events, and rising sea levels. Along with man-made conflicts and economic downturns, climate change is among the primary causal factors of hunger, which necessitates comprehensive and innovative approaches for mitigation. In this context, EY Open Data Science Challenge was undertaken to develop models that enable scientists to better comprehend the implications of climate change on crop yields and forecast rice cultivation yield across Vietnam's identified areas. Microsoft's Planetary Computer was leveraged for the challenge, and it involved Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data, along with temperature data from open-source packages. The study constructed new features that integrate radar, optical, and temperature data to investigate their influence on vegetation growth and employed machine learning to establish the interpretability of the rice yield prediction. The Light GBM model achieved the highest R2 score of 0.65 on the submission data among all the models tested.

articleTitle: A Compact Tri-band Microstrip Patch Antenna Design for 5G millimeter wave applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper outlines a unique and effective technique for creating a miniaturized three-band microstrip patch antenna that can be used in 5G millimeter wave wireless systems. The proposed antenna operates in three distinct bands at 15.2GHz, 23GHz, and 29.8GHz. The Roger RT/Duroid 5880 (tm) material has a permittivity (ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf> = 2.2) and a thickness (H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf>) of 0.8mm, and the antenna was designed based on these attributes. This compact antenna utilizes a hexagon shape patch with three rectangular slots to enhance antenna performance. The obtained results indicate that the proposed antenna demonstrates a better return loss for all three frequencies are 15.2GHz, 23GHz, and 29.8GHz respectively. The antenna has a measured gains are 7.183dB at 15GHz, 5.79dB at 23GHz, and 6.72dB at 29.8GHz. The antenna directivity and radiation patterns are further investigated to determine the antenna's behavior. Simulation carried out using Ansys HFSS reveals an overall radiation efficiency of more than 95%. The proposed antenna is believed to have strong potential for 5G applications, mainly because of its small size, high gain, excellent radiation efficiency, and tri-band design. Overall, this antenna design offers potential advantages in size, weight, fabrication cost and efficiency to be used in 5G millimeter-wave applications.

articleTitle: A Forensic Analysis Procedure for Dark Web Drug Marketplaces
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dark web marketplaces are areas of huge illegal trading of drugs. Collecting information about the drug markets, categories of products and services, and vendors can help Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) to track illegal trading. This work focuses on the collection of Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) of the dark web drug markets and investigates in detail the collected websites, products, and vendors operating on those marketplaces with the help of forensic tools, such as Onion Scan, Exchangeable Image File Format (EXIF), Kleopatra, Maltego, and Forensics Acquisition of Websites (FAW). This work has resulted in marking the genuineness of a few dark websites, the vendors operating, and the payment methods used in dark web marketplaces. Additionally, evidence for postal addresses and email addresses used as modes of delivery and communication is also found. This work provides a roadmap for LEAs through the visual evidence of hidden information in dark web markets.

articleTitle: A Sequential Model of Neural Networks for Low Light Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Enhancing the quality of low light images is a critical area of research, and the recent advancements in this field offer significant potential for enhancing the standard of low light images and their subsequent processing. However, most of these approaches do not consider the case of spatially uneven dark areas with backlit illumination. To address this issue, a pipeline of processes is proposed, where the sky region is segmented first, as most of the source of backlit illumination is a direct result of the presence of sky region. For noise removal and adjustment of exposure without color distortion, conversion of the remaining region from RGB to Luminance Chrominance color space is proposed. The enhancement is done on the Luminance component alone which is then combined with the chroma components and the segmented sky region. Furthermore, the results show that the proposed framework is promising and outperforms the Zero Deep Curve Estimation (DCE) model.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based framework for dynamic Detection and Mitigation of ARP Spoofing attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) is a protocol that links the IP address of a network node to the Media Access Control (MAC) address of another node for communication. An attack known as ARP spoofing affects a network’s data-link layer and permits malicious access to network data. The sending device can be tricked, and potentially valuable data can be stolen, by connecting the attacker’s MAC address to the IP address of the receiving device. Several approaches exist today to detect ARP attacks accurately and efficiently but have drawbacks in various aspects such as speed of detection, accuracy, dynamicity, and scalability. To overcome these issues, we propose DL-ARP, a novel dynamic framework based on an XGBoost Classifier followed by a CNN-LSTM architecture. This technique can identify and mitigate ARP spoofing assaults in real-time by collecting packets of data as they are received. The model automatically categorizes them and creates entry cache logs in the process. This paper aims to show the effectiveness and the potential of the suggested methodology for real-time ARP spoofing detection and prevention, this study also assess the performance of the proposed methodology in comparison to other existing methods.

articleTitle: Study of Topological Connectivity of Optical Networks Using Graph Spectra
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Transport networks between cities and the physical topological connectivity share a close resemblance. The study of this resemblance using graphs and matrices has been extensively researched in foreign cities. However, there has been relatively less focus on the Indian topological aspects. Therefore, this study aims to analyze the network connectivity of optical cables by correlating with Indian transport networks and using graph concepts and mathematical models.The study aims to investigate the various graphs and their properties generated from the rail network of different Indian cities, considering each locality as a node and compare them with corresponding graphs generated from optical cable networks. Graph Spectra are better indicator of connectivity and thus they provide an extensive details about various aspect that could help in enhancing the connectivity of optical cables.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Real Time Traffic Prediction Using Deep Learning in VANET
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: VANETs, or vehicular ad-hoc networks, are the upcoming technologies in vehicles for better and safer transportation using wireless communications. These intelligent vehicles can communicate with Roadside Units (V2R) as well as with other vehicles (V2V). With the increase in growth of the population, especially in metropolitan cities, one of the major concerns faced is increase in traffic. VANETs provide efficient traffic management by communicating between vehicles. Rapid changes in current technologies provided us with many new solutions for existing problems and one such technology is Deep Learning. We can deploy Deep Learning models to identify the pattern of vehicle travelling at a specific region which helps us in scheduling the vehicles thereby reducing traffic. Time series forecasting models such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM), Gated Recurrent Units (GRU) etc., uses the past data to predict the present and future outcomes. Different Neural Networks as mentioned above are used in the present work and a Hybrid model is developed combining Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) along with LSTM. These architectures are compared and Hybrid model developed outperformed other models with the accuracy of 99.96%.

articleTitle: Automobile Price Prediction using Machine Learning with Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The automobile industry is experiencing a rapid increase in demand due to the growing population, leading to an increase in the sales of automobiles. Industry experts focus on renewing automobiles and increasing their efficiency and power while making them user-friendly and cost-effective. To assist people in purchasing cars within their budget, machine learning algorithms are utilized to predict the price of cars accurately. A machine learning model with high accuracy is integrated into a user-friendly interface, allowing people to view the precise price of the car. The user interface is designed to be user-friendly, making it easy for people to use. This paper presents various regression and classification models and their accuracies and promises to provide the price of the cars according to given inputs with a user-friendly interface. A supervised regression model is developed using multiple regression techniques trained from the car dataset provided. Data cleaning is performed to enhance the performance of these regression models by converting null values to non null values in the dataset.

articleTitle: Cardiac Arrhythmia Analysis using Spectrogram and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the most commonly used signals in the detection and prediction of cardiovascular diseases is the electrocardiogram (ECG)). The ECG signals can detect rhythmic disturbances in the heart, also known as arrhythmias. For accurate diagnoses of patients acute and chronic heart conditions, careful analysis of ECG signals is needed. In this paper, the classification of ECG signals was done in two classes namely arrhythmia and regular heart rhythm using two-dimensional (2-D) convolutional neural network (CNN) model. Short-time Fourier transform is used to translate one-dimensional ECG time series signals into two-dimensional spectrograms. MIT-BIH arrhythmia dataset is used to test the proposed approach. The average classification test accuracy of 97% and training efficiency of 92.53% is achieved by using this model which is better than conventional methods of classifying arrhythmias. Performance metrices such as sensitivity and specificity etc., indicates significant improvement in showing the efficacy of the proposed CNN model.

articleTitle: Vocal Feature Extraction Based Hybrid ML Prototype for Parkinson's Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a degenerative disorder that affects the nervous system and can lead to a range of motor and non-motor symptoms. Early detection of Parkinson's disease is important to provide effective treatment and management of symptoms. In recent years, interest in using machine learning based algorithms for predicting Parkinson's disease. The study uses XGBoost model to detect Parkinson disease from the open data set available from CerrahpaYa medicine faculty, Istanbul University. Feature scaling was done using Max-Abs-Scaler, Features were identified using DCNN and selected using RNCN. Finally regularization tuning using ridge regression was done to XGBoost model which has improved the model performance. The proposed model got an accuracy of 98.4%, precision 100% and Recall score 97.

articleTitle: Dynamic Controller Placement in Software Defined Networks using Spectral Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper addresses the controller placement problem in Software-Defined Networks (SDNs), which involves determining the optimal locations for multiple controllers in a large network. SDN is a modern network technology that enhances network management efficiency by separating the control plane from the data plane. In SDN, devices in the data plane become forwarding devices, while the decision-making processes are centralized in a controller within the control plane. The placement of controllers is critical in SDN design and directly impacts various network performance metrics such as latency, flow setup time, network availability, controller load balancing, and energy consumption. To address the controller placement problem, this work proposes an algorithm that dynamically determines the arrangement of K controllers with limited resources in a cluster of hosts and switches. The approach involves efficiently clustering switches and assigning a controller to each group. Spectral clustering is employed as the primary technique in this work. The proposed work is implemented using the Mininet emulator with the POX SDN controller. To evaluate its performance, the results are compared with other clustering algorithms, including K-means and K-medoids. The results demonstrate that the spectral clustering-based mechanism performs better than K-means and K-medoids in terms of throughput, delay, and jitter, indicating its superiority in achieving efficient controller placement for SDNs.

articleTitle: Kalman Filter based Optimized Object Tracker with Auto-tuning of Process Noise Covariance Parameter and Performance Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Object tracking is a critical task in many computer vision and robotics applications. Kalman filters are commonly used for tracking, but their performance can be significantly improved by optimizing the tuning parameters of the system. In this article, an optimized Kalman filter object tracking approach is presented that automatically utilizes an algorithm to find the best tuning parameter for the filter. This article demonstrates how the Kalman filter can be improved by selecting an appropriate and proper process noise covariance matrix, and the verification of the chosen parameter is shown using sensitivity and robustness metrics. Firstly, an algorithm over a simple one dimensional tracking subject and also the proposed approach is evaluated on several standard object tracking systems. The results show that Kalman Filter with the correct process noise covariance is reliable even with low computation power compared to other methods in terms of tracking accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Image to Image Steganography using U-Net Architecture with MobileNet Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Steganography conceals information inside another object, so information is not immediately apparent in the examination. Different from encryption, where a ciphertext is an encrypted object, steganography aims to hide information and the fact that a piece of information is concealed. In the case of image steganography, the secret is embedded into a cover image so that the cover image does not differ substantially, and the secret can be extracted without too many alterations. This paper proposes a method to embed an image into another image using U-Net architecture with MobileNet Convolutional Neural Network. The proposed method is trained and tested on a readily available image dataset, CIFAR10, StanfordCars, and STL10. The result shows that the proposed method can embed and extract images from CIFAR10, StanfordCars, and STL10 datasets with average PSNR of 28.165 dB, 28.539 dB, and 28.226 dB for steganographic images; 27.075 dB, 29.759 dB, and 28.767 dB for extracted images.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of River Cleaning Boat
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Our water systems are becoming increasingly polluted, which poses a serious threat to both human and aquatic life. The hazardous waste present in the water can be fatal for aquatic animals that consume it. Furthermore, humans are also vulnerable to the consequences of this issue, as the contaminated water is employed for drinking and irrigation purposes. The utilization of such water in irrigation can result in the contamination of vegetables, leading to potential health issues. Ingesting this polluted water can cause respiratory diseases, as well as water-borne ailments like jaundice and skin disorders. The primary focus of this project revolves around tackling the accumulation of floating garbage on the water’s surface, which comprises plastic waste, household refuse, aquatic vegetation, and more.

articleTitle: Identifying Anomalous Indus Texts from West Asia Using Markov Chain Language Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Indus Valley civilization thrived during its mature period between 2500 BCE and 1800 BCE. and traded with the bronze age civilizations of West Asia in Mesopotamia and the Persian Gulf region. During this period, the Indus civilization developed a logosyllabic writing system that remains undeciphered. In our research, we built various Markov chain language models from the Indus texts corpus. Using a best-fit language model, we calculated the model perplexity for each Indus text found in the West Asian region. Our results show that the model perplexity was high for a majority of West Asian Indus texts and that these texts did not fit in well with the language model built with the Indus texts from just the Indian subcontinent. From this, we surmise that West Asian Indus Texts were written in a different language or syntax than those from the Indian subcontinent.

articleTitle: Intelligent Sign Language Recognition Enhancing Accessibility for the Deaf Community
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Every human being is unique in their own way while some suffer from disabilities like hearing and speech. It is unfair for individuals to encounter hardships when engaging in a fundamental activity such as having a conversation with others. It is commonly understood that having a conversation with people having such kinds of disabilities is a challenging task. Although various sign language standards exist, many individuals are reluctant to invest the additional effort required to learn these to facilitate effective communication with individuals with disabilities. This is where Sign language detection systems come in, they offer a solution to this problem by empowering individuals with disabilities to actively participate in conversations without necessitating knowledge of sign language. In this study, we propose a multilayer Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model designed to identify ten different signs of American Sign Language (ASL). The model is trained and evaluated on a comprehensive dataset, achieving a high validation accuracy of 95%. The CNN architecture enables the accurate recognition and classification of hand gestures associated with ASL, empowering individuals with disabilities to effectively communicate with others.

articleTitle: Deep learning model for Classifying leaves of Plants using VGG-16
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Systematic plant-based categorization has never been difficult. Targeted crop safety is dependent on automated technologies that detect and classify plants. Classical machine learning approaches have been used to categorize leaves using handcrafted features from the shape of plant leaves, which have yielded promising results. However, we concentrate on classifying plant leaves using non-handcrafted traits. To accomplish this, we employ the use of deep learning for extraction of features and categorization. Deep Convolution Neural Networks have recently demonstrated impressive achievements in picture classification and object detection challenges. This paper proposes using the built-in, compact VGG-16 model to detect and classify ten plant species from the Plant dataset. The proposed models are utilized to classify ten other classes. When contrasted with other pre-trained models, VGG -16 fared better in categorizing leaf images. Computerized plant species categorization could be beneficial to food engineers, agricultural professionals, researchers, and the general public.

articleTitle: Preserving Heritage Palaces: A Deep Learning CNN-SVM Hybrid Approach for Multi-classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the flow of time and enhancement in overall technology. People are disconnecting from their culture and the old palaces. This is very important for us to be connected with our old generations and learn the overall things from this from their architecture and experience. This all can be possible by studying the historical monuments and learning about our history. By increasing the saving historical palace moto this research can be done for predicting the different types of historical monuments with the help of machine learning and deep learning techniques and models. Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) may extract features using a variety of approaches without using specialized models, and over some time it can improve classification accuracy. To classify features from Heritage Palaces, a hybrid model was created that combines CNN and support vector machines (SVM). It is a double-layer Model. There image dataset of historical palaces has been collected from the web open source pics and created a dataset from it. As a result of web sources, a total of 4300 preprocessed images have been used for training and testing purposes in the CNN model. Many image preprocessing techniques have been implemented on it to make the dataset more functional. With the help of a combined CNN and SVM approach, a total of 97% classification accuracy is achieved by grand fountains, and Doric pillars feature classes. Traditional machine learning (ML) methods classify heritage palaces based on a few handmade items. That may result in an algorithm's execution failing, as well as reducing its efficiency. A glance revealed that the proposed hybrid model offers improved and more efficient strategies for classification.

articleTitle: Comparative survey on SVM kernel’s performance for classification used in IDS
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Our work covers implementation of an IDS using Machine Learning. For the experiment purpose we are using KDDCUP’99 dataset. Even after having few demerits as covered in this paper, KDDCUP’99 dataset is widely used for network security related research worldwide. For the comparison purpose we are using 10% of the dataset. Both the full dataset and a 10% of it are globally available in the internet. As a part of Machine Learning, hear we are using SVM for classification of the intrusion type. SVM is considered as one of the best models used for classification task. Depending upon complexity of the dataset, there are various selected kernels working as part of SVM model. These kernels are used to best fit data in the model and enhance its performance. While implementing an IDS, our work focuses on a comparison among few of these kernels in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Electricity Demand Forecasting Using an Ensemble Model with Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Accurate forecasting empowers electricity stake-holders to anticipate and arrange operational requirements for electricity production, ensuring reliable power. In this paper, a novel ensemble forecasting model proposed using the outcomes of Random Forest (RF) and Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU) model are fed to an XGBoost model as input. The input data contains temporal and weather variables,by applying filter, wrapper, and embedded methods a set of common selected features has been identified. With appropriate data pre-processing, it improves the forecasting accuracy. The performance of the proposed model is compared with that of the RF, LightGBM, and XGBoost models, using evaluation metrics as Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and Coefficient of determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). The performance metrics of proposed ensemble model is R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> 98.84%, RMSE 0.5401, and MAE 0.3738 excels the other comparable models.

articleTitle: Intellectual Parking Using OpenCV and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: India is a country with a high population density. Because of the enormous population, transportation and vehicle parking are key issues for the people. The current article’s objective is to give an intellectual parking system using image processing. Life being increasingly dominated by smart devices and the smart city designs have been inspired by the creation of technology that can send data over the Internet and connect to devices. The difficulty in finding free parking spaces is a common issue in most of the cities. The parking issue causes traffic congestion, wastage of fuel . A system for smart city parking proposals based on reservations is proposed . The proposed system uses registration via his/her mobile number through a user friendly mobile application. Image recognition is used to identify the empty spaces in the parking lot before assigning to an individual. After the slot selection the user will be required to provided his/her vehicle number and facial image. This will be followed by uploading the file into fire base cloud database. The system has been further upgraded by including facial recognition and no of free parking slot detection.

articleTitle: Analysis of Different Charging Modes in Electric Vehicle (EV) Application
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In 21th century the production and demand of EV is rising exponentially based on the development in the target towards Seventh Sustainable Development Goal (SDG7). Hence, charging time of electric vehicle (EVs) is one of the important factors. This paper investigates various charging algorithms such as Constant Current (CC), Constant Voltage (CV) and Hybrid Charging (HC) based on the buck converter closed loop control strategies in order to decrease the charging time. The simulation has been done in MATLAB for lithium-ion battery. This study carried out through MATLAB Simulation environment in order to reduce the charging time within 15 minutes. It includes the closed loop current and voltage control for this analysis. This analysis shows that CV charging mechanism is faster than the remaining charging methods. However, the high current charging implementation may lead to reduce the life time of the battery and charging equipment’s and increase the safety issues.

articleTitle: Improved Performance of Punching Machine Using Servo Motor Feeder Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The basic and important part of motor manufacturing is stamping. This article highlights innovative method in stamping process using Servo Feeder system with the help of Siemens programmable logic controller (PLC) and Human to Machine Interface (HMI). The Servo drives used in this proposed system increases productivity by increasing Strokes per minutes (SPM) and its quality, minimizes maintenance cost and eliminates human errors. Fully-programmable feed & release settings of Servo is user friendly which reduces setting time as well. Most importantly, the novel servo Feeder is an innovative improvement in the machine which controls the process with cost effectiveness.

articleTitle: Assessing the effectiveness of routing protocols in Opportunistic Network: the multiple-copy case
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The wireless networks have made everyone’s lifestyle sophisticated, convenient and comfortable. Over time, a type of wireless network, the Mobile ad-hoc network (MANET) has evolved which is infrastructure-less network. A variant of Mobile ad-hoc network, the Delay tolerant network (DTN) is intermittently connected mobile network characterized by delay in the network services. A sub-type of Delay tolerant network, the Opportunistic Network (OppNet), provides services through mobile nodes which come into contact, opportunistically. Hence, the routing in Opportunistic Network becomes a challenge. The work presents an insight to assess effectiveness of flooding-based routing protocols with performance metrics specifically tailored for Opportunistic Network.

articleTitle: Automatic Text Summarization based Web Application
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Text summarization is an important task in natural language processing that aims to condense large bodies of text into short but coherent summaries. This study provides an overview of text summarization techniques, including extractive, abstractive, and hybrid approaches. We explore various methods employed within each approach and discuss their advantages and disadvantages. Furthermore, we delve into the challenges faced by researchers in the field of text summarization and highlight potential avenues for future research. We introduce an all in one web application for text summarization that encompasses all aspects of text summarization.

articleTitle: Design of a Low-Power High-Gain Bulk-Driven Operational Transconductance Amplifier in 90 nm CMOS Process
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A low power consuming bulk-driven design of an Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) has been proposed in this paper. The design and simulation of the OTA is carried out using 90 nm CMOS technology using Cadence design toolkits. A high open loop gain of 57 dB was achieved by using the bulk-driven approach, which required just 3.76 µW of power from a 0.5 V supply voltage. Additionally, the unity gain frequency and phase margin are 6.46 MHz and 56° at 5 pF capacitive load. In general, the output of the suggested OTA is superior to other designs with similar characteristics and the low power consumption makes it suitable for bio-medical applications.

articleTitle: Flexible and Wearable EBG loaded SIW Band Pass Filter (BPF)
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) band pass filter (BPF) which is flexible in nature is discussed in this paper. Simple longitudinal ladder shaped electromagnetic band gap structure (EBG) is explored to obtain attenuation at the higher frequencies of the waveguide. Ordinary jeans fabric with thickness of 2mm, dielectric constant of 2.72 and loss tangent of 0.002 is used to prepare the filter for wearable applications. Wide passband frequencies ≈ 5 GHz to ≈ 13 GHz is observed by this technique. Important slot parameters which are affecting the transmission bandwidth are studied and presented with optimized results. The band pass filter which is proposed in this paper is having an insertion loss <1dB. The filter proposed in this paper is suitable for body wearable communication modules for emergency and rescue workers.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study of Sentiment Analysis on Covid19 Vaccine using ML and DL Based on Social Media Reaction of Bangladeshi People
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recently world is passing through a deadly pandemic called COVID-19. A global pandemic that was introduced or some say produced first in Wuhan, CHINA, and within some months spread around the world creating chaos in people’s minds because mankind had not seen such kind of virus in decades. Spending life in hard lockdown and keeping social distance affects people’s mental health and behavior. Within a year by the blessing of science, vaccines were introduced by different profitable and non-profitable organizations of different countries around the globe to fight back against the deadly virus. Due to mental health and behavior issue some peoples refuse to take the vaccine and also discoursed other people. Most of the activity happened on social media platforms like Facebook, and Twitter because of less monitoring. This effected the decision of people to take the vaccine as the vaccine is not taken as expected. On the other hand, some people express the benefit of talking about vaccines. In this paper, The Facebook comment that was posted related to covid-19 vaccine and vaccination campaign and tried to analyze the sentiment on covid-19 vaccine of people of Bangladesh has been examined. Due to the fact that Facebook comments allow users to voice their opinions, a dataset has been prepared from these comments. Dataset contained 1700 entries of Bangla comments and was labeled each entry with the corresponding sentiment from positive, negative, or neutral. Bangla comment was converted into numerical value by using the tokenizer method and performed various machine learning and deep learning algorithm on 1300 dataset which were where the LSTM algorithm appears as the best fit with an accuracy of 92.27%. LSTM works perfectly in the dataset containing Bangla comments.

articleTitle: A Real-Time V2I-based Emergency Vehicle Traffic Signals Management System (EVTMS)
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

authors.preferredName: J. N. V. R. Swarup Kumar

abstract: The aim of this paper is to present a novel solution to the problem of free traveling paths for emergency vehicles like ambulances. In India, due to heavy traffic congestion in cities and towns, ambulances get stuck in traffic jams, which can lead to failure in reaching the medical care destination in time. When there are delays in providing emergency medical services to people who require urgent medical attention, it can result in a failure to save their lives. To address this issue, we propose a system that utilizes real-time ambulance location data such that the corresponding traffic signals at intersections in the emergency vehicle traveling path are adjusted dynamically, which will provide priority to emergency vehicles and ensure that they can navigate congested roads efficiently. The timely delivery of emergency medical care is critical to saving lives and reducing long-term morbidity. This proposed approach leverages advanced data analytics, machine learning techniques, and vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) models to analyze traffic patterns and adjust signal timings on-the-fly, allowing emergency vehicles to move quickly and safely through urban areas. By implementing this solution, we aim to reduce response times and improve patient outcomes in emergency medical situations.

articleTitle: Low-rate Denial of Service Attack Mitigation Using Resource Usage Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The availability and reliability of web services is an issue of growing concern due to the heavy reliance of people on them and their susceptibility to Denial-of-Service attacks. As a lot of highly critical infrastructure relies on computer networks and web applications, the need to ensure that servers are readily accessible is important for businesses.
