The focus of this paper is the detection and prevention of some of the common low-rate DoS attacks that target the Apache web server. The solution we developed is open-source, does not require a reverse proxy, and is designed to be used by any website operator.

articleTitle: Efficient Method to Monitor Power Consumption in Industry Using Lorawanand Rs485 Retrofit
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this modern era usage of each and every component depends on electric power. Monitoring of power consumption plays a vital role. The main objective of this paper is power monitoring system. LoRaWAN is used for long range wireless communication. A smart meter, also known as an advanced metering system, is a digital metre that is able to measure power consumption. Energy meters with an integrated Serial RS-485 Modbus interface are used that allows data to be stored in cloud. The output recorded from energy meter will be send to cloud using LoRaWAN gateway. The values like voltage, frequency, power factor, Apparent power, current, Voltage to line to line, Voltage to line to Neutral and reactive power are noted.All these values are stored in cloud and analysed using python platform. Reading from Textile industry with three floor was observed for a month. Using the data maximum power consumed day is identified. After identifying the day, the energy meter reading of each component of that particular day is monitor. That data consists of power consumed by each and every component in that particular floor. With the help of that data the component that consumes maximum power can be identified. If a component consumes more power, then there is some defect in that component, with the help of this analysis the defect in that component will be rectified.

articleTitle: Multilingual Chatbot for Indian Languages
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Chatbots are user-friendly interfaces that emulate human dialogue. With the rise of technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Natural Language Processing (NLP), chatbots have become an effective tool in most conversational applications of companies. India is a multiverse country that demands making the chatbot functional in different languages. We present an effective approach to building a multilingual chatbot in Indian languages for fixed-response questions. This technique omits the expensive machine translation task with a large run-time overhead. We implement the chatbot's functionality to answer the query in context by fine-tuning the transformer model to the downstream task of question-answering. The MuRIL BERT model provides the best results for correct response prediction among major multilingual BERT models.

articleTitle: Audio Based Facial Expression Generation On Ar Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The shortcomings of 3D face technology in faithfully recreating human facial expressions, particularly for nuanced emotions, are examined in this research paper. The authors use augmented reality (AR) technology to give enhanced visual experience of the generated voice-over-character animation with expressions. The system receives user-provided audio speech as input, predicts the user’s facial expression from its text, and then displays it on a 3D augmented reality face. The authors also plan to use machine learning algorithms to analyze the emotion of the user’s voice, which could lead to a more personalized experience for the user and enhance engagement and satisfaction in scenarios such as virtual therapy or job interviews, where emotions play a crucial role in communication.

articleTitle: Exploring the Core Components of Cloud Computing and Its Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud computing has been a revolutionary technology disrupting the IT industry for the past decade. It has revolutionized itself for individual, business and company growth. The low cost, scalability and flexibility have made it an innovation for large and small companies to grow themselves, and due to this, it has reached and provided services to millions of users. This article explored the overview of cloud computing, including its architecture, service models, applications, and deployment models. The article also reviewed different research articles and compared various existing approaches. The paper also discusses the current trends and future scope of cloud computing. Load-balancing approaches in cloud computing have been studied and compared on the basis of various factors. At last, the paper highlights the important applications of cloud computing. The article concludes by providing the future scope.

articleTitle: Detection of Covid Disease using Computed Tomography Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: After emerging in Wuhan, China, in December 2019, the coronavirus 2019 (COVID-2019) quickly spread throughout the world and sparked a pandemic. Covid-19 The pandemic affected human health globally. In a few cases of Covid19 humans faced death situations also. The Respiratory system of the human body gets affected by Covid-19 and the severity of Covid-19 leads to death so there is urgent need of fast and efficient automatic diagnosis system of Covid-19 to help medical experts to diagnose this disease quickly and efficiently. This paper’s main objective is to provide a Binary Classification of Covid-19 disease using a dataset obtained from computed tomography. Four Deep Learning existing models ResNet50, Inception V3, DenseNet121 and Efficient Net B0 are employed here. Compared to ResNet50, InceptionV3, and Efficient Net B0, DenseNet121 performs better. DenseNet121 model showed 96.83% as training accuracy and 92% as validation accuracy.

articleTitle: Wheat Disease Detection And Growth Stage Monitoring Using Deep Learning Architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Traditional methods for diagnosing illnesses in wheat plants rely on visual inspections by experts, which is a tedious task. To enhance disease detection in plants, we propose a novel approach called Enhanced Vision CNN, which combines the multi-head attention feature of a vision transformer with the feature extraction powers of a CNN. Combining these methods allows the model to properly describe image features, and effectively capture both global and local information. Furthermore, to overcome limitations in conventional growth monitoring methods, we employ an ensemble approach using DenseNet201, InceptionV3, and InceptionResNetV2 models to track the growth stages of wheat plants. Our enhanced vision CNN model performed admirably in experimental findings, detecting diseases with a 99.4% accuracy. The ensemble models also obtain a growth phase detection accuracy of 88.5%. These results demonstrate the revolutionary potential of our methods for disease diagnosis and growth tracking in wheat plants.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Diabetes Care Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic condition defined by elevated blood sugar levels. Machine learning (ML) has become more and more applied in the prediction and management of diabetes. A significant public health issue, diabetes affects 425 million persons globally. Diabetes consequences like cardiovascular disease, renal failure, and blindness can be avoided or delayed with early diagnosis and effective care of the condition. Additionally, ML has been applied to increase the precision of diabetes diagnosis testing. For instance, when a neural network was used to analyze the results of an oral glucose tolerance test, the model outperformed conventional diagnostic techniques in terms of sensitivity and specificity. Additionally, ML has been used to personalize diabetic medication, track the progression of disease, and forecast the likelihood of complications.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Severity of Air Pollution in an Industrialized Suburb
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid industrialization and urbanization of developing cities have led to severe air pollution, caused mainly by transportation, construction activities, and solid fuel usage for heating and cooking. To address this issue, we have employed machine learning algorithms to analyze the severity of the air quality index and identify the key contributors to air pollution. By determining the most important features, decision-makers can focus on addressing these factors to mitigate air pollution levels. We have done our research study in Durgapur, an industrialized suburb in India, by installing air quality monitoring devices. Our analysis achieves 96% accuracy rate and identifies the crucial aspects such as temperature, humidity, and pollutants like CO and NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Furthermore, we surveyed residents to understand their experiences and concerns regarding air pollution.

articleTitle: NLP based model to convert English speech to Gujarati text for deaf & dumb people
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: NLP (Natural Language Processing) is a use for process Hu-man Language. It is a combination of language and Artificial Intelligence. This paper is helpful to understand about social neuroscience, Translation, speech to text, NLP levels, challenges and Applications of NLP. Deaf and Dumb people of Gujarat use a Gujarati Language as a speech or sign language, therefore there is a need of translating English to Gujarati to help the people to understand the context of the language.Translation of study findings must be done carefully in order to enable the impact of neuroscientific insights on our everyday lives Deaf and Dumb people use Sign Language for communication, as Normal peopleuses a Speech So This paper includes various sign language and speech recognition module for converting Speech -> text -> sign. It includes Speech recognition API like apiai, assemblyai, google-cloud-speech, pocketsphinx, SpeechRecognition, watson-developer-cloud and wit. It represents the development and testing of speech to text and text to speech mechanism with python code. Translation of study findings must be done carefully in order to enable the impact of neuroscientific insights on our everyday lives. It implements English speech by speech recognition API and translates in a Gujarati text. This paper analyze the Precision, Accuracy and Recall on speech to text Datasets. It gives 96% Precision, 83% Recall and 83% Accuracy.

articleTitle: Study and Comparative Analysis of InAs and GaN-Based High Electron Mobility Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this article, a comparative analysis of InAs and GaN-Based High Electron Mobility Transistors (HEMT) is considered and simulated to study their characteristics. The device is formed using a 2D Electron Gas (2DEG) at the interface of the InAs/InGaAs and AlGaN/GaN layers. The InAs and GaN-Based HEMT device structure are optimized for high-power operation by employing a larger barrier thickness and a high sheet density of the 2-DEG. To obtain a solution of Poisson’s equation is coupled with the 1-D Schrodinger equation to derive the mathematical framework for InAs and GaN layer to compute the surface potential, gate current, gate voltage, gate capacitance, I-V characteristics, cut-off frequency, and output conductance.

articleTitle: Integrating YOLOv5 and Pretrained Models to Enhance Wheat Leaf Rust Disease Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: To ensure consistent and dependable wheat production and food security, effective monitoring of leaf rust is essential which will increase the wheat grain yield quality. The wheat diseases are recognized by either experienced analyzers or farmers and this process is too laborious. To solve these issues, a deep learning-based YOLOV5 model along with pre-trained models has been employed for wheat leaf rust disease recognition in this paper. At first, 400 images of wheat in total have been gathered from secondary sources. The YOLOV5 model uses several hyperparameters to generate the wheat leaves masks. Once, the wheat leaves masks have been obtained, the binary classification of the wheat leaf is needed. The binary classification of wheat healthy leave and wheat leaf rust diseased has been performed by VGG16 and VGG19 pre-trained models. The YOLOV5 model has the highest precision, recall, and mAP of 97.8%, 97.3%, and 98.6%. In terms of performance metrics, the VGG16 model produces a higher F1 score (92.89%) than the VGG19 model (86.52%). This study demonstrates the potential of deep learning-based models in the identification and management of wheat leaf rust disease, which can lead to significant improvements in wheat production and food security.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Study on Smart Solar Grid with Embedded System and IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Smart Grid technology is an electricity network which can be used to monitor and resolve the problems by own in electricity transportation with various sources of renewable energy. It can be used to resolve the user demands without affecting the environmental condition. It helps the environment and has the high efficiency of power generation with less losses and economic system. The Smart grid technology has the advantage of making the connections with renewable resources with working grids is possible. The aim of this paper is, to search the best technology which is used in smart solar system in the current scenario. The research on the wide area has been introducing new methods for getting the maximum power in real world scenario. It helps to establish new system with the combinations of variety of existing systems in real time. Systems use various techniques like Machine Learning Technology (ML), Fuzzy Logic (FL), Artificial Intelligence (AI) etc., this article gives an elaborate supplement thinking with recent technologies in the area of smart grid on the current era.

articleTitle: Low Dose Computed Tomography Denoising By Concentrating Noise Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Three dimensional structure of interior body are created by employing X-ray radiation and are known as computed tomography (CT) images. Low Dose CT (LDCT) will lessen the radiation exposure, so that it can lessen its impact on the human body, including genetic and metabolic diseases. The non-stationary noise and streak-like distortions in these images are the main difficulties. The artifacts is due to photon starvation and patient’s mobility. High values of noise in the image domain makes denoising difficult. The primary goal of this study is to offer a prior knowledge of noise distribution by incorporating nonlocal and attention modules into GAN’s learning process. It makes use of CT image’s neighbourhood similarities. The 2016 NIH-AAPM-Mayo Clinic Low Dose CT Grand Challenge dataset used to evaluate our method showed that it outperformed the current state of the art method by a wide margin.

articleTitle: A Novel Waveguide Based Wireless Power Transfer Technique For Horizontal Impinging of Microwave into Dielectric Medium
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Electromagnetic wireless power transfer (WPT) has gained significant attention as a transformative technology for efficient energy transmission in various applications. Though the near-field and mid-field wireless power transfer techniques reduce the risk of RF exposure (as in the case of far-field transmission), these methods are specially confined and require a strict alignment of transmitter-receiver as they transfer power vertically into the media. This paper presents a novel technique to transfer power horizontally through the media non-invasively using a circular waveguide based radio front-end kept vertically to the medium. The proposed technique is validated through intensive simulation studies using ANSYS HFSS. The study showed promising results, especially when the medium of transmission is multilayered.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Image-Based Fire Detection Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fire is one of the most common risks worldwide that is present in all areas of life. It has been identified as one of the major hazards in the United Nations Global Assessment Report. Currently, most fire detection systems use temperature or smoke sensors, which take time to respond. These systems are costly and not effective in case the fire is far away from the detectors. A new detection technology, image fire detection has come forward as a cost effective method that has recently played a crucial role in preventing fire losses by alarming the authorities through early fire detection. It is based on algorithmic analysis of images for classifying them as either containing fire or not containing fire. This could be used for detecting the fire in the video feed from surveillance cameras installed in facilities. Different classification algorithms differ widely on various parameters like accuracy and computation time. In this paper a comparative analysis of various image based methods for detecting fire is done.

articleTitle: Regeneration Sites Identification in Translucent Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In a Translucent Elastic Optical Network, an optical signal can be propagated beyond its transparent reach by 3R regeneration (re-shaping, re-timing and re-timing) at certain nodes identified as regeneration sites. These regeneration sites increase network deployment cost and 3R regeneration of optical signals increases operational costs. So it is desired that optical signals undergoes 3R regeneration as sparingly as possible. This leads to the regeneration sites identification (RSI) problem, an NP-Complete problem. The goal of the RSI problem is to determine the minimum number of regeneration sites at which an optical signal needs to undergo 3R regeneration so that communication between all node pairs in the network can be established. In this paper, we present an Integer Linear Program (ILP) formulation for the problem for small networks and also propose a polynomial time heuristic algorithm ERSI (Efficient Regeneration Sites Identification) for large networks. Simulation results show that our heuristic provides near optimal results and outperforms known heuristics.

articleTitle: Quantitative and Qualitative Analysis of the human upper airway volumes
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A comprehensive review of quantitative and qualitative analysis of the human upper airway regions was performed. The human upper airway is divided into the airway region and paranasal sinuses. These structures are important for breathing and speaking activities. The quantitative and qualitative analysis of the human upper airway helps to understand the structures, sizes, and behaviors, and to develop a patient-specific treatment. This review provides various volumes and includes the factors which are affecting the sizes, shapes, or structure of the regions of the human upper airway with different imaging techniques. This comprehensive review study can be used by experts or researchers to study the quantitative and qualitative analysis of the regions of the human upper airway.

articleTitle: An Investigation to Distinguish the features of DDoS Attacks and Flash Events
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks is one of the hazardous cyber threats affecting top-notch companies of the world. Attackers are strengthening this attack by making a large bot army, including IoT (Internet of Things) devices, against the target and mimicking it as normal Flash Events (FEs) to prevent detection. Many researchers have found the unique characteristics of DDoS attacks only to detect and mitigate them. However, it is crucial to highlight the features that segregate DDoS attacks and FEs. In this study, we first conducted an extensive literature survey, found the characteristics distinguishing DDoS attacks and FEs and mentioned the proposed metrics. Genuine traces have been used to evaluate and validate the characteristics of both. The thorough analysis and results mention various technical differences that can be used to differentiate both DdoS and Flash Events.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Hybrid Index and Number Modulation Schemes over Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing Hybrid Index and Number Modulation (OFDM-HINM) is a newly proposed multicarrier transmission technique by combining both Index Modulation (IM) as well as Subcarrier Number Modulation (SNM). This leads to significant improvement in spectral efficiency (SE) and energy efficiency (EE). It effectively transmits the additional data by changing the both indices and the number of active subcarriers. Hence it creates an additional degree of freedom in both inphase as well as quadrature phase of the modulated signal. Due to this, a significant improvement in data rate is achieved. Hence, it is suitable for next generation wireless communication systems. In this paper, the performance of the HINM is evaluated using computer simulations and compared with the existing OFDM-IM and OFDM-SNM as well as classical OFDM systems under Rayleigh and Rician fading channels. From simulation results, it can be concluded that HINM achieves a lower bit error rate (BER) and higher throughput in contrast to the existing OFDM, OFDM-IM, and SNM systems.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient VM Allocation and Migration Approach Using Swarm Intelligence Algorithm in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The cloud computing environment is a demanding platform to perform large-scale business operations for different clients. Several studies have been carried out in order to minimize the power consumption in data centres. Intelligent VM allocation and migration is an effective approach to minimize unwanted CPU utilization without violating the SLA. The modified best fit decreasing (MBFD) has been employed to allocate the VM to the best available host in an efficient manner. In this paper, a novel swarm intelligence-based Grasshopper optimization technique has been proposed in order to improve the VM selection. The proposed framework provides a significant solution in the cloud data centre for minimizing overall energy consumption. The obtained results using the proposed model are highly efficient in terms of power consumption and SLA violations.

articleTitle: Autonomous wound bite point generation using UNet
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, a deep learning based autonomous wound bite point generation has been proposed. The proposed system consists of two setups Computer Vision (CV) followed by Robotic system. The CV setup consists of a series of steps that involves generating the binary mask of the wound using a U-Net model, which is further processed by the bite point generation algorithm to generate entry and exit points of the suturing needle in 2D space, this is called as CV pipeline. The robotic setup would utilize the results from the previous pipeline to perform the task of maneuvering the end-effectors to the desired location in 3D space. The proposed system’s output has been tested in the virtual environment of the robotic setup. The proposed U-Net model achieved an accuracy of 97% and IOU score of 70%, the entire system was integrated on a user-friendly interface for the ease of the use.

articleTitle: Automatic Piezoelectric Bicycle Headlight
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Piezoelectricity is a phenomenon that occurs in certain materials wherein an electric charge is generated in response to mechanical stress or deformation. This property has been utilised in various fields to generate electrical energy from mechanical sources. This paper proposes an innovative solution for powering bicycle headlights using piezoelectric sensors The proposed solution is environmentally friendly, as it does not rely on external power sources and does not emit any harmful gases. The experimental results demonstrated that the proposed system is capable of generating sufficient electrical energy to power a high-brightness LED headlight, making it a promising solution for sustainable and safe cycling. The system was able to generate an average power output of 13.69 W during normal pedalling conditions and provided illumination for a range of 60–70 cm in front of the bicycle, providing ample visibility for the rider in low light conditions.

articleTitle: Physical Implementation of Multi Power Domain SoC Design
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Most System on Chip (SoC) designs have multiple blocks in it which operate at different voltages, by operating different blocks of the same SoC at different voltages great amount of power saving can be done. Also, there is a direct relationship between Dynamic power and supply voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dd</inf>) (dynamic power is proportional to ${\text{V}}_{{\text{dd}}}^2$). So, if some blocks of SoC can operate at low voltage, the power consumption reduction will happen and lead to better design power performance. But whenever this Multi power domain approach is followed it adds complexity to Floor planning and Power planning to avoid this complexity the framework proposed in the paper can be adopted for Place and Route (P&R) which helps in doing efficient Floorplanning, Power planning and power saving.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Computational Fluid Dynamics Workloads on HPC in the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations are computationally intensive and often require High Performance Computing (HPC) resources to complete within a reasonable timeframe. Traditionally, on-premise HPC clusters have been employed for running CFD simulations. However, with the emergence of cloud computing, the option to utilize HPC in the cloud for CFD simulations has become available. This work presents an architecture for HPC cluster configuration in the cloud, which incorporates essential components such as an HPC job scheduler and a license server. Additionally, we carefully select and integrate various resources and services to optimize scalability and enhance performance specifically for CFD workloads. We perform a comprehensive performance evaluation of commercially available core-based floating license CFD applications on HPC in the cloud. By thoroughly assessing the performance metrics and capabilities of these applications, we contribute to a deeper understanding of their suitability and effectiveness of HPC in the cloud for CFD workloads.

articleTitle: Printing Design Paint Color Composition and Defect Detection in T-Shirt Printing in Rotary Screen Printer
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The T-shirt is a popular garment ingrained in global culture. It comes in various colors with printed applications. Quality is crucial for the final product in "Direct to Garment" rotary printing. Identifying designs and shades accurately is important. Studies show normal humans can distinguish 1 million colors, while "enchroma" individuals perceive only 1% (10,000 colors).The project automates color composition analysis and defect detection for rotary screen printed T-shirts. The thriving textile industry caters to all ages. Designs on T-shirts are essential for aesthetics. Currently, color composition and defect identification are done visually or manually.The project automates these processes by extracting printed designs using Pantone color dataset. Experts provide the designs, which are compared to printed T-shirt images. A web page allows users to upload designs and capture printed images. Errors trigger a buzzer for the printing machine operator.

articleTitle: Pneumonia Detection Using Transfer Learning And Hardware Implementation in Edge TPU
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the modern-day scenario, Machine Learning (ML) holds an important role in providing automation, dataset-based decision-making, security, and healthcare advancements. This paper presents an idea of how Machine Learning algorithms can be used to detect a deadly disease like Pneumonia. It is a problem of image classification where various Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures are used to classify whether the given chest X-ray has Pneumonia or not. At first, a dataset having 5856 chest X-ray images is collected and some data pre-processing is done. These include resizing images, pixel value normalization, and image augmentation (horizontal flip, rotation, etc). Four models are created, one by using CNN architecture and the other three by Transfer Learning using pre-trained models of standard architectures (Resnet50, Densenet121 and VGG19). All four models are trained with same dataset and a comparative study is presented in terms of architectures and performance. With the CNN model, highest accuracy of 92.6% is obtained. Models made using pre-trained models of Resnet50, Densenet121 and VGG19 gave accuracies of 77%, 91% and 91% respectively. This paper also proposes hardware implementation of the CNN model in the Coral Dev board with Edge TPU. After implementation, it is able to classify whether the given sample chest X-ray is ‘NORMAL’ or ‘PNEUMONIA’.

articleTitle: GWO Optimized PI Controller Fed PV Based Interleaved Luo Converter for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A significant role will be played by electric vehicles (EV) and renewable energy sources (RES) in the future as it relates to transportation and energy generation. However, the wide scale application of both these technologies requires an advanced power system architecture, especially in the form of an optimal design of DC-DC converters. An Interleaved Luo Converter (ILC) design is therefore suggested in this study to handle the issue of voltage conversion and control in these applications. The suggested converter type has a high voltage gain and minimal conduction loss, ripple and stress currents. Hence, the proposed converter design is effective in improving the life time of both PV and EV. This research also employs a proportional integral (PI) controller tuned using Grey Wolf Optimisation (GWO) to maintain the output voltage of ILC at a constant value. The credibility of the proposed converter along with controller is tested by modelling and executing its simulation model in MATLAB and by also designing a lab-scaled prototype of the ILC. From the derived results, it is confirmed that ILC functions with a remarkable efficiency of 97.5%.

articleTitle: Smart Protective Vest for Sanitary Workers using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sanitary workers have one of the highest levels of occupational hazards in their sector. This project aims to reduce that harm to an extent. It comprises a smart vest embedded with sensors such as Pulse sensor, Accelerometer and gyroscope sensor, Gas sensor. The microcontroller used is Raspberry pi 3B+. The sensors are fitted onto the vest with the microcontroller, the sensor data is monitored continuously. If any of the sensor readings go above board, notifications are sent to the concerned authorities that are monitoring the worker. If incase, the worker needs immediate retrieval there is a push button embedded on the suit, whilst pressing the button an alarm sound is produced in the speakers alerting the authorities that the worker is seeking help

articleTitle: An Intuitive Convolutional Neural Network to Perceive Tomato Leaf Ailment
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The biological properties of tomato leaves must be categorized to determine if the plant needs to be treated with pesticides or insecticides to produce a decent harvest. To maximize agricultural output, plant diseases must be quickly and accurately identified. A deep learning method that makes use of artificial intelligence may identify illnesses in plants using a huge number of photos of plant leaves. However, it is challenging to properly diagnose illnesses using deep learning with little datasets. A deep learning system that automatically extracts characteristics in a hierarchical fashion named convolutional neural network is suggested in this research. To categorize the characteristics of the leaves into 10 classes such as healthy, bacterial spot, and Septoria leaf spot—neural networks are used. The model detects illness using both saved and real-time photos of tomato plants. In order to determine the proposed model's high degree of its performance is further assessed using adaptive moment estimation (Adam), batch sizes of 32, and varied epochs. The metric for measuring performance that was acquired confirms the effectiveness of the technique. The technique is helpful for managing tomato plant disease and for remedial action.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning using Very Deep Pre-Trained Models for Food Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automated food image classification is a significant research problem given the large number of food-related photographs flooding the social media and the internet. Food image classification is mainly practiced with the help of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) having many hidden layers that are known as deep CNNs. The deep pre-trained CNN architectures have evolved over the past few years; they operate on the concept of transfer learning of knowledge from one domain to the other. In this paper, we have analyzed the performances of five popular very deep pre-trained networks namely, Inception-v3 with 48 layers, EfficientNet-B0 with 237 layers, Xception with 71 layers, DenseNet-121 with 121 layers, and MobileNet with 53 layers, for the classification of food images from the benchmark Food-101 dataset comprising of 101 food categories. Our experiments prove that Xception gives the best performance for classifying the 101 categories of food images, with an accuracy of 84.54%, significantly outperforming the other deep pre-trained networks.

articleTitle: Mobile Cloud Offloading: An Analysis of Methodologies, Limitations, and Research Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the Eleven unfold and undeveloped countries mutual possess or mobile phone sharing, and many owns their phone is far extra recurrent than sharing with others. In seven nations, more than 50 percentage currently have smartphone, and smartphone ownership is especially prevalent among younger and more educational populations. But mobile devices have yet to match the computational power of their desktop equivalents, and their performance and usefulness are far lower than those of desktop computers. It blocks the developer from developing effective or futuristic applications in mobile. The offloading process methods section details the different steps involved in the MCO process, including application segmentation, preparation, and deployment. The general obstacles and difficulties section discusses the various challenges encountered in MCO, such as platform variety, mobile cloud application security and privacy, fault tolerance, and on-going connectivity, automatic mechanism for offloading, and offloading economics and costs. The open research issue in MCO section discusses the current gaps in the research and opportunities for future work. The latest trends and research problems in MCO section highlights the recent developments in MCO, including the increasing interest in edge offloading and the need for energy-efficient offloading techniques. Finally, the gaps in current research and future direction section outlines the critical areas that require further research attention, such as developing new offloading techniques that can adapt to dynamic network conditions, addressing the challenges of heterogeneous mobile devices, and improving the security and privacy of mobile cloud applications. This survey paper provides valuable insights into MCO, its challenges, and opportunities, and identifies future research directions in this field.

articleTitle: Light-weight Deep Learning Model for Cataract Detection using Novel Activation Function
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In cataracts, the natural lens behind the iris and pupil is cloudy, which causes light passing through it to be distorted or blocked, causing blurry or dim vision. About 50% of all cases of blindness worldwide is caused by cataract, according to WHO and the National Library of Medicine. A timely diagnosis of cataracts can help prevent vision loss and other disease-related complications. Several recent developments in machine learning have significantly impacted medical science. However, most existing approaches for cataract detection are based on traditional machine learning techniques. There have been a few attempts to use deep learning in recent years; the models have delivered decent outcomes but require much computational power. Reducing ophthalmologists’ time can improve patient outcomes, increase access to care, lower costs, address workforce shortages, and improve healthcare efficiency. It allows ophthalmologists to see more patients and provide more accurate, timely diagnoses and treatments. Using lightweight deep learning algorithms, this paper proposes a solution that delivers rapid and precise results without requiring high-end hardware. A novel activation function is also proposed that significantly improved the performance. The proposed model is a lightweight one that achieved 95.8% accuracy using only 16,874 parameters.

articleTitle: Identification Of Users with Social Behavioural Biometrics On Twitter
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Online Social Network (OSN) platforms provide a valuable source of information, which includes user profiles and social connections that can be used to develop behavioural models of individuals. Tweets of four Twitter users are analysed and a method is proposed to identify users. The Twitter text data is pre-processed to get meaningful words to extract features of every user. Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) is employed to eliminate features with lower weights, extract essential features from the text, and retrieve the corresponding word vectors using a pre-trained Word2Vec model. These word vectors are input to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and CNN-LSTM for classification to generate a model to predict the user. The experimental results achieved an accuracy of 64.41% in identifying a user in a particular category. When the behavioural patterns of users change over time, it could be challenging to develop an accurate model calling for frequent updating of models. The proposed model can identify users on social media platforms by analyzing behavioural patterns from text data. This can enhance the security and trustworthiness of social media platforms. It can also identify attempts at impersonating other users by analysing behavioural patterns.

articleTitle: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder detection using deep learning approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: ADHD, a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by hyperactivity, inattention, and impulsivity, has many detrimental impacts and is out of proportion to age. ADHD causes executive failure and emotional instability, which can lower academic performance. We propose a machine learning and artificial intelligence-driven approach to diagnose and early detect this disease and assist ADHD medicine. SVM, logistic regression, XGBoost, AdaBoost, and two deep learning models were applied to our dataset (ANN and CNN). Our ANN model had 99% accuracy in dependability, expandability, and generalizability. We plan to use our machine learning technology to enhance ADHD diagnosis and treatment for everyone.

articleTitle: Route Of Soil Communication Using Wireless Underground Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A specific kind of wireless sensor network called a Wireless Underground Sensor Network (WUSN) focuses on underground sensors for irrigation and environmental monitoring. Sensors can now wirelessly connect thanks to WUSNs, making it possible to continuously collect data and exercise control over previously inaccessible subsurface spaces. The use of subsurface sensors enables more accurate sensing even though communication through the underground medium presents several difficulties, including significant attenuation, multi-path fading, and signal interference. WUSNs can measure the temperature, soil moisture, and other vital factors influencing crop growth and yield. They can also keep an eye on seismic activity and environmental factors like water and air quality. WUSNs provide several benefits, including low maintenance needs, energy efficiency, and autonomous operation. They are perfect for usage in isolated and dangerous locations including underground mines, oil wells, and nuclear power plants. They can also be used to follow the movement of subterranean water supplies, find pipeline leaks, and check on the structural condition of buildings and bridges. In summary, Wireless Underground Sensor Networks (WUSNs) can completely change the sensing industry. WUSNs have the potential to revolutionize a variety of applications, including precision agriculture, environmental monitoring, and subsurface mining, thanks to continuous research and development.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation using SC-PRLS for underwater Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sparseness controlled proportionate recursive least square algorithm (SC-PRLS) was proposed to work with a time-varying sparse environment. PRLS and SC-IPNLMS inspired it. The proportionate matrix distributes gain among filter coefficients during the updating process. The gain distribution coefficient is calculated using a degree of sparseness to deal with varying sparsity. The underwater acoustic (UWA) channel model considered different characteristics of the channel. By changing the channel impairments, UWA channel sparsity can be modified. The modeled UWA Channel was estimated using PRLS and SC-PRLS. The simulation was done in MATLAB for UWA channel estimation. The simulated results validate better tracking accuracy in a variable sparse environment. The convergence rate and steady-state error are both better for SC-PRLS than PRLS. For SC-PRLS, convergence begins at 105 iterations, but for PRLS, it begins at 160 iterations. For PRLS and SC-PRLS, the steady state error is found to be approximately 24.5 dB and 28 dB, respectively. It can be suggested that SC-PRLS performs better in all sparse conditions like sparse, relatively less sparse, and highly sparse environments. SC-PRLS also gives an overall robust performance.

Author Keywords: Sparseness controlled proportionate recursive least square algorithm

articleTitle: An Iot-Based Sustainable Energy Monitoring And Alert System With Billing Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research project aims to develop an embedded system utilizing Arduino Uno to integrate energy monitoring and environmental sensing capabilities. The main objectives include the implementation of a power measurement circuit for precise electricity consumption measurement, the monitoring of temperature and humidity levels, seamless data transmission to the ThingSpeak cloud platform, and the provision of a user-friendly interface for data visualization. The anticipated outcomes consist of a fully operational embedded system that enables real-time energy consumption measurement, temperature and humidity sensing, reliable cloud-based data transmission, intuitive data visualization interfaces, threshold breach notifications, secure data storage, and improved awareness of energy consumption for informed decision-making. The successful completion of this project will contribute to optimizing energy usage and promoting sustainability in residential settings.

articleTitle: High performance FIR Architecture for EOG Signal Noise Supression
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A unique architecture for a Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filter is proposed in this study to efficiently reduce noise in Electrooculography (EOG) signals. Electromagnetic interference (EMI) and muscular activity are two common sources of noise that regularly alter EOG signals, which are utilized to identify eye movements. Real-time applications can be challenging for conventional FIR filter architectures because of their restrictions on power consumption and delay. By utilizing a state-of-the-art technique for coefficient quantization that reduces the number of multipliers required in the filter, the recommended architecture gets around these shortcomings. FPGA implementation leverages the reconfigurability and parallel processing capabilities of FPGAs to achieve efficient denoising. The systolic FIR filter is implemented on an FPGA platform to achieve real-time denoising of EOG signals. The systolic architecture allows for efficient parallel processing of the input signal samples, resulting in high throughput and low latency. The implementation is verified using EOG signal datasets, and the denoising performance is evaluated in terms of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and mean square error (MSE).

articleTitle: Detection and Staging of Invasive Ductal Carcinoma Using Deep Learning and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Breast Cancer occurs when cells in the breast grow and multiply in an uncontrolled manner. It can be localised or spread to and invade other parts of the body. Invasive Ductal Carcinoma is the most frequent sub-type of Breast Cancer documenting for over 75% of all Breast Cancer cases. Detection and diagnosis of IDC involves a combination of tests and procedures. This process can be challenging and time consuming. Usage of AI can greatly aid this process by reducing false positives and as an implication, reduce diagnosis times. Early detection and diagnosis can improve survival numbers significantly. This paper explores the prediction of malignancy, detection of IDC, predicts its appropriate stage and compares the performance of several algorithms with varying accuracies with the highest one yielding 97.32%

articleTitle: IoT- Based Cattle Environment and Wellness Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Farmers are becoming increasingly worried about protecting their cattle because animal health and well-being are essential. Furthermore, monitoring the state of animals on a daily basis is complicated because workers lack the time to examine animals and detect early signs of sickness, and environmental conditions have such an effect on cattle health. The proposed system consists of sensors and microcontroller, cloud, and an android application for maintaining the cattle shed environment, regulating livestock health, and environmental conditions. The sensors monitor and collect environmental parameters such as temperature, soil moisture, fire detection, rain level, and gas values. The ESP32 microcontroller is utilized, and the Esp32Sensor component provides access to the Esp32 board’s in- targeted sensors. To configure the ESP32, the Arduino Integrated Development Environment (IDE) is utilized. The data is processed entirely in the ESP32 microcontroller using embedded C. The DHT11 sensor detects temperature using Negative Temperature Coefficient (NTC) and sends serial data to the ESP32 through the Data port. The ESP32 monitors the temperature, and, if the threshold is exceeded, the cooling fan connected via the relay is activated. The soil moisture sensor provides an analog output pin that emits voltage that is proportional to its moisture level. ESP32 activates a pump to irrigate the plants when the level is low. Raindrop Sensors are made up of two parts: a raindrop module that detects whether or not it is raining and a control board that processes data from the raindrop module by translating resistance into a voltage drop between the analog pin and ground. The MQ2 gas sensor detects methane. The MQ2 gas sensor generates output determined by a specified threshold through the potentiometer and the operating voltage of the microcontroller via LM393 dual comparator. Google Firebase, which aids in real- time tracking, is linked to the ESP32. The Firebase ESP Client library is used in the Arduino IDE. Google FireBase is coupled with the Android app. Using the mobile application, the farmer can access this data from anywhere and at any time. In the event of an anomaly, the farmer is notified via the end-user application

articleTitle: Autoencoder-Based Anomaly Detection in ECG Image Time Series Data: A Comparative Evaluation of Three Different Architectures
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Anomaly detection is an essential component of machine learning that renders the outcomes neutral to any category or class. Due to the wide range of anomalies that might exist in time-series data, it plays a crucial role in time-series modelling. This research paper presents an image reconstruction-based approach for anomaly detection in electrocardiogram (ECG) time series data and image data using three different autoencoders, and concludes with a comparison analysis. Anomaly detection is crucial for accurate diagnosis and treatment of heart diseases, and the proposed approach utilizes three types of autoencoders to learn the normal patterns in image data and identify any deviations from these patterns as anomalies. The approach uses a dataset of normal images and is tested on a dataset containing both normal and anomalous images. To reconstruct unseen data like anomalies, models trained only on normal sets will not be able to do so. The results demonstrate that all three types of autoencoders can effectively reconstruct the images, but the Convolutional Autoencoder was able to reconstruct most of the anomaly images correctly, which may not be ideal for anomaly detection. On the other hand, the Deep Autoencoder and Stacked Autoencoder show the reconstruction of the anomalies similar to the normal images, hence, can be very effective for detecting anomalies in ECG image time-series data and similar problems. The proposed approach demonstrates the effectiveness of autoencoder-based anomaly detection for image data and provides a comparative analysis of different types of autoencoders for this task. This can potentially improve the accuracy and efficiency of anomaly detection in various image datasets.

articleTitle: Bilinear Upsampling Gradients Using Convolutions In Neural Networks - Generalization To Other Schemes
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Image upsampling in deep learning is used to increase the resolution of the image or intermediate feature maps in many state-of-the-art neural network models. The methods of interpolation used by upsamplers include nearest neighbour interpolation, bilinear interpolation etc. In this paper we consider the computation of gradient of a bilinear image interpolator in the back propagation stage of gradient descent. Conventionally, image upsampler gradients are known to be computationally expensive and are likely to produce non-deterministic output because of Read-Modify-Write (RMW) operations on SIMD or vector processors. In this paper, we try to solve these problems involved in upsampling gradient computations by proposing an algorithm based on convolutions. We propose the algorithm taking bilinear interpolation as an example and generalize the concept to other interpolation schemes. The proposed algorithm is proved to be accelerated by matrix multiplication engines specialized at performing convolutions. Simulation results of the proposed convolution based algorithm also reflect the efficiency of the proposed algorithm in overcoming the above mentioned challenges faced by the conventional algorithms.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach based on Probability Color Distribution and Color Models to Detect Salient Object
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A salient object is the most important object in the scene which attracts to the human visual system. Salient object detection has been attracting a lot of interest, and recently various heuristic computational models have been designed. This paper presents a novel approach consisting of an algorithm based on RGB and HSV color models, and probability color distribution for detecting an appropriate salient object. Firstly, the proposed algorithm removes the background pixels of the image by subtracting the average mean of RGB channels from all the channels. Thus, fewer contributing regions from the channels are removed; still, a few non-salient regions remain. Then, the mean of the RGB component is subtracted from each RGB image respectively to remove less prominent pixels of each component and a most probable salient region is obtained after combining. This image is converted into HSV color. Hue and saturation have a strong representation of the salient object. The mean of HSV is computed to remove the non-salient region. The small mean image of HSV is multiplied by the maximum mean image of RGB to obtain higher probability color regions representing the salient region. Then, the salient region is pipelined to probability color distribution computation for non-salient region removal and finalizing correct detection of the salient object.

articleTitle: Health and Environment Monitoring System for Viral Respiratory Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The proposed system in this work is a contactless health and environment monitoring system designed after conducting a literature review on the most recent research on viral respiratory diseases and their impact on businesses, risk factors of a location, and surveillance of people for various safety measures and causes leading to its spread. The proposed system takes the form of an Android Mobile Application, designed to function as a safety entry checkpoint for various organizations, including businesses and educational institutions. It aims to detect viral respiratory diseases by leveraging the capabilities of a smartphone camera without requiring any additional external hardware specifications. Furthermore, the system incorporates users’ vaccination information, enabling a comprehensive assessment of health and safety. The key algorithms presented in this work focus on measuring critical body vital signs, including heart rate, temperature, and oxygen saturation (Oxygen saturation (SpO2)) levels. By utilizing advanced techniques such as mask detection and social distance monitoring, the system ensures the recognition of disease indicators and triggers appropriate actions to minimize the risk of transmission. To assess the safety of an area or environment, the proposed system employs the Euclidean distance metric and MobileNetV2, a state-of-the-art deep learning model. This combination enables real-time evaluation and analysis of the surroundings, providing crucial information for making informed decisions regarding the level of safety in a given location.

articleTitle: The Use Of Deep Learning In Music Genre Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: There has been an ever growing demand for a better music recommendation system which beats the traditional ones. Before recommending any song it is crucial that a prior classification of songs is achieved with the highest level of accuracy. This research paper is primarily focussed on categorizing the songs based on its genre. In order to achieve this, the sequential Neural network model with several layers of densely connected neurons, dropout regularization, and a Softmax output layer is trained on a large dataset containing the features extracted from the audio samples. The previous model has been upgraded with the aid of the CNN deep learning model.

articleTitle: Minutes: Hybrid Text Summarizer for Online Meetings
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Online meetings have become commonplace, making it difficult to keep up. A summarizer for meetings, that captures the meeting content concisely, can prove to be beneficial. Meeting Summarization involves two key modules: Speech-to-text conversion that extracts transcripts from the meeting audio, and a hybrid text summarization model, incorporating extractive and abstractive summarization approaches. Extractive summarization was implemented using a centroid-based method that utilizes the compositional capabilities of word embeddings to capture the semantic relationships between sentences. The extracted sentences are fed to an abstractive model which uses the BART model as a general baseline. The BART model was fine-tuned on a dataset and optimized to generate better quality summaries. The T5 model has been used to generate one-line abstractive summaries. The models were evaluated using quantitative and qualitative testing. The summarizer thus assists the user to run through the important aspects of the meeting at a later stage.

articleTitle: Assembly Line Stoppage Prediction at Mahindra Tractor Plant, Hingna
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Manufacturing operations often are dictated by employee productivity. Especially in the case of factories like the Mahindra Tractor Plant which is involved in the assembling of tractors, where the production involves assembly of thousands of small parts in an assembly line, and this production being carried out is semi-manual. Factors such as operator fatigue, stress, and training can have a significant impact on the performance of the assembly line. The use of statistical and machine learning techniques can provide valuable insights for identifying the frequency and duration of stoppages and reporting the overall performance of the assembly line, so that preventive action can be taken on the line.This paper provides a method to predict this frequency and determine hourly stoppages by taking account of factors such as the current models being manufactured, its quantity, previous reasons for failure with the same model, and the corresponding frequency by making use of machine learning techniques like logistic regression, decision tree, and finally a hybrid CNN-LSTM deep learning model along with techniques to reduce the effect of lack of high number of input factors which are used in existing predictive methods to capture the trend of such stoppages based on historical data.

articleTitle: Key Generation using Pseudorandom Number Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cryptography is crucial for securing data, and the rise of online transaction processing has raised the necessity for security. Cryptography uses various encryption methods to protect sensitive data from threats, which calls for cryptographic keys. Any encryption or decryption method is often built on cryptographic keys. The cryptographic key gives strength to the encryption algorithm. It increases its security, so the generation of keys are essential to data encryption. The significance of any algorithm lies in the fact that the keys are not duplicated so that it is not possible to break. The key is truly random, then perfect secrecy can be obtained. In the paper, we are generating the key using a pseudorandom number generator so that it is complex for any attacker to break the cryptographic key.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model to Improve Teaching-Learning Process using Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The integration of teacher capabilities and teaching quality has become a crucial concern in today’s Outcome-Based Education (OBE) in higher educational institutes. In addition, there is a requirement to utilize the vast amounts of textual qualitative data obtained through stakeholder’s input, primarily the responses to open-ended inquiries, which pose a significant problem to academics and institutions alike. The present research assesses instructors' interpersonal abilities using sentiment analysis techniques. We evaluated certain skills using aspect-based sentiment severity of the over 4,000 inputs left by Stakeholders for higher learning. The latest deep learning models and visualization frameworks were used to carry out the sentiment assessment system. According to the research presented, certain abilities are brought to light using aspect-driven sentiment analysis by the course’s structure, teacher’s teaching, and student’s learning. Additionally, the results show that stakeholders have an equally monolithic and converging perspective, supporting the legitimacy of their opinions and their significant involvement towards the tracking of the teaching environment generally concerning the ultimate aim of improving learning of the students.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Traditional versus Blockchain-based Voting Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Voting holds immense importance in any democracy, serving as the bedrock of any country's democratic structure. It possesses the transformative potential to shape the nation’s future. However, the history of elections and the voting process has witnessed significant developments. Initially, paper ballots and laborious counting methods were employed, but they faced severe criticism due to fraudulent practices and booth capturing. To address the shortcomings of the paper ballot system, Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) emerged as a technological advancement. EVMs addressed paper ballot drawbacks but concerns persist over hacking, fraud, software programming, manufacturer affiliations, machine security, and vote storage. An alternative to the prevalent EVM system is a blockchain-based voting system, although it has limitations. The primary objective of this paper is to present the working of traditional, EVM, and blockchain-based voting systems. Finally, the objective is to present a comparison between traditional, EVM, and blockchain-based voting systems.

articleTitle: Innovative Approaches to Java Plum Leaf Disease Identification: Federated Learning meets Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The spread of plant diseases negatively impacts agricultural output considerably, demanding quick, accurate, and reliable detection techniques. This paper presents a revolutionary method for classifying four types of Java plum leaf illnesses using a federated learning convolutional neural network (FL-CNN) model. The study achieves the combined goals of improving illness diagnosis accuracy and protecting data privacy across distant datasets using federated learning capabilities. The FL-CNN model was tested on a testbed consisting of five clients, each with its unique local dataset. The local performance indicators, such as precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy, consistently showed great values of over 90% for each client across all illness classes, highlighting the model's effectiveness. Client 4 achieved the most incredible local precision for Class A illness (96.35%). The global model showed similarly encouraging results once federated averaging was applied to the model parameters, with precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy values consistently close to 95%, 88%, 91%, and 0.96 across the five clients, respectively. Three global aggregation techniques were also studied in this study: macro, weighted, and micro averages. For the five customers, the macro average showed performance values ranging from 89.52% to 91.67%. A similar pattern was seen in the weighted average, with values ranging between 89.47% and 91.72%. Finally, the micro average showed that Client 1 performed better than the other clients (91.82%), with values for the other clients hovering around 91.41%. These consistently strong performance measures, locally and internationally, show how the FL-CNN model is resilient and flexible regarding various assessment approaches. The study demonstrates how federated learning may improve illness diagnosis while maintaining data privacy, opening the door for more research in this exciting area.

articleTitle: Real Time Biometric Authentication System Using ECG
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Reliable identity verification and authentication processes are now crucial and urgent duties for protecting the integrity of the devices and sensitive data. Passwords have shown some of their flaws, despite the fact that they have offered access control and authentication. Biometrics are the best authentication method due to their speed and convenience, and they have a low chance of being hacked. Electrocardiogram (ECG) has garnered the most interest from the biometrics field in order to get over the limitations of the traditional biometric systems because to its highly personalised character, ubiquity, and difficulty in forging them. The absence of substantial ECG databases, however, poses one of the biggest problems for the development of biometrics based on ECG. The person's capacity for authentication is strengthened by this study. There was much discussion about the investigation of filtering type, segmentation, feature extraction, and classifier usage. The six best P-QRS-T fragments are then extracted based on priority, and their positions are normalised using non-fiducial symlets and non-fiducial daubechies. This efficient feature extraction approach for ECG is then created. The proposed approach is then tested using the demanding, accessible MIT-BIH data base. The KNN classifier is compared using performance parameters, and the results show that, when compared to earlier literature, KNN classifiers offer an overall classification accuracy of 99.2%.

articleTitle: Improved Dynamic Collision Recovery in Wireless Ad-Hoc Networks: System and RTL Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wireless ad-hoc networks are local area networks that are built without a centralized administration point. They are widely utilised in many applications, particularly those involving the Internet of Things (IoT), such as environmental monitoring, smart homes, smart agriculture, and many other IoT applications. However, when the network's size grows, network throughput rapidly declines, mainly because of more collisions. According to the IEEE 802.11 standard, the carrier sense multiple access with collision avoidance protocol is the basic medium access control technique used by the 802.11 standard, also known as the distributed coordination function. It uses the Binary Exponential Backoff (BEB) algorithm for collision avoidance. Avoiding collisions will optimize the network with regard to throughput. This paper proposes an improved dynamic backoff algorithm called Dynamic Enhanced Collision Resolution Algorithm (D-ECRA), which improves the recently introduced Enhanced Collision Resolution Algorithm (ECRA) by replacing the contention window exponential increment with a less aggressive and dynamic contention window increment based on the network’s size. The Register Transfer Level (RTL) design of D-ECRA is proposed using Verilog HDL. Results demonstrate that D-ECRA surpasses BEB and ECRA with regard to throughput with a maximum improvement percentage of 4% and 1.2% respectively. Also, results showed that D-ECRA performed better than ECRA with regard to delay with a maximum improvement percentage of 43%. This thesis shows the assessment process for D-ECRA including simulation parameters and test scenarios for both system and RTL modelling.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Analysis of Forecasting Gold Prices using Neural Network Models: A Review and Future Research Agenda
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The surge in gold prices following the COVID-19 crisis has sparked significant interest among investors, portfolio managers, and speculators regarding investment in gold. This research paper employs bibliometric analysis to examine 202 Scopus-indexed journal articles published in English that focus on forecasting gold prices using neural network models. The study covers the period from 1993 to 2023, aiming to provide a comprehensive overview of the academic literature in this field. Through bibliometric analysis, we identify the most influential articles, prominent journals, leading authors, prestigious institutes, and noteworthy countries contributing to the research on gold price forecasting. This analysis sheds light on the key trends and research hotspots within this domain. Furthermore, this paper puts forth a future research agenda to guide future investigations in this domain. Overall, this study offers valuable insights into the existing literature on forecasting gold prices with neural network models and presents a roadmap for future research endeavors in this captivating field.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Heritage Site Information Retrieval: A Deep Learning Approach Utilizing CNN and SVM for Effective Classification of Cultural Heritage Sites
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Categorizing cultural heritage photographs into many categories, such as historical relevance, architectural features, and preservation status, is necessary for retrieving information from heritage sites. This research investigates categorising photographs from historical sites using deep learning methods like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM). For classification, we created a system that used a CNN model with three convolutional layers, four max-pooling layers, a fully connected layer, and an SVM model. Our model classified the 8645 photos in the dataset utilized in this research into six separate categories, with an overall accuracy of 0. 89091. To create a successful historic site information retrieval system, comprehensive data collection and processing, feature extraction, algorithm creation, and assessment metrics are essential. We review the methods and strategies used in each process and the difficulties and constraints faced during the system's development and testing. To obtain high classification accuracy, thorough data processing and model optimization is crucial. Our results show the potential of deep learning techniques for historic site information retrieval. Future research might increase the dataset's size further to verify the efficacy of the CNN and SVM models to include additional categories and pictures. It may also be investigated to optimize the CNN and SVM models further to increase classification accuracy. Overall, our work offers insights into the significance of meticulous data processing and model optimization in creating an efficient system and adds to developing a heritage site information retrieval system utilizing CNN and SVM algorithms.

articleTitle: A Review: Binary Classification and Hybrid Segmentation of Brain Stroke using Transfer Learning-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A medical disorder called a stroke is when the brain's natural blood flow is disrupted, killing brain tissue. After cancer and myocardial infarction, stroke is the third leading cause of morbidity in the world and the main factor causing developed disability. Automatic stroke lesion segmentation can predict the volume and location of the damaged tissue, which might be useful in clinical practice to more accurately assess and weigh the challenges of various treatments. Machine learning (ML) is a powerful tool in healthcare settings that can quickly and accurately anticipate outcomes and offer stroke victims specialized therapeutic therapy. Despite the growing usage of ML and Deep Learning in healthcare, some research fields are not getting enough attention for scientific discovery, regardless of the obvious need for the study. This study gives a general overview of brain stroke, the risk factors connected to them, and a brief discussion of the many methods used to identify brain stroke automatically. In-depth details about some deep learning-based and image-processing techniques are provided in this paper. This study examines the techniques for diagnosing brain stroke that have been discussed in the literature during the past five years (2018–2022). Also, a comparison table is mentioned. Nevertheless, brain stroke segmentation and classification has acquired recent growing attention as a practical and noteworthy alternative among the stated options.

articleTitle: Automatic License Plate Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: ALPR, also known as Automatic License Plate Recognition, is a technological system that employs the characters displayed on a vehicle’s license plate to identify and distinguish the vehicle. This information can be used create a reliable license plate-based automatic vehicle identification system. The technology is put into place at security inspection entries in extremely restricted and secure regions including military zones and areas close to significant government institutions like the Supreme Court and Parliament. The suggested ALPR system employs a multi-step approach that involves optical character recognition (OCR), image processing, and character segmentation. In the image processing stage, techniques such as edge detection, noise reduction, and image enhancement are utilized to enhance the quality of the input images. Individual characters are then separated from the license plate by using the character segmentation module, resolving issues like overlapping characters, different fonts, and varying license plate sizes. Through the use of machine learning and pattern recognition algorithms, the OCR module identifies and extracts alphanumeric characters from the segmented regions. The efficiency of the suggested ALPR system is shown by experimental findings, achieving an overall accuracy of 90% with high precision and recall rates for license plate identification. The system's processing time has been observed to fall within acceptable limits, enabling its real-time implementation in practical applications.

articleTitle: Detecting Helmets Of The Bike Riders Using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: We propose real-time bike helmet detection in our study. A lot of people ride bikes in our nation. Motorbikes are more popular than vehicles because they are cheaper to maintain, take up less parking space, and provide more mobility and adaptability in urban situations. Bike riding is entertaining yet risky. Bicyclist safety is the planned system's main purpose. Many drivers don't wear helmets even though they're mandated by law.
