Three categories exist for load forecasting where first is long-term load forecasting which is also known as LTLF, predicted to last for three to five years; second is medium-term load forecasting which is also known as MTLF, predicted to last for three months to three years; and third is short-term load forecasting which is also known as STLF, predicted to one day to six weeks are covered under the predicting period. Several variables, like the weather, the rate of expansion, and new clients, have an impact on STLF. In this study, machine learning methods are used to analyze data from smart meters related to energy consumption. This study illustrates how accurate future forecasts of electricity consumption or production may be produced using machine learning techniques by contrasting the multiprocessing machine learning techniques used in STLF with data variables.

articleTitle: A Biometric-Finger Vein Authentication System for Security Purpose using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Biometrics uses human physiological characteristics, is one way of protecting personal information. The usage of finger vein as a form of biometric become most popular method recently. Finger vein authentication provides a high level of security and accuracy, making it a reliable biometric authentication method. Finger vein authentication system compares the vascular structure of a person's finger with previously acquired data. This technique involves identifying patterns in vein images of human fingers below the skin's surface. The proposed system aims to enhance the security of user authentication by utilizing the unique features of finger vein patterns. The finger vein image is acquired from the database. The preprocessing done in order to remove the noise by means of Gaussian median filter in spatial domain and frequency domain. The segmentation of the image carried out through line tracking method which provided the better contrast image. The system utilizes Convolutional Neural Networks for feature extraction and the features are matched with the finger vein database. Then Deep Learning Approach used for classification of finger vein patterns between genuine and imposter users. For real-time communication the scanner scans the finger vein and send to Arduino board for storage followed by MATLAB for processing and classification of the images. The result is sent through GSM module as alarm or message. Then the information also stored in IoT for future references. with the user a GSM Module is integrated. The proposed system gives an accuracy of 96%. Thus, system is beneficial in several security applications such as access control, identity verification, banking system, and financial transactions.

articleTitle: Brain Image Segmentation for Tumor Detection Using Ensemble Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Brain tumors can develop when abnormal cells in the brain grow uncontrollably, and MRI images provide valuable information about the presence of unwanted tissue growth. Numerous academic publications have utilized machine learning and deep learning algorithms to detect malignant tumors. These algorithms can swiftly identify brain tumors in MRI scans, leading to faster prediction times and improved precision, thereby facilitating easier patient treatment. Radiologists benefit from the accelerated decision-making process enabled by these predictive models. The proposed study evaluates the performance of Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) and Sigmoid activation function-based Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) networks for the detection of brain tumors.

articleTitle: Enhancing Credit Card Fraud Detection with hybrid Squirrel Search - Honey Badger Algorithm Optimized Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Imbalanced datasets are a common challenge in machine learning, where the minority class is often underrepresented, leading to biased model performance. In this paper, we propose a novel approach that combines Weighted SMOTE based on Cross-Validation Uncertainty with a hybrid Squirrel Search -Honey Badger Algorithm (hSS-HBA) optimized neural network to address this challenge. The proposed approach generates synthetic samples that are better aligned with the underlying data distribution, and utilizes the hSS-HBA to optimize the neural network model. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in improving model performance in terms of accuracy and F1-score. Our model has achieved an accuracy of 99.97% and an F1 Score of 0.9000, offering a promising solution for addressing the challenges of imbalanced datasets in practical use.

articleTitle: EEG Data reduction with Epileptic Seizure Detection based machine learning in IoMT Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: There is a greater demand to enhance intelligent healthcare systems in order to keep track of the medical condition of patients. This demand leads to increase the interest in remote healthcare systems that make use of biosensors. These biosensors generate a significant amount of vital sensed data, which is then sent to the edge of the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) for processing before being sent on to the data centers of the cloud. In this paper, we propose an EEG data reduction and epileptic seizures detection in IoMT networks. The suggested method operates on 2 levels within the network: edge and fog levels. At the edge gateway, The EEG data is transformed into time-frequency representations using Short Time Fourier Transformation (STFT). Then, a set of statistical texture feature based on the gray level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) is extracted. These EEG based features are then compressed before being sent to the fog gateway using a binary-encoded representative method. In Fog Gateway, the received encoded features are decoded and passed into a classifier to determine the patient's situation. A set of classifiers are used to evaluate the proposed method using the Bonn University dataset. The proposed technique demonstrates the outperformance of the proposed method by achieving an accuracy of (100%) in multiple cases and an acceptable accuracy for other cases while considering fewer features compared to existing work.

articleTitle: Facial Detection and Anonymization for Privacy Protection from Social Networking Sites(SNS)
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A social networking site (SNS) is an incredible information exchange platform that helps advance and shares a lot of useful information regarding items, news, training, travel, medical care, etc. However, there are a lot of risks involved with protecting a person's safety and security. Posts of photos online can be shared, labeled, and reposted again without the permission of the individuals pictured. Using facial recognition, we propose a framework for identifying each person and examining the web-based account connections between people. Replicated, labeled, or replicated posts will be checked, regardless of whether they're by a known or unknown individual. Whenever a person is obscure, the images are convolved through a low-pass filter in order to eliminate clamor and edges that obstruct the image. The proposed solution used deep-learning-based VGG19 engineering to characterize pictures, Haar overflow viola jones calculations for location, and PC vision-based obscuring methods to remove objects from the picture. Thus, a region under the ROC curve (AUC) precision of 88% was achieved. There was a 91.53% accuracy achieved by using the proposed model, and we also assessed the model using Precision, Accuracy, Review, and F1-Score matrices, which yielded an accuracy of 70.83%, 82%, 71%, and 0.68% respectively.

articleTitle: Face Detection and Recognition Using OpenCV and Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Face recognition technology is vital in the real world with diverse applications. It is primarily used for security, law enforcement, personalization, healthcare, and education. Face recognition systems use biometric features like facial landmarks, texture, and shape to identify and verify individuals. The suggested approach employs a transformer-based architecture that solely relies on self-attention and does not utilize Convolutional Layers. This design choice enables the model to be trained efficiently with minimal computational power and fewer parameters than a CNN. The application of Vision Transformer (ViT) in various computer vision tasks has been highly successful, making it a state-of-the-art approach. Given its superior performance, we are interested in exploring whether ViT can enhance the accuracy of sheep face recognition.In this paper, we show that ViT can be a useful technique for facial recognition. Since there was no predefined dataset for face recognition, a PCI dataset was built for this investigation. Along with the PCI dataset, two more well-known datasets, AT&T and 5_Celebrity, we used to examine performance. In our model was seen that ViT could identify human faces on the PCI dataset with a 99% accuracy rate and perform much better than other face recognition algorithms like Eigenface, FisherFace, and LBPH.

articleTitle: Deep Learning approach for Detecting Intellectual Development Disorder using Scalogram Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Intellectual Development Disorder (IDD) is a brain growth disorder that hampers the normal cognitive functioning of an individual and makes them struggle for even the simple physical tasks of daily living. They are emotionally and behaviourally unsound as well. A person scoring less than 70 on a standardized IQ test is categorized under IDD. This study presents the use of deep learning algorithms to diagnose IDD. An Electroencephalogram (EEG) dataset comprising recordings of 14 individuals (7 IDD affected and 7 control) in 2 different conditions – resting state and while listening to music, is used. These EEG signals are preprocessed and are divided into small epochs of 1 second, which were converted into scalogram images using Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT). These scalogram images are fed to the proposed 2D Convolutional Neural Network (2D-CNN) model and four pretrained networks using transfer learning to diagnose IDD. The proposed 2D-CNN model contains approximately 2 million parameters, achieved an accuracy of 98.6% for rest-state and an accuracy of 97.9% for music-state. Among the pre-trained models, Resnet obtained the highest accuracy of 99.31% for rest state and music data but contains almost 12 times the number of parameters compared to the proposed model.

articleTitle: Energy Saving in Wireless Video Sensor Networks using Online Data Transmission Reduction Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wireless Video Sensor Networks (WVSNs) are used in many monitoring applications in various fields such as security, military, industrial, medical, and environmental. The video sensor nodes in these networks gather huge amounts of data and transmit it across the network. Transmitting the collected huge data will lead to increased energy consumption, bandwidth usage, and congestion over the WVSN network. Reducing energy for processing and transmitting data in WVSNs is difficult due to the huge amount of sensed data in real time. this paper proposes an Online Data Transmission Reduction Scheme (ODaTReS) to address energy conservation in WVSNs. The data reduction by the ODaTReS is based on two phases: the sensing phase and the transmission phase. Where ODaTReS employs frame rate adaptation using the ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF) algorithm in the sensing phase to limit the captured video frames. While in the transmission phase, it computes the matching ratio between frames. Experimental evaluations demonstrate the superiority of ODaTReS over other methods in terms of data reduction ratio, energy consumption, data quality, and validity.

articleTitle: Analytical Study and Recommendations for Computer Vision Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The purpose of this comparative study is to determine the effectiveness of various computer vision techniques for image analysis tasks. This research aims to investigate different computer vision models for object detection and recognition. Using computer vision models for object detection and recognition, this research aims to replace the cumbersome manual system currently in use. This is accomplished by comparing popular models such as YOLO and Haar Cascade based on their precision, speed, and efficiency. In addition, facial recognition methods, such as the Siamese Model and the face-recognition library, are analyzed based on their performance using metrics such as time, and similarity scores. The challenges and limitations of each approach are examined to identify the most suitable model for specific tasks. As a proof of concept, this study concludes by implementing its recommendation on a popular use case.

articleTitle: CNN-GRU Based Fusion Architecture For Bengali License Plate Recognition With Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Because of recent improvements to Bangladesh’s roads and highways, Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ALPR) has become a crucial component. Numerous crimes, including kidnapping, failure to pay tolls, and harassment of women, occur on both public and private transportation. The security forces will be able to locate offenders more quickly with the earlier and more accurate detection of license plates. The authors of this research proposing a deep learning-based fusion model for ALPR that integrates CNN and GRU on the basis of these circumstances. A total of 4753 images from various Bangladeshi roads and highways have been collected for training, validation, and testing purposes. The dataset consists of three classes of data namely Private cars, Public buses, and Trucks where all the images are in RGB format. To get precise and reliable findings, a variety of preprocessing approaches have been applied. After passing the images to the proposed architecture all the necessary parameters have been fine-tuned that causes a lesser amount of trainable parameters and more accuracy. The research demonstrates that the suggested CNN-GRU based fusion architecture, with a 98.97% F1-score, outperforms the leading models. Both static photos and CCTV video material can be used to accomplish ALPR tasks with comparable efficiency. Later, Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) model SHAP has been used in order to interpret the outstanding result with a region of features.

articleTitle: An Effective Early Detection and Prediction System for Gas Leakage in Smart Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Gas leakages can be catastrophic, resulting in human injuries and financial losses. If the gas leaks can be detected and predicted before time, it can significantly help prevent any hazards. This paper proposes to develop a gas leakage detection system using reliable techniques to avoid such situations. The key objective of this paper is to develop a detection and prediction method to identify gas leak situations and predict the amount of gas released and its concentration by the time of release. A sensor-based approach and the Internet of Things (IoT) are employed to find gas leaks in enclosed spaces. For tasks involving detection and prediction, deep learning methods like Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks are used. For evaluation purposes, this paper also compares the suggested strategy with other state-of-art techniques. Additionally, a monitoring and alert system is developed to notify users about gas leakage and hazards.

articleTitle: HSDH: Detection of Hate Speech on social media with an effective deep neural network for code-mixed Hinglish data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The phenomenal rise of social media platforms like Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, and Reddit has led to the blending of native languages or regional tongues with English for the purpose of improving communication in linguistically open geographic regions around the world. There are many ways in which Holocaust denial can lead to an increase in violence, from direct assault to purging out of compassion. Online, people are very hostile to one another. Distinguishing between language that incites hatred and language that is disparaging is a fundamental challenge in the categorization and tracking of extremely toxic lexical features. Our research focuses on identifying harmful tweets composed in Hinglish, a fusion of Hindi and the Roman alphabet. We propose a system in this paper for classifying tweets as either abusive, neutral, or offensive. The help of Hindi-English offensive tweet dataset is comprised of tweets written in the code-transferred language of Hindi and is further subdivided into three groups: neutral, abusive, and hateful. We studied the abusive and hate speech dataset with transfer learning and pre-trained the proposed model on Hinglish-processed English tweets. With our proposed model, we were able to improve accuracy to 98.54 percent.

articleTitle: Recognition of Brain Tumors Using Deep Learning with Data Balancing Techniques and Its Explainability with AI
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Brain tumors are the 22nd most frequent disease globally, accounting for 1.8% of all new conditions. It is such a type of disease that requires early treatment and diagnosis. As a result, an automated tumor recognition model is necessary to assist radiologists in detecting brain tumors. Automatically recognizing these tumors necessitates a large dataset that includes all variants of tumors. However, medical photos are always rare for various reasons, including a shortage of patients for specific conditions, a lack of medical equipment, patients who do not want their photographs to be used, and difficulty in getting images that fit the needed requirements. Therefore, this paper proposes a brain tumor recognition system that is based on deep learning with two renowned data balancing techniques and recapitulates the performance of the model with explainable AI. Because of the shortage of specific brain tumor patients, the dataset utilized in this paper was imbalanced. While SMOTE was used to balance the dataset, and the ResNet50 architecture was utilized for training to 15-class recognition, then an accuracy of 98.97% was achieved. The experimental results indicate the feasibility of the presented strategy for brain tumor multiclass recognition.

articleTitle: Lightweight Ring Learning With Errors Cryptographic Scheme for Secure Cloud-IoT Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Internet of Things is giving rise to a hyper-connected world in which people as well as things can communicate with one another. Integration of the Internet of Things technology with Cloud Computing has been recommended as a new paradigm, to overcome the present restrictions of IoT such as low power, volume and performance. However, there are security issues which need to be fixed in the new converged paradigm so as to reduce the risks associated with information protection and management. This work proposes a lightweight Ring Learning With Errors (RLWE) homomorphic encryption communication protocol for user and message management to secure the Cloud-IoT systems. The experiment shows the feasibility of the proposed lightweight RLWE for usage on resource constrained IoT or Edge Computing type of environments for the future smart application ecosystems.

articleTitle: Hybrid XGBoost and Extreme Machine Learning Algorithm on Diabetes Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetes is a long-term condition that places a considerable burden on the healthcare systems of countries all over the globe. Prediction of diabetes at an early stage that is both accurate and reliable may permit prompt intervention and improve patient outcomes. The use of machine learning algorithms to the diagnosis of diabetes and other illnesses has shown encouraging results. In this paper, a hybrid method for the prediction of diabetic illness is presented. This method combines the XGBoost and Extreme Machine Learning (ELM) algorithms. The purpose of the suggested technique is to attain better performance in terms of accuracy and generalisation by capitalising on the strengths possessed by both of the algorithms. Traditional machine learning methods such as KNN, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, and Linear SVC were used to evaluate the performance of the hybrid model after it was applied to a diabetic dataset that was made accessible to the public. The findings of the experiments show that the hybrid model that combines XGBoost and ELM performs better than either the individual algorithms or the more conventional classifiers when it comes to predicting diabetes. This work has the potential to enhance illness prediction and management, and it adds to the expanding corpus of research on sophisticated machine learning methods for applications in the healthcare industry.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Histopathology Image Classification Using Ensemble Feature Set
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Breast cancer accounts for 30% of newly diagnosed tumours due to lifestyle and genetic causes. According to WHO data, breast cancer is the second most frequent form of cancer globally. It was even predicted that by 2020 there will be a rise of 2.3 million more instances. Histopathologists manually quantify mitosis, which is time-consuming and subjective. CAD, a secondary reader system, improves diagnosis and therapy. Recent technology advances have focused on mitosis detection utilising hand-crafted or CNN-learned characteristics. CNN-based techniques are computationally intensive, yet hand crafted features are inaccurate. Our technique combines Convolutional Neural Network-learned deep features with handcrafted features and employs an ensemble machine learning model to classify. The model was trained using MITOS-ATYPIA-14 grand challenge mitotic images. The model fed HC and deep features has an F1 score of 96%. Thus, this model is more reliable and computationally efficient than current methods.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Detection of Agricultural Crops Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Crop classification is an important aspect of farming because it improves crop management and increases crop yield. This study proposes a CNN-based crop classification technique using high-resolution images. To use this method, we created a database of 30 crops, including jute, maize, almonds, rice, sugarcane, banana, wheat, and others. The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is an Artificial Intelligence-based algorithm that learns similar features from images and is capable of performing a variety of tasks such as image classification, object detection, and segmentation. In this system, CNN or ConvNet is used to learn the features provided in the input images by sequentially entering several layers such as Convolution, Activation function (RELU), Pooling, and Flattening. Finally, with only a few explanations in the training set, this providing outstanding classifies new images. The proposed method has two major components: preprocessing and categorization. The experimental results show that the proposed tactic worked extremely well, with a ground truth of 0.9264.

articleTitle: Minimal Parameter Estimation Based Non-Linear Control of Hexarotors With Uncertainty in Mass
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dynamics of a hexarotor contain non-linearities and uncertainties in the system parameters. The purpose of this study is to design a self-learning controller to track the altitude commands given to a hexarotor and achieve a stable hovering position amidst uncertainties in mass due to changes in the payload. The backstepping controller is a Lyapunov based controller which can accurately control and stabilize the vehicle when plant dynamics are completely known. While adaptive backstepping controller employs a dynamic feedback law with which it adapts to changes in the physical parameters. In this work, a Lyapunov based backstepping control law is first developed for a hexarotor platform, later an adaptive backstepping control is also introduced to nullify any destabilizing uncertainties in mass and thereby achieve stable hovering. Numerical simulations are performed on the MATLAB platform with variation in mass incorporated to test the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy. Software implementation of the system gives satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Management of Supply Chains Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Blockchain innovation offers significant open doors for the management of supply chains. This paper targets exploring and methodically planning research on blockchain possibilities in further developing production network execution. Reports were recovered from many significant information sources, chosen, assessed, assembled into different topics, and incorporated. Blockchain can give an extremely durable, shareable, reviewable record of items through their inventory network, which further develops item tracking, legitimacy, and lawfulness in a more financially efficient way. In this section, the potential enhancement assumptions through blockchain innovation for the instance of agribusiness were also examined. Blockchain has not yet been extensively applied in the business of supply chains. This paper adds to the writing by offering an extensive guide of examination on blockchain possibilities in further developing inventory network execution. The discoveries of this study will be useful for executives who look for a thorough comprehension of how blockchain influences their organizations, especially in inventory network management.

articleTitle: Adopting Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory Network to Detect Seizures
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recent advances in deep learning have enabled computer-aided medical data processing, thus adding to automated disease diagnosis and detection. Neurologists typically diagnose seizures, also known as epilepsy, through visual evaluation of Electroencephalogram (EEG) waveforms, which include data regarding the brain’s electrical impulses. However, because this is a manual, tardy, and difficult process, automated and precise detection of epileptic seizures can increase efficacy and patient quality of life. In this study, a one-dimensional convolutional long short-term memory (1D CNN-LSTM) architecture is proposed for the automated detection of seizures based on EEG waveforms. The proposed classification model combines the abilities of the convolution neural network (CNN) and the long short-term memory (LSTM) architecture forming a convolutional LSTM network, where the CNN extracts high level robust features from the EEG signal data while the LSTM layers aid with the extraction of temporal features. The effectiveness of the model being suggested is verified on the Bonn dataset and the maximum accuracy achieved by the model on the binary class seizure detection is 100%. To verify the sturdiness of the proposed architecture, it has also been tested on noisy EEG signals.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Missing Data Imputation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the era of advanced machinery including sensor technology, massive amount of data than ever before is produced every day in a variety of different fields. In the process of handling huge data, some data values are missed due to various controllable or uncontrollable factors. The missing data problem is a real-life problem which found everywhere and that is why it has received huge attention in research in the past decades. It is a major hurdle in data analysis and research. Therefore, for better analysis of data there are various imputation methods to handle missing data varying from directly deleting the data which contains missing values or using traditional methods like mean, median and mode to fill the missing value to using complex deep learning and machine learning techniques to predict missing value. This paper first discusses different kinds of missing data and then analyzing various imputation techniques from traditional to modern approach for dealing with missing data. It also analyzes advantages and disadvantages of different imputation techniques to get a better perspective of these techniques.

articleTitle: Kathak Dance Movement Recognition and Correction Using Google’s Mediapipe
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Indian Classical Dance (ICD) is a continuing tradition of India. This legacy has traditionally been guarded by gurus (teachers). They practice and teach the tradition to their Shishyas, who are frequently undocumented. Consequently, historical preservation is limited in time and scope. The advent of digital multimedia technology has enabled the preservation of history by preserving its accessibility over time. However, more efforts must be made to implement effective technology in dance pedagogy or maintain ICD history. This document describes a tutoring system for the ICD dialect Kathak. Using Media Pipe Holistic, Machine Learning Models, and Fast Dynamic Time Warping to detect postures and motions, we develop a system that can assist a trainee dancer in identifying deviations in her dancing postures and movements relative to previously recorded performances.

articleTitle: Adoption of Internet of Things for Smart Monitoring of Aquaponics
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Aquaponics is a cutting-edge, clever, and ecological technology for agriculture that combines both aquaculture and hydroponics to produce vegetable products prototype. This method promises to be environmentally friendly and viable due to its high-water consumption efficacy, lack of use of pesticides, and decreased fertilizer use. The main task is to make aquaponics viable and dependable at a business scale because interest in it is growing. By recognizing, being listed, and thoroughly describing each of the characteristics detected in aquaponics, as well as the smart platforms and Internet of Things (IoT) devices in the examined literature, this article hopes to support study towards a feasible business aquaponics option. The suggested study also identifies future efforts needed for mechanized aquaponics and possible voids in the existing literature. This is anticipated the fact that the system for aquaponics backed by smart control units will benefit in terms of profitability, intelligence, accuracy, and effectiveness within the context of the research studies examined in this paper.

articleTitle: Real Time Network Attack Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The threat of cybercrime is rapidly increasing on a global scale, exploiting vulnerabilities found in cloud computing infrastructure. To combat these cybersecurity issues, machine learning has emerged as a powerful solution, capable of addressing challenges such as intrusion detection, malware classification, spam detection, and phishing detection. Compared to traditional methods, machine learning algorithms offer more effective identification of cyber risks, thereby alleviating the burden on security analysts. Among these algorithms, deep learning has demonstrated superior performance, enhancing the cost-effectiveness of cybersecurity measures. Developing an efficient network attack detection system using machine learning involves several stages, including data collection, preprocessing, algorithm selection, model training, evaluation, and deployment. Continuous monitoring and regular updates further enhance the system's ability to counter various network attacks. In our study, we achieved high levels of accuracy, precision, and recall in detecting specific types of attacks, namely SQL injection (Accuracy: 0.928, R2 score: 0.659, Precision: 0.985, Recall: 0.774) and phishing attacks (Accuracy: 0.841, R2 score: 0.364, Precision: 0.919, Recall: 0.760). Additionally, our Intrusion Detection System demonstrated accuracy levels of 0.928 for K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), 0.659 for Bernoulli Naive Bayes (BNB), and 0.985 for Decision Tree Classifier (DTC). Furthermore, the model exhibited an accuracy of 0.985 in effectively detecting cross-site scripting attacks. These outcomes underscore the model's effectiveness in accurately identifying various types of attacks, providing robust cybersecurity measures.

articleTitle: Identification of COVID-19 from Other Upper Respiratory Tract Infections Using Random Undersampling and LIME-based XAI Model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The urgent need for an accurate and fast diagnosis of upper respiratory tract infections (URTI) has been made clear by the COVID-19 pandemic. Machine learning algorithms have shown the potential to aid early diagnosis and appropriate patient management by distinguishing COVID-19 from other URTIs. By analyzing clinical and laboratory factors, such as symptom profiles, vital signs, and laboratory markers, machine learning algorithms can identify distinctive patterns that set COVID-19 apart from other URTIs. Healthcare workers might use such approaches to make well-informed decisions about patient triage, isolation, and treatment, which could result in improved clinical outcomes and slower disease transmission. To achieve this goal, the current work utilizes a publicly accessible dataset of symptoms and Explainable AI to extract the most significant aspects of the symptoms. The class imbalanced problem in the dataset has been eradicated by Random Under Sampling technique. In addition, classification algorithms have been used to determine the type of disease from patient’s symptoms. These algorithms included Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting (GB), Logistic Regression (LR), Naïve Bayes (NB), Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Extra Tree (ET), Bagging Classifier (BG) and Stacking Classifier. The results of the proposed work indicate that the stacking ensemble model got the highest 97.31% of classification accuracy and outperformed the previous work.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Machine Learning Techniques for Voice-Based Gender Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: For humans, determining a person’s gender by looking at a few traits is not difficult. This does not, however, apply to machines. To do this, machines must be trained. The process of analyzing speech data to detect a speaker’s gender is known as gender recognition by voice. There are several uses for gender recognition in the real world, including enhancing human-machine communication. For instance, the advertising might be tailored based on the gender and age of the caller. In criminal instances, it can also assist in the spotting of the accused, or at the very minimum, it can lessen the number of accused. This work presents a review concerning methods that use data from pitch and frequency of voice. We have described the difficulties encountered and examined the typical implementations of these approaches. The results show that data sets collected in controlled situations have shown good performance, but there is still much that can be done to increase the gender recognition system’s robustness in real-world settings.

articleTitle: Addressing Drawbacks of MART and Enhancing Predictive Performance*
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Boosting, a successful machine learning algorithm, is often used for regression and classification tasks. Boosted ensemble algorithms, particularly when combined with tree base learners, can generate highly accurate and robust predictive models. This study explores the weaknesses of the well-known approach, Multiple Additive Regression Trees (MART), and proposes a new approach called Laplace Additive Regression Trees (LART) that addresses this issue by adding random Laplace noises. The algorithm is then improved upon by combining it with Dropout and multiple Additive Regression Trees, resulting in DLART [1]. In an experiment using a previously studied dataset, we compared the performance of LART, DLART, MART, and DART. The results were promising, as LART and DLART produced significant gains in accuracy for this particular task. For future studies, it would be beneficial to assess the effectiveness of LART on complex data sets and various other machine learning tasks, such as those related to data mining [2]

articleTitle: Study of Various Deep Learning Models for COVID-19 Detection Based on Fractional Order Optical Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The world entered into a new phase in the wake of Covid-19, which is declared as a global threat because countless people were losing their lives worldwide due to this disease every day. Even the best medical facilities were crumbling due to the rise of COVID-19 and lack of funding. However the use of nucleic acid-based testing generates an excessive amount of bio-waste and increases the risk of infection to the healthcare personnel. These tests take a lot of time, which contributes to the high mortality rate. To address these challenges, vision based techniques have been demonstrated to be beneficial in the early and swift diagnosis of COVID-19. Earlier imaging techniques used X-ray or CT-scan images to detect COVID-19. Consequently, these techniques do not filter out non-COVID cases, resulting in longer processing time. In this paper, COVID-19 identification is accomplished through the dynamic characteristics obtained from chest X-ray (CXR) images. These dynamic characteristics are derived as optical flow (OF). Moreover a fractional order-based variational model is used to estimate OF from two consecutive images of lungs. The novelty of this work is to use OF instead of images in COVID-19 detection. Further, the classification of lung dynamic features is performed with a convolutional neural network (CNN) in coordination of various machine learning (ML) classifiers. A detailed comparison is provided to show the significance of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Identifying the Optimal Deep Learning Based Image Recognition Technique for Dog Breed Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Information security is critical in the current digital age, where businesses and organizations heavily rely on technology to run their operations. With the increasing number of cyber threats and attacks, relying only on conventional security measures is insufficient to safeguard sensitive data and computer systems. Machine learning (ML) & artificial intelligence (AI) are essential for enhancing security measures. AI and ML have revolutionized our approach to information security by providing sophisticated analytical capabilities that help identify and respond to threats in real-time. The significance of image recognition technology has grown in information security as it provides a more advanced method for authentication and identification. Image recognition involves using computer algorithms to recognize and classify objects or patterns in photographs. It is used in information security for access control, fraud detection, and intrusion detection, among other purposes. In this research paper, a thorough analysis and study of various deep learning and transfer learning-based image recognition and classification models is conducted to identify the optimal approach for using which modern day information security systems could be designed which could stay one step ahead of the attackers, by making the cryptanalysis process even more difficult for them. In this research, a thorough analysis of Image Recognition models trained on a preprocessed dataset is done and the best model is selected which could be further be used in conjunction with various cryptographic models.

articleTitle: Health Insurance Recommendation using Probabilistic Data Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recommender systems are constantly evolving in the health insurance industry, with a focus on speed and efficiency. To meet the demands of clients, insurance providers need to generate personalized policy recommendations that are quick and accurate. This paper suggests a health insurance recommendation system that combines advanced algorithms to offer efficient and personalized recommendations based on user preferences and similarities. The proposed system leverages the MinHash and LSHForest algorithms, as well as collaborative filtering, to improve the recommendation process. MinHash approximates the Jaccard similarity between policies, while LSHForest enables faster search for similar policies. Collaborative filtering considers user preferences and similarities among policies and users. To ensure user input is secure and legitimate, the system employs a Bloom filter. This filters out unauthorized access to sensitive healthcare data and validates user input. The architecture of the system addresses various challenges related to personalization and privacy in health insurance recommendation systems. Based on the results, the proposed system surpasses existing approaches in accuracy, efficiency, and privacy preservation. This has the potential to be advantageous for both insurance providers and users as it helps streamline the process of choosing appropriate health insurance plans that align with individual requirements and preferences.

articleTitle: PYNQ Overlay for SVM-based Melanoma Classification with Learning Ability
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Support Vector Machine (SVM), is the most applicable supervised algorithms, used to solve classification and regression problems. Though the SVM classifier is challenging to implement on an embedded system, its benefits of faster processing and lower power consumption make the effort worthwhile. Melanoma is the most lethal form of skin cancer and thus increases mortality rates. Our goal is to create a melanoma-classification system based on the PYNQ Overlay that can be implemented in primary care settings. In contrast to current hardware solutions, which only offer inference capability with regard to melanoma, the proposed system combines learning ability with inference. The PYNQ platform's processing system is used to implement a SVM algorithm for melanoma classification with built-in training capability. The compute-intensive tasks of the proposed algorithm were developed as Intellectual Property (IP) using a high-level synthesis design approach and integrated with the processing system of the heterogeneous PYNQ platform for the hardware component. The experimental results demonstrated greater accuracy in melanoma classification compared to contemporary works, with the added advantage of learning ability.

articleTitle: Exploring Graph Classification Techniques Under Low Data Constraints: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This survey paper presents a brief overview of recent research on graph data augmentation and few-shot learning. It covers various techniques for graph data augmentation, including node and edge perturbation, graph coarsening, and graph generation, as well as the latest developments in few-shot learning, such as meta-learning and model-agnostic meta-learning. The paper explores these areas in depth and delves into further sub classifications. Rule based approaches and learning based approaches are surveyed under graph augmentation techniques. Few-Shot Learning on graphs is also studied in terms of metric-learning techniques and optimization-based techniques. In all, this paper provides an extensive array of techniques that can be employed in solving graph processing problems faced in low-data scenarios.

articleTitle: Periodical Analysis of Stress in Working Professionals
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The working sectors are introducing new products and technologies to the marketplace these days, giving it a modern feel. It ultimately caused workers' stress levels to increase. With the use of sophisticated machine learning methods and picture processing, our project's main objective is to detect stress in working professionals periodically. KNN classifiers are a kind of machine learning algorithm that is used to analyze a specific employee's stress pattern and ascertain how stressed out they are frequently or monthly. The previous stress detection methods, which lacked live detection, have been enhanced by our technology. This system, however, includes live detection as well as routine employee assessments that allow for the identification of employees' levels of physical and mental stress and the provision of appropriate treatment.

articleTitle: Chronic Disease prediction using Machine Learning Techniques: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In current era people are very much prone to the ChronicDisease because of the ambient circumstances and lifestyle practices. Thus it became very vital task for doctors to predictit at its early stage so that the rate of mortality can be reduced. But, sometimes it became difficult and confusingtask for doctors to find out it at its very starting stage. With the help of machine learning technology it is possible todetect it at its starting state. Chronic disease is those types of illness which required lengthy medical attention. In order to diagnose chronic diseases, this study analyzes machine learning predictive model applications. Most of the expenditures associated with global health are attributable to the chronic diseases. Individuals who have these conditions require ongoing care. These days, the diagnosis and prognosis of many disorders routinely make use of predictive algorithms. In this work, we start with a primer on the most popular systems for categorizing chronic illness. Machine learning Algorithms have proven to be quite effective in producing results with a high level of correctness, thereby preventing the onset of fatal diseasein many patients and reducing the impact in those who are already affected. It has aided medical researchers and doctors worldwide in recognizing patterns in patients, resulting inchronic sickness detection at an early stage. Finally, some survey was chosen to showcase all modeling procedure in the uniform manner which describes its treatment plan and functional results of specific maladies, alongside with their related advantages and drawbacks. The most important studies that have used machine learning classification approaches in this field of study are reviewed. There is a sizable table that contrasts and compares the articles. In the near future, these models are anticipated to become more common in medical practice and extremely useful in the grouping and diagnosis off at alma ladies.

articleTitle: An Automated Deep Learning Model for Dignosis of Alzheimer’s Disease using Deep Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a chronic, degenerative and incapacitating brain disease that affects millions of individuals worldwide. For the condition to be treated and managed effectively, early detection and a precise diagnosis are essential. The convolutional neural network (CNN)-based method for diagnosing Alzheimer's disease is proposed in this study. The proposed method utilizes four pre-trained CNN models: ResNet50, Xception, VGG16 and InceptionV3 to extract features from two unique datasets, DS-255 and DS-160, made up of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) brain scans of Alzheimer's patients and healthy controls. Principal component analysis (PCA) is used to decrease the collected features before they are fed to six different classification models, including the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression, and Perceptron. On the DS-255 and DS-160 datasets, the suggested technique achieves an accuracy of 92% and 91%, with the Decision Tree and Random Forest classifiers outperforming the others. These results demonstrate the potential of methods utilizing deep learning for rapid and accurate Alzheimer's disease diagnosis. These results highlight the potential of technologies based on deep learning for the rapid and accurate detection of Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: Solar Powered Dryer for Drying and Storing Grapes
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the earliest method for preserving food is through open sun light drying. This technique involves the reduction of the water content in food to a level where microorganisms are unable to grow when the food is dried. The process of drying helps to remove the enough measure of moisture content, which is necessary for the progress and micro-organisms activity and enzymes. By the reduction in activity of water, the removal in moisture gets increased so that the shelf life of the raisin gets increases. If the reduce in content of moisture is between 1 and 5%, the product can be stored for over a year. It is crucial to execute out the process of drying in a manner that preserves the nutritional value, aroma, and cooking quality of the food. A well-dehydrated product, when altered with water, should accurately resemble the original product. Drying vegetables, meat and fruits at home is done by various methods including the use of electrical drying devices such as household appliances; sun drying or wind drying. Freeze drying is often involved in the dehydration of industrial food. In this process, the food is rapidly frozen and placed in a reduced pressure system, which causes the water to evaporate directly from the solid to the gaseous phase. Although it can be more costly to freeze dry compared with conventional dehydration methods, freezing has the benefit of prolonging the flavor, texture and nutritional value of foodstuffs. To overcome this, we came over an idea using the new technologies to dry grapes. We use the dry air method to preserve and dry the grapes inside the box. The container also regulate internal temperature, according to the dry food kept inside there.

articleTitle: Early Prophecy of Low-Birth-Weight Babies Using BM Error Rate Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Approximately 15% to 20% of new born babies are underweight, according to a national survey. Low birth weight (LBW) is a symptom of sickness in new born babies. In later life, there are strong correlations between LBW, infant mortality, and other health problems. There is a clear correlation between mother health during pregnancy and birth weight, according to recent studies. In order to identify potential LBW patients early on, this publication uses machine learning techniques to collect relevant data from pregnancy-related health markers. The issue was restructured as a classification problem between the lower weight and NOT-Lower Weight classes using the Bayes classifier, transforming LBW detection into a binary machine classification task. High accuracy was reached by the suggested model.

articleTitle: A Study of Cyber Bullying Classification Using Social Media and Texual Analysis Based on Machine Learning Approches
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today's world, cyberbullying is a problem that is becoming more and more common, especially among teenagers and young people. The prevalence of social networking sites and other digital communication tools has made it simpler for offenders to harass their victims in secret and without repercussions. Natural language processing (NLP) methods have been used in recent years to categorize instances of cyberbullying and assist identify them. The language used in online conversations is examined using these approaches to look for trends and signs of cyberbullying behavior. The purpose of this study is to investigate how well NLP approaches can be used to recognize and categorize cyberbullying behavior. To provide a thorough knowledge of the many types of cyberbullying, the study will use a variety of data sources, including social media posts, chat logs, and other online conversations. Overall, this research will further our knowledge of the intricate nature of cyberbullying and shed light on the potential applications of NLP approaches to lessen its negative impacts.

articleTitle: Smart Police: A Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Crime Proactivity Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Conducting competent and precise investigations on criminal situations is necessary to establish peace, order, and justice in a community. With the increased use of modern sophisticated systems to track crime and violence, computer programmers may also significantly assist officials in law enforcement. Previous research was not successfully able to accomplish crime forecasting and precision of predictions made by learning models. This paper proposes CNN-LSTM hybrid approach for forecasting and predicting criminal behavior with improved accuracy. To understand the crimes data, the study uses different machine learning models such as Support Vector Machines, Naïve Bayes, k-Nearest Neighbors, Logistic Regression, Multilayer Perceptron’s (MLP), cloud gradient boosting (XGBoost), decision tree, random forests, time series analysis implementing a Convolutional Neural Network and (ARIMA) Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average and Long-Term Memory model and machine learning algorithm to improve error predictions. The demonstration of model was evaluated with various performance criteria. After extensive testing on real-time data, the CNN-LSTM model shows higher accuracy compared to existing models. Specifically, the model achieved 91% accuracy in the dataset of Denver and 90% in the Los Angeles dataset.

articleTitle: Exploring Gender Stereotyping in Indian Social Media Content: A NVivo- Based Content Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Gender Stereotypes are deeply ingrained in Indian Society. Women are frequently depicted as submissive and objectified, while men are portrayed as dominant and powerful. Video based social media platform, YouTube, have a significant influence on shaping these gender stereotypes. The user-generated content on YouTube provides a unique opportunity to study how gender stereotypes are perpetuated and challenged. This study utilized NVivo 12 to conduct a qualitative data analysis of 30 videos uploaded by Indian content creators that examine the concept of gender stereotyping. The study analyzed the videos thematically and through word cloud with the help of transcription generated from the videos. The findings indicate that gender stereotypes are prevalent in Indian society and are perpetuated through various elements associated with a particular gender. In addition to the user- generated content, YouTube's artificial intelligence algorithms also play a significant role in shaping gender stereotypes. These algorithms often recommend videos based on the user's viewing history, which can reinforce existing biases and stereotypes. The study highlights the need for greater awareness of the role of social media platforms in perpetuating gender stereotypes and the need for effective policies to address these issues.

articleTitle: Flood detection using remote sensing and deep learning approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A flood is an overflow of water that covers dry land. Floods can happen for a number of reasons, such as prolonged periods of severe rain, melting snow, or the collapse of levees or dams. There are various adverse effects of flood including loss of life, agricultural damage, economic losses etc. Early flood detection is important to reduce these effects of flood. Flood detection can be done in a number of ways, including the use of water level sensors, flood warning systems, remote sensing methods, machine learning and deep learning methods, etc. Our proposed approach is combination of remote sensing and deep learning to detect flood. We took sen-12 floods related dataset of sentinel-2 images in which each folder contains 12 bands images with labels flood (1) or no flood (0). We performed various preprocessing techniques on each folder bands images to reduce the impact of shadow and clouds in flood detection process. After this step, we trained various CNN models on preprocessed images and examined results.

articleTitle: Unmasking Cyberbullies on Social Media Platforms Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cyberbullying refers to an aggressive act or behavior with the intention of hurting someone through electronic communication tools. It involves insulting and sending threatening messages to the victim. Cyberbullying incidents are increasing worldwide, posing challenges in combating this form of victimization. Due to the vast amount of online data, tracking cyberbullying is difficult, making detection crucial. Several studies have utilized text mining techniques to analyze and detect cyberbullying. These studies involve classifying conversations or posts using supervised learning, labeling them with N-grams, and applying TF-IDF weighting. In the current system, comments on social media platforms are manually gathered and tagged, then processed using various binary and multiclass classification algorithms. The proposed technique offers practical insights into cyberbullying detection by utilizing deep learning-based models to comprehensively assess cyberbullying across multiple social media platforms and diverse subjects. To address the enormous volume of streaming texts from these platforms, an automatic cyberbullying detection system is being developed. The cluster and discriminant analysis stage analyze the text input to recognize abusive communications. The primary goal of this project is to empower victims by generating thorough reports that can be sent to the appropriate cyber cell for action.

articleTitle: Optimization for evaluation of the number of LEDs and estimation of QoS parameters for indoor VLC
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Visible Light Communication (VLC) is a subdomain of Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) that is synchronized by IEEE 802.15.7 and employs the license-free band of 400 THz to 800 THz. VLC is an appreciative Personal Area Network (PAN) short-range wireless communication technology that aims to combine communication with illumination to provide a high data rate. The objectives of the paper are twofold. As a primary objective, this work proposes a novel empirical conceptualization established on regression analysis employing the least square polynomial curve fitting approach to evaluate the optimum number of LEDs required to attain an illuminance in the range of 300-1500 lux within a distance of 0.25 m to 1.5 m distance between the transmitter and receiver by integrating factors of distance and illuminance. The second part involves the experimental implementation of an indoor visible light communication system to evaluate the received power, quality factor and Bit Error Rate (BER) using VLHW5100, VAOL-3GWY4 and VAOL-5701WY4 by using the evaluated number of LEDs from objective one. The quality factor and BER are evaluated for a distance of 50 cm at a maximum data rate of 1.2 Mbps.

articleTitle: DNN Based Channel Estimation for Indoor Mimo Multipath Visible Light Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A deep neural network-based channel estimation (CE) for multiple input multiple output (MIMO) DC-biased Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (DCO-OFDM) in an indoor visible light communication (VLC) system is presented in this paper. A complex-valued neural network (CVNN), a deep neural network (DNN) derivative that can directly use complex numbers as opposed to generic deep learning technologies that use real numbers, was used to estimate channels. Optimizers such as adaptive moment estimation (Adam) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD) are used to adapt CVNN's attributes and aid in loss reduction. The proposed CVNN-based CE outperformed the traditional Least Square (LS) estimator in terms of BER performance of LOS, LOS with first-reflection (L-R1), and LOS with first-reflection and second-reflection (L-R1-R2). The results show that the suggested CVNN-based CE may be utilized in OFDM systems without a clue of channel information for both LOS and non-LOS cases.

articleTitle: The Power of Predictive Analytics: Forecasting Crime Trends in High-Risk Areas for Crime Prevention using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The main objective of this study is to employ artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) techniques to analyze a large crime dataset. The aim is to propose a predictive model that can accurately forecast both the frequency and types of crime that may occur in specific areas within a city. To achieve this, various classification techniques were applied to the crime dataset from Chicago, allowing for the identification of key crime trends and patterns. Machine learning algorithms, including random forest, naive Bayes, decision tree, k nearest neighbor, and logistic regression, were utilized to predict the number of crimes in a given area. Additionally, a neural network was incorporated into the pipeline, introducing an algorithm called neural integrated learning. The performance of the developed models was evaluated using metrics such as accuracy score, precision, recall, and F1 score. The results of this study indicate that the proposed algorithm has the potential to accurately predict crime trends in Chicago with a high degree of precision. This research provides valuable insights into crime patterns in the city, assisting law enforcement agencies in their efforts to prevent crime and enhance public safety.

articleTitle: Analysis of Blockchain-Based Techniques for the Mitigation of DDoS Attacks in IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Despite the pervasiveness of the Internet of Things (IoT) as a result of its widespread adoption across multiple industries including healthcare, agriculture etc., these devices continue to suffer from significant shortcomings. Their structural limitations coupled with the lack of security implementations make IoT devices highly vulnerable, especially to Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, thus serving as an ideal tool for botnet manifestation. Despite the development of increasingly efficient defense mechanisms, there is a continual rise in the frequency and scale of such attacks which continues to outperform these countermeasures. The inherent characteristics of Blockchain, combined with the significant potential of smart contracts to be used for whitelisting, blacklisting, identity management, and traffic monitoring mechanisms, make this technology stand out as a promising candidate for developing mitigation strategies against different types of DDoS attacks. This paper presents a thorough analysis of IoT devices, their architecture, and their limitations. It aims to comprehensively examine DDoS mitigation solutions in three areas: prevention of device & network compromise, detection-based mechanisms, and reaction-based solutions while studying the integration of Blockchain, with other technologies like SDN, Fog Computing, Machine Learning etc.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of Denoising Methods for Satellite Imagery: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Satellite images often suffer from noise, which hampers data reliability and analysis accuracy. This study presents a comparative evaluation of denoising algorithms for satellite imagery, with a specific focus on a deep learning method called Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DnCNN). This study includes a comparison of spatial filters such as NLM, and weighted mean filters, frequency domain filters such as gaussian filters, wavelet transform-based filters, and the DnCNN model with an attention module. To assess the effectiveness of these techniques in denoising images, various evaluation metrics such as peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), and mean squared error (MSE) are utilized. Moreover, a novel approach based on the DnCNN network is presented, leveraging multiple layers and attention modules to selectively enhance important image features while suppressing noise. The proposed methodology highlights the DnCNN network's ability to capture intricate details and improve denoising performance. Results demonstrate the superiority of deep learning-based algorithms over alternative methods. The integration of attention modules within the DnCNN model further enhances the denoising process by leveraging image correlations and extracting pertinent information. This study offers valuable findings on effective methods for reducing noise in satellite imagery, highlighting the potential of deep learning and attention mechanisms in denoising satellite images.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Solar Photovoltaic Power Output using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A precise estimation of solar energy is necessary for a higher integration of renewable energy for better functioning of the current power system. Data-driven algorithms may be used to enhance solar energy estimates as a result of the availability of data at previously unheard-of granularities. The Linear Regression algorithm is provided in this work as the core model for the enhanced, broadly applicable stackable ensemble method. It is used to aggregate the outcomes from the core models, improving forecasting accuracy for solar PV power. In this paper comparison of two power plants has been done and it is found that one of them have better conversion accuracy than the other.

articleTitle: The Squash Behavior Graph Routing between the Business Process Event Capsules*
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, a set of Process Mining (PM) techniques and approaches has been developed to extract knowledge’s from business processes (BP) execution data. Although, these conventional PM techniques are pretty efficient to extract handcrafted features from the event log data, they still lack of the automatic features extraction that Capsule-Neural-Nets (Capsnet) models processes from the graph. These caps-net models express the node features of the constructed graph in form of capsules, and, the relevant insights at the graph level are captured by deploying the routing mechanism.This paper, proposes a novel Squash Behavior Graph Routing (SGBR) mechanism that constitute the backbone foundation of an Hierarchical Caps-Graph Neural-Net (H-Caps-GNN) architecture. The routing based features propagation mechanism in H-Caps-GNN structure is able to learn unified events feature’s of BP and their relationships. Those discovered properties represents the valuable insights for automatically learning the semantic of BP features which can be used in various BP applications’ (Process discovery, conformance checking, event prediction,…etc)

articleTitle: Underwater image re-enhancement with Simplest Color Balance, CLAHE Algorithm, De-noising Convolutional Neural Network and Unsharp Masking
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Restoring Underwater images is quiet challenging task. In an attempt to resolve this, a proposal of fusion algorithm that consists of a Simple Color Balancing algorithm, Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization, De-noising Convolutional Neural Network, and Unsharp Masking. To minimize the impact of color cast in underwater images, use of a simple color balance algorithm to stretch the r, g, and b values to their maximum range [0,255] to get a similar distribution of rgb channels in the histogram. To improve the perceptibility of underwater images, increase of the contrast of underwater images using the CLAHE algorithm. De-noising Convolutional Neural Network is used to remove the noise present in underwater images. An unsharp masking approach is implemented to eliminate the blurriness in output denoising images and sharpen the output images. PSNR values show that the resulting images of the proposed system have the best image quality. Some gave the best results based on their SSIM values compared to the MSRCR model. The UCIQE values of the resulting images dominate the results of other models. The efficiency of the fusion algorithm is proved by the results obtained and then compared with the results of current models.

articleTitle: SignNet: A Deep Learning Architecture for Accurate Sign Language Recognition from Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sign Language, as the word is self-explanatory, it means using the signs, or herein we can also call them as gestures for inter-communication between people who are specially-abled and even with those who try to express themselves with gestures. Sign Language System is a treading road for the field of deep learning and communication. There are models made every year that surpass all others and succeed state of the art mark achieving best results. Convolutional neural networks have evolved a lot in past years providing unbelievable outcomes and results. Thus, using ASL dataset and state of the art models like VGG16 and ResNet50, making a SLR system via transfer learning as well as understanding in-depth and detailed convolutional neural network structure and steps involved in it. It is an irrefutable fact that there are problems when it comes to communicating with disabled people, thus research regarding sign languages could be a great help for disabled people as well as for deep learning as a whole.

articleTitle: Popularity-Driven Optimized Caching Scheme for Content-Centric Networking
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Content-Centric Networking (CCN) emerged as one of the most promising Internet architecture. It offers data-centric communication instead of the host-based infrastructure, which has been used in the most of the existing solutions. In contrast to host based architecture, For effective content distribution and to raise the Quality of Service (QoS) for the end user, CCN offers in-network caching capabilities. However, in-network routers can cache a limited number of contents as their cache size is generally trivial in contrast to the content catalogue at the server. Thus, for improved utilization of the available network resources, an efficient caching approach has been suggested in this work. The approach implements a dynamic sized popularity table on every router. This table is invoked and searched during content caching to determine the content access frequency. The scheme proposed the empirical heuristics for optimal caching decisions based on a realistic network topology. Comprehensive simulation executions show effectiveness of the suggested caching technique as traditional caching schemes do not offer optimal network performance under the realistic cache size, catalogue size and request rate parameters. According to the simulation results, the suggested approach significantly improves the in-network cache hit-ratio when compared to majority of existing solutions while reducing network traffic and delay during content retrieval.

articleTitle: IoT Framework in a Blockchain dependent Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Due to characteristics like simplicity of use and improved Internet accessibility, the IoT and its utilizationsis growing in a rapid extent currently. Researchers can increase the effectiveness of IoT-dependent frameworks by integrating more cutting-edge technologies, such as blockchain and cloud computing. IoT applications may now be accessible from any location and at any time thanks to these improvements. However, a database is necessary to store the application's data. As it offers remote services like storage, processing, and analysis, cloud infrastructure is a perfect choice for storing IoT-based applications. These programmes' primary flaw is their inability to guarantee data confidentiality and privacy. With attributes such as immutability, transparency and decentralized framework, blockchain technology aids in solving these shortcomings. The objective of research work IoT framework in a blockchain. The simulation work has been performed in cloud environment. This article makes a proposal for an IoT application that uses the cloud and blockchain to help detect an attacker by effective surveillance. Important benefit for this application is that it can function in environments where it is difficult for humans to monitor, and the data is maintained in a secure environment using blockchain technology. The data privacy, security and portability have been enhanced. The proposed system can be used to monitor and record illegal activities. Finding presents that hybrid design used in this study enhances the system's portability and data privacy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Trustworthiness and Security in Cloud Environments: A Review of Methodologies and Advancements
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud Computing has reformed the way agencies manage and store their data by offering scalable and flexible computing resources. However, data security and trustworthiness in the cloud remain major concerns. Trust-based models and encryption techniques have emerged as effective approaches to enhance security and establish trust in cloud environments. This review paper explores various trust-based and encryption-based models in cloud computing, examining their methodologies, techniques employed, and performance characteristics. The performance evaluation of trust-based and encryption models demonstrates their effectiveness in enhancing data security, while also highlighting areas for further research and development. The findings emphasize the need for standardized metrics, improved trust assessment methods, and advanced encryption algorithms. This review provides valuable insights for researchers and practitioners, guiding future advancements in trust and encryption in cloud computing.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Based Approach In The Prediction Of Tinnitus Disease For Large Population Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Tinnitus is a frequent sensory disorder that puts a lot of strain on the patient. Usually, tinnitus results from disturbances occurring to the sensory systems, such as the peripheral seldom central, the somatosensory system, the head and neck, or a mix of the two. This can be found in people with high stress, anxiety, depression, and hearing disorders. Although there is progress in the medical domain using artificial intelligence (AI), research related to tinnitus using AI is limited. This work aims to bridge the gap using deep-learning techniques for evaluating the patient record by examining various parameters.
