Degree centrality and its various extensions are popular metrics for evaluating the nodes’ influence in complex networks. The Weighted Degree Centrality (WDC) effectively determines the nodes’ influence in weighted and undirected graphs. The WDC fails to distinguish the influence between the same weighted degree nodes. A new network measuring metric Node Contribution Factor (NCF) has been introduced to overcome this problem. The NCF effectively evaluates the nodes’ influence by considering the neighbours’ connectivity in weighted and undirected networks. This proposed metric has been appraised in varied structures of network. The metric has been examined on benchmark datasets to show the superiority of the suggested strategy. The proposed metric outperforms the state-of-the-art network measuring metrics to calculate the nodes’ influence in the weighted and undirected networks.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for Potato Leaf Disease Detection Using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Computer vision has recently developed into a crucial tool in agriculture for tracking plant health and treating illnesses. In this paper, we present a VGG19-based deep learning technique for recognising diseases in Potato leaves. Bacterial spot, early blight, late blight, and spider mite damage are four prevalent potato leaf diseases that the suggested system can detect automatically. 1,000 photos per class make up the 4,000 images of Potato leaves in the dataset used for this study. The photos in the dataset were resized and divided into training, validation, and testing sets as part of the pre-processing step. On the Potato leaf dataset, we refined the pre-trained VGG19 model using the transfer learning technique. According to experimental data, our suggested strategy outperformed other cutting-edge techniques, achieving an overall accuracy of 95.2% on the test set. Additionally, we compared various deep learning architectures and discovered that VGG19 is the best architecture for this task. A significant tool for farmers and agronomists, the suggested Potato leaf disease detection system might help them identify illnesses early and take the necessary precautions to stop their spread.

articleTitle: LTSum: Legal Text Summarizer
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the abundance of legal cases and law-related documents in countries with a large population such as India, it is becoming increasingly difficult for law professionals to assess cases by going through these large documents. Therefore, there is a growing need for text summarization models that specialize in legal tasks. In this paper, we propose a Legal Text Summarizer (LTSum) for the summarization of legal text documents. We evaluated the performance of the proposed LTSum using the ROUGE metric. Our LTSum incorporates a legal judgment prediction model to improve the accuracy of the generated summaries. We illustrate the effectiveness of our approach on the large set of legal documents. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed LTSum outperforms existing methods in legal text summarization. The results show that the incorporation of a legal judgment prediction model improves legal text memorisation significantly.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Detection of Forest Fire
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Forests are an essential natural resource for humanity because they provide a variety of direct and indirect advantages. It is essential to investigate the automatic detection of forest fires to prevent catastrophes. First, to address the issue of unequal distribution and a lack of samples, high-quality samples of forest fires were produced using General Advanced Networks, or GAN. Second, the forest fire area picture was predicted using an Adaboost classifier based on the properties of HOG (Histogram of Oriented Gradients), and the fire area was recognized secondarily using convolutional neural networks (CNN) and other methods: support vector machines, or SVMs. We want to automatically identify forest fires using deep learning (DL) based on the dataset of pictures (obtained by planes, satellites, and drones). In this study, we focused on the building of a deep learning model which will designed in such a way that it can detect wildfires using transfer learning methods from the best-trained deep learning computer vision architectures. Our proposed approach demonstrated its applicability in actual forest fire detection applications by achieving a detection rate of greater accuracy across various parameters.

articleTitle: Predicting Diseases using Machine Learning on Big Data from Healthcare Communities
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study investigates the application of machine learning methods to large-scale healthcare community data for disease prediction. The study makes use of a dataset containing information about the healthcare community gathered from multiple sources, such as medical records, social media, and online health forums. Machine learning algorithms might utilise the relevant data after it had been cleaned and converted to their preferred format. Additionally, the effectiveness of several machine learning techniques for disease prediction is evaluated.

Author Keywords: Area under the ROC Curve(AUC ROC)

articleTitle: Water Quality Monitoring with Satellite Image Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Monitoring the quality of water becomes vital in maintaining the security as well as the viability of water supplies. The manual sampling and analysis in laboratories used in conventional monitoring techniques can be time-consuming and expensive. During this era, imagery from satellites became a useful tool for assessing water quality across wide geographic areas. This paper is to assess and monitor water quality parameters using Convolutional Neural Network with 98% accuracy. It employs data acquired from satellites to detect and quantify various factors impacting water quality, such as pH, salinity, turbidity, chlorophyll and temperature. Spatial analysis differentiates water quality characteristics whereas Temporal analysis compares satellite data over time to detect changes in water quality. The proposed system offers significant advantages over traditional monitoring methods. It can be further improved by incorporating more advanced machine learning algorithms and satellite imagery.

articleTitle: Sketch to Image synthesis using attention based contextual GAN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Generating realistic and high-quality images from sketches remains a challenging task in the fields of computer vision and graphics. Although deep learning approaches, specifically Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), have showed promise in generating images in this area, issues such as image quality and diversity persist. In this study, a novel approach for generating human faces from sketches was proposed by leveraging a contextual GAN with attention mechanisms and ResNet-50 feature extraction. Proposed method aims to enhance image quality by incorporating attention mechanisms. Specifically, we extract relevant features from the input sketch using the ResNet-50 feature extraction technique, which are then utilized to guide the image synthesis process. To evaluate the model’s performance, a comparison is made with existing approaches using the CHUK dataset, assessing the results based on the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) score. The proposed technique achieves an impressive SSIM score of 0.78, outperforming other methods in generating realistic and faithful representations of the original images.

articleTitle: Mobility Aware Computation Offloading in Fog Devices using Virtual Machine Migration
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the current era, it is observed that most of the devices used for computation are mobile and consume a vast number of exhaustive resources. Edge computing saves bandwidth and decreases response time by fetching computation and data storage closer to data sources. Enabling computation at the edge empowers companies to enhance their management and utilization of physical assets, as well as facilitate the development of novel interactive human experiences. However, after a mobile device offloads computation to an edge device, it may leave the range of the edge device. To tackle this, the best fog server selection model using weighted majority is proposed along with a VM migration model with computation migration and handoff strategies to subsequent fog servers based on users’ mobility which is simulated using MobFogSim, an open-sourced cloud simulation tool built on iFogSim.

articleTitle: Emotional Analysis of Drug Addicted Patients using Virtual Reality Therapy and EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Human Brain consists of billions of neurons which play an imperative role in maintaining and controlling the behavior of the complete structure of the body as external or internal sensory stimuli. In today's world, the rapid development of drugs and alcoholic things more affecting the human mind. This is the reason for the spreading of several issues in health that are increasing day by day. To understand the cognitive things of human behavior is to analyze the signals of the brain. This can be visualized through the sensorimotor cortex which is the part of the brain that is associated with coordinating the muscle motions and the perception or thinking skills of the human brain. In this article, an experimental study is conducted for emotional analysis of drug addicted patients using Virtual Reality therapy. In the study, EEG signals of 12 patients are recorded using Emotiv Insight 5-channel EEG device and analyzed using the Emotiv Pro software. The study outcomes indicates that Virtual Reality therapy has a significant positive impact on stress and focus of the drug addicted patients.

articleTitle: Dockomation System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Delivering a good quality product is the prime requirement for software development process in which the quality aspects include consistency, reproducibility, environment dependency, etc. wherein execution time is a decisive factor for grading any software. Automation plays a crucial role in reducing time, effort, cost and manual errors to ensure high quality results by surpassing human errors. Most of the software automation tools currently being used are based on virtual machines. One of such prominently used tools is Jenkins. However it suffers from configuration time, execution time, complex user interface, cronjob triggering and host environment dependency. A docker based automation system (Dockomation) has been proposed to address the outset issues. The proposed system has been implemented in python and tested in the real time environment. The comparative assessment with Jenkins in terms of configuration time, execution time, etc. shows that Dockomation outperforms Jenkins.

articleTitle: An Optimal Approximation Technique for Fractional-order Lead Compensator Applied to a Car Suspension Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper deals with the optimal approximation of fractional-order lead compensator (FOLC). Stable, minimum-phase FOLC rational approximants are guaranteed using a constrained optimization procedure. The optimization is carried out using a state-of-the-art metaheuristic to approximate the frequency characteristics of the FOLC. Variation of the approximation order on the accuracy of the proposed FOLC, when applied to a car suspension compensation problem, is investigated. The efficacy of the algorithm in terms of convergence rate and computational time is evaluated. Comparison with the published literature demonstrates the lower approximation error achieved by the proposed approach.

articleTitle: IOT based Vehicle to Vehicle Communication and Accident Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The paper discusses the utilization of wireless communication in a particular field, which is referred to as Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication or Automotive Wireless Communication. It provides an overview of this technology and its applications in the automotive industry. V2V communication refers to the exchange of real-time data between vehicles wirelessly. The primary objective V2V correspondence is to forestall mishaps by enabling vehicles to share their speed and position information with each other. In case of any potential danger, the driver may receive a warning or on the other hand the actual vehicle might go to prudent lengths, for example, applying the brakes to dial back.

articleTitle: Improvement in transient and steady state response of a buck converter by designing optimal fractional order controllers using GA and MA
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper aims to improve the transient and steady state response of a buck converter in a close loop. To achieve this, the work explores four different controllers, i.e., PI, PID, fractional order (FO) PI and FOPID controllers. For each controller, parameters have been tuned using two different optimization techniques, namely Mayfly Algorithm (MA) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) to minimize Integral Time Absolute Error (ITAE) objective functions. The performance of the converter has been tested under three inputs of 10 V, 15 V and 20 V by keeping the desired output voltage at a reference value of 6.2 V. It has been found that the FOPI and FOPID controllers show better performance as compared to the conventional PI and PID controllers in minimizing the peak overshoots. MA based FOPI and FOPID controllers yield 0% peak overshoot. However, if the settling time is also considered, the GA based FOPID controller results in the best performance. GA based FOPID controller provides 0−18.4% peak overshoot and 7.5−12.9 ms settling time. The output parameters are also dependent on the input voltage.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Impact of No-Code/Low-Code Backend Services on API Development and Implementation: A Case Study Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Backend development requires a lot of boilerplates, and technical terms are difficult for everyone to understand. We are developing a platform where users can easily establish their backend endpoints and publish their code in order to address this issue. The goal of this project is to assist those who lack technical expertise yet desire to develop a backend for their projects, products, etc. A user can easily create their own backend logic with the use of a simple user interface, such as Scratch (a simple learning tool to assist people to learn to program). Using a drag-and-drop interface, the author is creating a backend service. These services offer pre-built blocks, templates, or drag-and-drop interfaces for users to utilize in order to create their own backend services, such as APIs, without having to write any code.

articleTitle: Traffic Safety Enforcement and Document Verification System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the continued evolvement of lifestyle, vehicles have become an important part of human lives. As a result, the number of vehicles that take to the road are increasing at an alarming level. This has in turn, led to a huge increase in traffic congestions. This poses a major challenge to the policing of vehicular movement, where the traffic policemen would find it extremely difficult to manually verify the hard copies of all mandatory documents, when required and to enforce traffic safety norms like wearing the seat belt. To tackle this issue, the following system is proposed through which, the law enforcement authorities would be able to efficiently verify the vehicle documents within a short span of time, without requiring the deriver to pull-over. Along with this, the system is also capable of monitoring and updating the seat belt status of the vehicle occupants in a real-time database, which can be accessed by the law enforcement authorities. The proposed system would be of immense help in reducing the time and effort taken for policing the large flow of vehicles in a real-world scenario.

articleTitle: A Step Forward to Smart Farming using Internet of Things and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With high-performance computers, machine learning has arisen to provide new opportunities. Huge volumes of data are being collected in all domains. The biggest issue is to meet the current population’s food need due to increase in population and fluctuating weather condition. Smart farming marks the start of an era in traditional agriculture. Agriculture has evolved with the help of artificial intelligent systems. Internet protocols, gateways, and IoT nodes can increase performance. Smart agriculture method is consisting of using Machine Learning (ML), Internet of Things (IoT), Blockchain algorithm, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). Real time data monitoring, data processing can be maintained by the algorithms. ML and AI can also protect using smart farming ecosystem. Using this method can increase the quality and quantity of the agriculture industry.

articleTitle: Forest Cover Type Prediction using Automatic Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The forest has been an important source of food, medicines, and other goods. However, as the human population has grown, the land is changing at an alarming rate, resulting in a lack of vegetation that hinders the biological system's operation. There are many different kinds of forests, from tropical to coniferous. Therefore, we must comprehend the forest type in order to enact or develop better policies and legislation. In recent years, ML has made significant progress and emerged as one of the most well-known and sought-after technologies of the moment. Its increasing value is due to its widespread use. Skills and computer resources, on the other hand, are the two biggest barriers to making effective use of machine learning (both classical and deep learning). Although spending a significant amount of money can provide computational resources, it is still difficult to locate skilled individuals to address the machine learning challenge. As a result, anyone with a limited understanding of machine learning cannot access it. To address this problem, Automatic Machine Learning (AutoML) was developed. It offers a number of ways to make machine learning accessible to people who don't know much about it. Its goal is to make it unnecessary for qualified individuals to build the ML model. It likewise assists with further developing proficiency and speed AI research. The Motivation behind this paper is to comprehend AutoML procedure utilizing apparatuses, for example, H2OAutoML, Python Jupyter Note pad and Python libraries, for example, numpy, pandas,h20, matplotlib, seaborn and so on. in order to accurately predict the type of forest cover. To contrast the accuracy of the best AutoML H20 model with that of previous studies on forest cover type prediction. We used n=8 fold cross validation to accomplish this, and the accuracy was 90.09% higher than in previous studies.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low Quantum Cost Reversible Universal Shift Register
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel and efficient design of a 4-bit Reversible Universal Shift Register (RUSR) using reversible logic gates. RUSR performs shifting operations the same as CMOS-designed universal shift registers, such as left shift, right shift and parallel load, respectively. In this paper, we are designing a 4-Bit RUSR using a reversible Master-Slave D-Flipflop (RMSDFF) and reversible 4X1 Multiplexer (RMUX41). The proposed RMSDFF and RMUX41 are designed using Feynman (FG), Fredkin (F) and Modified Fredkin (MF) gates. Modified Fredkin gate plays a remarkable role in the implementation of the proposed optimized architecture. The efficiency of the proposed architecture is demonstrated in terms of garbage outputs (GO) and quantum cost (QC). The proposed architecture reduces the power consumption with a low quantum cost, a minimum number of reversible logic gates and garbage outputs. Due to this, the proposed design is particularly beneficial in quantum computing, Low-power CMOS design, and other applications. In this paper, the RUSR is designed by the proposed RMUX41 and RMSDFF, which are designed with the reversible logic gates using the hardware description language Verilog and verified with the simulated results using the ModelSim Altera tool.

articleTitle: From Bullshit to Bull’s Eye - story of persuasive argument winning us a big pie
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Argument persuasiveness applications are becoming increasingly popular in today's digital age. These applications are designed to assist users in developing and delivering effective arguments, with the aim of persuading others to their point of view. The purpose of this research is to explore the applicability and effectiveness of argument persuasiveness prediction model. Specifically, this study aims to predict the argument's ability to influence the opinions of others using sentiment analysis on various argument components.

articleTitle: Incentive-based Energy-efficient Federated Learning Aggregation for Intrusion Detection in IoT Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: At present, the wide range of critical applications encompassing healthcare and financial management are inhabited by wireless sensor networks (WSN). The foremost challenge associated with it is the resource constraint. Also, the WSN being itself deployed for critical applications, the adverse wireless security threats lead to head-on effect on the safety and operational efficiency. Hence in WSN, the intrusion detection implementation should corroborate the energy-efficient implementation for seamless operation. The inherent distributed characteristic of WSN mandates the federated learning to avoid the huge communication cost. This in turn preserves the security of critical sensor data used for training. However, the sensor nodes suffer from energy depletion due to local training and communication for federated model aggregation. Thus, in the proposed Incentive-based Energy-efficient Federated Learning Aggregation (IEE-FedAgg), the global model incremental training performance is considered for optimally scheduling the sensor nodes for learning. The aggregation number is further tuned based on the real-time performance exhibited. The simple multi-layer perceptron (MLP) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) were considered for local training. Both the communication and computation energy consumption of the sensor nodes are considered for better analysis. The proposed IEE-FedAgg-LSTM model demonstrates the multi-class prediction accuracy of 99% and 98% for iid and non-iid data distribution respectively. Further, the proposed IEE-FedAgg mechanism attains the energy savings of 50% and 24% respectively for instrusion detection in iid and non-iid data distribution.

articleTitle: Harnessing TernausNet For The Segmentation Of Heart From Chest X-ray For The Recognition Of Atrial Septal Defect
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Semantic segmentation of chest X-rays can aid in the early detection of cardiac conditions, including atrial septal defect, which improves patient outcomes. The U-Net architecture is a popular approach to semantic segmentation, but it has some limitations such as the risk of vanishing gradients and the difficulty of capturing global context information. The TernausNet architecture is an improvement over U-Net that addresses these limitations by using residual connections, VGG16 encoders, stretching convolutions, and batch normalization. In this paper, we compare the performance of TernausNet and U-Net on the cardiomegaly datasets showing that TernausNet achieves better segmentation accuracy. We also analyze the advantages of TernausNet over U-Net in terms of architectural design and explain how these advantages improve the performance of the model.

articleTitle: E-Waste Intelligent Robotic Technology (EIRT): A Deep Learning approach for Electronic Waste Detection, Classification and Sorting
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In nowadays world, electronic waste (e-waste) has become one of the leading and most present type of waste in the world, posing various environmental and health problems, hence becoming a problem that can no longer be ignored. In this paper we propose a deep learning-based approach in order to accomplish detection, classification and sorting of e-waste. Such approach has been named EIRT, standing for E-waste Intelligent Robotic Technology, and it consists of a classification algorithm, which will be used for the classification and of the e-waste, and a car equipped with a robotic arm, which will be used to move around within a certain area detecting, collecting and sorting the e-waste accordingly. The algorithm was written based on the EfficientNet-D2 architecture, having achieved an 82.32% of accuracy.

articleTitle: Quantification of Individual Gas Components for Gas Sensor Array using Neural Networks with Levenberg–Marquardt (LM) and Bayesian Regularization (BR) Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Treating the signals from various gas sensors to increase their selectivity and sensitivity is promising. Feed-forward neural networks (FFNN) were used for pattern recognition to discriminate gas species and concentrations. This paper uses a publicly available gas mixture dataset of 16 gas sensor arrays. The dataset contains a mixture of Ethylene & CO and Methane & Ethylene in the air. The FFNN used a variation of Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) and Bayesian Regularization (BR) to train neural networks for better quantifying the individual gas. Based on statistical and computational complexity results, feed-forward neural networks (FFNNs) are the best classifier among the considered training model. Using the FFNN with the LM and BR models, the ppm concentrations of the identified gases were estimated. Both training models are perfect for mixed gas sensor data; Bayesian regularization provides results more accurately than the LR but took a very high run time, infact 3 times the LM model.

articleTitle: Optimal Ship Route Search Based on Multi-Objective Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Optimization of ship routing depends on several parameters such as ship and cargo characteristics, environmental factors, topography, international navigation rules and crew comfort, etc. Ship route optimization is an essential problem for ship operators to reduce fuel consumption and voyage duration. This work presents an algorithm to plan safe and optimal routes for ships moving inaccessible areas and with unlimited traffic direction. The route obtained is optimized with multiple objectives which makes it more unique and optimal. An evolutionary algorithm is used to create numerous locally optimal routes, and a parallel genetic algorithm is used to construct a final route by optimizing a set of said routes.

articleTitle: Customer Churn Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One significant problem that businesses face is customer attrition. It has become crucial for corporate operations and growth to prevent customer churn and work to keep clients. It is challenging to effectively estimate customer turnover because the majority of the existing projections use a single prediction model. Concentrating on the results of predictions of the models of machine learning, this study proposes a combination of estimating model for customer turnover and performs practical research on the model's efficacy. The combined prediction model outperforms the single customer churn prediction model in terms of accuracy and predictive impact, according to the findings of the predictions. It can also more naturally express the fundamental traits of the churn consumers.

articleTitle: Implementation of Perturb and Observe MPPT Algorithm for the Performance Enhancement of Hybrid Power Generation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The mismatching of electricity supply and demand leads a transition from Non-Renewable Sources to Renewable Energy Sources (RES) of power generation. Solar based power generation shows superior performance compared to other Renewable Energy Sources. However, unreliability is the major issues with solar based power generation. A suitable Hybrid Power Generation System is capable of overcoming the issues of independent operation of solar based power generation system. Further improvement of solar based hybrid power generation is achieved by incorporating Perturb and Observe Maximum Power Point Tracking algorithm which is cost effective and less complex. The proposed solar based hybrid power generation system is one of the feasible solutions for remote villages where conventional grid is unavailable. In this research, the performance parameters of proposed system are evaluated using MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: The Significance of Virtual Prototyping in reducing design risk and Accelerating Product Innovation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The utilization of prototypes can significantly impact the success of introducing new products in today's competitive global market. Virtual prototypes are widely used to reduce design risks, accelerate innovation, and shorten development time. A comprehensive approach is necessary for the design and development of the product, which involves the creation of performance-based simulation modules that replace physical prototypes. A methodology is proposed in this study to create a virtual prototype of a toy model, from concept to simulate the actual working environment. The purpose was to create a new product with minimized risk of failure and meet the required specifications. The approach aided in identifying and resolving potential issues, preventing inefficient use of resources, and improving overall system performance. In this study, a methodology is proposed to utilize virtual prototypes in visualizing, simulating, and exhibiting the real-time dynamic response and behaviour at the system-level functioning of products. This approach enabled the creation of performance-based simulation models that were crucial in testing and optimizing product behaviour while minimizing the risk of failure and ensuring the required specifications were met. Virtual prototypes also proved to be valuable test tools in validating product designs, serving as substitutes for physical prototypes. The results of this study demonstrated the effectiveness of virtual prototypes as aids in the design and development of products.

articleTitle: Prediction of Students’ Performance in Students’ Marks using Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The primary goal of an educational institution is to help in the growth of its students. Every Student needs proper attention but students who are below average needs special attention so that their performance can be improved. In this research, we will use machine learning algorithms to predict how many hours a student needs to study to score a certain desired percentage. Taking a dataset of students and then predicting their marks using the ‘Marks Predictor’ and then comparing it with the actual marks scored by them in their examination we can calculate the growth of students based on the difference between actual and predicted marks.

articleTitle: Developed an algorithm to Reduce Operational Complexity for Cyclotomic Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The paper presents an algorithm, difficulty arises in efficient computation of discrete Fourier transform over Galois field is measured. Method for reduction of additive complexity in Cyclotomic fast Fourier transform is proposed. The approach presented in proposed algorithm is initially sort even matrix then identify the identical terms present in the equations and replace them with a new variable. Comparitive analysis of Proposed algorithm with existing available methods is done and expérimental result shows that the proposed algorithm reduces operational complexity of Cyclotomic Fourier Transform.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Crop Management: A Smart Approach with WSN and AI Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: India's agriculture sector is critical to the country's economy, providing livelihood to over seventy percent of the rural population and contributing almost twenty percent to the GDP. However, traditional farming methods pose significant challenges, including soil fertility depletion, waterlogging, and crop damage. To modernize the sector, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) can play a crucial role. IoT's Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) can monitor soil moisture, temperature, nutrient levels, and humidity, providing real-time information about crop health and soil conditions. AI algorithms can help farmers make informed decisions about water and fertilizer use, optimize yields, reduce wastage, detect crop diseases and pests, and monitor large-scale farms using drones. The adoption of AI in agriculture has the potential to revolutionize the sector, ensuring continued growth and prosperity.

articleTitle: Consumer Complaints Classification using Deep Learning & Word Embedding Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The goal of Text classification is to categorize a document into predefined categories. Various supervised and unsupervised classifiers can be used to achieve this. In the research work proposed, SOTA (State of the Art) deep learning models and embedding techniques are used to classify consumers' complaints, which is in form of text, into 6 classes. Words and documents are represented as numeric vectors through embedding, enabling vector representations for related words. These representations are easily ingested by NLP algorithms. The classes represent departments where complaints are routed. Deep learning models like LSTM, Bi-LSTM, GRU and 1D CNN are used, along with word embedding techniques like Word2Vvec, Fasttext, Bert and Distilbert to represent text. The experimental results indicate that DistilBert and CNN achieved a 93% F-score.

articleTitle: Demand Response in Smart Grids using SDN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digitization of analogue meters has enabled the travel of information into duplex in electric power grids. This has fetched the ability of data collection and analysis from the consumer sinks. Transfer of such data requires extensive digital network transmission infrastructure as a parallel space. Being incorporated with a fresh network environment since proposals, harnessing and applying the modern network technologies(Software Defined Networks, Network Virtualization) in smart grids from elemental level provide opportunities for building applications which are dynamic and generic. This study explores the Demand response event, where the various problems of supply constraints (considerably in peak hours) are dealt with possible load smooth and reducing inefficient power generation. This follows the exploration of Variable Pricing possibilities based on factors like seasons, power generation modes, demand times. The whole network infrastructure is built upon Software Defined Networks’ (SDN) Virtual Network Functions (VNF) which gives possibilities for customization, easy adaptation to custom behaviours and much.

articleTitle: A Novel Trench Cavity-Based CP-TFET for Label-Free Biomolecule Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work presents a novel trench cavity (TC) charge plasma (CP) based TFET biosensor that produces significant ON current in the presence of biomolecules otherwise remain insensitive under vacant conditions. Hence, the TC-CP-TFET biosensor saves power in the absence of biomolecules but is capable of detecting their presence as soon as it senses a change in charge value or dielectric constant. It is found that the proposed biosensor has 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> times greater I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</inf> sensitivity as compared to conventional CP-TFET. Further, TFET biosensors are label-free and hence, reduce the cost to a great extent.

articleTitle: Deep Cascaded Broad Learning System with Sparsity based Framework for Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Due to Technological advancements lots of images are captured, stored and transmitted every day. Contamination of noise while capturing or transmitting over channel is inevitable. Due to this quality of obtained image needs to be improved by reducing the noise, which has applications like enhancement of images captured using camera, X-Ray, CT imaging, realistic noise removal, etc. Original BLS has already proven its ability for classification and regression tasks. DCBLS has cascaded feature mappings and enhancement nodes which has better feature representation. Original DCBLS based Image denoising is parallel approach which learns weights using analytical pseudo-inverse-based approach and has closed-form solution with adaptive technique to update regularization parameter λ. In this paper, simplified Deep cascaded Broad Learning System (DCBLS) and Sparsity based DCBLS framework for image denoising have been presented. Simplified DCBLS is sequential and has fixed regularization parameter. Second way is to learn the weight matrix using dictionary based sparse representation algorithm, Orthogonal Matching Pursuit(OMP), from training set of patches. Experimental Results obtained over the datasets Set5, Set14 and BSD-500 are presented and compared in detail for AWGN, and Poisson Noise Removal. Proposed denoising methods are compared against state-of-the-art methods which shows need of improvement with possible future directions.

articleTitle: Smart logistics multi-classification system using CNN and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Goods delivery and transportation have been an integral part of logistics, but damaging mismanagement of parcel packages has caused a draconian effect on the logistics and e-commerce industry. To mitigate this mismanagement and adverse effect on commodities, the proposed work has presented a smart logistic System (SLS) with parcel detection of damaged and fine parcel packages based on deep learning (DL) based image classification approach using an amalgamation of convolutional neural networks (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) classifying fine and damaged images of parcel packages resulting in detection accuracy of 96.84%. Furthermore, multi-classification of fine parcel images have been conducted to classify images based on four different weighing capacity of parcel packages which gives the best classification accuracy of 98.52% at the light parcel weighing level. In terms of detection accuracy, the presented study is an effective and authentic strategy for parcel classification.

articleTitle: Study and Comparative Analysis of ChatGPT, GPT and DAll-E2
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) has evolved greatly over the years, resulting in the introduction of sophisticated models such as GPT, ChatGPT, and Dall-E2 that employ deep learning approaches to evaluate and create humanlike replies to textual material. As a result, they have become indispensable tool for a variety of applications such as language translation, question answering, and text condensation. This research paper compares the aforementioned models. Secondly, the configuration of each model is explained, stressing its particular elements and discrepancies. Second, the study examines the training data which is further used for training the models, examining the dimensions and quality of the data. Lastly, the performance of each model is compared based on its capacity to create reactions similar to those of people. According to the findings, the ChatGPT, GPT, and Dall-E2 models have various strengths and drawbacks when it comes to creating human-like answers to text inputs. Yet, given the enormous quantity of conversational data required to train it, ChatGPT excels GPT and Dall-E2 in providing natural and realistic replies. Furthermore, ChatGPT's design is optimized for dialogue production, giving it an advantage over competing models.

articleTitle: DFRC Signal Classification: The Power of Deep Learning vs The Simplicity of Traditional Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With an increasing number of users and demand for higher data transmission rates, the need for bandwidth increases. The solution to this is to introduce spectrum sharing between radar and communication signals, so instead of competing for frequency, the signals can coordinate. This paper mainly focuses on comparing various signal separation and identification algorithms used to classify radar and communication signals in a Dual-functional radar-communication (DFRC) system. The noteworthy applications of DFRC systems are Air Traffic Control, Autonomous Vehicles. Other applications include IoT applications, military applications, drone applications, and civilian applications. The two methods incorporated in this paper are the traditional signal processing method and the deep learning method. In traditional signal processing, we have Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). In deep learning, we have Residual Network (Resnet) which uses neural networks for classification. PCA and Fast ICA methods extract independent signals using Blind Source separation.

articleTitle: Early Cerebral Infarction Detection and Classification Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The human body's most sophisticated and complicated organ is the brain. According to the Indian Stroke Association (ISA), the incidence of stroke is increasing in India, with up to 18 lakh brain stroke cases recorded each year. A brain stroke, also known as cerebral infarction, is the leading cause of death globally and it can damage the brain severely resulting in long-term disabilities. There are three key components of the human brain, first component is cerebrum (front-brain), second is brainstem (mid-brain) and third is cerebellum (little-brain). A cerebral infarction occurs when the circulation of blood to the brain is disturbed owing to difficulties with the blood arteries that supply it. Since it's a critical medical illness that necessitates emergency treatment, it must be diagnosed as quickly as possible to avoid brain damage and to decrease fatality rates. This paper offered a framework and methodology for accurately anticipating brain strokes. The algorithm was developed using data from brain strokes. So, we conclude from the data that our recommended model was employed to have the maximum level of precision by applying performance evaluation criteria like accuracy score and sensitivity rate

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Weed Detection and Classification Datasets for Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The plant that grows along with valuable agricultural goods is called a weed. This weed inhibits the crop’s growth and diminishes farm productivity, so the weeds should be detected and removed. Weed detection and control play a vital role in agriculture, as weeds reduce crop yields, degrade product quality, and raise production costs. Weed detection is the challenge of properly recognizing the area of weeds so that particular regions may be targeted for spraying with the least amount of spraying on the crops of interest. Weeds are managed using herbicides. The herbicide may also damage the plant if the weed species isn’t detected. To manage weeds in fields, it is required to identify and categorize them. A convolutional neural network, a DL-based computer vision system, is used to analyze images. Most of the existing reviews focused on the CNN-based technology to identify weeds. There were two key steps in this suggested technique. The first step is image gathering and labelling, in which the characteristics for images to be tagged based on images are extracted. The second step is to develop the CNN model, which is used to identify the weed. This paper gives the taxonomy of various publicly available datasets for weed detection. This paper aims to study and analyze the weed detection and classification approaches in precision agriculture. We present the taxonomy of various publicly available datasets for weed detection as an outcome of the literature study. We review these datasets’ primary traits and uses and discuss the important factors that should be considered while producing high-quality public image databases for weed detection and classification. This paper also focused on research challenges in current weed detection approaches.

articleTitle: XGBoost Classification of XAI based LIME and SHAP for Detecting Dementia in Young Adults
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As technology progresses on a fast pace, it is imperative that shall be used in the field of medicine for the early detection and diagnostics of dementia. Dementia affects humans by deteriorating the cognitive functions, and as such many algorithms have been used in the detection of the same but all these algorithms remain a black box to the medical fraternity which is still dubious about the nature and credibility of the prediction. To ease this issue, the use of explainable artificial intelligence has been proposed and implemented in this paper, which makes it easy to understand why and how the model is giving a particular output. In this paper the XGBoost classification algorithm has been used which give an accuracy of 93.33% and to understand these predictions, two separate algorithms namely Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) and Shapely Additive Explanations (SHAP) have been used. These algorithms are compared based on the type of explanation they provide for the same input and thus the weakness of LIME algorithm has been found out at certain intervals based on the clinically important features of the dataset. On the other hand, both the algorithms make it easy for medical practitioners to understand the dominating factors of a predicted output thereby helping to eliminate the black-box nature of dementia detection.

articleTitle: GingerBangla: A Supervised Machine Learning Approach for Predicting Ginger Yield using Bangladeshi Climate Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Ginger (Zingiber officinale) farming is an important part of Bangladesh's agriculture, and it also contributes significantly to the country's economy. Accurate prediction of ginger yield is essential for farmers, and decision-makers, to optimize their cultivation practices, and for other agricultural stakeholders to use in their strategic planning. In this study, We propose to use Bangladesh climate data to develop a supervised machine-learning method for predicting ginger yield. To predict ginger yield, four machine-learning models were used: XBGR, GBR, RFR, and DTR. The model's accuracy was evaluated using historical data from 23 domestic Bangladeshi regions covering a 54-year period from 1968 to 2021, obtained from the Government organization in Bangladesh. According to the results, XBGR predicted ginger yield with an accuracy of 91%, GBR, and RFR predicted it with an accuracy of 95%, and DTR predicted it with an accuracy of 85%. The results demonstrate that supervised machine learning models can predict ginger yield with accuracy using climate data. The high accuracy of the GBR and RFR models shows that they can be used to predict ginger yield in Bangladesh. These models can help farmers and policymakers make smart decisions about handling crops, where to put resources, and how to reduce risks. This study helps to address current issues with ginger farming in Bangladesh. Production of ginger is severely hampered by unpredictable climate patterns, which include temperature changes, rainfall unpredictability, and severe weather events. Using supervised machine learning models, especially GBR and RFR, to predict ginger production in Bangladesh is a good way to do this. The accurate yield predictions made possible by this study can help farmers, reduce expenses, and make sure that ginger production is sustainable, even when the weather is unpredictable.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks for Automated Glaucoma Detection: Performance and Limitations
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Glaucoma is a set of eye disorders that, if left untreated, can cause optic nerve damage, resulting in vision loss and blindness. While glaucoma is often linked with high eye stress, it can also develop with normal or low pressure. The most common variety, primary open-angle glaucoma, is known as the silent thief of sight because it causes slow vision loss with no symptoms. Ethnicity, age, diabetes, bloodline, and hypertension are all dangerous factors. Regular eye exams are crucial for early detection. To aid in glaucoma detection, a model utilizing eye fundus images is proposed. Fundus images provide valuable information about the optic nerve’s health and abnormalities. The model employs a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to classify fundus images and detect glaucoma. By automating the process, the proposed system aims to improve accuracy. This CNN-based model has the potential to enhance glaucoma detection, enabling prompt interventions and better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Blood Pressure with Video Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach for the purpose of ongoing blood pressure monitoring using a non-invasive method. The method utilizes photoplethysmography (PPG) signals, which are procured from video processing techniques. By leveraging the camera on a smartphone, the video can be easily captured and analyzed to estimate blood pressure. The video is broken down into frames, and the average pixel brightness of these frames is calculated, providing an estimate of blood pressure (BP). To enhance accuracy, a low-pass Butterworth filter is applied to the PPG signals extracted from the video. The system's blood pressure measurements were compared against those of adigital system. The outcomes demonstrated that the suggested approach succeeded with remarkable accuracy, with a measurement error of ±3.38%. This level of error falls well within the acceptable limits for blood pressure measurement, hence demonstrating the efficacy of the developed system. This innovative approach has the potential to revolutionize blood pressure monitoring by offering a convenient, non-invasive, and reliable solution for continuous measurement using smartphone technology.

articleTitle: Multi-Disease Classification in In-Field Coffee Leaves Using Cost-Efficient Ensemble Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Computer vision techniques have been instrumental in predicting plant diseases so that preventive measures can be taken on time. The current study uses deep learning ensemble techniques to focus on multiple disease classifications - healthy, red spider mite, and rust in coffee leaves. Transfer learning has been employed using eight pre-trained models - VGG16, VGG19, InceptionV3, ResNet50V2, EfficientNetB0, MobileNetV2, DenseNet201, and InceptionResNetV2, for classifying coffee leaf images into the three classes. An in-field dataset has been used, and data augmentation techniques are employed to overcome the problem of data imbalance. The models have been trained, validated, and tested using a 60-20-20 train-val-test split ratio, and the classification accuracy and the training duration of the models are examined. Analysing the trade-off between the two factors, the top two models have been chosen as base classifiers to constitute a more robust and cost-efficient ensemble classifier. The results show that EfficientNetB0 architecture is the most efficient, with a classification accuracy of 92.48% and a training duration of 1.09 hours. MobileNetV2 architecture is the second top model with 91.16% accuracy and 0.79 hours of training duration. The 2-model ensemble classifier performs with an average accuracy of 97.01% on five random test sets with a total training duration of 1.88 hours. The model also outperforms the state-of-the-art and performs exceptionally well (99.4% accuracy and training time- 1.05 hours) on the Arabica coffee dataset with class labels - healthy, miner, cerscospora, leaf rust, and phoma. Therefore, the proposed model can be used for multi-disease classification in real-time coffee leaves to minimise yield losses.

articleTitle: Realization of improvements to compressive sensing based speech enhancement for hearing aid applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Enhancing the speech distorted with various noises and making the speech intelligible to humans is the prime requirement in hearing aid applications. In this work, a novel compressive sensing based speech enhancement technique with two improvements of low congruence binary sensing matrix and combined filter gain is proposed and realized using Simulink. The proposed solution has four stages of filtering, sparse representation, adaptive compressive sensing and optimized reconstruction. These four stages are realized in Simulink. The performance of the proposed solution is tested for different noisy speeches and performance measured in terms of various voice quality metrics and delays. The performance of the proposed solution is compared against other compressive sensing-based speech enhancement techniques

articleTitle: Recognition of Obstructive Sleep Apnea from a Single Lead Electrocardiogram Signal Using a ResNet Model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a prevalent sleep disorder that induces respiratory disturbances during the state of sleep. Furthermore, it is associated with several comorbidities, such as cardiovascular ailments like coronary heart disease and hypertension. Nocturnal polysomnography (PSG) is a clinical diagnostic modality utilized for the diagnosis of OSA. This method is associated with significant costs and discomfort for patients, as it necessitates manual interpretation by trained professionals and is time-consuming. Methods utilizing electrocardiogram (ECG) signals for the diagnosis of OSA have been proposed as a means of mitigating associated challenges. Nevertheless, the vast majority of the currently available solutions are based on feature engineering, which requires a large amount of specialized knowledge and skill. The present study introduces an innovative technique for the categorization of OSA through the utilization of a ResNet model on a solitary-lead ECG signal. In order to train and test the proposed model, the PhysioNet Apnea-ECG database was used throughout the process. ReseNet18 and ResNet50 are both deep learning models, and they are used to predict how well the model will perform. For a batch size of 256, after 2, and before 2, the ResNet 18 proved its maximum performance by achieving an accuracy of 89% and a recall of 89%. In addition, the ResNet 50 was able to attain its maximum performance by doing the following: obtaining an accuracy of 89%, a precision of 89%, an F1-score of 89%, and a recall of 89% for the batch size of 512, after 1, and before 1.

articleTitle: Nano-scale Quantum Modified SnTe/Pb0.98Sn0.02Te Supper lattice Structure Based Highly Sensitive Exotic p+-i-n+ IR Photo-detector
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, asymmetrical super-lattice SnTe/Pb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.98</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.02</inf>Te exotic p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-i-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> nano-scale photo-sensor has been reported with significant improvement of photo-responsivity and quantum efficiency in the near infrared wavelength region. The photo-electric characteristics of the proposed Device-Under-Test (DUT) are studied by developing self consistent Non-linear Quantum Modified Drift-Diffusion (NQMDD) Model with appropriate boundary conditions. The proposed NQMDD model is validated by comparing the simulated results with the experimental results under a-like operating-conditions. An excellent agreement, in between the simulated and experimental results, under a-like operating-conditions, reveals the validity of the proposed NQMDD simulator. The performance of the DUT is enhanced by incorporation of alternate thick – SnTe and thin- Pb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.98</inf> Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.02</inf>Te layers into the active region of the device. To the best of authors’ knowledge this is the first report on asymmetrical super-lattice SnTe/Pb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.98</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.02</inf>Te exotic p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-i-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> nano-scale IR photo-sensor. The proposed DUT will play an important role for device-engineering for the development of highly sensitive circuits in defence and bio-medical industries.

articleTitle: CopulaGAN Boosted Random Forest based Network Intrusion Detection System for Hospital Network Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The growing dependence on technology in healthcare has resulted in the creation of sophisticated hospital networks that are highly linked and vulnerable to cyber threats. A reliable Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) is required to identify and prevent such cyberattacks. The network intrusion detection is vital for safeguarding hospital networks and guaranteeing data security. The CICIDS2017 dataset contains a comprehensive set of network traffic characteristics for assessing network intrusion detection systems. Besides that, class imbalance is a prevalent difficulty in intrusion detection and it may have a considerable impact on the effectiveness of classification algorithms. The suggested solution employs a Machine Learning (ML) based NIDS for hospital networks that utilizes CopulaGAN (Generative Adversarial Network) to address the challenges due to imbalanced class ratio. The synthetic samples of minority classes were created to balance the dataset and improve detection accuracy. The Random Forest (RF) algorithm is used to discover the most defining features in the dataset and its hyperparameters are tuned to improve classification performance. Overall, the CopulaGAN boosted Random Forest based NIDS described here is a valuable solution for detecting network intrusions in hospital networks.

articleTitle: FlashMe: Automatic Flashcard Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The task of studying and revising can be perceived as challenging due to the intricate nature of concepts presented in dense textbook material. Furthermore, it has been observed that students allocate as much as 50% of their study time towards study techniques that are deemed less effective [1]. Thus, encouraging students to employ efficient methods is important. Additionally, numerous studies have demonstrated that flashcards are an exceptionally efficient method for enhancing learning outcomes. [2]. To tackle this issue, our research indicates the utilization of various advanced Natural Language Processing models. These models would be combined to develop a multi-stage transformer architecture that enables the automated creation of flashcards from text containing technically rich literature.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Data Mining Approaches for Forecasting Sales of FMCG Food Products
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sale forecasting is considered a key factor for balancing risk of over-stocking and out-of-stock. Its performance is largely influenced by the input it provides to supply chain activities. A competitive advantage for producers and retailers is the ability to predict sales of fast-moving consumer goods with greater accuracy, particularly in the food industries. If the accuracy of the sale prediction is poor, even with significant effort and financial investment, supply chain activities will still be unreliable and inefficient. The objective of the study is to evaluate the effectiveness of various data mining algorithms for predicting the future sales of FMCG food products. The study analyses four popular data mining techniques: Cluster Analysis, Regression Analysis, Visualization and Tracking Patterns on a dataset of historical sales data. The study compares the accuracy and efficiency of these algorithms using various performance metrics. The research aims to help the different stakeholders, like various businesses were involved in wholesale, manufacturing, marketing, logistics, and retailing. This study provides valuable insights for FMCG food product sales forecasting, and can be useful for businesses to make informed decisions about their sales strategies.

articleTitle: An Efficient Voting Based Consensus Algorithm for Permissionless Blockchains
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Blockchain is an emerging technology that offers a wide range of applications in various sectors such as financial services, industrial products, healthcare, and media, among others. The important component of any blockchain system is the consensus algorithm. It plays a major role in deciding the performance, efficiency, and security of the blockchain network. Currently, there are over 30 consensus algorithms in use, including Proof-of-Work (PoW), Proof-of-Stake (PoS), and Proof-of-Authority (PoA), among others. However, these algorithms have drawbacks in terms of security, stability, and productivity. While PoW is widely used by popular cryptocurrencies, it is unsustainable and inadequate for ensuring blockchain-based security solutions. PoS is more vulnerable to the concentration of wealth, leading to potential system destabilization by those with significant stakes. To address these issues, Delegated Proof-of-Stake (DPoS) is created, an algorithm that eliminates the competition for computing resources in block production. This approach reduces the cost of block generation and introduces a fully PoS-based election system, but still has security issues. This work introduces an enhanced version of DPoS called Improved Delegated Proof-of-Stake (iDPoS), which includes a downgraded mechanism to eliminate malicious nodes while maintaining security. Performance analysis demonstrates that the improved consensus algorithm is more efficient compared to PoS and DPoS consensus algorithms.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of CNN Architectures For Driver Drowsiness
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Drowsiness is the sensation of being sleepy without warning. Sleep deprivation, tiredness, and fatigue can all contribute to drowsiness, which can cause a driver to lose attention and cause irreversible damage. To help reduce the occurrence of such mishaps, early detection of drowsiness is essential. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have recently shown remarkable performance in a variety of applications, including drowsiness detection. This study focuses on fine-tuning these networks for the purpose of drowsiness detection in drivers. Finally, an evaluation was done for the comparison and the analysis of the latest architectures, including CNN, Inception V3(IV3), and Visual Geometry Group(VGG 16), in order to determine which one achieves the most favorable outcomes for the intended task. Inception V3 and VGG-16 "transfer learning models" with the most effective classification results were chosen for the analysis and comparison. The dataset utilized for the research, named "yawn-eye-dataset-new (YEDN)," consisting of 2900 images taken from Kaggle, has four classes: two states (i. open, ii. closed) for the eye and mouth, respectively. The models were assessed on the basis of their F-Score, sensitivity, accuracy, and precision using a multi-class statistical analysis. VGG-16 technique shows an accuracy of 98.6% and sensitivity of 98.5%. The VGG-16 model can be used in drowsiness detection systems to significantly improve driver safety and reduce the occurrence of unfortunate incidents brought on by driver drowsiness thanks to its high success rate, which allows for this conclusion.

articleTitle: Enhanced Link Quality-based Routing Protocol for underwater networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the fundamental functions of any Underwater Acoustic Sensor Network (USANs) is routing. Due to long transmission delays, change in the position of nodes, bandwidth issues, and changes in frequency, designing routing protocols for UASNs presents several diﬃculties. Numerous UASNs routing protocols exist and were developed based on various factors such as link quality, hop count, and packet delivery probability. One of the key elements affecting how well routing functions in underwater communication is link quality which is measured using the physical characteristics of underwater. The paper’s main contribution is designing an Enhanced Link Quality-based Routing Protocol(ELQRP) for underwater networks where cumulative packet delivery ratio(PDR) is being used to determine the next best hop for any node in a network. ELQRP chooses the link which has the highest cumulative PDR. Implementation of ELQRP is done using Matlab.

articleTitle: Collision Resolution of VANET Nodes for TDMA MAC Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: TDMA is a channelisation MAC protocol that is advantageous in Vehicular Ad hoc Networks(VANETs) to schedule and control the access to shared communication channels, so that multiple vehicles or nodes can transmit and receive data without interfering with each other. However, when multiple nodes transmit data at the same time slot, a collision can occur, and may result in loss of data or data corruption. This paper aims to investigate and propose an improved collision resolution mechanism that improves the network’s throughput and reduces packet loss. The goal is to ensure efficient and reliable communication among nodes in VANETs, which find various applications in emerging technologies.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of 9T and 6T SRAM Cells at 7nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Performing an investigation on the power consumption and delay parameters of 6T and 9T SRAM cells, respectively. Memory power consumption is a crucial design aspect because of the direct impact it has on the overall energy efficiency of the system as well as the amount of power that it draws. Because it requires a larger voltage swing during write operations and is more vulnerable to leakage currents, the 6T SRAM cell is often the one that consumes more power than its 9T counterpart. On the other hand, the 9T SRAM cell has a differential write mechanism that helps decrease the voltage swings and leakage currents, which results in less energy being used by the cell. The amount of time that must pass before a memory cell may be read from or written to is referred to as the "access time." Because of its more straightforward design and more compact transistors, the 6T SRAM cell often demonstrates faster access times than its 9T SRAM counterpart. The increased number of transistors in the 9T SRAM cell causes an increase in the access latency experienced by the cell. As can be observed from the comparison of performance, the power and delay characteristics of 6T and 9T SRAM cells are distinct from one another. The 9T SRAM cell consumes less power but has much longer access times than its 6T cousin, which normally draws more current but offers faster read/write operations. These differences are due to the fact that the 9T SRAM cell has a higher density of transistors. With the assistance of the Tanner software, the 6t and 9t SRAM topologies have been included into the 7nm predictive technology model (PTM).

articleTitle: Effect on Public Health Due to Environment Condition- Role of IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The biggest environmental issues are poor air quality, polluted water, contaminated food, polluted transportation, and radiation contamination. In order to ensure sustainable growth and preserve a stable social structure, adequate monitoring is required. With the development of contemporary sensors and advancements in the internet of things (IoT), environmental surveillance has evolved into a smart environment monitoring (SEM) platform in recent decades. The emergence and widespread use of Internet of Things (IoT) devices and its supporting technologies are the driving forces behind the growth of ubiquitous systems, as shown in this study. This study analysisIoT has great promise in the environment, health, & safety (EHS) industries that involve high risk. The social health can be improved with the use of technology that manages and organises information about individuals. IoT may actually serve as the foundation for a society that is health. In this study, we discussed how the Internet of Things (IoT) may benefit individuals and how it can be used for public health. and also highlight IoT-related problems and a suggested remedy.

articleTitle: Recent Trends To Detect Melanoma Using Dermoscopic Images: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Skin cancer poses a significant public health concern, with melanoma being one of its most prevalent forms. Early detection of melanoma plays a crucial role in effective treatment and patient outcomes. Automated screening systems have shown promise in accurately identifying melanoma at its early stages. In recent years, advanced deep learning algorithms have demonstrated impressive outcomes, in detecting melanoma using dermoscopic images. This research article provides an insights into the recent developments and achievements in using deep learning algorithms for melanoma detection using dermoscopic images.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Analysis in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In machine learning, no model achieves 100% accuracy because of their probabilistic nature, and thus they end up providing a probability for false predictions. In B2B applications false predictions have a huge impact on the product. So, it is important to ascertain the incorrect inferences, but based on just probability analysis, we can't tell them with confidence. One of the main reasons to get a false prediction is the presence of outliers in the multivariate dataset. These outliers can unduly influence the results of the analysis. Outliers are data points with deviated statistical properties from normal observations. But the problem here is that the change in statistical properties of one feature does not imply a change in the overall data record. So, to address these issues, we present a method that calculates a score for each record of the dataset, based on feature weights and outlier scores, and using that score, we determine a confidence interval so that it will help us identify false predictions caused by an ML model when it is in production.

articleTitle: Handwritten Character Recognition using Dynamically Mapped CNN Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach to developing a handwriting recognition system by leveraging deep learning techniques. The proposed method involves several stages. Firstly, a dataset is obtained from Kaggle, followed by a thorough data-cleaning process to eliminate unreadable samples. The data is then preprocessed by converting the images into the grayscale format, resizing them to a width of 256 and a height of 64, and finally normalizing the pixel values to fit within the range of [0, 1]. Subsequently, the dataset has been split into training sets and testing sets. with appropriate labels prepared for the CTC loss function. The model architecture is constructed by combining convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for feature extraction with sequence layers containing bidirectional LSTM (bi-LSTM) units. The model is trained using the training set and then evaluated using the testing set, utilizing n-gram analysis as the evaluation metric. The evaluation results show that the developed handwriting recognition system is efficient and successful.

articleTitle: Cyber Security and People: Human Nature, Psychology, and Training Affect User Awareness, Social Engineering, and Security Professional Education and Preparedness
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work focuses on how machine learning methods may be used to identify threats and provide countermeasures. Security threats and vulnerabilities pose significant difficulties in today’s digital world. Algorithms trained with machine learning can sift through massive volumes of data, look for trends, and spot possible security breaches as they happen. These algorithms can offer preventative security measures and actions because they use sophisticated analytics and predictive models. This abstract delves into the use of machine learning to bolster security, focusing on its potential to improve threat detection and provide implementable suggestions for shoring up overall security.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of DC Microgrid With Multiple Renewable Energy Sources And Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: DC microgrids with renewable energy sources and battery storage systems are a promising technology for as a means of enhancing reliability and sustainability of power systems.
