The effective management of power flows in such microgrids is critical for ensuring efficient and dependable source of power to the loads. In this study, a power management strategy is proposed for a DC microgrid with PV, wind, and battery storage systems, supplying power to a single-phase AC load. The control strategy employs a PI controller to regulate the voltage and current of the microgrid, while the Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) algorithm is used to optimize the control parameters. The ISE objective function of the GWO algorithm is to minimize the deviation of the voltage and current from their reference values. The proposed strategy is implemented in MATLAB/Simulink, and its performance is evaluated under different operating conditions. The simulation’s outcomes show that the suggested technique can effectively regulate the voltage and current of the microgrid, ensure a balanced power flow among the different sources, and improve the overall system efficiency. The GWO optimization technique enhances the performance of the PI controller and achieves a faster response compared to the conventional tuning methods. Overall, the proposed power management strategy is a promising approach for the efficient and reliable operation of DC microgrids with renewable energy sources and battery storage systems.

articleTitle: SEOHFB: A Secure Environment for Organization based on Hyperledger Fabric Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Blockchain and hyperledger are decentralized approaches used for maintaining security, secrecy, and integrity of organization based business transactions. In our study we have built a permissioned blockchain using HyperLedger Fabric framework that able to handle data storage and secure intra-and inter-organizational communication. The key reason for which we have chosen HyperLedger Fabric framework is that, it uses RAFT consensus algorithm that provides permissioned blockchain network by creating a channel that was unavailable to the public blockchain network. We have made a smart contract for the permissioned blockchain by developing and writing the chaincode. We have used Fabric-CA server to generate crypto material. Then we have set up the network configuration, organizations, ordered peers, endorsing peers, anchor peers and developed client application for Hyperledger Fabric. We have integrated the web-front with fabric using WEB-API.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Breast cancer develops when cells in your breast multiply and expand out of control, resulting in a lump of tissue known as a tumor. Feeling a lump, observing a change in breast size, or observing changes to the skin surrounding your breasts are all examples of breast cancer symptoms. Early detection may be aided by mammograms. The goal of this project is to determine the likelihood that the characteristics of a breast mass computed from digital photographs may accurately indicate the type of breast cancer (malignant or benign). The cases offered are cases where a tumor of some kind has been diagnosed, although only a small percentage of them (about 37% of them) are malignant. Based on the characteristics gathered from the breast mass, this study will examine the data provided and attempt to predict whether a diagnosis of breast cancer is malignant or benign.

articleTitle: Ergodic Capacity Analysis and Power Optimization in Time Shared Cooperative NOMA
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work proposes a cooperative NOMA system that operates on the time-sharing model, namely TS-C-NOMA. According to this paradigm, a base station provides direct service to a cell center user (CCU), but a cell edge user (CEU), even with a direct connection with the base station, needs the CCU's cooperation (as a relay) for proper signal reception. Conventionally, a separate relay has been provided to the CEUs for signal reception. Consideration is given to a case where CEUs outnumber CCUs. The aforementioned method time-shares a CCU with numerous clustered CEUs, effectively using the various CEUs' frequency ranges, which may go unused in typical C-NOMA. Power optimization has been done with the utilization of channel state information. With the use of time-sharing and power optimization parameters, ergodic capacity is thoroughly determined. The ergodic sum capacity of the proposed scheme with fixed power allocation and optimum power allocation is analytically computed, verified by simulations, and contrasted with traditional methods to demonstrate the capacity gains attained.

articleTitle: Traffic Prediction Using Auxiliary Information Based on Mlbsae-A Hybrid Deep Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Traffic prediction is one of the challenging tasks and has many applications. The effective predictive data analytic algorithm gives the smart city concept wings and is essential for controlling chaotic traffic conditions. Due to the non-linear and chaotic features of large traffic data, Deep Learning techniques can play major role in increasing the effectiveness of predictive analytics in Traffic Modeling. Taking into account the benefits and drawbacks of various prediction models, this study proposes a hybrid deep learning framework based on BiLSTM and stacked autoencoders. We called this model MLBSAE (Multi-Layer BiLSM and Stacked Auto-Encoders). Complex chaotic features from traffic data are extracted using stacked autoencoders (SAE). Output of the feature extraction produced by stacked autoencoder becomes input sequence to the multilayer BiLSTM. Experiments are conducted on traffic data from California that includes auxiliary information like weather, accident and incident data apart from the traffic data collected through sensors. Recent prediction models like SARIMA, XGBoost and Random Forest models are used to compare the effectiveness of the suggested hybrid model.To evaluate the effectiveness of the models, statistical error measures such as accuracy, precision; F-Score and recall of both micro and macro are considered. The results of the simulation show that MLBSAE generates more precise projections compared to the state of art models.

articleTitle: Analytical Hierarchy Process based routing protocol for Multi-channel Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: An Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) based multi-channel routing protocol for multi-channel WSN (MWSN), has been proposed. It is based on the virtual grids formed out of the whole sensor network. The considered network is a combination of static and mobile nodes; some sensor nodes are fixed and others are mobile. The sink is fixed and placed outside the sensor field. Data forwarding decision, from the source to the base station, is taken with the help of a mathematical tool known as the Analytical Hierarchy Process. Channels are assumed to be colored with unique colors so that each channel can be distinctly identified at ease. Thus in an ideal situation, the entire channel starting from the source node to the base station is expected to be of single color, however, it may not be always the case. The proposed work is simulated in Matlab 7.1. The performance of the protocol has been compared with two well-known protocols namely ABORt and DRCS. The protocol outperforms both in terms of throughput and energy efficiency. The future direction of the work has been outlined.

articleTitle: 32nm CMOS Analog Circuit Implementation of STDP for SNNs
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Spiking Neural Network is a network that operates with neurons that generate voltage or current spikes and are connected by synapses. Spike Time Dependent Plasticity (STDP) is a learning rule which governs how strong or weak the connections between two neurons will be based on temporal information of spike activity of two connected neurons. We propose a 32nm analog CMOS implementation of STDP based synapse in this work. Simulation results demonstrate that the circuit effectively emulates the behavior of STDP. The proposed circuit can be used as a synapse in the construction of a complete SNN architecture.

articleTitle: Time Series Forecasting of Agricultural Products Sale Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Due to the massive production of data, the time series dataset is useful for time-based prediction as it holds time related information. Different forecasting techniques help to predict in the field of the stock market, sales, healthcare, banking, weather etc. The coming out of new companies has increased every year, and they have taken part in the competition with other existing organizations with their products and services. As the competition is growing day by day, sales analysis is a must for every organization to make a strong position in the competitive market. In that case, product and area-wise sales analysis can help a company to attain its aim by accomplishing its target. The success of a business mainly relies on the sales of its product. Predicting the sales may help the company to discern the amount of growth rate. Moreover, this research target is to estimate the production amount for their next manufacture. More precise predictions can give fame and make companies successful. Though it is a challenging task, with the help of machine learning algorithms this issue can be sorted out effectively. In this research, we have analyzed the product selling rate and used Multi Step LSTM for forecasting the sales of the agricultural product for the next month sales.

articleTitle: Fin-STance: A Novel Deep Learning-Based Multi-Task Model for Detecting Financial Stance and Sentiment
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Stance detection has been gaining popularity in text mining and information retrieval-based research. Recognition of sentiment also plays an important role in the analysis of text whether the underline stances are in favor or against for a particular domain. However, there is extensive research in this direction, but considering its impact on the financial text has not been explored yet. This paper presents a new deep learning based multi-task approach for financial stance detection and sentiment detection. A new model called Fin-STance is introduced which performs two-classification tasks as stance detection and sentiment detection based on the financial data. It constitutes of an input, embedding, followed by shared and task-specific layers. The empirical evaluation of this study is conducted on a newly created dataset and it shows impressive results. Also, this study receives better results with relevant compared methods.

articleTitle: Cyber Security Implementation Issues in Small to Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) and their Potential Solutions: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As the tech industry is advancing day by day, the digital data they store, their dependency on technology and other resources is also enlarging. Although large businesses account for returning high returns and turnover, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) also have a large market share in this evolving era of technology. As these SMEs are becoming dependent on technology and moving towards the cyber space, the cyber security risks for these companies are also increasing. In current scenario, providing cyber security is more inclined towards large businesses, but what about the SMEs? Today, SMEs are not well prepared to defend themselves from cyber threats and attacks, and some of them can't even detect data breaches and manage cyber security risks. In addition, the mindset of the people within these SMEs is like "We SMEs are too small for any cyber-attack or threat". But this is just a myth and a mistake. Since they are small, lack resources and capital, SMEs become one of the prime targets of hackers. Therefore, this review paper gives a literature review and insights about the research conducted so far around the world regarding the cyber security problems faced by SMEs and how they can cope with cyber security threats and defend themselves against malicious cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: An efficient data collection tool for crop recommendations model using Robotic Process Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Farmers in rural areas make the crop decisions based on the forecasts and collective knowledge transferred over generation within their community. Farmers who rely on their own prediction for farming and other agricultural activities lead farmers to go through huge loss. A farmer take decision on which crop to be grown is mostly based on intuition and other factors like profit based crop and what their ancestors followed on choosing the crop. Due to changes in soil structure and climate condition farmers tend to make wrong decision. Crop recommending models involve huge collection of data’s from various sources like soil data, weather data and historical yield data. It involves multiple stages of data collection, processing and analyzing. In this paper we proposed an efficient data collections tool for crop recommendations model using RPA.RPA (Robotic Process Automation) is a tool used for collecting data from various sources by automatically. By implementing RPA for crop recommendation model ensures that data’s are to date and accurate. It also saves time and increase efficiency. In this proposal we presented an efficient predictive model that uses Robotic Process Automation (RPA) by developing software robots to automate the repetitive tasks and processes using UiPath tool. RPA is commonly used in healthcare and finance sectors. We found use cases of RPA in agriculture domain as well. On the basic of existing work this paper focus on RPA in Agriculture to automate data collection, processing and analysis. A Challenging work in Crop Recommendation is collecting metrological data and climate data and making connecting between them. This research paper proposes an efficient predictive modelto choose the best crop to grow by integrating RPA into Crop recommendation model.

articleTitle: Design of a Compact Microstrip Antenna for Wi-Fi, WLAN, X-Band and UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This article proposes a compact and simple antenna design for UWB (Ultra-Wideband), Wi-Fi and WLAN applications. The bandwidth of the proposed antenna ranges from 1.9 GHz to 15.9 GHz with maximum return loss at 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz (Wi-Fi frequencies) and 8.2 GHz (X-Band International Telecommunication Union (ITU) applications). The antenna has a low-profile structure with a flower like patch with parasitic circular elements and its shadow with a slit in the ground plane. It is built on low-cost FR4 substrate with a dimension of 15 mm×12 mm. The parasitic elements shifted the operational bands to sub-6 GHz range and the Defected Ground Structure (DGS) helped in including lower frequency range, fine-tuned to attain maximum return loss at 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz and attaining an ultra-wide bandwidth from 1.9 GHz to 15.9 GHz. The antenna offers a gain of minimum 2.54 dBi and a radiation efficiency of 86.92%. The fractional bandwidth of the antenna is 1.573. The designed antenna can be employed as a multi-functional antenna for Wi-Fi and various UWB applications.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Unmixing by Convolutional Auto-encoder with Deep Subspace Clustering and Cadidate Pixel Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The hyperspectral unmixing process is central to identifying the objects in a ground scene and quantifying their fractional abundance in each pixel. However, the high spatial resolution and the intrinsic interactions pose a challenge in object identification from hyperspectral images by non-linear unmixing. Typically the data points are generated due to non-linear, intimate mixing from non-linear subspaces. In this work, we propose a deep subspace clustering framework to identify the underlying non-linear subspaces in the initial stage and perform non-linear unmixing on the local clusters. To this aim, we proposed a deep auto-encoder network with additional total variation and spatial consistency regularization to determine the underlying non-linear mixing process from each cluster separately. Next, we identify the pixels which contain a dominant source from the latent representation obtained after the encoding stage. Subsequently, we carried out unmixing on local clusters using a linear algebraic based on the low-rank structure of the data. A detailed comparative analysis of the unmixing algorithms on three real hyperspectral images exhibits that our proposed algorithm achieves improved performance.

articleTitle: Comparative Result Analysis of Underwater Image Enhancement methods
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Image enhancement is a method of increasing an image's quality by enhancing its characteristics. This research presents a comparative analysis of several enhancing methods for these underwater images. Since there are poor visibility situations, the underwater image has poor contrast and image quality, making object identification difficult. The analysis of gathered underwater images is required since the quality of these images has been impacted and some of the images constitute few major challenges in comparison to images taken in better surroundings. A significant amount of noise occurs in underwater images because of the poor contrast, lack of visibility conditions, distraction of natural light, uneven lighting and minimal color variations, and blurs effect. For all of these reasons, various methods are available to improve these underwater images, and various different approaches are also present in the literature for analyzing, processing and enhancing.

articleTitle: Smart Embedded System for Accident Prevention based on Lane Navigation and Drowsiness Detection using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Road safety is essential for safeguarding lives, preventing accidents, and reducing financial burdens thereby ensuring effective transportation. Fatigue induced driving is a significant concern that is often disregarded and contributes to a significant proportion of accidents occurring on our roads. When people are drowsy or fatigued, they are less able to concentrate, act swiftly, and make wise decisions, endangering both themselves and other road users. The smart system attempts to prevent road accidents caused by driver inattention, intoxicated driving, or unexpected health concerns through continuous monitoring. The system comprises of 3 subsystems. The drowsiness detection subsystem detects the drowsiness of the driver and sends out an alarm. The lane detection subsystem keeps note of the direction of travel of the vehicle by tracking the edges of the lane. The alcohol detection subsystem detects the alcohol level of the driver and presence of alcohol in the vehicle. If so, it cuts the fuel supply off and the engine comes to a halt. The overall performance of the embedded system is analyzed. Lane detection system captures the edges of the roads by using image processing techniques and convolution neural layers. The alcohol detection system has been implemented using neural networks. Eye aspect ratio (EAR) has been taken into consideration for detecting the state of the driver.

articleTitle: A Review of The Algorithm Visualization Field
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Algorithm visualization has been a popular topic in computer science. It is an effective tool that helps practitioners, researchers, and students to comprehend and study algorithm behavior by visualizing algorithm execution and performance. In this research paper, authors present a comparative analysis of different algorithm visualization techniques based on previous research by various researchers. And examine each algorithm’s technique, as well as its advantages, disadvantages, and findings from related academic articles. This paper also talks about some of the existing platforms for algorithm visualization which are available at present and analyze these platforms for a better understanding. Through this analysis, the author identify gaps in the literature and suggest areas for further exploration. In the end, this paper provides a valuable resource for researchers and educators seeking to understand the state of the art in algorithm visualization and to develop effective visualization tools for teaching and learning.

articleTitle: Efficient Classification Of Autism in Children based on Resnet-50 and Xception module
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Children with autism spectrum disorder struggle to process emotions appropriately, which makes it difficult for them to understand facial expressions. It is crucial for autistic children to recognize emotions because emotion is a crucial component of good socialization. In the proposed method, we use the two different CNN architecture which includes Resnet-50 and Xception modules, and designed an app to classify autistic and non-autistic children. The results demonstrated that the accuracy of the Resnet-50 method is better when compared to the existing conventional methods.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Hybrid OTFS System over κ – μ Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Future wireless communication systems are envisioned to provide reliable communication in high-Doppler scenarios, such as Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication and high-speed trains. Orthogonal Time Frequency Space (OTFS) modulation is a potential candidate in these scenarios. We consider the hybrid system model for the performance analysis, where the combination of ISFFT-based transmitter and Zak-based receiver is used to derive the input-output relation. We model the channel coefficients using κ-μ distribution and employ a linear minimum mean square error detector at the receiver. We analyze the performance of an OTFS system with and without zero padding over the high-mobility wireless channels.

articleTitle: A Simple Frequency Selective Surface based Polarization Convertor for X-band applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A simple microwave Frequency Selective Surface comprising of copper and FR4 layers is simulated, fabricated, and tested for Linear Polarization Conversion. The FSS structure is typically a unit cell that consists of a square patch of 10 mm with a diagonal cut on FR-4 substrate which is placed over a metallic ground of 0.035 mm, for reflective type conversion. The proposed design is simulated using CST microwave studio and fabricated. The FSS is experimentally verified using microwave test bench and is found to be stable with changes in incident angle upto 50<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup>. The simulation results show Polarization Conversion Ratio of more than 85% over a broad range of 4 GHz (8.25 GHz to 12.25 GHz). On further investigation on experimental analysis, maximum Polarization Conversion Ratio of 83% is achieved over a broad range when transmitter and receiver horn is at a far-field distance from FSS.

articleTitle: Influence of Data Quality and Quantity on Assamese-Bodo Neural Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Influence of data quality and data quantity on Assamese-Bodo neural machine translation model training has been investigated in the current work. A series of experiments with progressively augmented dataset in terms of quality and quantity has shown that although both the parameters- quality and quantity are critical for the performance of a neural machine translation system, data alone can not contribute to the performance enhancement, rather smaller quantity of quality data augmentation could contribute significant improvement in the performance metrics. The experiments have been performed with OpenNMT-py system, and BLEU score has been used for recording performance and analysis. Domain specific BLEU as well as overall BLEU on a test dataset of 500 parallel Assamese-Bodo sentence pairs have been recorded, and the results and analysis are presented with tabular as well as graphical representations.

articleTitle: Small-World Inspired Neural Network (SW-NN) for an Effective and Accurate Diagnosis of Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As the use of artificial intelligence in medical diagnosis is growing, the need for enhanced efficacy is becoming paramount. By merging the robustness of neural networks with the distinctive attributes of small-world networks (SWN), the possibility arises for even greater levels of accuracy with maintaining good generalizability. This work presents a novel approach for diagnosing diabetes using a Small-World inspired Neural Network (SW-NN). By constructing a SW-NN using Newman-Watts algorithm, we employ its architecture to classify diabetes and compare it to a conventional NN. The SW-NN outperforms the conventional NN in classification accuracy and evaluation metrics as shown by the experimental results. Our accuracy analysis conclusively demonstrates the superiority of the SW-NN, highlighting its potential to improve diabetes diagnosis.

articleTitle: Prediction of Vehicle Status and Alerting System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: An increase in automobile vehicle also increases the job of predicting the vehicle status . Predicting the vehicle status includes predicting the accidental smoke and LPG gas and also monitor them by give audible and visible alerts . Another most important Adxl335 is used when unnecessary vibrations and tilts in the vehicle.This projects aims to have safety for the vehicle and passengers. Model includes the GPS tracker through this we can get the location and GSM is used to send the relevant vehicle location values as a SMS . So by this the guardians or else the vehicle owner immediately gets the message and would take an action. We may use this technique to decrease lengthen the life of our vehicles. This project intends to develop an vehicle tracking. The components of this tracking system are a GPS receiver, The user's mobile device will receive the position information. GAS, SMOKE, and ADXL335 sensors in this system are used to detect status of the vehicle. The esp8266 Wi-Fi module used to upload sensor data, together with the date and time, to the Thingspeak cloud. If there is any abnormality, a buzzer will sound an audible warning. In the event of an accident, the vehicle will use GSM and GPS to send an alert SMS to the predetermined mobile number along with the location. We created a system called an IoT-based vehicle monitoring system that allows us to easily monitor all vehicles in order to monitor them all. In this project, the Internet of Things is crucial. The amount of smoke and gases is monitored by exhaust sensors, and with the help of IOT, the value is updated in the cloud. This makes it simple for the owner of the car and the transport agency and an individual to keep an eye on it.

articleTitle: Security Analysis and Threat Modelling of Mobile Banking Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Technology revolution has transformed the way consumers interact with financial institutions. With SMS and applications, the usage of mobile banking has exploded. With 5.22 billion mobile banking customers worldwide, the financial transactions made through mobile banking crosses into trillions. Though this has eased tedious banking processes, threats are rampant. Threats range from simple malwares to serious crimes threatening safety of financial assets and causing irreversible losses. This paper aims to collate the 5 major threats to banking applications (and also in the context of SMS), provide an objectified view of how vulnerabilities in mobile banking applications could cause these threats and ways to address them. This comprehensive review provides a threat modelling framework that help in detection and mitigation strategies for these threats.

articleTitle: Smartwatch-based Vomiting Sensation Detection using Heart Rate Analysis and Metaverse Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research project focuses on the development of a smartwatch designed to assist individuals with eating disorders in managing their health and recovery journey. The aim is to address the barriers to treatment, such as high costs and lack of awareness, by leveraging advancements in technology. The smartwatch incorporates unique features, including the analysis of heart rate, finger movements, and emotional states. Significant changes in heart rate above a predetermined threshold trigger alerts to healthcare providers, enabling timely intervention. The use of a metaverse platform allows caregivers to engage with patients virtually, providing assistance when needed. Monthly emotional trends are analyzed using LSTM algorithms to gain insights into patients' progress. Additionally, a skin conductance sensor enables the analysis of a patient's heart condition through sweat. The smartwatch was developed using Android Studio and Java, utilizing various sensors such as PPG, accelerometer, IMUs, gyroscopes, and Heart Rate Variability analysis. The integration of metaverse technology enhances connectivity and offers immersive virtual reality experiences for patients and healthcare providers, promoting better engagement and support in the recovery process.

articleTitle: PSO-tuned support vector classifier based Nifty50 index movement prediction using market positions and sentiment scores
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Predicting the movement of the stock price index is a challenging financial time series analysis task. However, an accurate forecast may generate enormous profits for investors. Due to the complexity of stock market data, developing accurate prediction models is arduous. In this context, this study aims to develop an effective model to forecast the direction of daily returns based on the closing price of the Nifty50. The data from multiple social media platforms, including Twitter, StockTwits, Facebook, and YouTube, have been combined for sentiment analysis. The market positions have been used to train the prediction model. Performance comparison of the supervised machine learning models, including support vector classifier and particle swarm optimization-assisted support vector classifier, has been conducted. The model's hyperparameters have been carefully tuned to attain more than 99% prediction accuracy. It has been observed that the novel approach of combining the Nifty50 market positions with social media sentiments resulted in high prediction performance, and the proposed model is robust and dependable to forecast index returns.

articleTitle: Improved MRI Reconstruction via Deep Learning-Driven Compressed Sensing and k-Space Theorem
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A test known as an MRI creates precise images of the inside of the body using strong magnets, radio waves, and a computer. One of the most dynamic and secure imaging methods now used in clinics is MRI. However, MRI acquisitions can take a long time, which limits patient throughput, reduces the range of possible applications, and raises expenses. In this paper we proposed a compressed sensing (CS) technique for speeding up MRI acquisition time. The proposed methods involve the under-sampling k-space theorem to collect fewer data points. Deep learning techniques are then used with these data points to quickly produce an image of high quality. Several experiments are conducted to justify the use of deep learning methods for reconstructing MRI images using k-space data with under-sampling techniques. The experimental results exhibited good-quality images in a short time in terms of reconstruction with limited measurements.

articleTitle: Alzheimer Detection Using Tuner Optimization with Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a neurological ailment that gradually impairs memory, thinking and reasoning skills, as well as day-to-day function. The majority of persons affected by this condition are seniors, particularly above the age of 65. Although the precise cause of this condition is still unknown, it is currently thought that it may be genetic, accidental, or due to other factors. There are a few ways to find the condition, like physical examination, CT scans, MRI scans or positron emission tomography but MRI scans are the most popular one. Additionally, scanned images from MRI scans are used for this research. In this study, the disorder has been divided into four categories: healthy, mildly demented, very mildly demented, and moderately demented. Deep Learning algorithm is used in this proposed model and the most common used CNN algorithm is used along with the tuner optimization because of their fast, reliable and efficient working. The dataset was collected from Kaggle, and then it was pre-processed to make a uniform data. Than the data was divided in to training and testing datasets in the ratio of 80:20, after this the tuner optimization is done to automate the selection of various parameters to improve the model. Then using the CNN the feature extraction and classification is done to find out the disease and its category and the model shows an accuracy of 97%. It helps the doctors to find out the disease and the extent of its spread which helps them to detect the patient’s condition and can help them in finding an effective treatment and therapy.

articleTitle: OrthoSNet: A framework for Identifying and Verifying Tuberculosis in Chest Radio graph images using Discrete Orthonormal Stockwell transform
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: X-ray imaging is one commonly employed method among the range of diagnostic tools available for detecting lung tuberculosis. Pulmonary tuberculosis is often detected and screened through chest X-rays (CXR). Nevertheless, the examination of chest radio-graphs by skilled physicians to identify Tuberculosis (TB) in clinical settings can be time-consuming and prone to subjective inconsistencies. Medical experts analyzing medical data face substantial subjectivity and variation in image quality. Therefore, there is growing interested in the healthcare sector to leverage machine learning to improve the accuracy and efficiency of medical data analysis. Considering this matter, Digital Pathology (DP) and Algorithmic machine-assisted diagnosis (AMAD) systems have the potential to significantly aid in the large-scale examination of pulmonary tuberculosis through the analysis of chest X-ray image features. We propose OrthoSNet: a network architecture that learns image contrast translation invariant features. We have made use of the Tuberculosis Dataset for the development and substantiation of the model. Our experiment validates the practicality and utility of our alternative approach, With a significant improvement in accuracy. The proposed model predicts a superior accuracy of 99 % with a sample size of 1400 images.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Alzheimer's Disease using Feed Forward Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Millions of individuals throughout the world are affected by the progressive neurological complications known as Alzheimer's disease (AD). Early AD diagnosis is essential for efficient care and treatment, but conventional diagnostic techniques can be incorrect or intrusive. In this paper, we analyze how feed-forward neural networks (FFNN) are used to predict the onset of AD using the OASIS dataset, a publicly available neuroimaging and clinical dataset. We apply a series of preprocessing steps to clean, transform, and normalize the data, and train the FFNN to predict the presence or absence of AD based on a set of input features. We evaluate the performance of the FFNN using several metrics, including accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity and compare the results to other commonly used machine learning models. Our findings demonstrate the potential of FFNNs for the early detection of AD and highlight the importance of careful preprocessing and evaluation of machine learning models.

articleTitle: SRAM Cell Leakage Reduction Methodologies for Low Leakage Cache Memories
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Static memory cells (SRAMs) are a kind that are used in many different electrical systems. It uses less energy, works more rapidly than other memory cells, and doesn't need to be replaced often. SRAM is thus the most often used memory cell among VLSI designers. Octa-core processors, which have been used in electronics for around 5 to 6 years, are utilised in mobile appliances, thus as size decreases, transistor density and capacity increase. We are thereby creating memory that is space-efficient. SRAM cells can retain information as long as power is provided without needing to be constantly restored. The acquisition of SRAM was made possible by its significant lead (DRAM). In this research paper, we have simulated various leakage reduction Techniques to compare the leakage power of SRAM cell, also various parameters like rise time, fall time, delay, SNM, dynamic power consumption, static power consumption and slew rate are calculated.

articleTitle: Assessment of deep neural network for prediction of chronic kidney disease
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study uses deep learning techniques to detect chronic kidney disease at earlier stage to aid in its prevention. Disorders that affect the kidney's natural function are referred to as kidney diseases. This research recommends using a perceptron classifier with multiple layers classifier that is based on deep neural networks to identify CKD in patients. In order to diagnose chronic kidney disease, a database of 400 individuals with 25 attributes was employed. For the tests, the means of the respective attributes were used to replace each missing value in the original data set. The deep neural network's optimal parameters were then produced by fine-tuning the parameters and running several trials. In this research, A deep neural network is designed and developed. The performance of proposed model is compared with various cutting-edge machine learning techniques. Experiments show that the proposed model performs with 99.85% testing accuracy in classification tasks.

articleTitle: Linux CPU Schedulers: CFS, MuQSS, BMQ and CacULE Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: CPU scheduling is a crucial task for kernel functions and choosing the right scheduling algorithm can improve CPU utilization while minimizing resource usage. Our study aims to analyze the performance of these four scheduling algorithms viz. CFS, CacULE, BMQ and MuQSS, through various benchmarks, including latency, turn-around time, and interactivity. To evaluate the algorithms, we measure turn-around time by compiling software, interactivity by running simulations of various processes such as video, audio, and variable load X under different background loads, and latency by using benchmarking software. Our results provide insights into the performance differences of these four scheduling algorithms in different use cases.

articleTitle: Colourify: Image Colourization using AI techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Converting a grayscale image into a coloured one is known as image colourization. This is a challenging task that needs human assistance to produce high-quality photos. Our model, which is an improved version of the VGG16, is what we suggest in this study. The dataset used is a subset of the MIT Places Dataset available on Kaggle. The architecture is divided into 2 parts, an automatic encoder and an automatic decoder. The model will predict the values of ‘a’ and ‘b’ in the Lab colour space. Architecture of the proposed model has been presented. The results have been compared with the existing models.

articleTitle: IoT based Real Time Patient Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Since 1980, numerous perilous and transmissible diseases have emerged and continue to persist. These diseases pose significant challenges globally, affecting both developed and developing nations with limited resources. Consequently, they have garnered considerable attention in the twenty-first century, primarily due to their economic and health impacts. Halting the emergence of new infectious diseases presents a formidable task, given the interconnectedness between individuals, animals, and the environment. Nevertheless, it is possible to implement precautionary and preventive measures, such as comprehensive global surveillance and advancements in diagnostic technology, active treatments, and vaccines. By examining specific diseases as examples, we can highlight human activities that contribute to the transmission and development of infectious diseases. The COVID pandemic serves as a stark reminder, with over 20 million reported infections and a staggering death toll of more than 730,000 globally. Monitoring the health-related characteristics of affected patients remains a daunting challenge, primarily due to limited resources and the risk of contagion. Direct contact between doctors and patients is often impossible. In this project, a novel Internet of Things (IoT)-based health monitoring system is proposed. Utilizing the ThingSpeak cloud application, doctors can remotely monitor patients' body temperature, heart rate, and pulse rate. Additionally, the system can issue emergency alerts through Telegram. The work introduces a new paradigm for telehealth monitoring systems, centering around the ESP32 development board equipped with active sensors such as the DHT11 and MAX30100. This system continuously monitors patient-specific health parameters, wirelessly transmits the data to an IoT server via WiFi, and enables real-time data analysis on the ThingSpeak cloud. Given that this chronic virus significantly affects vital health indicators like body temperature, pulse rate, and heart rate, such a system proves invaluable.

articleTitle: Leveraging Multimodal Information in Speech Data for the Non-Invasive Detection of Alzheimer’s Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common form of dementia, affecting millions of individuals worldwide. Early identification and treatment of AD are critical for advanced planning and preventing the gradual emergence of harsher symptoms. Speech data analysis is a promising non-invasive tool for the early identification of AD. This study investigates the possibilities of employing machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches for speech data processing describing methods for detecting Alzheimer’s disease using unimodal and multimodal data analysis of a patient’s speech. Thus, in this study, we analyzed speech recordings from participants and classified them into AD and normal control (NC) categories. According to experimental findings, using multimodal models might increase the accuracy and robustness of speech-related diagnoses, leading to the early identification of AD. With its insights into the possibilities of speech data analysis and multimodal models for this purpose, this work adds to the expanding body of knowledge on non-invasive methods for AD identification.

articleTitle: A Multiple Branch Fusion Network for Feature Learning and Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification has made extensive use of deep learning approaches, specifically Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). CNN's ability to fully capture local contextual aspects of HSI makes it an excellent HSI classifier. Although, a significant factor in the poor classification performance is the scarcity of training data. Conventional CNN-based methods don't use the integrate-band relationships of HSI as much as they could because they typically employ 2D-CNNs to extract features. On the other hand, 3D-CNNs use a similar procedure to get both spectral and spatial data. This gets around the problem with 2D-CNNs, but it could mean that not enough features are extracted. As a solution, we offer a multi-scale 3D-CNN with multi branch feature fusion, which we call multi branch fusion CNN (MBF-CNN), for HSI classification. We begin by applying 3D-CNN on multiple scales to extract HSI features. After that, the multiple distinct characteristics are streamlined and combined together. The fused features then go through several fully connected layers to get the classification outcomes. The experiments are executed on both the new data sets and the publicly accessible benchmark data sets to expose the efficiency and durability of the proposed model. Empirically, it has been demonstrated that the presented model succeeds over the remaining state-of-the-art approaches in terms of classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Loan Status Prediction using SVM and Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Over the past few years, credit lines are the primary source of income for banks. The assets of bank are determined by how much "Loans" they have provided to the customer. Behind this credit line, one more important is that "Will the customer be capable of repaying the debt in a given time?". We can consider many attributes such as age, gender, income source & expenditure which limit the customer to pay the loan over a definite period [1]. To maximize the profit of bank, it’s very important to analyze the various models and compare them. One of the very effective models is Logistic regression. This model is widely used because it predicts over a group of independent variables, the categorical dependent variable. We have gathered data from Kaggle for our research and forecasting purpose. The data obtained from here will act as base for loan default prediction because it contains customer personal attribute like age, objective, previous credit utilization, credit extent, and credit period. After evaluating customer on following attribute, the bank should realize to whom they should provide the loan or to whom they shouldn’t. This can be analyzed by Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machine technique for truthful results. Our model doesn’t consider only the rich people should be given loan but it considers customer characteristics who satisfies the following above attribute, which plays an important role in credit choice and forecasting lone defaulters.

articleTitle: Energy efficient robust tree-based routing protocol for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The creation of compact, reasonably priced nodes with the capacity to sense, communicate, and process data is expected to be facilitated by advancements in processor, memory, and wireless technologies. Together, these nodes can function in networks to carry out distributed sensing of environmental events. Sensor webs made up of nodes with wireless connections are used to gather valuable data from the field. It is important to collect sensor data in an energy-efficient way if a sensor network is to function for an extended period. As a result, we proposed a protocol called Enhanced Tree-Based routing protocol which is self-organised where it enables the nodes to connect to other node which has highest virtual potential energy. Each node automatically connects to the next node and transmits data to the sink node.

articleTitle: A Metaheuristec Approach for Feature Extraction of mmWave based 5G Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the increase in subscribers day-by-day, the popularity of mmWaves is also increasing due to its ability to increase the bandwidth over smaller and densely populated areas. In the context of 5G networks, resource allocation is a major issue which can be achieved by increasing the hardware which in turn lead to increase the cost of project. In contrast to it, another way to experience efficient resource allocation is to optimize the current system architecture. Thus along with mmWave based communication architecture, the use of swarm based algorithms can also be utilized to customize data for training the system. In this paper we have designed a network consisting of random number of nodes. Using the AODV Route Discovery process, we have discovered path from source to destination node. Further by applying channel estimation we have obtained QoS parameters. To analyze the QoS parameters Metaheuristic based ABC algorithm is used. The labeling of Good, Moderate and Bad QoS parameters is performed using ABC algorithm.

articleTitle: Two Stage No Idle Flow Shop Scheduling To Minimize Rental Cost Including Transportation Time
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The algorithm of the 2-Stage flow shop scheduling problem under the no idle constraint has been described in this paper, where transportation time is allocated for carrying the jobs from one machine to another. Our research aims to determine the optimal jobs sequence processing with the shortest makespan possible, reducing the machine idle time to zero and lowering the machine rental cost. A heuristic algorithm is made clear with a numerical example.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach to Solve Complex Rook Polynomials in Strategic Games
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A rook polynomial in combinatorial mathematics is a generating polynomial of the number of possible arrangements of non-attacking rooks on a checkerboard-like board, where no two rooks may be arranged in the same row or column. The board is any subset of the squares on a m by n rectangular board; we refer to it as the squares where a rook may be placed. There are various formulas like expansion formula and product formula that provides a polynomial related to a given circumstance i.e. for a particular number of rooks in a particular size of checkboard given but for generating functions like n x n arrays to construct rook polynomials for a board that is decomposes into n disjoint sub-boards C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>,….., C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> and a rook polynomials with R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf> , n(x) possible rook movement spaces in a combinatorial way is very tedious task with practical approach.Therefore, in this paper we attempt to automate the rook polynomial and apply them on a practical basis to solve strategic games. Further attempts have been made to formulate an algorithm to paint a picture of solving rook’s polynomial using backtracking and various other strategies like recursion and loops to combine or place the contents of the list such that no similar content will be placed in same row or same column.

articleTitle: A Personalized Similarity Learning Method for Service Recommendation in Web
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Web services (WS) that are functionally equivalent to the number of clients using them are becoming increasingly prevalent as more organizations supply services electronically. Therefore, most information is user-generated making it challenging for customers to find the right WS. Hence, there is a need for a recommended solution that will evaluate the WS quality feature. Although there are many ways to select and recommend Collaborative Filtering (CF) based WS, few have considered the impact of personalization on customers and WS quality features. The personalization similarity learning approach (PSLM) for WS recommendation is presented in this study. A vital factor of PSLM is computing a measure of similarity between the customer and quality features of the WS. The mechanism of PSLM implements the analysis of customer-products of WS relationship computation for personalized service recommendation utilizing the similarity learning computation model. A series of tests carried out on actual WS datasets show how much the concept has improved.

articleTitle: Fine-Tuned Transformer Models for Question Answering
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Effective question-answering is crucial for applications involving natural language processing such as conversational artificial systems. The pre-trained BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) model achieved outstanding results on the Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD), a well-known benchmark for question answering tasks. The three different BERT models (BERT-base, BERT-large, DistilBERT) are pre-trained on general text corpus. These BERT models are trained to identify the right context in a paragraph to give answers. Further, fine-tuning the models with few-shot learning on domain related questions and answers improves the performance. Hence, our work proposes different strategies to improve the performance of BERT models on tasks requiring domain-specific question-answering tasks using a customized SQuAD dataset. Our work highlights the significance of optimizing the BERT models on domain-specific data for enhanced performance in particular tasks. The results of this study have implications for domain-specific knowledge in natural language processing. With a score of 0.9632, the BERT-Large model has the best accuracy out of all the BERT models tested. The performance of the BERT-Large model consistently beats that of the other models in several parameters, including precision, recall, and F1 score.

articleTitle: Nuclei Classification in Histopathology Images Using Fuzzy Ensemble of Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The development of computational pathology and healthcare studies depends on cell nuclei classification. It has several lifesaving uses, particularly in cancer diagnosis. It is helpful in various applications, including disease diagnosis and medicinal therapy. Due to the number of problems, human examination of these image slides is unpleasant and time-consuming. Morphological traits add to the intricacy. We suggested a fuzzy distance ensemble of Convolutional Neural Networks to achieve state-of-the-art nucleus classification performance. This new model is easier to train and makes more accurate predictions using underlying basic classifiers. To examine how well our model worked, we used the PanNuke dataset. Our model’s scores are 0.811 for accuracy, 0.811 for F1, 0.815 for precision, and 0.809 for recall.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Telemetry Data Reception using Diversity Combiner for a Spinning Projectile
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The paper proposes a novel system for improving the performance of telemetry data reception in a spinning projectile using a diversity combiner technique. The system utilizes two receiver antennas with unique Spatial-Polarization Diversity to capture telemetry data from the projectile during flight. The received signals are combined using Maximal Ratio Combining (MRC) to improve the overall Signal-to-Noise ratio by 2.5 dB. This approach results in significant improvements in signal quality and reduced Bit Error Rate in the S-band frequency. The performance of the diversity combiner is evaluated through simulation and field experiments carried out up to a distance of 5 km, demonstrating its potential applications in the military and aerospace industries for high-speed and reliable communication for a spinning projectile.

articleTitle: Machine learning technique-based diagnosis of wrist-radial pulse
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A growing research on the nadi signal or the radial pulse has shown that physiological states and chronic illnesses are linked to each pressure change occurring in the arteries. The variation in the kapha, vata and pitta energies is associated with various reflexes that help our body to react to situations. The three energies together is known as Tridosha and each individual has a unique balance of tridosha. It requires great focus and accuracy to exactly determine the tridosha ratio by an Ayurvedic person. Owing to the advancement in technology in medical sciences, these signals can be collected, filtered, amplified and categorized with greater precision. The work proposed is used to implement the above-mentioned process in order to help patients self- diagnose the imbalance in the tridosha for diseases such as diabetes mellitus and blood pressure. The pulse signals are attained by pulse sensors positioned at the wrist. The signal passes through the Arduino where the analog counterpart are transformed to digital form. The converted signals are sent to the raspberry pi where the features are extracted from the signal and are compared with the model built based on a Machine Learning algorithm. The output is finally displayed indicating which doshas are not balanced and the illness which has occurred due to that imbalance.

articleTitle: Designing and validating an MD5 Hash Algorithm using the UVM Verification Framework and Checkers
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The MD5 algorithm is widely employed for generating fixed-size hash values to ensure data integrity. By incorporating MD5 into the UVM verification framework, designers can efficiently verify the algorithm's functionality within digital designs. The UVM framework provides a structured environment with standardized components, including agents, sequences, and checkers, facilitating the development and verification of complex designs. Dedicated UVM checkers designed for MD5 verification automate and streamline the verification process, ensuring the accurate operation of the MD5 algorithm. These checkers monitor input and output data, comparing the generated hash value with the expected outcome, enabling thorough verification of the algorithm's integrity. Integrating MD5 into the UVM verification framework with checkers improves the verification process's efficiency, reducing manual efforts and enhancing reliability. This integration allows designers and verification engineers to effectively validate the implementation and accuracy of the MD5 hash algorithm in digital designs.

articleTitle: Protecting SDN from DDoS Attacks Using AI Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: SDN, is also referred to as software-defined networking, it is a type kind of network architecture which is used to address problems with the conventional network. It is a dynamic, programmable network that follows a layered architecture. We can build and design the hardware components by using this network architecture, and dynamically we can change the network settings, whereas it is not possible in the traditional network due to the fixed network connection type. The main problem that SDN is facing is denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks which is a DOS attack type; in a DDoS, multiple internet and server connections are used to attack the targeted system. It’s a powerful attacking method against a system. In this research, we offer some cutting-edge methods for detecting and combating DDoS assaults in the SDN network using deep learning and machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Advances in Deep Learning for Dermatology: Convolutional Neural Networks for Automated Skin Disease Detection and Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Skin conditions provide serious health risks and need a precise and prompt diagnosis in order to be effectively treated. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs), in particular, have demonstrated encouraging results in automated skin disease identification in recent years. In this paper, we describe a unique method for identifying seven distinct categories of skin illnesses using the HAM10000 image dataset, with a CNN-based model, and a 95 percent accuracy rate.The HAM10000 dataset, which comprises of dermatoscopic images, is preprocessed into seven classes: Benign keratosis,actinic keratoses,dermatofibroma , melanoma ,vascular lesions, melanocytic nevi and basal cell carcinoma. It reach a 95 percent overall accuracy on the testing set after much experimentation and fine-tuning.The results demonstrate that utilising the HAM10000 image dataset, the proposed CNN-based technique can successfully diagnose a wide range of skin diseases. The accurate and automated diagnosis of skin problems using deep learning techniques can greatly aid dermatologists and other healthcare professionals in offering quick and effective treatments. This study makes a significant contribution to the expanding area of dermatological computer-aided diagnosis and provides insightful information for future developments in skin disease detection.

articleTitle: Deepfake Detection System Using a Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: There has been a rapid advancement in deep fake technology in recent years, which makes it increasingly difficult to detect fake images, especially those involving human faces, which have become difficult to detect. The traditional methods of detecting deep fake images are usually based on a human-crafted feature or a rule-based system, which can be easily beaten with simple cheating techniques. Intending to detect deepfake face images, we present a novel method that uses CapsNet and EfficientNet as feature extractors to detect deepfake face images. They are well suited to detect deepfake images that have undergone geometric transformations or variations as they can learn the spatial relationship between those features. Using EfficientNet, a powerful and efficient deep learning architecture, as a feature extractor, we extract high-level characteristics from an input image to create a more accurate image analysis.Based on our experiments,it was found that this method demonstrated the capability to detect various types of deep fake images with an accuracy rate of 99.64%, including those fabricated through face swapping and re-enacting. This method could be applied to a wide range of real-world applications, including in media forensics, law enforcement, and online media verification, so that it could be applied in many different contexts.

articleTitle: Non Small Cell Lung Cancer Diagnosis Using kNN and Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One in nine people develop cancer during their life time in India. Chances are that we already know someone who has been affected by cancer. But what is cancer? Simply put, they are made of trillions of cells that grow and divide over one’s lifetime as needed. Abnormal or old cells die after a certain period of time but some cells do not die and overcrowd the space and stop the body from functioning normally. The most recent screening technology makes early identification of lung cancer simple and may extend the patient's life. The use of automated technologies can also improve the accuracy of illness detection, aiding medical professionals in making accurate diagnoses. The automated lung cancer diagnosis method described in this article uses a machine learning algorithm to distinguish between benign, malignant, and normal lung cancer. The proposed lung cancer detection technique has a 98.7% accuracy rate, which is higher than the approaches that were examined.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of SnS–based Heterostructure Solar Cell using Cu2O HTL
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Tin–monosulfide (SnS)–based solar cell (SC) that has been recently gaining the attention of scientists owing to their exceptional semiconducting properties. The basic purpose of this article is to enhance the performance of (Al/ITO/CeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SnS/Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O/Ni) photovoltaic cell and analyze the effect of Copper Oxide (Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O) Hole Transport Layer (HTL) and Cerium Oxide (CeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) Electron Transport Layer (ETL) along with measuring the characteristics such as open circuit voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf>), current density (J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf>), fill factor (FF), and power conversion efficiency (PCE). Solar Cell Capacitance Simulator (SCAPS–1D) software has been used to conduct this research. To increase the performance, key metrics including thickness, doping concentration, defects density, working temperature, front and back electrodes have been studied. The above structure operates effectively with a thin (300 nm) SnS absorber layer at lower carrier concentrations (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>). The (Al/ITO/CeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SnS/Ni) SC where the values of PCE is 20.34%, V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf> is 0.817 V, J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf> is 31.00 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and FF is 80.27%. In the structure of (Al/ITO/CeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SnS/Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O/Ni) solar cell, the value of PCE, V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf>, J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf>, and FF are obtained 27%, 0.975 V, 32.72 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and 84.63%, respectively. After using Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O HTL, the thickness of 30nm and doping density 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> that provides high efficiency 27% of the SC. Depending on the lower thickness and doping concentration, different layer parameters such as the CeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> ETL, Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O HTL, and SnS absorber layer are used to improve the performance. Also, it has studied various effects of defect in different layer of (Al/ITO/CeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SnS/Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O/Ni) solar cell. This conception expresses that Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O could be a promising HTL for reducing manufacturing costs and enhancing the performance of Tin–monosulfide based heterostructure solar cell.

articleTitle: Predicting PKB/Akt Downstream Signaling Blockers Using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cancer is one of the root causes of unusual deaths in the world. To prevent cancer, Protein Kinase B (PKB) is one of the targets utilized to discover anticancer drugs. The quantitative structure-activity relationship method has been extended with machine learning approaches to select drug candidates for inhibiting PKB/Akt downstream signaling cascades. The study incorporated 76 probable PKB/Akt signaling blockers from the ChEMBL database. After preprocessing to handle the entries with missing bioactivity data, the compounds are distinguished into active and inactive categories based on their IC50 values. The research includes the calculation of molecular descriptors of Lipinksi’s rule of five for analyzing the absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion properties of the small ligand molecules to analyze their capability to act like active drugs. The bioactivity data is computed by PaDel descriptor to enumerate the PubChem fingerprints in binary patterns. Out of 34 machine learning regression predictive models that have been used to train on fingerprint data to predict the drug-likeness of the small molecules, the best-performing four are XGBoost, DecisionTree, GaussianProcess, and ExtraTree. These models have shown good fits to the data demonstrating coefficients of determination values: 0.9 for each and high potential to predict the drug ligands. This study establishes a novel approach for anticancer drug discovery to restore the regulation of abnormal PI3K/Akt signaling pathways.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis to Prepare Current Derating Chart of LV Switchgear inside Metal Enclosed Panel
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The air circuit breaker is a switching device used in low-voltage power systems to carry current in normal conditions and break currents under specified abnormal circuit conditions by proper operation. During normal conditions, the current flowing through the air circuit breaker generates heat, increasing the temperature. The temperature of the breaker should always be within limits as specified by the standards for the safe operation of the circuit breaker. The main problem during the circuit breaker installation is calculating the maximum current that the circuit breaker can carry without any damage and untimely aging according to the service temperature. This paper proposes a methodology to prepare the derating chart of the circuit breaker. The heat generated in the circuit breaker depends on the internal structure of the switchboard, busbars and cables, the cross-section of the conductors, ventilation inside in switchboard and the path of current flowing in the switchboard. The circuit breaker assembly is analyzed thermodynamically to identify the correct rating and typology of the circuit breaker to be installed in the switchboard. For thermal analysis, the modeling of the breaker is done on CREO software, and the thermal analysis is performed on ANSYS software. The analysis includes parameters namely the degree of protection, the material of the bus bars used, the type of installation, the orientation of the adaptors, and ambient temperature for different current ratings.

articleTitle: Predicting air quality indicators using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The importance of understanding and managing air quality with the rise of industrial activity has led to a tremendous increase in research towards the application of machine learning in providing statistical and predictive insight by modeling and predicting air quality indicators which includes air pollutant concentrations and air quality indices. The exhaustive survey by Méndez et al [9] provides an important overview of the application of such models according to which deep learning performs the best and LSTM is the most-widely used model. In this study the goal is to study the performance of such predictive models for air quality indicators. This study has the following two objectives: (1) Gather statistical insight about the air quality data collected from a specific station at Hyderabad city. (2) Compare the effectiveness of all major ML techniques to predict air quality indicators using data collected from a specific station in the Hyderabad city.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Printed Planar Flat-Plate Dual-Band Wlan Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, dual-band WLAN service, a low-cost single-sided antenna design is proposed. A 50 mini-coax cable is employed for the connection to the dipole antenna, which is rectangular in shape and measures 10 mm by 37 mm. Each radiating arm may be made into two dipole arms by cutting two L-shaped holes through each. The two resulting dipole arms are then merged to operate in the 2.4 and 5 GHz bands, respectively. Short dipole arms enable the antenna to be created by pressing a flat metal plate. A excellent omnidirectional radiation pattern is seen and the impedance bandwidth for 2.4/5 GHz WLAN operation is at VSWR less than 1.5.

articleTitle: Multi-modal Medical Image Denoising using Wavelet Transform and Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Medical image denoising performs a crucial role in image processing since noise can considerably deteriorate image quality. In medical imaging, Gaussian and Salt & Pepper noise are commonly encountered during image acquisition, transfer, and storage. To enhance the quality of medical images, researchers are continuously investigating effective denoising techniques that can produce high-quality images, characterized by low Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) values and high Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR). Two powerful denoising methods, Wavelet Transform (WT) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA), have been widely utilized in denoising medical images. In this research, experiments are conducted on X-ray, MRI and CT images, by adding Gaussian and Salt & Pepper noise. The denoising performance of WT and PCA was compared based on their RMSE and PSNR results.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of DP-QPSK based FSO Systems under Different Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Weather conditions have a big impact on how well free-space optical (FSO) communication systems perform. The performance of an FSO system based on Dual Polarization Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (DP-QPSK) is analyzed in this paper in relation to the effects of various weather conditions. Fog, rain, snow, and atmospheric turbulence are among the weather factors which are taken into account.
