Bit error rate (BER), Constellation diagrams, and Q-factor are used to assess the FSO system's performance in various weather scenarios. Based on the results of the simulation, it can be seen that the DP-QPSK-based FSO systems provide very high bit rate performance and perform well under different weather conditions due to their digital coherent receiver. This paper also compares the performance of the DP-QPSK modulation format and NRZ binary modulation format for multi-channel wavelength division multiplexed (WDM) FSO systems.

articleTitle: MIMIC III Text classification with the generalization of BERT transformer model synergized with XGBoost classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a field of machine learning in which machine learning models are trained to analyze and synthesize natural language and speech. Text classification is a popular application in NLP. Previous text classification algorithms that were implemented include the usage of the Naive Bayes Classifier and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). The introduction of Transformer based Neural Network architecture, which uses Attention heads to understand the text and its context, has shown state-of-the-art results in various NLP tasks. With the development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the medical field, many AI techniques and models have also developed, and the need for good performance is crucial in the medical field. One of the medical applications of text-based AI is classifying Electronic Health Records (EHRs). The data-set we have chosen is the Note events data-set from the MIMIC III (Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care) database. In this work, we are introducing an integrated framework that uses a BERT based transformer in synergy with an XGBoost classifier in its tail to perform text classification, which theoretically and practically gives more efficient results. This novel synergy of XGBoost with the BERT model resulted in a significant boost in test classification accuracy compared to using the BERT model alone. Specifically, the proposed hybrid model achieved an excellent improvement factor by boosting the classification performance of the training accuracy metric by a factor approaching 10 to 13% and the testing accuracy by a factor of 3%.

articleTitle: An Application of Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces in Satellite Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this research paper, we investigate the effectiveness of an Intelligent Reflecting Surface (IRS)-assisted satellite communication system consisting of a single antenna transmitting earth station and a single antenna receiving earth station. The satellite node is equipped with multiple reflecting elements, which intelligently manipulate the signal propagation environment. We analyze the system's signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) at the receiver station. By deriving the SNR expression, we aim to assess the suitability of IRS in satellite communication systems. Furthermore, we explore the envelope Probability Density Function (PDF) of the end-to-end channel to gain insights into the system's performance. We consider the impact of varying parameters such as the number of reflecting elements and the shadowing effect on the PDF.The results obtained from this research can be useful in the design and implementation of future satellite communication networks, leading to improved spectral efficiency, increased coverage, and enhanced quality of service.

articleTitle: A heuristic Approach for an Open Shop Scheduling Problem with Fuzzy Transportation Time, Set Up Time and Weights of Jobs Along with Job Block Criterion
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Reallife scheduling problems often have many uncertainties. The most important tool for modeling uncertainty, fuzzy set theory is a n attractive tool to contribute to manufacturing research. In this article, we introduce a mockup fuzzy model for twostage open shop scheduling with multiple and limited jobs. Use fuzzy logic to represent business and machine uncertainty in machining processes. This paper presents the development of a new heuristic method that guarantees the best solution for a given problem to reduce the elapse d time according to the working time, weight, shipping time, rental policy in a shopping mall with n jobs, 2 machines considering installation time. In addition, working hours are not random but closely related to each other.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Enabled Framework for Classification and Detection of Intrusion in MANET
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: An Intrusion Detection System is a necessity in order to ensure the security of the existing network and user data which is travelling across in the network. Because of the rapid development of network technologies, the identification of dangers based on the analysis of contextual information may be application and network-specific. A remedy to such a challenge may be found in the form of a hybrid intrusion detection system (IDS) which uses machine learning algorithms for optimization. Many possible attacks are viable in a network, but our study id limited to few of them. In one of the popular attack known as denial of service(DOS) attack, the approach is to overwhelm the victim's MANET network with an overwhelming number of packets. It is now possible for this kind of attack to create substantial issues for networks of any scale. When analyzing high-performance hybrid intrusion detection systems, one of the most critical challenges is the processing of vast volumes of information including a large number of features. An excessive quantity of features may slow down the training and testing process, increase resource usage, and decrease detection accuracy. This can be a problem for malicious pattern recognition, which can be inhibited as a result. This article provides a detailed description of a framework for an intrusion detection system that takes use of machine learning. As a result, it is essential to bring the size of the benchmark dataset down to a more manageable level and get rid of any unnecessary features. Cleansing up data sets may be accomplished by the use of preprocessing, which involves deleting out-of-range numbers, uncommon combinations of data, and missing information. In order to improve the accuracy of classifiers, it is common practice to apply methods known as feature selection (FS) in order to rid a dataset of data points that are extraneous or unneeded. In the paper there were three machine learning techniques namely SVM, Naïve Bayes and ID3 which were considered for comparative study. It was observed that SVM is achieving higher accuracy in intrusion data classification and detection.

articleTitle: Hindi Fake News Detection using Stacking Ensemble Method
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Day by day, usage of social media is increasing amongst the users giving rise to certain issues which need attention. Since information can be shared across social media very quickly, it has become a popular medium of information sharing. Users use these platforms to share information to individuals, groups and to communities. As information is spread across social media platforms very quickly, misinformation also gets spread very quickly. Detecting fake contents is very important at the initial stage so that spread of fake information can be prevented. In existing research most of the research carried out is for English news. Very few researchers have attempted to develop a model for other languages. We present a machine learning solution for fake information identification for Hindi News articles. We carried out experiments on three datasets using various machine learning approaches such as Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Multinomial NB and Random Forest, these learners are used individually, and their performance is evaluated. Then we use these learners in stacking ensemble method and evaluated the performance. To extract features from news TF/IDF is used. Results show that RF performed well over all datasets as individual learner. Ensemble learning resulted in significant improvement in the performance over individual learners in all performance evaluation metrics. In some cases, results of LR are closer to that of RF.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Human Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Understanding of human behavior and assigning a label to each action is what Human Action Recognition (HAR) is all about. Its main objective is to accurately characterize human behaviors and interactions by examining the video-based dataset. Due to its broad applicability in the automatic retrieval of recordings of a specific activity using visual cues, human action recognition has grown in popularity. The model is prepared in such a way that it will access the data in the form of video and then convert them into the fames and then use them for the further process. When it comes to computer vision research, the topic of human action recognition is expanding. Object and human recognition, feature extraction, activity detection, and classification are some of the most frequent steps in action recognition. In our work we are using ANN (Artificial neural network) and SSD (single shot detection) technologies for predicting the class of the particular data set.

articleTitle: Prediction of Insurance Premium using Machine Learning with an Adaptive Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The insurance market is very large and expanding day by day. There are many parameters to consider before deciding on insurance premiums. Sometimes it becomes difficult to browse all the documents before applying for insurance, so it is necessary to understand the insurance industry and point out issues related to competition in that industry. This type of company is very interested in forecasting. The goal of this article is to find accurate predictions based on considering different dimensions of machine learning to reduce the company's financial losses. Machine learning helps companies to optimize their services with greater accuracy and fewer losses. It can also help insurance companies effectively screen cases, evaluate them more accurately, and make accurate cost forecasts. This research work uses machine learning-based methods like linear regression, KStar, and Random Forest and suggests a suitable method to produce results with high accuracy and less relative error. In addition to this, it demonstrates how to create a specific data subset that can be used to test and train a machine learning system. The effectiveness of the suggested strategy is assessed by contrasting the estimated value with the actual value of the simulated data. Insurance firms are capable to construct consistent financial structures, such as monthly premiums or payroll taxes, to provide funds to pay for the medical benefit agreements that are defined in insurance policies by calculating the whole risk of the expenses associated with health care and the medical system.

articleTitle: Optimal Constructions of LRCs based on Cayley Table
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Network coding techniques have emerged as an essential tool in the aspect of storage applications, especially in distributed storage systems (DSS). Locally repairable code (LRC) is one of these. LRCs with availability are designed to tolerate single node failure in a DSS while still allowing the stored data to be recovered. A code is called information symbol (n,k,r,t) LRC if each information coordinate can be achieved by at least t disjoint repair sets, containing at most r other coordinates. This paper includes some explicit constructions through the standard parity check matrix of a class of information symbol (n, k, r, t) LRCs based on two different Cayley tables of a finite field. The minimum distance of these constructed codes is optimal against the bound $d \leq n - k - \left\lceil {\frac{{kt}}{n}} \right\rceil + t + 1$ in which some of these codes have non trivial optimal minimum distance also.

articleTitle: CNN and Transfer Learning Modeling for Jujube Spices Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Jujube make up a major portion of Bangladesh's total fruit production. It might be challenging to tell the differences between the many different species of jujube. The manual examination of jujube' physical qualities, which is time-consuming and prone to human mistakes, is the method of identification most commonly used in traditional methods. In this investigation, we make use of computer vision methods to zero in on particular jujube types that are native to the Bangladeshi region. In our approach, the question is solved with the assistance of a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) and Transfer Learning. Our method obtains an outstanding 98.0% accuracy on a test dataset after being trained on photographs of jujube taken in and around Bangladesh. Our work contributes to the growing body of research on applying computer vision and deep learning techniques to agricultural problems. Further research can be conducted to improve the accuracy of our system by collecting a larger dataset of jujube images, exploring the generalizability of our system to other regions and countries, and investigating the potential for using our system to recognize other fruit crops in Bangladesh or other countries.

articleTitle: Blackhole Attack Detection in Wireless Sensor Network Using Backpropagation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The usage of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) in commercial and consumer applications is common. WSN places a high priority on privacy, making it crucial to protect any utilized, transferred, or stored data. Nevertheless, since wireless communications use a broadcasting mechanism. WSNs have no security safeguards, they can be easily manipulated by intruders. Hence, a hacker has exposure to all transactions and is able to listen in, transmit destructive signals, replay previous messages, or commandeer a sensor-node. In this research we are focusing on the blackhole attack, which is one of the most vulnerable attacks: With this kind of attack, the attacker discards data packet that passes through him. As a result, each packet that passes through this malicious intermediate node will experience partial or complete data loss. By employing the Back Propagation algorithm in Artificial Neural Network for WSN we are successfully identifying malicious nodes. Through this work, we are able to improve the accuracy rate for identifying malicious nodes by 77.78.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In previous days, Initially the interaction or communication between the humans occurs through the different sign language. There are no scripts and language to interact. After some centuries the man discovers the fire, water and leaves to eat in forests, there comes the hand gesture as the sign language to communicate between the humans. In initial stages recognition of hand from the other parts of the body becomes most difficult. In this project we had offering you different hand gesture more than alphabets of the English language. For the Gray Scale Image, we have used the hash-based histogram equation. The classification was implemented using the Euclidean distance as well as Fisher Linear Discrimination Analysis (FLDA). The process becomes more effective. The recognition rate was more than 98.23 (Approximately) because of lightning effects varies in different locations, in addition to resolution of the camera pixels the recognition of gesture becomes easier to reach more appropriately.

articleTitle: Human Detection in crowd using One-stage and Two-stage object detection models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Object detection has various uses for recognition, detection, and tracking. Detecting humans in crowded low-quality images is an emerging topic and is a difficult task. In this paper, different object detection are compared for our purpose. Here we use the two models - YOLO and Faster R-CNN and test their working for human detection on low-quality images. We take a low-quality image collection and utilize pre-processing techniques to improve its quality. Using the same experimental setting, we build YOLO and Faster R-CNN and evaluate their results based on accuracy and speed. After comparing the results it shows that in terms of detection speed, YOLO outperforms Faster R-CNN. And YOLO lags than Faster R-CNN when it comes to accuracy. Further we also discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using these models and which is best suited for the scenario we intend to work on. Our findings give useful insights for the development of low-quality image object detection systems for accurate human detection in crowded images, with practical implications for a variety of applications.

articleTitle: Predicting Sugarcane Yields using Supervised Learning: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Bangladesh's sole source of white sugar is sugarcane, an agricultural commodity used to produce biofuels and other products. In recent years, ML techniques have been used to forecast yield, with encouraging outcomes. In this academic study, a supervised ML technique is suggested to forecast sugarcane yield from the perspective of Bangladesh. Weather patterns, sugarcane yield, and other relevant information are gathered from a variety of sources, including the BBS and the BMD. Many ML models, including Linear Regression, GBR, DTR, RFR, and XGBR, are trained. Different evaluation measures are used to compare the effectiveness of various models, such as MAE, MSE, and RMSE. The GBR model fared better than other models, according to the results. The results of this study can be used by farmers, policymakers, and the sugar industry to improve sugarcane yield in Bangladesh and make educated decisions. Future studies can investigate how to estimate sugarcane productivity in other areas and for other crops using ML approaches.

articleTitle: Automated Machine Learning-based Farmer Support System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research proposes an integrated farmer support system that utilises Automated Machine Learning(AutoML) and the Internet of Things(IoT) to provide end-to-end support for farmers. The system aims to address the challenges faced by farmers in conventional farming methods and provide them with accurate information related to crop selection, weather prediction, plant disease detection, and market analysis. It also includes a business module that predicts future needs and provides a marketplace for purchasing chemicals and seeds from genuine companies. The proposed system is available in multiple languages, making it accessible to farmers from any state. The AutoML datasets used by the system are updated in real-time by data managers, ensuring that the information provided to farmers is always up-to-date. The system aims to increase farmers’ profitability and revolutionise agriculture using advanced technologies.

articleTitle: Multilingual Speech Recognition Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A system that properly converts spoken language into written text is what the voice recognition and transcription project seeks to create. The system will analyze audio inputs and turn them into text using a variety of methods, including neural networks, language modeling, and acoustic modeling. The project's main goal is to increase transcription accuracy by tackling issues, including speaker accents, background noise, and audio quality. To make sure the system is capable of properly transcribing various speech varieties, it will be put to the test using a range of audio sources. The system's performance and limitations will be covered in a report that will accompany a functioning prototype of the voice recognition and transcription system. The project's findings will help numerous businesses that rely on voice recognition and transcription technologies improve communication, accessibility, and production.

articleTitle: News Article Topic Classification Using Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rate at which data is produced has increased dramatically in recent days. Without a suitable category or tag, having a lot of data is merely useless information. The consumer may quickly find the content they’re looking for and search for older news stories with ease when news items are properly categorized or classified. The classification of News Article Topics into proper categories aids in many tasks such as finding older data in a faster way, useful organization of data, enabling quick fetching of required data, etc. The proposed system analyses the Antonio Gulli’s (AG) News Classification Dataset using different embeddings. The proposed model also experiments with different types of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Classifiers for classifying the embeddings.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Deep Learning and Machine Learning Models for Speech Emotion Recognition Using Multiple Features
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study presents a comparison between different deep learning and machine learning method for emotion recognition of speech data. Multiple features were extracted from the data and used for training the LSTM, MLP, Random Forest, and CNN models. Datasets used in the study are CREMA-D, RAVDESS, SAVEE, and TESS. The combined dataset are categorized into seven emotions such as surprise, neutral, disgust, fear, sad, happy, and angry. The features extracted from the dataset are zero crossing rate, MFCCs, root mean square, chroma stft, spectral contrast, spectral bandwidth, spectral centroid, spectral rolloff, spectral flatness, poly feature, mel spectrogram. LSTM model gives an accuracy of 57.5%. MLP model provided an accuracy of 59.6%. The accuracy of Random Forest model is 67.8% whereas the CNN model provided an accuracy of 75.8%. The results shows that CNN model out performs the LSTM, MLP, and Random Forest models when used for emotion recognition of speech.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of a Compact U-Shaped Patch Antenna for C-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A requirement for expanding the C band of the satellite frequency band in the communication field has expanded along with C band usage due to the abundance of satellite resources and the rising demand for satellite communication. The suggested antenna design features a ground plane with triangular slot and a U-shaped patch. Microstrip antennas with slots benefit from features including low profile, simple construction, simple feeding, simple system integration, and, most importantly, higher gain. In this study, a microstrip patch antenna with a U-shaped radiating element and microstrip line feeding is proposed. Using CST Microwave Studio, one may design and parameterize. The antenna is made of FR-4 Lossy material, at which the dielectric constant and thickness are 4.3 and 1.6mm, respectively. The antenna has a 28mm*28mm*1.6mm size. According to simulations, the antenna's S11 (return loss) is -64.68 dB at 4.01 GHz, -10-dB impedance bandwidth is 59%, 3-dB axial ratio bandwidth is 12.84% at 4.01 GHz, and its VSWR is 1.01 at that frequency.

articleTitle: Stroke prediction analysis using federated machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Stroke is one of the main cause of disability across the world. A stroke can be treated with the right medicine and recovered if it is detected early enough. In the existing method a stroke is predicted utilising various machine learning algorithms such as random forest, AdaBoost, stochastic gradient, decision tree, logistic regression, and naïve bays classifier etc. There may be drawbacks such as scalability problems, no security and minimum accuracy. The minimum accuracy, privacy problem and scalability problem has been overcome by the proposed method. The three datasets are chosen two from the internet and one from hospital which is the real time dataset which includes ten features. Each dataset has maximum values which results in better prediction of accuracy. The stroke dataset is taken and the data are pre-processed to overcome the missing values in the dataset. The Logistic Regression model is built in a federated way while keeping track of the training loss and the training accuracy. Three datasets are taken and simulated as three hospitals using Pysyft by using the abstraction of the Virtual Worker object; there could be more hospitals. The Model is shipped to individual dataset and it is trained with the local data present. The three part weights are sent to the model , which averages all the part weights and the averaged weights is sent to the 4 parts at the start of each iteration .It has been done for five iterations and ten epochs. Finally the testing has been improved and the scalability problem has been solved since the dataset is split into three parts and the privacy problem has been overcome since a federated model has been used which is the privacy concern model. In the existing method random forest gives an accuracy of 96% and in the proposed method the accuracy has been improved to 98.8 %.

articleTitle: Solar panel with Graphene Nanoribbon Interconnect
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: with the advent of new materials having tunable properties and technological improvement, the renewable energy sector has become competitive with conventional sources in both cost and efficiency. Here we propose a photovoltaic structure with graphene nanoribbon (GNR) interconnect to improve the overall efficiency of solar cells. The characteristics of the structure are analyzed using the Nano tool. The GNR interconnect conductance is studied by varying the dimension of the graphene layer.

articleTitle: Ensemble Deep Learning Using faster RCNN Model and Fuzzy rule System for Health Monitoring of Heritage Castles
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Heritage castles detection involves the use of various technologies and methodologies to identify, document, and preserve historic castles and other structures of cultural significance. This process is critical for preserving these structures for future generations and ensuring that their historical and cultural significance is not lost. The heritage castles are recognized through experienced evaluators or computer vision techniques. The process of experienced evaluator is highly laborious and too costly. The computer vision techniques help to recognize the heritage and non-heritage castles automatically and resolve the experienced evaluator issues. In this study, a hybrid approach is based on faster rcnn and resnet-50 models along with fuzzy rules to recognize the health monitoring of heritage castles. Firstly, the heritage castles in form of four objects ("thick walls", "moat", "towers", and "drawbridge") have been detected and their features are classified through Resnet-50 pretrained model. Based on classified features, fuzzy rules are produced which is helpful to determine the health conditions of castle features. The proposed approach has been trained and tested on 4300 preprocessed images. Several performance parameters have been used to employ to measure the performance of the proposed hybrid approach. During the testing process to recognize the different castles recognition, a total of 94.16% accuracy has been achieved in tower feature images. Overall, heritage castle detection is an important process for preserving the rich cultural heritage of the past and ensuring that future generations can continue to appreciate and learn from these historic structures.

articleTitle: DDoS Attack Detection Using Ensemble Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As more devices connect to the internet, security becomes a major daily challenge. The prevalence of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, which are highly sophisticated, is a growing concern. These attacks are increasingly difficult to detect and are causing significant disruptions. They hinder legitimate users’ access to services, resulting in decreased network performance and, in severe cases, complete network shutdown. DDoS attacks reached a record high of nearly 13 million in 2022, while adversaries are increasingly skilled at bypassing traditional DDoS mitigation and defense mechanisms. In the last four years, over 4 million DDoS attacks have persisted for over an hour, with 25% of those lasting for more than 12 hours. This emphasizes the need for adaptive DDoS solutions that can effectively handle both short and long-lived attacks. This paper proposes an ensemble machine-learning technique which outperforms standalone machine-learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Machine learning-based text to speech conversion for native languages
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Marathi is one of India's most ancient languages. This research project (TTS) focuses at the growth of the Marathi Text-to-Speech system. Marathi text produced in either Devanagari or Ekalipi script is used as input for Marathi TTS. The Text to Speech system's purpose is to convert any given text into speech. In order to mimic human speakers, speech synthesis involves creating technology that can produce human-like speech from any text input. Two key elements of a text-to-speech system are text processing and speech production. It is crucial that the text processing component provides an adequate sequence of phonemic units in order to construct a speech synthesis system that produces natural-sounding speech. The Hidden Markov Model is used with the statistical parameters for speech synthesis. This research is conducted to improve the pronunciation accuracy. The primary goal of this research is to improve and fine-tune the TTS system's pronunciation accuracy for native Indian languages like Marathi and make it seem more natural than current TTS systems (like how humans speak). The WASRAW ("Write as Spoken, Read as Written") technique is what the TTS system uses to speak written text. The objective is to create a language-independent solution as opposed to current solutions, particularly with regard to pronunciation. Unique script i.e., Ekalipi script has been used along with Devanagari script for Marathi language. The proposed model has been tested for 35 Marathi speakers for Devanagari script and achieved MOS of 4.38 for speech intelligibility, MOS of 4.45 for pronunciation accuracy and MOS of 4.44 for naturalness. Also, for Ekalipi script it has been tested for around 10 users who are familiar with the script. The dictionary-based approach has been followed in order to speak Ekalipi words. It has achieved good results for simple words written in Ekalipi. Even though the system is able to synthesize Ekalipi words correctly, there is still a need for a generalized model. As a future work, rules can be defined and the generalized model can be implemented for Ekalipi script and can be tested with the more no users and more no of languages can be added.

articleTitle: Implementation of Bagging Ensemble Deep Covnets for Iron Ore Image Characterization
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to Iron ore image characterization using ensemble learning based on CNN. The proposed method uses multiple CNN models such as DenseNet169, Inceptionv3 and Xception. The average ensemble is used to make the final prediction. The proposed approach is evaluated on (RLM)reflected light microscopy images of Iron ore acquired from Kiriburu mines, Jharkhand, India. The experimental results demonstrate that the ensemble learning approach outperforms the state-of-the-art single-model approaches in terms of classification accuracy and robustness. Specifically, our method achieved a test accuracy of 99.34%, which represents an improvement of 1.31%, 4.57%, and 0.65%, on the accuracy of DenseNet169, Inceptionv3 and Xception respectively, compared to the best single-model approach.

articleTitle: An Approach to Android-based Search and Rescue Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The term "embedded system" refers to a mix of hardware and software systems. Robot that is embedded in a certain system and has a controller architecture that is a component of a hardware and software system. In this project, a device that might be used to rescue people from the ground quickly or from any form of natural deserter if they get trapped within a building or in another tight space where even a person cannot assist them is offered. Everyone wants to live in safety in the twenty-first century, yet unforeseen risks or natural disasters might hurt individuals at any moment. It takes time to locate them and their position if some individuals get unhappy after being placed in an unexpected circumstance, and it may even be fatal for some of them. This robot can enter extremely small or severely damaged spaces, locate humans, and provide the victim's position, saving both their time and lives. Using its sensors and a wireless Android application, the octomoms system could manage this robot in two different ways. It sent data through Bluetooth and provided a visual feed of the working environment. Two Arduino microcontrollers were used in this project.

articleTitle: Isolation Improvement in MIMO Antenna for WLAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the present work, complementary split ring resonator-based defected ground structures have been employed to improve the isolation between two closely spaced multiple-input multiple-output antenna elements. The split-ring resonators offered lower isolation when they were used as decoupling elements in the top layer, as evident from full-wave simulations. A rectangular slotted structure in the ground provides lower isolation as compared to the complementary split-ring resonator. At 5.5 GHz, isolation between the 2 proximal antenna elements is -24.5 dB. The separation between the 2 adjacent edges of the radiating elements is 0.1375λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>. The suggested antenna design utilizes an FR-4 substrate of thickness 0.03 λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> with physical dimensions of 0.79λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> x 0.66λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>. The full-wave simulations indicate that the suggested antenna exhibits a gain of 3.40 dBi.The -10 dB impedance bandwidth of the proposed antenna is 200 MHz. A prototype has been fabricated and evaluated for proof of concept. Measured and simulated results depict close resemblance.

articleTitle: Face Recognition through Landmarks to Find Accurate Distance Between Two Landmarks Using Pythagorean Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Being accurate and efficient and compact is crucial for a face recognition system for practical use. This technique relies on the fact that these features are relatively stable and unique for each individual, making them ideal for face recognition purposes. Face landmark detection involves identifying and localizing key points or landmarks on a person's face. These landmarks are typically areas such as the corners of the eyes and mouth, the tip of the nose, and the contour of the jawline. More concretely, we customize an end-to-end method to calculate the distances between two or more landmarks. The process of face recognition through landmarks involves various steps, including face detection, landmark detection, feature extraction, and matching. Feature extraction involves measuring the distance and angles between these landmarks to create a unique facial signature for each individual. This approach is independent of any face detection and landmark detection algorithms where the distances are to be calculated between the 468 3D landmarks using the proposed technique. The entire concept and the problems for each technique are highlighted in this paper

articleTitle: Analysis of Cricket Shots and Dismissal of Batsmen
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The field of computer vision has witnessed remarkable advancements in recent years, driven by the convergence of deep learning techniques and advancements in computer hardware. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have emerged as a pivotal technology in revolutionizing computer vision tasks, such as image classification, object detection, and image segmentation. The domain of sports, specifically cricket, has also experienced a surge in the adoption of CNNs. Consequently, this paper employs a CNN architecture to accurately classify different types of batting shots played by cricketers. The proposed methodology involves the extraction of video frames capturing the batsman in action, which are subsequently fed into a pre-trained CNN model. To enhance the model’s performance in shot classification, transfer learning is employed to fine-tune the pre-trained network. Additionally, the paper delves into the realm of dismissal prediction in cricket using computer vision. This prediction is based on analyzing the length of the delivered ball and the batsman’s position during the moment of delivery. By evaluating the accuracy of the prediction model for specific batsmen, a comprehensive analysis is provided to assess its effectiveness. The integration of deep learning and computer vision presents substantial potential for advancing cricket analysis. The outcomes of this study can also be extended to other sports, facilitating further enhancements in game analysis and thereby improving players performance.

articleTitle: Envision: Assistance System for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: People who are visually impaired experience many difficulties completing daily duties and need technology solutions to enhance their quality of life. This study proposes to build a mobile application using deep learning and the Flutter framework to help visually impaired individuals perform their daily tasks. The application includes object detection, currency recognition, image-to-text conversion, and text-to-speech ability. It has features like vibrations on screen swiping and larger buttons for easy navigation. The suggested system operates online and in real-time, making it possible to utilize it without an Internet connection. The study emphasizes the need of addressing the difficulties faced by those who are blind and the requirement for technical solutions to help them in their everyday routines.

articleTitle: Local Fruit Classification and Recognition using Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The practice of automatically classifying images is gaining popularity. Many of us have very little knowledge of the local fruits, yet even in that case, we can vouch to their quality. In our study, we'll talk about a deep learning based system that can distinguish local fruits automatically. Fruit identification is a highly common activity, but automatically classifying fruits based on their placements, shapes, colors, and other attributes is a difficult task. Our study involved the collection of samples from several local areas, followed by the use of various transfer learning models, including VGG-19, Inception-v3, MobileNet, etc. MobileNet provided us with the highest accuracy of 99.53% among them. A top model was also suggested depending on the accuracy of our training. We used 60% of the image data from the 3240 total samples for training, for the purpose of validation we use 20% of the image data, and 20% of the total image data for testing. We received a satisfactory outcome after training and testing. Local fruits are classified as a consequence of this research model, which can be useful for everyday fruit identification.

articleTitle: Function Locking Fused with Hashing Technique to Mitigate Re-entrancy Attacks in Smart Contract
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Reentrancy attacks have been a significant threat to smart contracts on blockchain platforms. This attack allows an attacker to repeatedly call a vulnerable function in a contract, leading to unexpected behavior and loss of funds. In this research paper, we propose a preventive approach to mitigate the reentrancy attack by introducing a locking mechanism. Our proposed method involves the use of a lock that prevents a contract from being called again until the previous execution is completed. We implement and evaluate our proposed approach on the Ethereum blockchain platform using various benchmarks. Our results show that our approach effectively prevents reentrancy attacks while incurring a low overhead cost. Our proposed approach can be integrated into smart contract development to enhance security and protect against reentrancy attacks by implementing the Function locking technique and Verifying by hashing technique.

articleTitle: Smart Glasses for Visually Impaired People using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Moving about in new places and avoiding impediments are only two of the numerous difficulties that people who are visually impaired have faced for decades. This study suggests smart glasses equipped with object recognition and text-to-speech technology as a solution for the difficulties faced by the visually handicapped. Objects in real time are identified with the use of the Raspberry Pi’s OpenCV software and the YOLO algorithms. The text-to-speech conversion is done using the Google API. Words of caution are spoken to the visually impaired individual to help them find their way. The technology is meant to be user-friendly, so those with visual impairments may move about with more assurance and ease. Components include a Raspberry Pi 3, a camera module for the Raspberry Pi, and a speaker.

articleTitle: Blockchain In Air Pollution Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The detrimental effects of air pollution on human health have become significant issues in many parts of the world. The assessment and forecasting of the air quality near people have recently attracted more research attention. The Internet of Things (IoT), which connects several sensors in various areas to improve people’s quality of life, is widely used in many fields. This makes air quality monitoring easier than before. The traditional method of installing stationary sensors does not effectively give a full picture of polluted air in people’s surroundings because the closest monitors may be kilometers away. To promote pollution control, assessment and prosecution are used, which may entail actions like industry-wide shutdowns that are harmful to regional economic growth. A new economic era has begun with the application of blockchain technology, which is known as the foundation of Bitcoin. Recent years have seen the development of many blockchain-based programs and services. Blockchain applications are becoming more numerous and diverse across a range of sectors, such as the (IoT)Internet of Things, finance, and reliability. In this essay, we examine the application of blockchain technology to protect data in air quality monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Detection And Prevention of ARP Attack in Software Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Software-defined networking (SDN) offers community directors flexibility, programmability, and centralized control. However, it also brings new security demanding situations, such as ARP spoofing attacks, that may compromise community safety and disrupt network offerings. In this paper, we endorse a method to hit upon and mitigate ARP spoofing assaults in SDN networks using RYU controllers. Our solution is based on the ryu utility, which inspects ARP packets and detects ARP spoofing assaults by way of comparing the sender's MAC and IP address with with a formerly discovered mapping. If a spoofing assault is detected, the RYU controller drops packets from the attacker's Mac address. We implement our answer using the Open Flow protocol and test it on a experimental switch topology with 4 hosts. Our experimental outcomes show that our solution is powerful in detecting and mitigating ARP spoofing assaults inside the network. Furthermore, the solution is lightweight and does no longer introduce massive overhead to the network. We agree with our solution may be incorporated into current SDN networks to enhance their security posture and prevent ARP attack.

articleTitle: Enhancing Quality of Service (QoS) In Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud computing is a paradigm shift in the way computing resources are delivered and consumed.The demand for cloud computing services has led to an increase in the complexity of cloud systems, making load balancing an essential component of their performance and reliability. In this paper, we propose an enhanced approach to cloud computing load balancing that not only improves the performance and reliability of cloud systems, but also finds correlations between resources and applications. Algorithms in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning aid in the dynamic and real-time resource allocation, taking into account multiple factors such as traffic patterns, resource utilization, and service level agreements. Our approach goes beyond traditional load balancing methods by also discovering correlations between resources and applications, providing valuable insights into the relationships between different components of the system. The interpretation proves to be helpful in optimizing resource allocation which in turn corresponds to the prevention of performance degradation. Our evaluation results in the enhanced performance with respect to latency and resource utilization, as well as a clear understanding of the correlations between resources and applications. This work highlights the potential for AI and ML to not only enhance cloud computing load balancing, but also provide valuable insights for optimizing resource allocation and improving the overall performance of cloud systems.

articleTitle: Cycle Slip Detection on IRNSS/NavIC Data for Single and Dual Frequency Receiver
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS) is a satellite based navigation system developed and deployed by Indian Space Research Organization consisting of seven satellites with two frequencies in L5 and S bands. The positioning uses pseudorange, carrier phase or combination of both. In the receiver, loss of lock with the signal in phase measurements often results in an accumulation of integer cycles introducing an error that ultimately affects the ambiguity resolution. The aim of this work is to develop a software module for the detection of the Cycle Slips for single and dual frequency IRNSS data to detect Cycle Slips in majority of cases. Doppler Integration method and Carrier Phase combinations are used on single and dual frequency data respectively. Additionally, a Comma Separated Variable file is created to store the Cycle Slip detection flags to analyze the occurrence of Cycle Slips for available Satellites over the observation period.

articleTitle: Optimal Network Selection using Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The network requirement is increasing day by day because, in today’s world, every person has a mobile phone. To compensate for the demand for the best Quality of service (QoS), next-generation networks consist of mixed heterogeneous networks because one network cannot fulfill the demand of every user. So, to switch from one network to another, there is a need for the network selection algorithm. It is important for organizations to provide continuous services such as calls, SMS, Internet, multimedia, video calling, etc. to customers irrespective of their location. In this paper, JAYA algorithm is presented for the selection of optimal networks for four different applications. After that, the comparison of JAYA algorithm is done with GRA algorithm. Finally, the performance of both algorithms is analyzed in terms of two parameters, i.e. accuracy and Relative standard deviation (RSD).

articleTitle: An Improved Gauss-Markov Mobility Model for FANET using NS3 Simulation in 3-Dimension Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Drones connect with other drones to create a network in the FANET wireless communication network. There have been many research barriers because of the high node mobility, frequent topology change, and protocols that are not crucial to FANET. Nodes change places quite rapidly in FANET because of how swiftly they move. During simulation, the boundary area for node movement has been determined. The nodes’ excellent mobility caused them to sometimes wander beyond the simulation border. A node (sender) may be beyond the boundary when its efforts to communicate data to another node (receiver) might result in data loss. This research implements an improved Gauss Markov Mobility model(IGMMM) in the NS3 Simulation environment, causing a flying node to collide with and cross the simulation border and lose data. The original Gauss Markov mobility model (GMMM) is also enlarged to minimise data loss in the 3-dimensional unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) environment data loss in the 3-dimensional UAV environment; the original Gauss Markov mobility model was also enlarged. We employed packet distribution ratio, throughput, packet delivery ratio (PDR), and end-to-end delay performance measures to assess the effectiveness of the present GMMM and its upgraded implementation. The results demonstrate that the Enhanced 3-D Gauss Markov Mobility model outperforms the present GMM in a 3-D FANET system by preventing flying nodes from crossing simulation borders. The NS3 network simulator uses this as its implementation.

articleTitle: Reviving Black and White Images: Enhancing Colorization with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the more intriguing deep learning applications is colourizing black and white photographs. The restoration of old or damaged images is one application that has drawn a lot of interest in the automatic image colorization technology in the decade since its introduction. Prior to AI and deep learning, this work required a lot of human intervention and hardcoding, but today, the entire process has been entirely automated from beginning to end. Using GANs to restore and recolorize historical photos is one answer to this problem. The objective of this project is to showcase the effectiveness and advantages of GANs Networks by implementing a GAN model capable of transforming fixed-size black and white images into colorized images of identical dimensions. Concerning the dataset, I have approximately 3000 rgb photographs from diverse domains such as mountains, forests, and cities, which we will convert to grayscale and use as labels for our model. I used binary cross entropy as the discriminator's loss function and mean squared error as the generator's loss function, & then I used Adam to optimise the generator and discriminator. Moving on to the results, the colourized output from the generator was significantly closer to the original rgb image.

articleTitle: Robustness Analysis of EV Charging System using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Electric cars offer numerous benefits and are considered the future of the automobile industry. However, their worldwide adoption still needs to grow. One of the primary reasons for this delay in electrification is charge anxiety, which refers to the uncertainty customers feel when connecting the charging cable to the car. To address this issue, this study analyses the performance of the charging system using a machine learning model to identify sensitive signals that influence the charging process and can cause successful charging or charge termination. The analysis will also help to define robust operating regions where the charging component can reliably function, regardless of external conditions. This study’s findings will provide insights into electric vehicle charging behavior with the supply station.

articleTitle: Design and comparative performance analysis of wideband CFBG with multi narrowband gratings for DWDM system
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A dispersion compensation scheme comprising two chirped fiber Bragg gratings (CFBGs) is proposed to compensate the dispersion of 8×20 Gbps DWDM system over a 100 km link length. The proposed scheme requires a grating length of 350 mm to achieve maximum quality factor for all the channels. The proposed design is compared with multi-narrow band gratings approach. The effect of temperature is observed on both the systems. The results reveal that with the rise of temperature, the performance of the multi-narrowband gratings system deteriorates severely, with the Q factor of the system reaching below 6 at temperature of 30°C. However the Q factor of the system comprising the proposed two CFBGs maintains a value above 10 for temperature as high as 45°C. The proposed scheme is more resistant to temperature variations and cost effective than multi narrowband gratings.

articleTitle: HDR Reconstruction from LDR Scenes Using Basic Image Formation Procedure
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: High dynamic range (HDR) images are the one’s which includes all the objects from the original scene with correct exposure. The HDR content can be very helpful in analysis purposes as it possess all features of the scene as it is. Although it is useful the creation of HDR is very much expensive. Low dynamic range (LDR) images are less expensive but may include saturation regions leads to the absence of some content. For this reason there is a necessity to think of an alternative. The reconstruction of HDR from LDR content can be the alternative solution for the problem. This process can be done using different methods.The studies mainly represents different kinds of machine learning techniques. The methods include machine learning , deep learning , different kinds of CNN architectures specially designed for particular purposes , GAN models , reverse tone mapping operators etc. This survey also analyses evaluation techniques for assessing quality of images and techniques like image declipping, tone mapping operator etc. Some of the analyzed methods also deals with reconstruction of HDR videos from LDR videos rather than from raw images.Comparison in the survey reveals accuracy of different methods.

articleTitle: Classification of Diabetic Retinopathy using pre-trained Deep Learning Model- DenseNet 121
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: An upsurge in cases of diabetes patients is witnessed worldwide with 108 million sufferers in the year 1980 to a whopping 422 million in the year 2014. The growth rate is lesser in countries with high earnings in comparison to the nations with small and intermediate earnings. Diabetes causes many other ailments in the body like kidney malfunction or failure, permanent vision loss, cardiac arrest, strokes, and amputation of the lower limb. Generally, the populace having diabetes mellitus for a prolonged period like that of more than 15 years have a higher probability of developing diabetic retinopathy (DR) that damages the eyes permanently if not treated in the earlier stages. The new age automatic detection system employing deep learning (DL) algorithms can prove to be fruitful in detecting diabetic retinopathy in the initial stages and therefore treatment can be provided well in time. In this paper, one of the most coveted DL techniques DenseNet is used to classify DR into five different stages. The hyperparameters are tuned and the maxima are found for these parameters, batch size, learning rate and epochs. These hyperparameters are usually application-specific and vary in accordance with the type and size of data.

articleTitle: Optimizing LightGBM for Intrusion Detection Systems using GOA
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Increasing popularity of IoT devices across the world is because of its applicability in wide range of areas and disciplines like healthcare, education, business, defense etc. The information is continuously being shared as they work 24x7, thus making vulnerable to several types of attacks. Intrusion Detection Systems are smart intelligent systems that detects the occurrence of any malicious activity. Due to the growing size of the internet, intruders are trying new ways to inject newer kinds of attacks and perform malicious activities. Hence, there is a need of robust and reliable IDSs. This paper presents a methodology using LightGBM classifier with hyper parameter tuned using Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm using NetFlow based UNSW-NB15 dataset. The proposed methodology aims to give a contribution to several works done using NetFlow based data, achieving ∼97% of the detection rate.

articleTitle: Digital Verification And Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Due to the information technology industry's rapid growth and easy access to affordable, cutting-edge office equipment on the market, the fake of important papers has been an issue in recent years. As a result, authentication and verification processes are very necessary for a variety of important papers, such as those used in the banking sector, the government, and transaction. However, a lot of challenging and tedious steps make document verification very challenging and complicated, which is what motivated us to conduct this study. In this work, we describe a decentralized internet-based program for between peers cloud storage for digital document verification of documents built on Blockchain. By making it simpler to examine, see, and audit the verification process, this application seeks to improve it. The suggested approach includes several cloud-based security measures, digital signatures, peer networking, and proof of work, which makes it simpler and quicker for any organization or authority to validate any uploaded documents with just a single click. Our proposed model completely satisfies all requirements for a digital document verification system by resolving the drawbacks and difficulties in the existing document verification techniques.

articleTitle: Generating Relevant Question Answer from Video
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Online video lectures are currently a widely used form of instruction as online education has grown significantly. The process of creating question-and-answer pairs from these videos could be laborious, time-consuming, and exhausting. In this study, we offer a cutting-edge methodology for creating questions with meaningful answers, which would simplify the laborious process of question development. To extract text from videos, we employ speech recognition software. By sending a synchronous request to Google Speech Recognition, the video is converted to text. Two times, first for extractive summarization and then to perfect it for question creation, we employed the T5_base transformer. The condensed text is utilised to produce keywords, which are then supplied to the T5_base transformer with SQuAD dataset tuning to produce questions, along with context. In order to examine the calibre of the queries, we also compare our model to a few previously developed models using the same input. We discover that when compared to other models, our model produces superior questions and responses.

articleTitle: 10T SRAM cell Analysis for improved Read and Write Noise Margin
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper includes simulation and analyses of 10T Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) with various supply voltage ranging from 0.5V to 1V. For simulation, Cadence virtuoso tool with 45nm gpdk is employed. The simulated results are compared to existing SRAM cells such as Conventional 6T,TA8T, D2p11T,11T SRAM cells. In 10T cell, read decoupled structure has been utilized to enhance the read stability. The read static noise margin (RSNM) of 10T SRAM cell has been improved by 1.96× at 1V as referenced to 6T SRAM cell. The dynamic loop cutting technique is used to strengthen the write static noise margin (WSNM). This gets enhanced by 1.18× as referenced with 6T SRAM cell. To compute the impact of process variation, Montecarlo simulations have been performed for 2000 samples at 27°C temperature. The read current mean value is increased by 1.08× as of 6T SRAM. Further, hold static noise margin (HSNM) of 10T cell is increased by 1.02×/1.77× as compared to 6T/D2p11 cells.

articleTitle: Analysis of Aperture Coupled Microstrip Patch Antenna for Improved Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, four different aperture (slot) shapes have been investigated for getting maximum coupling in an Aperture coupled microstrip patch antenna (ACMSA). A comparison of coupling from various aperture shapes for example "H-shaped" "Bowtie" "Dogbone" and "Hourglass" ACMSA have been presented and results are validated at different operating frequencies. The optimized simulated impedance bandwidth is in the range of 28 to 30% for each case. Additionally, validation involved fabricating an ACMSA with an "H-shaped " aperture, followed by conducting measurements at 1.06 GHz. The simulated and measured impedance bandwidths show a strong agreement with each other. The study is also carried out at two other operating frequencies i.e. 1.8 GHz and 2.4 GHz. Impedance bandwidths for all four different apertures are calculated and presented. The simulated gain and front- to- back ratio are 8.2 dBi and 11.2 dB respectively. This study will be helpful for designing ACMSA at different frequencies for different applications.

articleTitle: BigBasket Fairness Analysis for Searched Outputs
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a fairness analysis of the ranked outputs of BigBasket website. Using live data set and by applying rKL, rRD, rND, nDCG. We examine whether the ranking algorithms treat all products,sellers fairly and equally, regardless of their demographic or other characteristics. We analyzed the ranking algorithms using various fairness metrics, including group fairness and individual fairness. We identified the key features and criteria that influence the product rankings. We find that the ranking algorithms are complex and multifaceted, taking into account various factors such as product relevance, popularity, ratings, reviews, and pricing. We applied different measures to several real-time scraped data-set and detected cases of bias. Additionally, We observed that the ranking algorithms are dynamic and adaptive, constantly adjusting to the changing user preferences and market trends. Our findings have significant implications for e-commerce platforms, regulators, and researchers interested in promoting fairness, transparency, and diversity in the online marketplaces.The implementation of this work is available at https://github.com/deep9069/Bigbasket-Fairness-analysis-Btech-Projec.

articleTitle: Data Classification with Different Sorting Techniques using Machine Learning Algorithm on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this modern world, the biggest challenge faced by the generation is classification and analyzing a large amount of data. There are many algorithms that are present today as a tool for us to treat and analyze this bulk, complex and varied data set. This is where machine learning comes into play, which is a type of AI which uses training models in order to train itself and provide the desired output. The main aim of training computers is to compute complex data, do classification and present the desired results on the basis of the inputs provided. In this paper, we have implemented a classification algorithm namely, KNN using two different sorting techniques and compared them on the grounds of hardware utilization and speed on FPGA using HDL.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Machine Learning Approaches for Accurate Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Heart disease is a global health concern, and early identification is crucial. Machine learning (ML) shows promise in predicting heart disease [5], but choosing the best algorithm is challenging. Comparing ML models is vital for selecting the optimal one. This study compared six ML algorithms: Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Decision Tree, Random Forest, and SVM (Support Vector Machine). Accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score assessed their performance.KNN excelled with a precision score of 0.92, followed by Random Forest at 0.91. SVM performed well with 0.88 accuracies. Logistic Regression and Decision Tree scored 0.86, while Linear Regression was the least accurate (0.55). While evaluating the precision, recall, and F1 scores confirmed KNN’s superiority. Other models varied in performance.These findings highlight the pros and cons of ML models for heart disease prediction. While KNN was the most accurate in this study, further research is needed to identify the optimal algorithm for different datasets. ML models can revolutionize cardiology by quickly forecasting and identifying the cardiac disease, improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: An Efficient Management of Delivery and Logistics Using Euler Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In our day-to-day life, we find many shortcuts which we eventually will stick to. When it comes to hectic tasks such as everyday travel, it's normal to want to take the simple route. Due to this, innumerable people around the world have saved time and money by just following simple alternatives. Today's Euler graph has achieved the highest level of success in a variety of situations that happen in physical science, communication science, computer science, economics, and many other domains. This concept helps us to understand the logic of how a parcel can be delivered to its various destinations whether by visiting junctions on multiple occasions, visiting every route at least twice or selecting the most cost-effective route so as to save time and other useful resources such as fuel, man-power etc. The graphs show the relationships between the points (junctions) and lines (nodes). With the help of Eulerian graphs, delivery logistics companies and customers will be of utmost advantage as packages can be delivered quickly and efficiently. In this paper, we want to uncover and investigate a technique used by logistic corporations to locate the best paths for package delivery using the Euler Graph Theorems.

articleTitle: DMS: A Necessity in Agricultural Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the realm of contemporary agricultural planning, decision-making systems have emerged as a crucial tool that assists farmers in making well-informed decisions to optimize crop yields, lower production expenses, and enhance resource management. These systems employ a range of technologies, such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics, to scrutinize data from various sources, including weather forecasts, crop characteristics, and soil composition, to offer valuable insights to farmers. The use of decision-making systems in agriculture has become increasingly vital due to the intricacies involved in modern farming practices, including precision agriculture and the emphasis on sustainable practices. This abstract analyzes the current usage of decision-making systems and its importance in agricultural planning, highlighting the potential to revolutionize the industry, increase productivity, and mitigate environmental impact.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Classification of Metals and Plastics under the methodology of Deep Learning using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A purely automated solution for the recycling procedure. In the course of recycling the problem comes up to light, the classification and segregation of materials. The waste consisting of both plastic and metal can easily be now categorized without any complication. The details will be set aside in the form of data and can be used on any occasion. This model will work on the neural network to classify the quality of the product. The model will provide ease in segregating the waste in the right way, this is fruitful for nature as the segregated waste can be disposed of easily and saves time and resources as well. The proposed model uses CNN for image classification under the domain of Deep Learning Neural Networks using Python.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient MIMO-OFDM for THz Communication in FANETs
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The primary properties of flying-ad-hoc-networks (FANETs), which are autonomous wireless networks, include high mobility, scalability for various applications, situations, and robustness to handle potential communication failures. They still face a number of limitations, including the restricted flying time of Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and lower throughput. Because the location of the UAV may be changed in FANET, it is possible to adjust the distance between two nodes and subsequently optimise the capacity of the related connection to increase network throughput. In this study, a simulation model for UAV ad-hoc network is built. Various antenna configurations are examined also. When we utilise up to a certain number of UAVs, the reduced latency makes single input single output (SISO) systems, capable of handling greater data rates. MIMO is shown to boost performance when the number of UAVs in the network surpasses a particular threshold, though. As the system's antenna count increases, its performance improves. The use of MIMO OFDM for terahertz communication in FANET is highlighted. The proposed architecture is built on the Marcov Chain paradigm. We arrive at the formulae for throughput, BER, path loss, and outage probability. When MIMO antennas are configured, the system's overall performance improves as its BER drops and its throughput rises.

articleTitle: Harvesting Insights: Unveiling the Future of Mango Yield Using Real-Time Bangladesh Climate Data by Supervised Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Mango, a unique fruit of the Indian subcontinent, was cultivated under the supervision of Mughal emperor Akbar [1]. Its exceptional taste impressed Alexander the Great [2]. Considering the potentiality of this unique fruit this study focuses on predicting mango yield in Bangladesh using machine learning algorithms. Bangladesh's economy heavily relies on the export of Ready-made Garments (RMG) and Knitwear, and there is a need to explore alternative revenue sources due to the increasing trade deficit. Mango production has the potential to contribute significantly to export earnings and GDP growth. However, predicting mango yield has become challenging due to climate change and natural calamities. To address this, a comprehensive dataset covering 54 years of mango production and weather conditions in all 64 districts of Bangladesh was collected. Regression algorithms were employed to predict mango yield, with the Random Forest Regression (RFR) model exhibiting the lowest error rates. The contributions and practical impact of this study include the creation of a real-time dataset, demonstrating the accuracy of the proposed algorithms, and facilitating improved health outcomes and economic benefits through effective production planning.

articleTitle: Wax Apple Disease Detection and Curative Solution Recommendation System using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recently, computer vision systems have contributed in numerous ways to smart agriculture. Several of those research has focused on detecting fruit and leaf diseases for more effective cultivation and better production. In this paper, we have tried to bring attention to wax apples- one of the popular fruits among South East Asian countries, the diseases that affect the fruit and their prevention through early detection with the help of machine learning. For experimentation, we have collected images for four distinct categories- insect damage, fruit rot, anthracnose, and benign. The proposed system can predict the disease from pre-processed images using machine learning algorithms such as Random Forest, Bagging Classifier, Decision Tree, SVC, KNN, Ridge Classifier, etc. Among all, the KNeighbor classifier got the highest accuracy of 96.17% in recognizing wax apple diseases. Finally, the confusion matrix, precision, recall, and f1 score are shown here for the justification of our outcome.

articleTitle: Unit Test Framework for Distributed Unit Manager (DUMGR) of 5G RAN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The three main parts of 5G wireless systems, commonly referred to as 5G New Radio technology, are user equipment, access side, and core side. The Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) is designed to enable the Next Generation-RAN, which is a crucial component for providing wireless connectivity through a radio link between devices and the core network. The Radio Unit, Centralised Unit, and Distributed Unit make up the gNodeB.This project focuses on developing a Unit Test Framework for DU MGR (DU Manager) and creating stubs or simulators that can replace the actual implementation of a component during testing using C language. For instance, we have developed CU stub, RLC stub, MAC stub, DUOAM stub and F1U stub to simulate the behavior of the components that DU MGR interacts with. By using these stubs, we aimed to validate the functionality of DU MGR, which is our Device under Test (DUT). We verified the cell bring-up, UE attach call flows of 5G and negative scenarios possible through writing test cases.The project has used the "VS Code" editor to write code in the C language. Also, we used Jenkins CI/CD to develop and run tests for our code. The "MobaXterm" application was used to execute and repeat testing suites and to verify logs for debugging purposes.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Time Series Models for Bitcoin Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Bitcoin is the very first digital or cryptocurrency based on Block chain concept.
