The objective of this paper is to forecast the price of Bitcoin using various Machine Learning Time Series models like: Moving Averages (MA), Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). As we know that the price of Bitcoin is very volatile in nature so producing appropriate predictions is difficult. Also we know that Bitcoin Price nature is not stationary, so we have converted our non-stationary data to stationary for models like ARIMA which works properly on stationary data only. At last, we have compared the results of MA, ARIMA, XGBoost and LSTM for Bitcoin prediction based on RMSE and we found that first three models have given somewhere similar results whereas LSTM has given different.

articleTitle: Air Pollution Monitoring & Prediction System for Ahmedabad Region using IOT and ML
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Humanity would not be able to survive without air. Daily industrial, transportation, and domestic activities churn up dangerous toxins in our environment. Monitoring and predicting air quality are now essential, especially in developing countries like India. A system is suggested in this work that employs the MQ-131, GP2Y1010-AU0F, MQ-9, MQ-135, DHT11, 110-601-SO2, and MiCS-2714 to monitor the concentration of air pollutants NH3, O3, NO2, CO, PM2.5, PM10, temperature, SO2 and uses ESP8266 data sent to the cloud. The next phase was applying the Linear regression and ARIMA models to accurately predict the pollution levels from hazardous gases and the Air Quality Index (AQI) for the ensuing seven days. We accurately predicted the observations of the following 7 days after training our best model using data of preceding 60 days. This indicates that our model's accuracy in correctly predicting the values for all the parameters is close to 90% or higher. Therefore, we believe that such a solution would be advantageous if a large-scale installation were to be made. By allowing users to check the air quality remotely, this initiative, which is being developed for Ahmedabad City, will contribute to a decrease in the quantity of pollution in the atmosphere.

Author Keywords: Linear Regression model and SARIMAX model

articleTitle: Performance analysis of 8×8 Truncated Multiplier using 1-bit Hybrid Full Adder
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digital signal processing relies heavily on multiplication operations and while parallel multipliers can provide a rapid multiplication method, their implementation in VLSI often requires a considerable amount of space. To mitigate word size growth in signal processing applications, it is typically advisable to use rounded output. This means that minimizing the space required by the rounded output multiplier is a crucial design objective. This article presents a parallel multiplication approach that calculates the product of two n-bit values by summing only the highest significant columns and leveraging a technique to improve the accuracy. Though many technologies evolved to increase the performance of the arithmetic circuits but intended only to a certain limit such as failing in power usage or speed factor. The study evaluates the performance of an 8x8 truncated multiplier developed based on hybrid full adders with 16 and 22nm CMOS technology using the Tanner EDA tool. It includes a comparative study of hybrid full adders with 16nm & 22nm CMOS technology using the same tool. Adoption of the hybrid full adders results in a significant improvement in performance metrics including reduced power consumption & area. Area occupied is reduced by 27.2% in case of both 1-bit & 64-bit adder, power consumed by circuit is reduced by 57% & 66% for 1-bit & 64-bit full adder respectively. It is observed that area occupied & power consumption is reduced by 27.2% & 9% respectively in case of 8-bit truncated multiplier.

articleTitle: A Wearable Dual-Band Dual-Polarized Antenna for GPS L-2 and ISM Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A wearable antenna with dual bands and dual polarizations is presented in this paper. The antenna operates at the GPS L2 band of 1.227 GHz with linear polarization (LP) & the ISM band of 2.45 GHz with circular polarization (CP). The suggested antenna includes two substrates: a square-shaped patch on a felt substrate and a circular patch antenna printed on a Taconic TLY-5 substrate as the main radiator. The simulated 10-dB impedance bandwidths are 25.68% (1.12-1.45 GHz) at the lower band (LB) and 11.08% (2.30-2.57 GHz) at the upper band (UB). The upper CP band exhibits a 3-dB Axial Ratio bandwidth of ~ 90 MHz (2.41 to 2.50 GHz). All the simulation has been carried out on Ansys® HFSS software tools.

articleTitle: A Verifiable Secret Sharing Scheme using Elliptic Curve Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the significant problems with communication technology is data privacy, which impacts our everyday activities. Sharing a secret is crucial for safe contact and has many uses in information security. Secret sharing allows a select group of authorised users to view private information. Few authorised members are given access to the secret key in various organisations, with a certain number of them being expected to figure out the secret. In secret sharing, all individuals are assumed to be trustworthy, but in reality, there is the chance of cheating. This study suggests a threshold method called verifiable secret sharing to detect a cheater and verify each individual’s honesty. The elliptic curve cryptosystem, hash function, XOR, and Lagrange interpolation technique do the sharing process. Only shadow shares, not the actual shares, are given to the participants, and before sending information, participants perform combiner authentication. Analysis of security and performance reveals that the proposed method is more effective.

articleTitle: Slang language Detection and Identification In Text
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The prevalence of internet slang in modern communication channels, such as the internet and mobile services, has led to the emergence of new linguistic phenomena. While some of these terms are previously registered words with new applications, others fall into the category of out-of-vocabulary slang. Dismissing internet slang and replacing it with unfamiliar phrases is no longer viable, as these terms carry significant connotations in social media writings. This research paper focuses on the detection and identification of slang words using a range of techniques. The study aims to improve the understanding of internet slang and enable accurate interpretation of social media texts. By employing various methods, the research achieved a high accuracy rate of 95.37% in detecting slang words within sentences. The results of this research emphasize the significance of accurately identifying and understanding internet slang in social media posts. Accurately identifying and interpreting these terms enhances our ability to understand the nuances and context of online conversations. The high detection accuracy showcases the effectiveness of the employed techniques and contributes to the field of natural language processing. By continuously improving the detection and identification of internet slang, deeper insights can be gained into the evolving linguistic landscape of online communication.

articleTitle: Optimal Algorithms for Covering a Rectangle with Identical Circles
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The optimization problem of covering a given geometrical region, such as a rectangle, with the minimum number of identical circles has been extensively studied in various disciplines. The paper introduces two quadratic time algorithms to solve two variants of the problem. The first algorithm computes the configurations or positions of the circles to cover the rectangle provided the circles cannot overlap. The second algorithm computes the same for the problem variant where the circles can overlap. The algorithms proved effective in handling diverse rectangle sizes and circle radii, efficiently solving the problem of covering a given rectangular region with the minimum number of identical circles and finding their positions. The empirical evaluation shows that the two algorithms compute the configuration of circles with minimum overlap or loss respectively.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Effectiveness of a Facial Recognition-Based Attendance Management System in a Real-World Setting
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Face recognition technology has been extensively used in multiple verticals of security, surveillance, and human-computer interaction. Conventional techniques including manual sign-ins, identity cards, or biometric verification have been used by traditional attendance systems. Face recognition systems have, however, become a popular way to track attendance, thanks to developments in computer vision and machine learning. The construction of an attendance registration application is the main topic of this research study, which also offers a thorough overview of facial recognition attendance systems. This study seeks to provide light on the benefits, drawbacks, and potential applications of these fast-developing technologies. Face recognition technology may be integrated into attendance systems to increase productivity, accuracy, and user comfort. However, issues like privacy worries and technological constraints must be resolved. With predicted future improvements in machine learning algorithms and hardware capabilities, face recognition attendance systems look to have a bright future. This research article adds to a deeper understanding and successful application of facial recognition technology in attendance systems by examining these features.

articleTitle: Novel Isolated Two Port High Efficient Electrolytic Capacitor Less Led Driver
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Light Emitting Diodes(LED) are more efficient and having more life span. Using electrolytic capacitors in the driver reduces the life time of LED but using film or ceramic capacitor not effect the life time of LED so, eliminating the electrolytic capacitor at the output side of the driver circuit became the major area of research. In this paper, A Novel Isolated Two Port High Efficient Electrolytic Capacitor Less LED Driver is presented. The topology discussed in this paper consist of an isolated flyback DC-DC converter operating under DCM (Discontinuous Conduction Mode) is used to obtain unity power factor at the input side of the diode bridge rectifier.Effective ripple ports are installed at the output side of the LED driver to reduce the amount of storage required there and to employ film capacitors as alternatives to electrolytic capacitors. In this paper, a simple constant voltage controller and an hysteresis controller strategy is used. This combination of flyback converter and ripple port at output of LED driver is 93.9% efficient. The driver’s input side achieves a 0.999 power factor. 3.19% of input current THD.

articleTitle: An approach to Arduino Uno-based smart car parking system
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Since both the population and the number of cars in Bangladesh are growing quickly, a modern parking infrastructure is crucial. Since there aren't enough places for people to park their cars efficiently, more and more drivers are having to leave their cars parked on the road, contributing to congestion and a halt in the flow of traffic. Only approved users are able to park their vehicles in our automated parking, making it a secure and convenient option for car storage. When there is less traffic on the road, there is less pollution from the cars and trucks on that route. There is no possibility of paying a bribe to park a car since the whole system is computerized. Better infrastructure can be built since all the money will go to the government.

articleTitle: Free Verse Figure Of Speech Calculator: An Aid To Poet Style Determination
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Poetry writing and analysis are both qualitative subjects. To get over any possible biases of human perspective it is necessary to map these poetic features on a scale of real numbers. Free verse is a form of poetry that is unrestricted by the requirements of metre and rhyme. This article is focused on free verse compositions viewed through the lens of rhetorical properties or figures of speech. The state-of-the-art model FoSCal cannot handle free verse compositions. On the other hand, FVRCal is a state-of-the-art tool for free verse that computes rhyme (not FoS) on a numerical scale. The proposed tool, FVFoSCal, covers a broader section of alankāra than the state-of-the-art model. It can measure the alankāra score for any free verse composition. The scores generated by the proffered tool form a dataset, FoSSset, which is later used to determinethestyleofthepoetusingsuitablestatistical tests. The statistical analysis performed in this experiment establishes commonality and diversity among the four renowned poets of Hindi literature, namely; Bachchan, Dushyant Kumar, Nirala, and Agyey.

articleTitle: A Reliable Fault Classification Method in the AC Distribution System Based on the Bagged Tree Ensemble Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Many typical faults in the such as LG, LLG, LLLG, and LLL, can distribution system, standard protection relays because the fault impedance is too excessive. Several approaches for overcoming these issues have been described in the literature. Nevertheless, these approaches were incapable of classifying fault types or determining their severity. In this paper, a fault classification prevention approach for AC distribution systems is proposed using Empirical wavelet transform (EWT) and Ensemble classifier techniques. The proposed technique has been tested against various defects such as LG, LLG, LLLG, and LLL situations. The precision is tested on an IEEE 13 bus system.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of PTP in Switched Ethernet Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Most of the developing applications and futuristic applications such as robotic surgeries, advanced driver assistance systems, cloud-based gaming, etc. are developed using switched Ethernet networks and have timing constraints along with reliable data delivery. Precision Time Protocol is a time synchronization protocol that helps to achieve the hard real-time constraints in various applications. PTP will distribute the Time-of-Day information network devices without the requirement of external dedicated hardware for timing distribution. Evaluating the performance of the network device that supports PTP in the Pre-Si stage is very important so that necessary changes to design can be done at early stages. The performance evaluation is done using timing parameters cTE (Constant Time Error) and dTE (Dynamic Time Error), which are obtained using inaccuracies in the network such as Packet Delay variation and asymmetry in design, etc. Based on timing parameters the network device’s performance with the Class C standard defined by International Telecom Unit (ITU) will be evaluated. The timing accuracy requirement for the PTP Class C standard is cTE<10ns, dTE<20ns.

articleTitle: Implementation of Polar Codes Over Multipath Rayleigh Fading Channel Using Channel Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this manuscript we take a look into the implementation of polar codes over Rayleigh fading multipath channels. For this requirement, we use a channel transformation technique, wherein the channel impulse response vector of the multipath channel is used to create a Toeplitz matrix which is then decomposed. The resultant matrices are used to convert the Rayleigh fading channel into an additive white gaussian noise (AWGN) channel. This enables us to use the standard structure of the polar codes designed for AWGN channels, inclusive of the reliability sequence be used for Rayleigh fading channels with any number of taps. Simulation results show bit error rates of the order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> at bit-energy to noise ratio (Eb/N0) in the range of 1.5 to 2 dB.

articleTitle: Recognition of Handwritten Medical Prescription using CNN Bi-LSTM With Lexicon Search
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digital technologies have advanced more rapidly than any innovation in the history of the world. The field of Medicine, however, seems to be lagging behind in this regard. A large number of medical prescriptions around the world are still handwritten on paper. A handwriting detection model for medical prescriptions could digitalize written prescriptions for users in a matter of seconds from a simple picture. Moreover, the problems of ambiguity and confusion in deciphering a doctor's handwriting would be solved. Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) is implemented fundamentally using a combination of Convoluted Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) on the popular IAM dataset of written words. This paper presents multiple improvements to the current approach by introducing real-life written prescription data as the input, as well as tuning hyperparameters for more accurate results. Lexicon Search has been implemented as a decoding algorithm that checks output predictions against a vast database of drug names used in India. This makes the model work better specifically for medical prescription data in comparison to basic models.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a mechanism to identify and defend against ARP spoofing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the most frequently discussed computer security breaches is the Man-In-The-Middle attack(MITM), which is causing significant worry among security professionals. Attackers aim to obtain the data being exchanged between end-points and compromise its integrity and secrecy. In most situations, MITM attacks are primarily based on Address resolution protocol(ARP) poisoning. The primary weakness of ARP lies in its stateless nature. As a result, it is unable to monitor answers to issued queries. In this study, we proposed a novel approach that accomplishes a number of objectives and offers a number of advantages over conventional methods. The objectives of proposed approach are, to strengthen the address resolution protocol so that it becomes a stateful protocol with making a demand depending on the bogus attacker answers received in order to prevent cache poisoning attacks by disregarding the unregister reply and to establish a dependency between the host’s Media Access Control(MAC) and Internet Protocol(IP) addresses. The objective is to protect the LAN setting not just against MITM attacks, but also against comparable forms of hazards. Experiments were carried out by establishing a virtual network in order to test the functionality of the suggested mechanism. Experiment findings suggest that the proposed method can identify and reduce ARP poisoning.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach for Denoising ECG Signal using 4-Tap FIR Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Electrocardiogram signal is used to analyze the electrical activity of heart. The ECG signals can be used to identify some type of heart diseases and cardiac efficiency. During acquisition of the signal, it is contaminated with various types of noises. It is essential to remove noise from the signal for correct diagnosis of heart disorder. Low pass FIR filter is implemented to remove high frequency noise from the ECG signal. To eliminate noise, the signal is passed through 4-Tap direct form-lowpass FIR filter. The coefficients of filter are floating point numbers. Therefore, the filter is designed to accept floating point values to minimize the error. The filter is implemented in Verilog and performance (area, power, delay) of the design is evaluated using Xilinx 14.2. This approach is carried out in the FPGA unit (spartan 3E). Performance of the filter is evaluated using metrics like Mean square error and Signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Intelligent E-Learning Platform: A Fuzzy Logic-Based Adaptive Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study suggests an efficient adaptive online learning system that makes use of a triangular membership function to display the student's conceptual understanding in a selected topic area. The level of understanding for each topic in the field is evaluated using a fuzzy logic system, which also generates feedback based on student performance to address any gaps in comprehension. To assess the learner's conceptual understanding, the system collects data through an initial pre-test before using the learning system, followed by a post-test and a practical exam. The aim of this research is to showcase the enhancement of student performance and comprehension through an innovative and personalized e-learning system.

articleTitle: Evaluating Phase Error of IRNSS using Narrow Correlator
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System with an operational name NavIC is a regional satellite system that provides positioning and timing services in India. IRNSS System consists of receiver responsible for tracking and acquisition of incoming signals from satellite. The Receiver consists of a correlator which is mainly responsible for synchronization and tracking. The Correlator in a Satellite receiver system compares the received signals with previously known reference signals. The PRN codes transmitted by satellites are correlated with the codes that are already present in IRNSS Receiver System. The paper focuses on designing a Narrow correlator which gives better tracking efficiency and accuracy when compared to a Normal Correlator. Normal Correlator has a chip spacing of 1.0 chip whereas a Narrow Correlator has a fractional chip spacing even lesser than 1.0 chip.The efficiency and Accuracy of code tracking loop can be improved by introducing a fractional delay to the input binary sequence. Further decrease in fractional delay can improve the tracking efficiency of IRNSS Receiver by reducing the phase error. The phase error are evaluated for 1.0 chip (Normal Correlator),0.8chip spacing ,0.5 chip spacing,0.4 chip spacing,0.3 chip spacing,0.2 chip spacing and 0.1 chip spacing. The phase error obtained from the above cases are compared and analyzed. It is found that the phase error obtained from a Narrow Correlator of 0.1 chip spacing is lesser than the phase error of a Normal Correlator. Therefore ,a Narrow Correlator of 0.1 chip spacing produces less Tracking Errors and higher accuracy.Correlator model was designed and analyzed for S band frequency with operational frequency of 2492.028MHz.

articleTitle: Verilog Implementation and Functional Verification of Hybrid Cryptography Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: On today’s platforms, on-chip network communication has become important significance. The security of data has become more significant during the transmission of data between the peripherals. There might be a need of some encryption standards to prevent corruption of data. Data Encryption Standard(DES) and Advanced Encryption Standard(AES) are symmetric encryption and decryption algorithms.This work mainly focuses on understanding the working of both the algorithms and to design a hybrid cryptography algorithm by combining the features in both AES and DES algorithms. Dual Coupled Linear Congruential Generator(DCLCG) has been used for key generation process. After performing all the stages of encryption like key generation, substitution, permutation, key expansion, encryption rounds the cipher text is available. The secret key and the encrypted text is given as input for decryption and all the other process are done in reverse order. After the designing is completed, the design is functionally verified using the System Verilog in QuestaSim and achieved the coverage of 83.33%. Then certain parameters like timing, complexity, efficiency and area requirement has been calculated using the Vivado design suite and avalanche effect algorithm. It was found that proposed algorithm takes only 12 ns for encryption but conventional algorithm takes 18 ns. Then the area requirement is 116 LUTs, which has been increased because the keyed permutation takes more area as it has more number of S-Box permutation stages.

articleTitle: Emerging Technologies in the Field of Smart Monitoring Healthcare System with Cardiac Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The genesis and spread of illnesses have become a serious problem in the ever-expanding world of innovation and evolution. Technology-assisted precaution, disease control, and prevention have emerged as the top challenges facing the medical community. Due to our hectic work schedules, it is now hard to keep a healthy routine. The answer to the issues raised earlier is a smart health-monitoring system. The creation of smart and affordable sensors that provide in-person, real-time health screening has been facilitated by the current industry 5.0 and 5G revolution. IoT system integration increased patient confidentiality information integrity and effectiveness to guard against patient data exploitation. The establishment of a smart health monitoring platform model on Bi-LSTM (bidirectional long short-term memory), which uses deep learning to evaluate patient records in order to fulfill numerous goals, has made it possible to provide patients with preventative healthcare and control patient fatalities. This has made it feasible to diagnose chronic conditions early, such as cardiac diseases, which was previously impossible. The study includes a thorough analysis of the health system, as well as recent technological developments and current difficulties.

articleTitle: The Impact of Childhood Trauma on Childrens and Adults Behavior
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Childhood trauma can have a lasting impact on an individual's mental health, leading to conditions such as anxiety, depression, and insomnia.[1] This paper provides an overview of the different types of childhood trauma, their causes and symptoms, and their effects on mental health.[2] It explores various therapies that can be used to treat these conditions, including cognitive therapy, behavioral therapy, cognitive-behavioral therapy, psychodynamic therapy, and trauma-focused therapy. The paper also discusses how family and friends can support those who have experienced childhood trauma. The solutions provided in this paper include therapies, socialization, exercise, and regular medical checkups.[3] Overall, this paper emphasizes the importance of recognizing and treating childhood trauma to improve mental health outcomes.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Remote-Controlled Boat with GPS Navigation for Water Quality Measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study aims to develop a remote-controlled boat with GPS navigation and a sensor system for water quality measurements, to contribute to water quality monitoring efforts. The boat is equipped with sensors that collect data on various aspects of water quality, including pH, EC/TDS temperature, and coordinates. The collected data can be stored and accessed through an interface and transmitted in real time to a central server for analysis. The study successfully met its objectives. The sensor system was designed and implemented, the durability and longevity of the water quality were tested, an interface for data storage and access was created, and a network design for real-time transmission was developed. The study showed that the remote-controlled boat with GPS navigation and sensor system is a valuable tool for water quality monitoring, as it provides accurate and real-time data on different aspects of water quality.

articleTitle: A survey on various Classifier models for Diagnosis of Diabetes from Tongue Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Over the past decade, the diagnosis of diseases based on medical datasets has been carried out using machine learning models and the need for diagnosing at an early stage is always necessary to initiate precautious treatments. The tremendous growth in medical sector has resulted in CT Scans, MRI and thereby the medical image datasets has been attained for the participants. This research study was built to identify the presence of diabetes from the captured tongue image datasets at an earlier stage using suitable machine learning algorithm(ML).

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Dimensionality Reduction Techniques for Datasets using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dimensionality reduction techniques play a crucial role in handling high-dimensional datasets by transforming data into a lower-dimensional space while preserving essential information. Deep learning, a powerful subset of machine learning, has shown remarkable success in various domains. Dimensionality reduction strategies can be used to lessen the complexity between various qualities. With these techniques, a lower-dimensional dataset is created from the dimensions of the initial input dataset. Feature extraction and feature selection are the two primary categories of dimensionality reduction techniques. In contrast to the feature selection method, which selects a subset of features from the original set to create a smaller subset that can be used to build the model, the feature extraction method reduces the high-dimensional dataset to a lower dimension space, that is, a space with fewer characteristics with different values from the original dataset. We've examined a variety of dimensionality reduction techniques, including traditional methods like PCA, LDA and MDS, throughout data processing, to minimize the dimensionality of a sizable and complicated dataset. Additionally, we talked about numerous methods for reducing the dimensionality of data and contrasted them according to different factors. In conclusion, this research provides valuable insights into the effectiveness of dimensionality reduction techniques for high-dimensional datasets. Additionally, we identify potential areas for future research and improvements in the realm of dimensionality reduction.

articleTitle: Design of A Real Time Remote Monitoring and Controlling System Using LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper proposes a Virtual Instrumentation (VI) based graphical user interface (GUI) that is effective for Remote Monitoring and Controlling for small scale electrical infrastructure using LabVIEW. The graphical user interface (GUI) is created utilizing LabVIEW, whereas the hardware is formed through voltage and current sensors, Arduino Uno and relay. Through USB communication, the program and device are interfaced. The monitoring interface utilizes real time measurement data to generate graphs displaying power, current, and voltage. Additionally, it has the capability to store and access a database file for the purpose of analyzing historical data. The control function involves the ability to activate or deactivate the system. Energy management of a building can be monitored and controlled by these GUI and prototype. This user interface can be used to demonstrate how to implement embedded systems projects, communicate through USB, acquire data, and monitor systems like distribution systems for commercial and industrial applications.

articleTitle: Epileptic Seizure Recognition with Wavelet Transform using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A Seizure is a sudden, uncontrollable electrical disturbance in the brain that can cause changes in behaviour, movements, sensation or consciousness. It can be caused by various factors such as epilepsy, head injuries, infections or medication side effects. Seizure detection using machine learning involves developing algorithms that can accurately detect seizures in electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings. This is a challenging task due to the complex and variable nature of seizures, as well as the presence of various artifacts in EEG signals. Machine learning approaches have shown promise in addressing these challenges by leveraging features extracted from EEG signals to classify seizure and non-seizure states. In this approach, the raw dataset will go through a Discrete Wavelet Transform to further sample down the dataset to increase the accuracy of the results acquired by feature extraction. Then, Support Vector Machine Algorithm is used to find the efficiency of the modified dataset as it has one of the highest accuracy with respect to other machine learning algorithms. At last, with the help of Artificial Neural Network, a weighted neural network is formed to help in the real-world applications. Using the single board computers, the weighted neural network can be used in real-time to find out the presence of the seizure in the patients.

articleTitle: Real Time Data-based Demand Side Management Techniques for a Microgrid to Minify the Grid Dependency
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Renewable energy sources (RES) based microgrids (MGs) are the future of the growing electrical industry. Numerous government and private organizations are working in this sector to increase its penetration to the conventional electrical system. But this expanding industry is hindered by its intermittent nature and expensive cost of storage. To make MG based electrical industry sector more sustainable and promising, a technique, demand side management (DSM) is integrated with the system. This paper proposes the development of two DSM based techniques i.e., non-essential load shifting technique (NELST) and direct load shifting technique (DLST) to maximize the solar photovoltaic (PV) usage and to minimize the operational cost of the MG. These techniques were analyzed with the real time data collected from the installed MG at BITS Pilani, Pilani campus, India and it was found that there was a significant decrement in grid import (GI) and grid export (GE). It was observed from the results that there was a significant increase in the solar PV utilization and significant decrease in the operational cost of the MG.

articleTitle: Design of PIFA for 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A design for a compact PIFA dongle with 5G support has been presented in this paper, along with its simulation results for various metrics. The antenna has been designed using Ansys HFSS software, and operates at 3.37 GHz, across a bandwidth of 735 MHz. It's 5G-compatible as it supports the n77 (3.3 to 4.2 GHz) and n78 (3.3 to 3.8 GHz). The antenna has a peak gain of 2.65 dB and shows a Return Loss of -35.03 dB at its operating frequency of 3.37GHz. Various characteristics such as return loss, surface current distribution and radiation pattern have been observed by simulating the antenna and have been presented in this paper, along with methods to improve PIFA's performance in parameters such as bandwidth and gain.

articleTitle: Implementable Smart FIR Management
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the current scenario, the Indian policing system handles around 3 million cases per year involving a variety of interstate and personal issues. This paper aims to present an implementable and feasible First Information Report (FIR) management system with regard to the hierarchy and workings of the Indian policing system using blockchain technology. This will help to improve security, transparency, and information and intelligence sharing in the policing network. This blockchain network will allow users to file the report and officers to review it and take action. The aim here is to improve and evolve the efficiency of the policing system by demonstrating a Hyperledger Fabric network that is able to handle multiple organisations and networks, along with the usage of private data transaction facilities for critical cases like prosecutrix, child abuse, etc., in accordance with the policing structure of India. We will use the minifabric to demonstrate and evaluate the network with built-in tools like Hyperledger Explorer and Hyperledger Caliper.

articleTitle: Detection of Explicit Lyrics in Hindi Music Using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Music can significantly impact a child’s development, but the increasing amount of sexual and violent content in song lyrics has raised concerns. Despite efforts to filter explicit content, the existing systems often fall short, requiring significant time and effort. Recent advances in neural network and machine learning technology had sparked interest in using these tools to detect explicit lyrics more effectively and thus an explicit lyrics detection system is developed to filter out explicit songs. This study proposes the use of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks for detecting explicit lyrics in song lyrics. The proposed LSTM model takes advantage of its ability to process and remember sequential data, making it an ideal candidate for this task. The dataset used in this study is a collection of song lyrics that have been labeled as explicit or clean by human annotators. The model was trained and tested using this dataset and achieved a high accuracy rate of 81.6%. The proposed model can be used as a tool for content filtering in music streaming services or for parental controls on devices used by children.

articleTitle: Exposing a False Source of News on Social Media by using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fake news, or information that seemed false with the intention of misleading the public, has been all too common in recent years. By fostering political polarization and scepticism towards the government, the dissemination of this kind of information harms societal cohesion. Human validation has become impossible due to the massive amount of news being shared on social media, leading to the development and organization of automated methods for spotting false information. To increase the appeal of their publications, fake news publishers employ a number of stylistic strategies, one of which is stirring up reader’s emotions. Our proposed methodology for exposing false news by performing feature selection method of Ensemble Bagging Classifier (EBAC), and Ensemble Boosting Classifier (EBOC), Multi-Kernel SVM(MKSVM), to experiment and choose the best fit features to obtain the sensitivity, specificity, Kappa Score, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC).

articleTitle: Analysis of various Classification Techniques using CNN models for the Detection of Alzheimer’s Disease using MRI images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a brain disorder that is associated with memory loss and is typically observed in elderly and aging individuals. This condition is irreversible in nature. Neural networks have shown better performance than traditional machine learning algorithms when it comes to analyzing high-dimensional data from Magnetic Resonance Images (MRI) brain images. This is an approach for processing such data. Detection of Alzheimer’s disease is essential because the early treatment can control the progression of the disease in a slower pace. In this work, the proposed model used different models of convolutional neural networks (CNN) techniques to process the MRI images of the brain and classified them into different classes. The proposed model detects AD using neural network feature extraction and classification methods based on the pre-processed datasets. Here, in the proposed model, various algorithms such as Resnet-50, DenseNet-169 and Hyperparameter tuning of Convolutional Neural Network are utilized to find the better performing model in terms of accuracy when compared with other traditional techniques.

articleTitle: Empowering the Future: An In-Depth Investigation of Computer Science Graduate Employability Cognitive Factors
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study investigates the cognitive factors influencing computer science graduates' employability through a two-phase approach, involving data collection from 562 students and exploratory factor analysis (EFA) of 30 variables. Sample adequacy was confirmed, and principal component analysis (PCA) revealed six factors accounting for 78.925% of total variance. Varimax rotation identified the factors as: 1) problem-solving and decision-making skills, 2) knowledge of contemporary issues, 3) competence in specific engineering disciplines, 4) knowledge of science and engineering principles, 5) competency, and 6) engineering system approach. High internal consistency was found for each factor. The results offer valuable insights for educational institutions and employers to enhance skill and knowledge development in computer science graduates.

articleTitle: Sequential Computational Time-Released Encryption Technique Using Variable Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Time-released encryption (TRE) is a cryptographic technique that enables encrypted data to be automatically decrypted or made accessible after a certain period of time. The receiver is usually made known the decryption time or release time of the encrypted text. TRE uses a time delay between encryption and decryption to provide an additional layer of security. TRE produces a higher level of security when combined with other cryptographic algorithms. In this paper, the process of encryption and decryption of plain text is performed with the help of the Sequential computation technique of the TRE algorithm along with sender-induced time delay. An additional layer of security is also added by combining the TRE algorithm with two traditional algorithms i.e; RSA and RSA-OAEP to provide security for the data. Both methods are compared and the results are shown accordingly.

articleTitle: Circularly Polarized Wideband Aperture Antenna for Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The present research work is a design of Circularly Polarized Wideband Aperture Antenna for Wireless Communication. The proposed antenna is a microstrip line fed aperture coupled antenna and is operates at Ka-band. The radiating patch is excited by the energy delivered by microstrip feed through aperture slot. It is analyzed through HFSS software at frequency band 26.5-32 GHz. Right hand circular polarization (RHCP) is achieved (AR ≤ 3 dB) 12.92 % at 27.36-31.14 GHz. The return loss band width (RL ≤ -10 dB) is obtained 12.72 % at 27.97-31.77 GHz. The overall gain is given by this antenna is 6.40 dBi at 29.25 GHz.

articleTitle: Graph Based Image Segmentation by Dinic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In Computer Vision objects are represented by images and analyzing labeling segmenting them is important for processing them. To solve this need image segmentation comes into the picture. There are numerous approaches to implementing image segmentation deep learning, graph-based, threshold-based, etc. Each has its pros and cons and is suited for the particular use case. In this paper, we will be looking at the graph-based approach which is an advanced one and fairly new in digital image processing.As of now, we have a lot of a number of methods present that can extract the required foreground from the background.But, most of these methods are solely based on the boundary or regional information which has limited the segmentation result. Thus graph cut based approaches have been proposed which has obtained a lot of popularity because it utilizes both boundary and regional information. Furthermore, graph cut based method is efficient and accepted throughout the world since it can achieve the globally optimal result for the energy function.Graph-based image segmentation approaches itself has implementation based upon the algorithm used like Ford Fulkerson, Edmond Karp, Dinic Algorithm, etc. We will be focusing on Dinic here as it is the fastest and most efficient among its peers and there is hardly any literature shedding light on it. We will look into comparative analysis, algorithm, and how it can be applied to image segmentation problems.

articleTitle: Smart Helmet for Coal Mine Worker Safety through Live Data Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Increasing worker safety is an imperative concern given the multitude directly involved in mining, the large financing and operating costs of mining projects, the uncertainty of various mining outcomes, and the perilous nature of mining conditions. The mine worker position detection system which is a unit of this smart helmet is used to detect the position of the worker in which tunnel/mine lane he is working in. When it comes to dangerous working conditions in deep mines, a real-time and instantaneous monitoring and warning system is essential to boost safety. If a worker gets stuck in a tunnel, then this detection system detects the worker using an RF signal and Wi-Fi. The sensors are attached to the worker's helmet. As the worker moves through the tunnel, sensors on the helmet detect flammable gas (LPG) and send a signal to the exit station via Wi-Fi. It is connected to the external control room in a tunnel via Wi-Fi. For our demo project, we are using Arduino as the controller, and an Ethernet shield is used to connect the system via Wi-Fi. The position of the worker is determined by the tunnel map. Each tunnel is Wi-Fi enabled by a repeater to increase network range. The gas and temperature sensor sends a signal to the control room, so the control room gets an alert and the status of each tunnel. Each helmet has an emergency button so that the worker presses the button and dispatch immediately receives help for the worker.

articleTitle: BeautyShop Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: E-commerce will make up 20.4% of global retail sales by 2023.A promising future for online commerce is offered by India’s rising Internet user population. With the exponential growth of e-commerce and the abundance of products available online, consumers often face the challenge of choosing the right products that meet their specific needs and preferences. Online shopping recommendation systems have emerged as powerful tools to address this issue by providing personalized product recommendations based on user data and preferences.For the purpose of recommendation there are various techniques namely Collaborative filtering, Content-based filtering, Matrix Factorization, Association rule, Hybrid Recommender System, Demographic Filtering, Context Aware filtering, Deep-learning based recommender system, Popularity based filtering, Sequential recommendation etc. To recommend a right product to the user the preferred algorithm is Apriori. The Presented Recommendation system generates recommendation using python, flask framework and MySQL as backend. Client’s happiness is positively impacted by the features of the product recommendation system, thus it’s important to meet client demands based on a survey that prioritizes quality.

articleTitle: A Web-Based Chatbot for Indian Cities: A Comparison of CNN, ANN, and LSTM Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Digital transformation is necessary to bring an inclusive opportunity for technology and society to meet the needs brought by both environment, circumstances, and events. In this work, we explore the capability of Generative AI in the societal context of smart city resource management with a particular focus on tourist service management. This work attempts to collaborate many services and resources as an information service to cater to the needs of smart city tourism. We demonstrated the potential of AI in achieving this collaborative information service dissemination with the help of an AI-enabled chatbot Web-application. We also discuss the technical elements required for the real-time information management that we envision for future smart city tourism initiatives. Our experimentation shows that LSTM outperforms CNN and ANN in performance.

articleTitle: Predictive Selective Repeat - an Optimized Selective Repeat for Noisy Channels
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Automatic Repeat reQuest (ARQ) is a technique used in two-way communication systems to make sure that the transmitted data is received properly without any errors. The underlying mechanism on which ARQ operates is the acknowledgment (ACK) sent by the receiver to the sender on the orderly arrival of data frames. Some protocols which have been employed include Stop and Wait ARQ, Go-Back-N ARQ, and Selective Repeat ARQ. There have been many attempts to optimize these protocols to decrease the number of Round-Trips and increase the throughput. Predictive Selective Repeat (PSR) ARQ is the technique introduced in this paper to send multiple copies of frames without waiting for ACK. The main goal of PSR ARQ model is to optimally predict the number of required copies for a particular frame so as to reduce the number of Round-Trips by using a Time series Forecasting Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model.

articleTitle: An Innovative Two-way Recommender System for Students and Teachers
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A recommender system utilizes the user's preferences or past behavior as criteria to filter the dataset and generate predictions. The Innovative Two-way Recommender System for Students and Teachers, a novel approach, is specifically designed to cater to the needs of users by offering personalized predictions aligned with their preferences. Traditional recommender systems recommend items from one end like movies recommendation, food recommendations, etc. This research focuses on how a "Two-way" recommendation can be realized efficiently in some social spheres like student-teacher platforms. There is a difficulty with the one-way recommender system that applies the K-Means clustering algorithm on both sides of the student-teacher platform. In this research, a method for solving this issue is proposed by applying the K-Means clustering algorithm just once; however, in a novel way. Additionally, the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm is applied, and the quality of clustering is compared in terms of Mojo Distance.

articleTitle: Development of UVM Testbench for I3C protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The rapid evolution of semiconductor technologies and the increasing complexity of SoC’s have necessitated the use of robust and efficient design verification methodologies. Universal Verification Methodology (UVM),based on Systemverilog is a widely adopted standard for functional verification of the Register Transfer Level(RTL) design in the semiconductor industry.The Automotive,IoT and the Mobile SoC’s require many sensors to be integrated into the processor core.In this regard,the I3C (Improved Inter-Integrated Circuit) protocol developed by the MIPI Alliance,which combines the capabilities of SPI (Serial Peripheral Interface) and I2C (Inter-Integrated Circuit), is gaining popularity in various applications due to its enhanced features and capabilities like increasing speed, reducing pin count.The main objective of this paper is to develop a reusable and efficient UVM testbench for verification of MIPI I3C-based designs.The development process entails creating a comprehensive UVM testbench with protocol-specific sequences, transactions, and coverage models tailored to the MIPI I3C protocol.

articleTitle: DWT and SVM Approach based Incipient Fault Detection Methods for Underground Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a supervised machine-learning technique for incipient fault identification in an underground cable. The nature of the incipient fault is aberrant so it is required to classify incipient faults from non incipient faults. The simulation work has been carried out in the PSCAD platform and several cases such as incipient fault, non incipient faults like switching transients are simulated. The wavelet-based technique is used for feature extraction. Both balanced as well as unbalanced datasets have been tested with several Support vector machine techniques, where fine support vector machine outperforms others.

articleTitle: Design of a Metamaterial Integrated Dual-Band Antenna for S-Band and C-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work presents a metamaterial (MTM) integrated dual-band antenna. A closed ring resonator (CRR) and an I-shaped metamaterial cell make up the dual-band antenna. The outer CRR attains the 4.02 GHz C-band (4-8 GHz) resonance, which has a bandwidth of 1.89 GHz from 3.58 GHz to 5.47 GHz. The I-shaped MTM cell shows negative permittivity, negative permeability, and negative refractive index from 2.1 to 2.98 GHz. The MTM cell is responsible for the resonance frequency of 3.198 GHz with a bandwidth of 27 MHz in the 3.173 GHz to 3.2 GHz region. The antenna has a percentage bandwidth of 10.9% for the S-band (2-4 GHz) and 47.01% for the C-band, respectively. The antenna has a size of 25×25×0.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The suggested antenna has gains of 2.1785 dBi and 3.637 dBi at the low and high resonance frequencies respectively. An omnidirectional radiation pattern is achieved also. Therefore, the suggested antenna may be a good fit for S-band and C-band applications.

articleTitle: A Centralized LGBM based Attack Detection and Mitigation Approach for Software Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Software Defined Networking is one of the most emerging technologies in the field of network architecture due to Its capability to centrally observe all the network-related activities happening in the network. On one side, where SDN is getting popularity, the attacks are consistently increasing day by day. In the current work, a centralized approach to detect and mitigate the attack in the controller of SDN has been proposed. For this, a dataset created in the controller of SDN has been used to train some well-known tree-based classifiers namely XGB, RF, ET, LGBM, and GB. They have been evaluated under 8 metrics, namely execution time, recall, FAR, accuracy, F1, precision, CKC, and AUC-ROC where LGBM is found outperforming other classifiers under all the metrics, so it deployed in the controller to detect and mitigate the attacks. The values given by LGBM for accuracy, precision, recall, and f1 are more than 99%. For FAR, CKC, and AUC its value is 0.5%, 98.54%, and 0.995, respectively.

articleTitle: Improving Intrusion Detection in Internet of Things Networks with Feed-Forward Neural Networks Based on the UNSW-NB15 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The research presented here proposes a new technique for identifying malicious activity in IoT networks by analyzing data from the UNSW-NB15 dataset. The considered approach uses a feed-forward neural network to detect malicious behaviour. One input layer, two hidden layers, and one output layer make up the feed-forward neural network's design. The hidden layers are used to detect malicious actions, whereas the input layer contains characteristics taken from the dataset. The output layer gives the verdict on the categorization. After testing, it was determined that the under consideration method achieved an accuracy of around 0.88 during attacks and around 1.0 during regular data sampling. According to the results, the proposed method is able to accurately detect malicious activity within IoT networks. The proposed technique provides a reliable and efficient approach for detecting malicious behaviors within IoT networks. In addition, the proposed method may be easily included into existing IoT infrastructures.

articleTitle: Development of Noise Robust Automatic Speech Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent times, automatic speech recognition (ASR) has seen many developments, but background noise persists to be one of its major hurdles. When speech corrupted with background noise, also termed as noisy speech, is the input for an automatic speech recognition (ASR), the predicted text is not indicative of the actual words spoken, implying a low accuracy. This paper proposes a deep neural network (DNN) based noise robust ASR system which overcomes this problem by employing a non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) based speech enhancement model prior to speech recognition. The aim is to provide enhanced speech as input to the ASR model since speech enhancement improves the intelligibility of noisy speech by eliminating the background noise. The proposed ASR system is evaluated with speech corrupted with distinct noises, namely airport, babble, street and white noises. The proposed model has been shown to improve the accuracy of the predicted text in noisy environments, thereby minimizing the word error rate (WER) of the ASR system. The proposed model is noise robust in the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range [-15,5] dB.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Driven Threshold Optimization for Wavelet Packet Denoising in EEG-Based Mental State Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The accurate classification of mental states from electroencephalography (EEG) data using machine learning (ML) techniques is a developing area of research. However, the presence of noise and artifacts in EEG signals poses a significant challenge to achieving accurate results. In recent years, Wavelet Transform (WT) has emerged as an effective method for denoising and analyzing non-stationary biosignal data, such as EEG. This study focuses on using Wavelet Packet Decomposition (WPD), an extension of Wavelet Transform (WT), for denoising EEG signals and evaluates its effect on classification accuracy of mental states during music listening versus no-music stimulus. In WPD-based denoising, the optimal choice of threshold level is crucial for balancing signal retention and noise reduction. EEG classification performance also depends on the choice of feature sets used to train classification models. Statistical, covariance, entropy, and wavelet-based features were extracted from EEG signals denoised at various threshold levels using WPD. We empirically evaluate the effects of different threshold levels on the classification performance of EEG feature sets using k-Nearest Neighbours (kNN) classifier. Our findings show that the choice of denoising parameters and feature sets are interlinked, and by optimally choosing a feature set and corresponding EEG signal denoising threshold, maximal classification performance can be achieved. Using covariance features, aggressive signal denoising, and the kNN Classifier, maximal classification accuracy is achieved.

articleTitle: Colour Detection Using HSV and RGB Colour Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a colour detection application that utilises a deep learning model to predict the name of a colour based on its HSV value. The use of the HSV values rather than the RGB values makes for a more intuitive representation of colours. The application supports two modes of operation, real-time mode and static mode, which cater to the needs of visually impaired individuals and content designers in the varying scenarios that they may find themselves in. This paper presents a design that leverages the advantages of deep learning and the stability of the HSV colour scheme to provide a model with good accuracy in detecting colours and labelling them accordingly. The application’s integration with the Flutter Framework and Firebase database provides a scalable and robust platform for both managing the gathered data and collecting more relevant data for the improving the model further.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Power, Temperature and Hardware Utilization on Implementation of 4:16 Decoder
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Numerous developing countries are currently experiencing severe energy shortages. Environmentally aware communication has evolved thanks to the research and creation of an energy-efficient 4:16 decoder using the Vivado software framework and a number of FPGA families. Three distinct FPGA families, Genesys, Kintex, and Virtex, each with seven series, have been constructed in quest of the most power-efficient FPGA series. The power levels used by the Genesys, Kintex, and Virtex families are 1.20-Watt, 1.252 Watt, and 4.181 Watt, respectively. Comparing Genesys, Kintex, and Virtex temperatures, which are 57.9° C, 72.4° C, and 73.4° C, respectively. As instructed, the power dissipation can be decreased by using the Genesys 7 series of components rather of the other two families. Genesys’ energy efficiency is equivalent to that of other FPGA families. This method conserves energy for the future. Genesys board is also less expensive than others.

articleTitle: FuSeR: Fusion of wearables data for StrEss Recognition using explainable artificial intelligence models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wearables such as smartwatches have become increasingly popular and have many applications such as health monitoring and chronic disease management. As wearables are becoming more widely available and affordable, so personal data that these devices provide also increases. Additionally, many biological signal sensors are integrated into wearables and can be used for collecting personalised physiological data. Following data collection, classification techniques can aid in analysing the data insights. In this study, the effectiveness of a stress recognition approach using wearables’ physiological data fusion was evaluated. Specifically, four data level fusion methods (Fusion 2, 3, 4 and 5), consisting of two, three, four and five physiological modalities have been used. Different combinations from electrocardiogram (ECG), electrodermal activity (EDA), electromyography (EMG), accelerometer (Acc.), temperature (Temp.) and respiration (Resp.) signals have been considered for each fusion method to recognize stress. Extra gradient boost (XGBoost), light gradient boost (LGBoost) and CatBoost machine learning methods along with explainable artificial method (XAI) are implemented to classify stress. WESAD dataset is used for training and testing the models. Performance metrics for Fusion 1 (two physiological modalities), 2 (three physiological modalities), 3 (four physiological modalities) and 4 (five physiological modalities) are evaluated. Overall, the accuracy of the stress recognition model increases with increase in modalities. Fusion 4 consisting of five modalities provided the best performance with an accuracy from 95% to 99%. XAI explains more influence of EDA modality among other modalities on the model accuracy. The proposed stress recognition model with fusion of wearables data using XAI efficiently detects stress and contributes to mental health monitoring.

articleTitle: Artist-Specific Analysis of Spotify using BI Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Spotify is one of the world’s largest music audio streaming and media service provider with over 489 million monthly active users, including 205 million paying subscribers as of December 2022. The music from various artists around the globe can be found on Spotify where songs from these artists compete daily in order to top the charts. In this paper, we present an analysis of the music charts using many features that describe a song such as acousticness, danceability, etc., and present artist-specific suggestions that can help the artists know the genre of the songs that is most popular among the listeners and therefore, produce songs accordingly and hence help the artists gain popularity among the audience.

articleTitle: Synchronization likelihood based functional connectivity investigations on participants with autism spectrum disorder
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The term autism spectrum disorder is frequently used to describe a wide range of conditions that affect how the brain develops. Electroencephalography is now the procedure that is most frequently used to look for biomarkers of autism (EEG). EEG recordings often offer a vast quantity of data with dynamic properties. In this study, alpha waves in the frontal lobes of relaxed healthy, and autistic participants are investigated. The raw EEG data is first pre-processed utilizing several techniques, such as normalization, filtering, and re-referencing. The disturbed connectivity theory has drawn a lot of research as a probable pathophysiological underpinning for autism spectrum disorders (ASD). According to this hypothesis, difficulties with the approach the brain synchronizes and organizes activity across multiple regions may account for the clinical symptoms of ASD. To understand the neural synchronization using the parameter synchronization likelihood, this study employed electroencephalography recorded from participants when they were relaxed and performed a functional connectivity-based analysis on the preprocessed EEG signals. Using a dataset supported by the King Abdulaziz Hospital in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, the suggested technique produced encouraging results in testing.

articleTitle: Deepfake Detection Using Custom Densenet
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Deepfake detection has grown to be an increasingly important research area due to the potential harm that deepfakes can cause to individuals and society. In recent years, deep learning techniques have shown promising results for detecting deepfake images and videos. In this research, we provide a deep learning-based strategy using Custom DenseNet for deepfake image detection. This model used a big dataset of actual and deepfake photos to train a convolutional neural network (CNN) using the Custom DenseNet architecture. The Custom DenseNet architecture is a deep residual network that has shown excellent performance in various computer vision tasks. To categorize images as real or fake, the CNN is trained using a binary cross-entropy loss function. To evaluate the approach, we used several performance indicators including F1-score, recall, accuracy, and precision. We also contrasted our strategy with other cutting-edge deepfake detection techniques. Our test results demonstrate that our solution employing Custom DenseNet surpasses existing deepfake detection techniques in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. We achieved an accuracy of 97%, a precision of 95%, and an F1- score of 75%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in detecting deepfake images. Overall, our study shows that deep learning techniques, specifically the Custom DenseNet architecture, can be highly effective in detecting deepfake images.

articleTitle: Heart Diseases Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Heart disease is a major global health problem, and early is critical to improve patient outcomes. In this study, we look at how machine learning algorithms can be used to predict cardiac disease. To classify the presence or absence of cardiac disease, we use a dataset containing several patient variables and many famous machine learningalgorithms. Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbours, Support Vector Machines, Naive Bayes, Decision Tree Classifier, Gradient Boosting Classifier, and MLP Classifier are among the models investigated. The characteristics needed to train and evaluate the models are extracted after preprocessing the dataset. To examine the prediction capabilities, we use accuracy scores and confusion matrices to evaluate the performance of each model. We hope to find the most effective machine learning model for predicting cardiac disease through experimentation and analysis. Our findings show that machine learning algorithms have the capacity to effectively forecast cardiac disease. The results show that [name the best-performing model] accurately classifies patients with heart disease. The model’s effectiveness is bolstered further by the accompanying confusion matrix, which provides insights into classification errors and identifies opportunities for development. The successful implementation of machine learning models for heart disease prediction could help to develop efficient diagnostic tools and help healthcare practitioners make educated decisions. The incorporation of these models into clinical practise has the potential to improve patient care and lower the burden of heart disease on individuals and healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Design of Arithmetic Logic Unit Using Hybrid Power Reduction Methodologies For Super Computer Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Arithmetic logic unit (ALU) is used to perform mathematical and bitwise operation on integers that are combined in digital circuit used for supercomputing applications. Energy consumption has become a particularly critical issue as a result of the Internet of Things (IoT) device technology's quick development. The full adder circuits are used in the ALU structure mainly affects its power, area, and delay. In existing approach, the ALU circuits are implemented using fully swing gate diffuse input logic. In this article, the design of an ALU using hybrid VLSI methodologies has been proposed. Using the Cadence Virtuoso tool, the proposed and existing ALU is designed and tested on 180 nm CMOS technology. The proposed design and other circuit topologies that are mentioned in the literature will be contrasted in terms of delay efficiency, power reduction, and other assessment metrics showing circuit performances. Based on the results obtained the proposed design has better PDP without any performance degradation.

articleTitle: Design a Gated PMOS Spillage Reduction Approach for CMOS SRAM Cell in 90nm Technology Node
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The proposed circuit has several objectives, the most important of which is to increase speed while simultaneously reducing power consumption. We will use a number of techniques on the 6T SRAM cell in order to accomplish this objective. The objective is to reduce the amount of power that is wasted as a result of leakage while maintaining the same level of functionality that the cell now has. "Static random access memory" (SRAM) is a form of RAM that does not require regular data refreshment. This type of RAM is denoted by the acronym "SRAM." SRAM cells have been processed in various ways, all to reduce the amount of power lost due to leakage while maintaining their operational capabilities. Read, write, and hold are the three distinct modes of operation that are suggested by this investigation's gated PMOS 6T SRAM cell. The proposed design seeks to achieve some important objectives, the most important of which are to reduce leakage current in standby mode, increase stability in active mode, and retain the logic state when the hold mode is activated.

articleTitle: Alzheimer Staging and Detection User Interface using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Early detection and diagnosis are essential for controlling Alzheimer's disease because they enable effective therapies and long-term planning. Continuing endeavors are being made to gain deeper insights into the fundamental causes of the illness and to create improved therapeutic approaches. When the disease progresses, the person diagnosed would have trouble remembering recent events. At present, there is no known remedy for Alzheimer's disease. This work focuses on creating a user interface in the form of a mobile application for early detection and staging of Alzheimer's. This work contributes as an aid for both the diagnosed individual and the carer of the diagnosed. This work involves two phases in which the first phase involves the phycological questions and an audio recording which enhances the accuracy of the work. The detection phase employed a feedforward neural network with multiple inputs and a single output. This phase additionally requests the user under test to record their voice based on a reference audio. The correlation of the two audio files plays a significant role in the detection of the disease. The second phase is the staging in which the image of the brain scan is to be clicked and uploaded and the stage of the Alzheimer is detected if present. This staging phase of the disease is achieved by employing a convolutional neural network. This network was integrated to the user interface using a Tensor Flow Lite model, thus resulting in a high accuracy staging of the disease.

articleTitle: Design of PID Controller for Fourth-Order Quadratic Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research article presents the modeling and design of a fourth-order quadratic boost converter (FOQBC) utilizing the state-space averaging (SSA) technique employing reduced order modelling. In FOQBC, the voltage conversion ratio is directly proportional to the square of the duty cycle. The FOQBC is one of the promising option for DC-DC converter applications such as fast charging devices, micro-electro-mechanical systems, electronic gadgets, photovoltaic systems, piezoelectric crystals, etc., that demand a substantial step-up voltage. The utilization of a QBC ensures minimal phase behavior due to the exclusion of zeros of right-half plane. This characteristic simplifies the design of controller for the converter system. In this work, proportional-integral-derivative control design, specifically for FOQBC is proposed by incorporating reduced order modelling. The obtained results, with and without the controller are supported by responses and tabular comparative analysis for FOQBC proposed model and control design.

articleTitle: PikFresh - Fruit Quality Detection using ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fruit quality detection has started becoming an increasing concern for inexperienced individuals. Upcoming generations struggle the most when it comes to buying fruit in the market of idle quality, as they lack the experience required to purchase something that is fresh. This novel system aims to ease the process of analysing the quality of fruit. This paper focuses on the transfer learning algorithm ResNet50, integrated with the React Native framework, to build a complete end-to-end solution. A customised dataset was created for certain fruits.
