In this research, the primary aim is to assess the efficacy of utilizing the maximal information coefficient (MIC) as a means to identify and diagnose Alzheimer's disease (AD) in its early stages. The study utilizes neuropsychological tests and data from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to investigate the relation between the MIC coefficients and the progression of AD. The results of the study suggest that MIC coefficient can be a reliable measure for detecting the beginning phases of AD. This discovery might open up a new path for the creation of diagnostic tools that can detect early-onset AD more accurately, which could ultimately lead to earlier interventions and improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Stress Detection Through Single Channel Real-Time EEG Signal from Temporal Lobe Using Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a prompt method for brain signal recording with good temporal resolution, being comparatively cheaper and portable. Stress detection to help facilitate psychological analysis will increase its certainty and accelerate it. The aim of the research is to validate a real-time dataset built with the objective of simplicity and instantaneous detection of stress through recording of EEG signal. In light of that, a dataset was built using only a single channel device of 200 Hz sampling frequency and recording from temporal lobe (T3 and T5) was taken for a short time (30-50 seconds). The EEG data was pre-processed using a bandpass filter and used as a whole to extract features. As FFT is not able to comprehend the non-stationary nature of the data, FFT along with Power Spectral Density (PSD) as features acquires an accuracy of 72.7%. A better feature to properly incorporate the non-stationary characteristics of EEG data, Wavelet Transform was used to acquire an accuracy of 86.96% in Random Forest machine learning classifier. Finally, an accuracy of 97.7% is achieved by incorporating all three features at a time in Random Forest classifier.

articleTitle: A Zigbee Based Cost-Effective Home Monitoring System Using WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: WSNs are vital in a variety of applications, including environmental monitoring, industrial process control, and healthcare. WSNs are a network of spatially scattered and dedicated sensors that monitor and record the physical conditions of the environment.Significant obstacles to WSN efficiency include the restricted power and processing capabilities of individual sensor nodes and the issues with remote and inaccessible deployment sites. By maximising power utilisation, enhancing network effectiveness, and ensuring adaptability and durability through dispersed and decentralised operation, this study suggests a comprehensive approach to dealing with these challenges. The suggested methodology involves data compression, aggregation, and energy-efficient protocol. Using these techniques, WSN life-times can be increased and overall performance can be improved. In this study we also provide methods to collect data generated by several nodes in the WSN and store it in a remote cloud such that it can be processed and analyzed whenever it is required.

articleTitle: Cutting-edge Analysis of Sweet Potato Leaf Diseases: Leveraging Federated Learning and CNNs for Severity Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study proposes a unique method for categorizing and estimating the severity of illnesses that affect sweet potato leaves using federated learning and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The work is especially noteworthy since it may apply to agricultural situations where data privacy is crucial. The federated learning model demonstrated great precision, recall, F1-Score, and accuracy across five severity levels of sweet potato leaf diseases for four customers in the local results analysis. For example, Client 1 had 98% accuracy across all severity levels, and such patterns were seen in other customers. By averaging the local client data, aggregated performance measures for examining worldwide outcomes were produced. With an average precision of 94.96%, a recall of 94.52%, an F1-Score of 94.61%, and an accuracy of 98% across all customers, these measures showed the model's strong performance. This outcome confirms that the federated learning strategy was successfully implemented to maintain good performance across several clients. Finally, average metrics such as Macro, Weighted, and Micro averages were used to examine the overall data. For example, the Weighted average recall was 94.91%, the micro-average accuracy was 93.91%, and the macro-average precision was 94.60%. These averages demonstrate the model's accuracy, precision, and suitability for use in real-world agricultural contexts, regardless of the distribution of classes. The study's findings support federated learning in the agriculture industry by providing a scalable, precise, and privacy-protecting system for categorizing the severity of sweet potato leaf diseases. It offers a potential direction for ongoing study and real-world applications in intelligent farming, enhancing crop health and productivity.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis on Brain Stroke Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Brain Stroke is a disorder that occurs when brain's blood vessels become clogged, resulting brain to be destructed. When there is insufficient blood flow to the brain, it could be a potential cause of stroke. Timely recognition of diverse warning indications of stroke can aid in lessening the intensity of stroke. Well timed detection of stroke indicators can be a life rescuer. Machine Learning now a days is a prevalent strategy that can be used competently in this domain for preliminary detection of stroke inflicting signs. This paper compares and contrasts various machine Learning algorithms namely Random Forest Classifier(RF), Logistic Regression(LR), Support Vector Machine(SVM), K-Nearest Neighbor(KNN), Decision Tree(DT), XGBoost Classifier(XGB) and Naive Bayes(NB). XGB algorithm turned to be the best, attaining an accuracy charge of about 95.38%

articleTitle: Ocular Disease Recognition using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Ocular conditions may result in permanent eyesight loss. A proper diagnosis given early on can save someone’s vision because some symptoms manifest as soon as necessary. Since the human eye is susceptible to error, an automatic and exact method is required for this operation. The project’s goal is to develop a classical that can recognize an eye ailment from fundus photos. Iris recognition systems are among the most precise biometric technologies and have a huge potential for use in global security applications. This study investigated the impact of ocular pathology on iris recognition, specifically if ocular disease could lead to the failure of iris recognition systems. A prospective cohort of 54 patients with anterior segment eye illness who were seen at the acute referral unit of the Princess Alexandra Eye Pavilion in Edinburgh participated in the study. Before starting therapy and again at follow-up appointments after it had been administered, patients provided iris camera photos.The primary outcome metric was the mathematical difference between the iris recognition templates taken from patients' eyes before and after the eye condition therapy. Results revealed that the iris recognition templates taken from patients' eyes before and after the eye illness therapy differ mathematically. Results revealed that iris recognition performance was impressively resistant to most ocular illness states, including conjunctivitis, corneal oedema, and iridotomies (iris laser punctures). However, some patients with acute iris inflammation (iritis/anterior uveitis) experienced issues. The results demonstrate that Random Forest provides better prediction accuracy in less time than other ML approaches. The consequences of an individual having anterior uveitis could render obsolete the current recognition technologies. Iris recognition is a crucial biometric technology, so those who are creating and using it should be aware of any potential issues that could arise.

articleTitle: A Conceptual UAV based Resource Allocation Framework for Next-Generation Heterogeneous V2V Communication Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The current V2V communication architecture presents a significant challenge in achieving seamless and reliable connectivity for vehicular communication. This paper proposes a novel adaptive resource allocation scheme for drones to support QoS in V2X. By leveraging the strengths of this technology, this approach aims to enhance the connectivity and coverage of V2V communication, especially in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) scenarios or out of coverage zone. The use of UAV in the V2V communication system provides a viable solution for addressing coverage gaps and signal degradation caused by obstacles or distance. This paper provides a conceptual framework of the proposed architecture and discusses the potential benefits associated with this approach. Simulation results show that the proposed approach significantly improves the reliability and performance of V2V communication, demonstrating its potential as a promising solution for the next-generation V2V communication architecture.

articleTitle: A Construction of Three Party Post Quantum Secure Authenticated Key Exchange for Mobile Users
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A three-party authenticated key exchange protocol enables two entities to agree on a session key with the help of a dedicated server through an insecure channel. Lattice based cryptography plays a very important role in authentication and key exchanges that protects against the threat of quantum attacks. However, it is not easy to design quantum resistant password based three-party protocol due to the high demand for security requirements and the limited resources nature of mobile devices. In this article, we have proposed a new post quantum three party key exchange based on a variant of lattice assumption, the ring learning errors. The protocol ensures security against impersonation attack, stolen smartcard attack, password guessing attack, and other existing attacks. In authentication phase, the protocol have used lattice based cryptography that plays a very important role in authentication and key exchanges that protects against the threat of quantum attacks. The proposed protocol ensures both securities against quantum attacks and efficiency due to simple algebraic operations that are polynomial addition and multiplications.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cryptocurrencies have become a major element in enterprises and financial market showing promising potential during the past ten years. Predictions that are accurate can help cryptocurrencies investors to make the best decisions and possibly enhance their earnings. For this work 4 cryptocurrencies namely Bitcoin, Binance Coin, Ethereum and Tether (USDT) are considered. The considered dataset is for around 5 years, which has a total of 9 columns, One Date Column ranging from year 2017 to 2022 and for each of the Coin there is the Closing price and the Volume. The Dataset is collected from Kaggle. Attempts are made to build the models in various ways, by dealing with certain features or by taking a subset of the dataset. All the models, according to the way the dataset was dealt were evaluated based on certain evaluation metrics like R-squared, mean square error and root mean square error. The models used are KNN, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost and CatBoost. Visualized and understood how the prices of those cryptocurrencies were impacted by other features of the dataset. The models that outperformed are Random Forest and CatBoost. Achieved RMSE was 365, 2.99, 29.99 and 0.0023 for Bitcoin, Binance, Ethereum and USDT respectively.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Covid Vaccine Tweet with Vader, and Implementation of Different Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, referred to as opinion mining, is a natural language processing (NLP) technique that indicates a document's emotional tone. Since Covid-19 epidemic, there has been a lot of talk on social media and news sites about the necessity for a COVID-19 vaccine. However, the general public has expressed their concerns of vaccines security and efficacy on social media websites like Twitter. Using the Twitter API, these tweets are gathered from Twitter. For this research, we are using the Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK) for analyzing opinions expressed in tweets associated to covid vaccine utilizing the vocabulary- and rule-based sentiment analysis tool VADER (Valence Aware Dictionary for Sentiment Reasoning), which has been specially designed to analyze sentiments from social media. The dataset is converted into TF-IDF vectorization and the model was trained using different classifiers. We compared different ML applications and got our highest accuracy with Linear SVC with L1-based feature selection.

articleTitle: An Analysis on various Machine Learning Algorithms (AI) & Nature Inspired Algorithms for modern Inventory Management
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The following article refers to importance of AI and Machine Learning methods in handing inventory in an optimized manner. In the era of online shopping or retail shopping: stock managing, supply handling, items on hold, holding charges, return on Investment etc. affects the profitability and existence of the entire channel of demand and supply. AI plays a major role in managing this with less or minimum human intervention and applying intelligence to maximize profit and make decision making strong. Here in this paper, we have reviewed few sets of algorithms that are AI based or Nature inspired and their contribution in this area of Inventory management which have proved their importance. Businesses can assess and manage their inventory levels, estimate demand, spot abnormalities, and automate repetitive operations with the help of AI based techniques like machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. With the growth in the business, decision making using these algorithms can ease the very need of industry today. Many huge platforms like Amazon, Oracle and many others have shown the importance of implementing these methods for Inventory Handling and Management.

Author Keywords: Applied AI techniques in Supply Chains

articleTitle: Enhancing Performance of Deep Learning Models with a Novel Data Augmentation Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Data augmentation is a popular deep learning strategy for increasing the size of the training set and improving the generalisation capacity of deep learning models, particularly in computer vision problems. This paper provides an overview of popular data augmentation techniques used in deep learning models (like CNNs), such as rotation, flipping, cropping, scaling, neural style transfer, grayscale and adding noise to the input images. We propose a new data augmentation technique which involves four sequential steps: rescaling, rotating, flipping, and converting to grayscale to enhance the performance of CNNs further. Using a dataset with numerous parameters, we show that the suggested strategy outperforms state-of-the-art data augmentation methods. The accuracy of the model trained using the suggested technique was 93.33%, representing a 3.33% improvement over the accuracy of the model built using typical data augmentation techniques.

articleTitle: Enhancement of PAPR Reduction Performance of Modified SLM technique using Moth Flame Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: PAPR is a major problem in OFDM systems, despite of many advantages of OFDM technology. Numerous methods have been proposed to minimize the PAPR, from basic low complex clipping techniques to high complex tone reservation techniques. Selective mapping technique has also been proven to be one of the best and robust techniques for PAPR reduction. In this paper, modified SLM using phase sequence vectors has been implemented and applied for different baseband modulated signals. Also, further enhancement in the PAPR reduction performance of modified SLM has been achieved by introducing Moth Flame optimization algorithm to achieve optimal results. From the results, the optimal modified SLM performance is proven to be better than modified SLM under various cases such as using different number of subcarriers and different baseband modulated data.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Learning-Based DDoS Attack Detection Considering the Impact of ICA
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks can cause considerable financial harm and operational concerns in the internet business era. Detecting such attacks necessitates overcoming two challenges: distinguishing normal packets from attack packets and consistently and effectively identifying distinct attack categories. As a result, an ideal detection system should be simple, reliable, and effective, with low false alarm rates. The goal of this paper is to give an analysis of machine learning (ML) methods for the detection of DDoS attacks using Ensemble Learning with and without implementing Independent Component Analysis (ICA). It improves the feature extraction, source separation, noise reduction, and data pre-processing, resulting in better performance and insights. The KDD-99 dataset is used to train and test ML models, using Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Decision Trees, K-Nearest Neighbors, and Gaussian Naive Bayes. They are used to extract data while categorizing the different types of input features during the training. The performance of the proposed mechanism is analyzed with and without the use of ICA. Results show that the DDoS attack is most successfully detected using the Random Forest classifier with an accuracy of 99.9670%. Moreover, ICA improves the performance of all ML models when compared to unsupervised learning techniques.

articleTitle: An Approach for Identifying and Detecting Manholes to Assist Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: According to the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), open manholes and ditches in India result in at least two fatalities per day. The likelihood that blind people would trip over the manhole, be hurt, or experience other negative outcomes rose. Therefore, early detection or identification of manholes is crucial to avoiding the challenging situation that blind people may encounter. In this work, an image processing method is applied for real-time implementation using FPGA to recognize manholes and pits. The edge detection approach is used to detect manholes with visible brightness. Since manhole designs are often circular, it is imperative to detect and recognize these shapes for precise estimation. The MATLAB and FPGA platforms are used to accomplish the accuracy comparison.

articleTitle: System Complexity Reduction Using 3-D Matrices and Novel Logic Gates
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the modern era, we all want to accelerate the speed of data processing network. Due to the acceleration of speed, complexity of circuits is also increasing. So to reduce the complexity of the design Circuit 3-D dimensions matrix are one of the most novel technologies. Technology for which digital intricacy and computer system design must be reduced. In the proposed work, the Bit-Vector-Matrix (BVM) and Peer-Logic-Gate (PLG) signifiers are demonstrated. The Peer Logic symbols are used to make a concurrent design for digital system and computer system during the design of Peer Logic Gate symbol whenever the Peer Logic Gate symbol changes accordingly, their Bit Vector Matrix and Matrix of elements are also modified.

articleTitle: Design of Hexagonal Wideband Microstrip Patch Antenna for MIMO Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this work, a four-port MIMO structure has been proposed to achieve improved isolation and operate in the ultra/super-wideband (UWB) frequency range. The projected designs comprise hexagonal rings embedded with UWB hexagonal units with a partial ground plane defect. The alteration of the hexagonal patch and ground planes modifies the current flow and yields in realizing a wider fractional bandwidth. The triple-band notches are created on conventional hexagonal geometry using rings. The proposed unit cell is centrosymmetric geometry and it resonates from 2.62 − 20.64 GHz with fractional bandwidth of 155%. The proposed four-port MIMO configuration has physical dimensions of 0.86λ × 0.86λ × 0.017λ and it resonates from 2.70 − 20.70 GHz with fractional bandwidth of 153.85%. The distinctive feature of a unit cell and MIMO geometry is incorporating a simple effective ground defect structure to generate the isolation of 18 dB over the resonating spectrum. Further, the MIMO diversity characteristics have been performed and achieved good performance which indicates the proposed geometry is appropriate for wideband communication systems.

articleTitle: A Mobile Application for Plant Disease Classification using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Mobile applications have now become the most efficient and direct way to deliver information to the user. Agriculture requires mobile applications that can identify plant diseases from pictures of a plant’s leaves. A model with fewer parameters is taken into consideration while implementing this from the existing models. A mobile application built on the Mobilenetv2 architecture is created to categorise plant diseases from leaf photos. The plant village dataset, a publicly accessible dataset that includes photos of both healthy and diseased plant leaves from crops grown all over the world, is taken into consideration for training a model. There are 54,305 samples of fourteen crops over 38 groups in the collection. Of these, 10,849 samples are considered for testing and the remaining 43,456 samples are used for training and validation. The proposed model has a 92.45% accuracy rate. The model has been implemented as a mobile application that will detect plant disease. This application will be an easy way for the farmers to detect the diseases and get a remedy at the earliest.

articleTitle: Secure Watermarking Algorithm for Enhancing Invisibility and Robustness of Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In contemporary times, within a society that is highly advanced in terms of technology, all data is gathered and archived in a digital format. In the realm of medicine, diagnostic data is also captured and transmitted in a digital format. The paramount considerations when transmitting information through digital means are security and authenticity. Watermarking is a technological approach that guarantees the credibility and genuineness of clinical images, patient data, and diagnostic data.The present study introduces a secure watermarking algorithm that enhances both invisibility and robustness simultaneously. The transform domain scheme is utilized as a primary step to ascertain the suitable coefficient for embedding data. In order to provide a fair balance between robustness and invisibility, this research provides a secure watermarking method using hybrid transformation. Multiple attacks are also included to show the robustness of the images.

articleTitle: An Ameliorated Methodology for Water Supply and Management Using Binary Trees
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Water supply system is an infrastructure for collection, storage, transmission, and distribution of water to homes, factories, irrigation of agricultural fields, etc. Water holds an important factor in growth of the city. Earlier, lakes and rivers are the major source of water supply to the cities and villages. The rivers followed their own path throughout the city and provided water to some specific areas. Due to this the new areas which were being developed would not have direct connection to the new areas, the people would have to look for other alternatives or use the water available from the underground water beds, by building wells. Water connection to different regions is setup in an organized manner. Even though everything is organized, but there are certain drawbacks such as improper detection in the leakage of pipe lines and failure in the proper use of technology to setup and organize.In this paper, an attempt has been made to rectify these problems by applying the concept of binary search tree. Also, we have discussed about how pipelines can be setup underground in a smooth manner and using IOT devices to detect leakages or breakages in the pipelines, so that the water is not wasted.

articleTitle: Evaluating Bert and GPT-2 Models for Personalised Linkedin Post Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Social networking platforms have become essential tools for individuals and organisations to connect, communicate, and collaborate in today’s digital age. LinkedIn is a professional social networking platform facilitating career development and job searching. LinkedIn’s traditional post recommendation system limits users to seeing only those posts that have been engaged upon by their following or first-degree connections, limiting the user’s perspective. The proposed system leverages the content posted by the user to provide personalised content delivery on LinkedIn, potentially enhancing user engagement and satisfaction. This research study proposes and examines the performance of three content-based recommender models developed with Machine Learning (ML), Generative Pre-Trained Transformer (GPT-2), and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT). In terms of capturing the similarity between user-generated and recommended posts, BERT outperformed the other models, achieving the highest similarity score of 97.13%, compared to GPT-2 (96.27%) and basic ML (95.69%).

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a VGG based Deep Learning Model for Classification of Weeds and Crops
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: VGG19 is a deep convolutional neural network designed for image classification tasks and has attained cutting-edge performance on a number of benchmark datasets. However, adding additional fully connected dense layers can improve the model with additional capacity to learn more complex representations of the input data. The proposed modification involves adding two completely coupled dense layers, after the last convolutional layer, each with a SoftMax activation function. The first dense layer has 512 neurons, while the second dense layer has 256 neurons. After the two dense layers, a layer of dropouts is added with a rate of 0.5 to minimize overfitting. The proposed modification to the VGG19 architecture has shown improved performance on crop and weed classification tasks, achieving higher accuracy than the original VGG19 model. The added layers provide additional capacity to the model, allowing it to learn more complex representations of the input data, while the dropout layer helps to prevent overfitting and improve generalization. Accuracy of modified VGG architecture is about 96% while that of the existing CNN architecture is about 88%. Hence the proposed model using the modified VGG architecture obtained 8% higher accuracy than the existing CNN model and standard VGG model.

articleTitle: A Virtual Reality based Mind Game-Comparative Study of VR Ray Interactor and Hand Tracking for Improving Attention & Elevating Mind
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Innovative applications in cognitive training in the improvement of mental health have become possible because of the rapid breakthroughs in virtual reality (VR) technology and our growing understanding of the human brain. The goal of this research is to create an immersive VR environment that involves people in a game that demands their attention while also grabbing their interest. The suggested mind game uses interactive components to encourage prolonged attention and cognitive engagement, such as visual stimuli, hand tracking, and difficult tasks. As they move around a virtual environment, users come across a variety of stimuli that demand their concentrated attention and prompt decision-making. Pilot research was carried out with a group of participants to assess the efficiency of the VR-based mind game. Assessments were given before and after the intervention to track improvements in attention performance. To quantitatively understand the improvement of attention, the attention levels recorded by the NeuroSky equipment were compared. Participants showed improvement in cognitive engagement and attention levels while playing the VR-based mind game and hence had a positive effect on improving attention. The comfort of the participants in the game while using a hand-tracking feature and VR ray interactor was investigated. Hand tracking is more effective for boosting attention and promoting engagement.

articleTitle: Textural Analysis for Breast Cancer from Feature Dataset using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In practically every area of life, deep learning algorithms have accelerated the development of new technology. As a result, its application is also used in the field of medical imaging. One of the worst illnesses in the contemporary era can be treated earlier by creating a tool that detects breast cancer through textural analysis utilizing neural network-based deep learning. The automation of the textural analysis for the identification of malignant tumors is ensured by using CNN. The dataset utilized for the Deep Learning Model's comprehensive training is made available to the public by the University of Wisconsin and contains 569 occurrences

articleTitle: A Hybrid Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approach for Remote Sensing Scene Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents an alternative approach for the classification of remote sensing scene images using a combination of deep learning and classical machine learning techniques. The suggested model employs the EfficientNet architecture to extract features from remote sensing images, which are then enhanced through the use of three attention mechanisms - Channel, Spatial, and Local Relation Attention. Next, the feature vectors are reduced in dimensionality using principal component analysis (PCA) and support vector machine (SVM) is utilized for classification. To optimize the performance of the model, a grid search algorithm is used to find the best possible hyperparameters. The trained model is evaluated using metrics such as Macro F1 score and accuracy on a test dataset. The proposed model shows promising results and can be used for classification of image data of remote sensing in various applications. The efficacy of the presented approach is assessed on four datasets, UC Merced, EuroSAT, MLRSNet, and RSI-CB256

articleTitle: Secured Authentication System for Product Verification: Integrating Blockchain and Secure Data Management
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Counterfeit items are a serious hazard to consumers and businesses, resulting in financial losses, brand reputation harm, and severe health and safety issues. In answer to this issue, we provide a revolutionary counterfeit detection system based on blockchain technology. Our project combines Kotlin, Android, Hyperledger Fabric, and FirebaseDB to create an Android app that enables users to authenticate items via barcodes, QR codes, and serial numbers. Users receive immediate feedback on the legitimacy of the goods after scanning or inputting the product details into our app. This data is collected from a blockchain-based logging system that securely records and monitors each product’s status changes. We secure the immutability and transparency of the logged data by employing blockchain technology, prohibiting unauthorized duplicates or changes of product information. Our project’s implementation addresses the shortcomings of existing anti-counterfeiting techniques by offering a user-friendly and efficient means for customers to check the authenticity of their acquired items. Furthermore, the incorporation of Hyper-ledger Fabric, a permissioned blockchain platform, improves the system’s security and privacy. Our research emphasizes the benefits of using Kotlin and Android development for mobile-based verification systems, as well as the potential of blockchain technology in combatting counterfeit items. Our project’s results demonstrate the efficacy and feasibility of the suggested solution, presenting a potential method for protecting consumers and companies from the hazards connected with counterfeit items.

articleTitle: Mobile Application based Sign Language System for Hearing and Speech Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The primary obstacle faced by individuals who have hearing or speech impairments when interacting with others is communication. Successful communication necessitates the participation of all participants. Learning sign language isn’t easy, and developing and practicing conversation skills takes time. This imposes a problem for the hearing and speech impaired people for communicating with others. Hence, this project aims to create a mobile app that facilitates bi-directional communication among individuals with hearing and speech disabilities. There are two phases in the project – (i) Sign language to text conversion and (ii) Audio to sign language conversion. During the process of converting sign language to text, a camera is used to capture an image of the sign language input. From these images, the characters are predicted by the neural network and the corresponding text is displayed. For the audio to sign language phase, the audio is taken from the microphone and given to the google speech API. The speech is converted into text format. The text output is compared with the data given in the database that contains Graphics Interchange Format (GIF) files and the particular text in GIF. The sign language to text and audio to sign language are both interfaced in the app. The app can perform both the case based on the requirement of the people.

articleTitle: SUTRA : Methodology and Sign-off
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: VLSI technology is specifically tailored to meet the requirements of contemporary electronic devices and systems. Although the ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit) flow methodology offers numerous benefits, it also entails certain drawbacks that companies must consider. Therefore, it is crucial for organizations to carefully assess the advantages and disadvantages to determine the methodology's suitability for their specific project requirements. In light of the persistent drive for miniaturization, improved performance, reliability, and expanded functionality in the electronics industry, VLSI technology is poised to lead the way in driving future innovations. This progress necessitates the development of a methodology that is simpler, easily comprehensible, and adaptable to efficiently implement the desired designs. To address these needs, a simplified and automated methodology has been developed to target any RTL (register-transfer level) design for a specific technology while adhering to the desired constraints. This methodology comprises a streamlined flow for synthesis and physical design within the ASIC flow, along with an automated technique for implementing it. Furthermore, timing sign-off is performed to verify that the design meets the required timing specifications and functions correctly. Detailed reports summarizing the results are generated in HTML format for easy accessibility and convenience. By employing this methodology, any RTL design can be processed as input, leading to the generation of a routed layout as the output. This approach simplifies the design process, enhances automation, and facilitates the achievement of desired design goals in a more efficient manner.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of AI Based Efficient Emotion Detection and Music Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent times, with the development and operation of big data, deep learning has taken more and more attention. As deep learning neural network, a convolutional neural network plays an extremely important part in face image recognition. In this paper, a combination of expression recognition technology of an convolutional neural network and automatic music recommendation algorithm is developed to identify a model that recognizes facial expressions and recommends music according to corresponding mood. The facial expression recognition model established in this paper uses FER2013 with a recognition rate of 62.1. After relating the matching expression, a content- grounded music recommendation algorithm is used to prize the point vector of the song and a cosine similarity algorithm is used to make the music recommendation. This exploration helps to ameliorate the practicality of the music recommendation system, and the affiliated results will also serve as a reference for the operation of the music recommendation system in areas similar as emotion parameter.

articleTitle: Security Identity: An Audio-Video Biometric Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Audio-Video biometrics finds applicability in various sectors such as banking, network security, and e-commerce. Secure audio biometric authentication refers to a system that can verify a person's identity using their unique voice characteristics. Incorporating visual information can complement audio information, by verifying the person's face and hence improve the system's accuracy. The paper aims at developing an audio-video biometric authentication system, capable of overcoming the challenges such as audio replay attacks and audio forgery attacks. A CNN-based facial recognition system as well as a MoE-based audio recognition system is implemented in this work. The combined system achieved an accuracy of 85% in identifying the user based on the audio and video inputs. An app is also developed to serve as a front-end for the classifiers in order to facilitate practical interfacing.

articleTitle: SVM-based regression for forecasting building power energy consumption using smart meter data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Traditional physical modelling and mathematical computation are unfeasible due to the complexity and nonlinearities of the modern power system. Artificial intelligence and predictive machine learning techniques allow for efficient system modelling and analysis. As a result of its technical as well as economic significance, load forecasting is a crucial component of electrical power networks. Energy management and sustainability studies both benefit greatly from energy consumption predictions. Additionally, efficient energy allocation can be achieved through accurate energy forecasting. In this article, two different machine learning algorithms have been applied for load forecasting on a load dataset from a publicly available household dataset in the UCI machine learning repository. The above two models are utilized to create a predictive model for electricity consumption as an output. The simulation results of the Support Vector Machine (SVM) based forecasting model give the best results when compared with the real data. The validation results indicate that it has the lowest Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) value of 95 and is twice as accurate as tree-based regression, respectively. Approximately 63% of the data is used for training, and the remaining 37% is used for testing. This predictive model can facilitate power companies’ resource management decisions.

articleTitle: Thermal Imaging Based Quality Assessment of Pomegranate
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Thermal imaging can be used for primary examination of fruit grade. Invisible radiation patterns of any object are converted into visible images and these images are called thermal images. Various thermal image camera are available in the market and their purpose varies depending on the application. In the study presented in this paper, thermal images were taken using the FLUKE Ti32 IR fusion technology camera, which contains temperature information of fruit from the various angles. By studying heat distribution over the damaged area, quality of fruit can be categorised and decision can be taken for its acceptance or rejection. For this study 47 number of images are captured in different angles . Texture features are extracted using Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM). This paper reviews about primary inspection for fruit grading on the basis of the thermal features like temperature and texture features and classification accuracy at various epochs. These results are also compared with RGB dataset and found RGB gives 88.8% accuracy which better than thermal dataset.

articleTitle: Multimodal Healthcare Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Understanding where viral proteins are inside of cells is important for studying how viruses work and making effective medicines. Where we set up shop within a host cell is tough to forecast. In order to predict where viral proteins would end up in the cell, a computer algorithm was used in this investigation. In this architecture, a deep learning network and several local attention modules (called MuLA) work together to improve protein feature retrieval. Several deep learning models (LSTM and CNN) and machine learning classifiers (AdaBoost, Decision Trees, and KNN) were compared to the MuLA to illustrate its superior performance. When applied to the PAAC descriptor, the MuLA model outperforms MLCs, LSTMs, and CNNs in terms of accuracy (93.66%), specificity (99.21%), and sensitivity (89.81%). In addition, our performance was significantly superior to that of the previously mentioned deep learning and machine learning models for a variety of classifications.

articleTitle: Design Analysis of Inductor less LNA with Noise Cancellation Technique for Ultra Wide Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The proposed circuit of LNA has been implemented for a frequency band of 3GHz to 14 GHz cover a ultra wide band range. The purpose LNA consist of two stage one is current reuse stage and second one is common source stage. Current reuse stage is used for low power dissipation in which a NMOS and PMOS transistor are connected in cascode. Henceforth share common biasing current while second stage common source is connected in cascade to improve the gain of proposed LNA .A digital to analog circuit is used a body terminal to control the gain of proposed LNA. . Proposed LNA is simulated In 90-nm CMOS technology in cadence virtuoso for a frequency range of 3.0 GHz to 14.0 GHz. At 4.3GHz, the suggested LNA obtained a peak power gain (S21) of 17.8dB and -24.4 dB S11. The suggested LNA has a bandwidth of 3.9GHz -7.8GHz, -9.9dBm IIP3 and a minimum Noise Figure of 5.4dB. The suggested Low Noise Amplifier has a power consumption of 1.8mW. and a supply voltage of 1.2Volt.

articleTitle: Agriculture Chatbot(AGRIBOT)Using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Agri-bot is a text-to-text chatbot which will help the farmers in answering the queries posed by them, in text form. Through text-to-text communication, farmers can interact with the chatbot to obtain information on various aspects of agriculture, such as weather updates, crop management practices, pest and disease control, and market prices for agricultural products. The chatbot uses different Natural Processing Techniques like lemmatization and tokenization and it is trained using sequential Model. The text-to-text chatbot is made in English which shows the accuracy 80% and Hinglish which shows the accuracy 85%. The use of an agriculture chatbot can improve farmers' productivity, reduce costs, and increase their access to information, particularly in areas where internet access is limited.

articleTitle: Implementation of Efficient Restoring and Long Division Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The basic elements of an electronic system are arithmetic operations. Arithmetic operations are the building block of any electronic application and algorithm is a sequence of instructions used to carry out calculations or solve problems. Division implementation has received less attention than the other arithmetic operations, despite the fact that addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division are essential components of arithmetic implementation in the electronic system. If we divide two integers using the procedure, a quotient as well as a remainder is produced. Implementing division operations is quite difficult; in this case, a sophisticated technique is used for implementation success. A successful system must have good division circuit performance. In this research work, the Restoring division and long division algorithm Class are implemented for nsigned integers with data sizes of 8-bit, 16-bit, 32 bit and 64-bit using Verilog HDL language. Three registers named A, Q and M are used for the computation in both the algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Two-Step Security System for Cargo Vehicles Theft Prevention and Real-time Monitoring through IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Logistic transportation is the backbone of the supply chain. An uninterrupted transportation of any goods keeps the supply chain well balanced and thus helps the business as well as the economy. But in this current world, the transportation of goods is being harmed in many ways. One of those is theft, where the driver is also involved or not, but the thief steals the goods with or without breaking the seal. Both the supplying company and the client are affected by this. To reduce the problem, we are proposing a two-step security system. So that even if one system is deactivated somehow, the other system can be alerted, and necessary steps can be taken accordingly. By doing so, we can maintain a constant connection with the vehicle. Through this proposed project, the outer door seal of the cargo vehicle can be locked or unlocked, and the server can observe in real time whether any items inside are being stolen without opening the door. The security of logistics supply vehicles through the proposed paper will be more robust and beneficial to both the transport service provider and the service taker.

articleTitle: A CNN Ensemble Approach to Provide Non-combat and Support Roles Training Deaf and Dumb Individuals using Hand Signs
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Appointing deaf and dumb individuals in military services is very challenging, as it is very difficult process to provide them training. Machine learning model is a useful tool for providing effective non-combat and support roles training to deaf and dumb individuals through hand signs interpreters. We have developed a CNN Ensemble approach to recognize and classify various hand signs used in during training sessions. This can help interpreters to quickly and accurately interpret the commands given by military trainers, making training more efficient and effective. We have made a comprehensive dataset for this research purpose. We have designed this dataset for 35 common commands used by military trainers during training. For each of command class we have taken 160 images. So our dataset consists of total 5600 images. To design our final model, we have proposed two Convolutional Neural Networks model. Then we have imported VGG19 using TensorFlow and Keras libraries. We have applied these three models on our dataset. To get better performance we have also applied Voting Ensemble model on these three models. We have also combined these three models to make an Average CNN model and applied several classifier models such as SVM, RF, KNN and DT on that model. As we have noticed, Voting Ensemble model performed better than all these models with highest accuracy 94.20%. We believe that our proposed models will bring a great impact in defence sector.

articleTitle: Minimization of data centers in survivable dynamic SDM-EONs
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Energy consumption due to massive use of data center (DC) is increasing rapidly. The need to improve the energy efficiency of such DC aims to develop an effective DC-placement algorithm. Again, a sudden disaster in the network can affect both fiber path as well as the DC nodes resulting in fiber cuts and huge data loss. Space division multiplexing-based elastic optical network (SDM-EON), being more efficient than the traditional elastic optical network (EON) due to the inclusion of multiple cores in a single fiber link, tries to maximize the utilization of resources by reducing blocking probability. This paper presents a novel DC-placement algorithm in dynamic DC-based SDM-EONs which focuses on enhancing energy efficiency in the network, thereby ensuring the survivability of the network against any sudden disaster. Rigorous simulation analysis proves the efficacy of the proposed algorithm over other existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Jelly-Roll Pressure Sensor based Improved Cuckoo Search Particle Filtering Strategy for Predicting Remaining Useful life of Lithium Iron Phosphate Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries are core power source for hybrid and battery operated EVs. High perfection in state of charge and state of health of batteries related to safety and sustainable manufacturing and design of Electric vehicles. In this paper, change in internal pressure was introduced in improved cuckoo search and particle filter algorithm, to determine the remaining useful life of batteries. Here, a viable physical method was developed to examine the remaining useful life of LFP batteries by real time monitoring the change in jelly roll pressure for single charge-discharge cycle. The printed sensor was integrated in batteries jelly roll of batteries monitor the change in pressure due to reversible volume expansion during charging-discharging of LFP batteries. The capacity degradation model was developed by using exponential growth model and improved cuckoo search particle filter model to evaluate effect of pressure in estimation of remaining useful life of batteries. Finally, the parameters of capacity degradation model were optimized by an improved cuckoo search algorithm to improve the accuracy for the predicting the remaining useful life. This estimation methodology using internal pressure data (jelly roll) gives higher precision than reported prior articles or methodologies.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Approach to Smart Door Locking System based on Real Time Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A wireless remote-control lock system is used for pedestrian entrances to both homes and businesses. To engage and disengage a door latch component, this locking mechanism is powered by electricity and consists of a striker plate assembly with a movable striker plate element A radio frequency receiver and a circuit that responds to signals from an operator-controlled radio emitter power the striker assembly. The striker assembly has the ability to unlock the door either temporarily or permanently. The circuit in the control unit is made up of a self-latching relay, a selection switch, and a second relay. The door will stay open for up to 3.5 seconds, or until the emitter transmits a new signal to the receiver. Because everyone is accustomed to using physical keys to lock and unlock doors, this is the most natural and prevalent method. The physical key is a well-known and dependable mechanism, but it has limitations. It is impossible to have multiple distinct keys for the same lock. Several of the locks work with multiple key types.

articleTitle: Emotion Detection and Suicidal Intention Prediction of Differently Depressed Individuals Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Facial expressions play an important role in conveying emotions, especially in human-machine interaction. Automatic facial expression recognition (FER) systems have numerous potential applications, such as detecting mental disorders, understanding human behavior, and generating synthetic human expressions. However, achieving high recognition rates remains a challenging task. In the literature, two popular approaches for automatic FER are based on geometry and appearance. The FER process typically consists of four stages, namely pre-processing, face detection, feature extraction, and expression classification. In our project, we utilized various deep learning techniques, specifically convolutional neural networks, to detect seven essential human emotions: anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, and neutrality. Furthermore, our aim was to predict suicidal tendencies based on the detected emotions since depression is the primary cause of suicide. Detecting emotions in depressed individuals could facilitate their monitoring and help prevent suicide risk by forecasting the rate of suicidal intentions based on their emotional state.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Based Poisonous Frog Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Frog species across the world are vulnerable and in decline, despite the fact that frogs are an integral part of biological systems. Within this enchanting world, we encounter two intriguing groups: non-poisonous and poisonous frogs. This phenomenon prompts the development of an automated computer vision-based frog detection system that can distinguish between deadly and non-poisonous frogs, leading to the development of early treatment methods and a reduction in relative economic loss. In this study, we present a convolutional neural network-based technique for frog detection. The CNN model required numerous epochs to run in order to provide the best result. However, we must also consider the trade-off in convergence speed. In our exploration, we conducted experiments with different epochs. Interestingly, our findings revealed that running the model for 30 epochs yielded the highest accuracy, reaching an impressive 90.83%. Through rigorous and thorough experimentation, we evaluated confusion metrics and discovered that they yielded exceptional results.

articleTitle: Peri- and Intra-Tumoral Radiomic Signatures to Distinguish Benign and Malignant Tumors in Breast Ultrasound Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The alarmingly low survival rate of breast carcinomas at later stages has been a matter of great concern for the human clan in general. It has been seen that diagnosis of such tumors at initial stages can play a vital role in decreasing the mortality rate of the person. Here, the role of in-silico diagnostic models are immense as it can help the radiologists largely by acting as a second reader. This paper proposes an automated AI based pipeline to differentiate between benign and malignant lesions in sonomammograms using Radiomic signatures. In this analysis, a total of 647 (437 benign and 210 malignant) breast ultrasound images have been obtained from the Breast Ultrasound Image (BUSI) Database. Here ultrasound based radiomic features have been extracted from the tumor as well as the peritumor region to detect the malignancy status of the subjects. After subsequent feature reduction, the discriminative capability of the features has been analysed using several classifiers like SVM, Random Forest, Logistic Regression and XGBoost. Classification results show that using SVM(polynomial) as classifier, accuracy and Area Under Curve (AUC) of 0.90 and 0.96 were obtained when the features were considered along the peritumoral region whereas accuracy and AUC of 0.96 and 0.99 were obtained when the features were considered along the tumoral region. Hence, the radiomic features from the peritumoral region can also play an indispensable role to differentiate between the lesions and capture the tissue heterogeneity in the vicinity of the primary tumor.

articleTitle: Grading of Diabetic Retinopathy using iterative Attentional Feature Fusion (iAFF)
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of blindness in people suffering from Diabetes Mellitus. The biggest challenge with the detection of DR is that it is very difficult for ophthalmologists to detect it early, and it is irreversible. To tackle this problem, deep learning methods have been used to automate the detection and help ophthalmologists. In this paper, iterative attentional feature fusion (iAFF) has been used. iAFF is an attention model which gives more importance to the features, which will help in grading the disease better and creating a better model. It works in an ensemble model with modified InceptionV3 and Xception to give better results than the pre-existing models. The proposed model gives an accuracy of 73% on the IDRiD data set.

articleTitle: MVT: Using Mixup in Vision Transformers for Enhanced Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Using large deep neural networks for image classification can be very effective, but it has some negative effects such as memorization and vulnerability to "adversarial examples". To tackle such issues we propose to apply mixup [4] in various parts of attention space of vision transformer [1] architecture. Mixup is a data augmentation technique which involves training a neural network on pairs of examples and their associated labels with pre defined weights associated to each input. By doing so, the network is encouraged to behave simply linearly between training instances, thereby acting as a form of regularization. While previous work on mixup has focused on the image domain, we introduce it here in the context of the encoder blocks of the vision transformer and explore its impact on classification accuracy across different datasets.

articleTitle: Wikipedia for the Blind- a Voice Command Based Screen Reader for Efficient Navigation within Wikipedia
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s world, the relevance of content available over the internet has increased manifold. This has led to more dependency on the internet and its utilities. For the visually impaired people, viewing information over the web is complex and they resort to conventional screen readers. In this paper, we describe an application "Wikipedia for the Blind" which is a Wikipedia reader having customized features to allow efficient navigation within the various sections of the Wikipedia page, among various hyperlinks available on the page, prioritization of these hyperlinks, and access to the summary of every topic, section, and subsection within the topic. This tool provides unhindered and comfortable learning to the blind with an easy to use and responsive user interface.

articleTitle: Deep-GlaucomaNet: A Deep Learning based Approach for Glaucoma Detection in Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Glaucoma is a chronic eye disease that is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss worldwide. Early and accurate classification of glaucoma is crucial for timely intervention and effective management. In this study, we propose a novel glaucoma classification model named as Deep-GlaucomaNet based on advanced deep learning techniques to achieve high accuracy and reliability. Here, the GoogLeNet model has been employed as a base model. The last four layers of the GoogLeNet were replaced with the customized 15 layers. The augmentation technique has been applied for avoiding overfitting is-sues. The performance of the model is evaluated with two activation functions ReLU and Swish. The proposed model earns better classification accuracy 94.39% on the G1020 dataset and represents its perfection over other existing models.

articleTitle: Revolutionary Baby Care Solution: Enhanced Cradle with Advanced Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, taking care of a baby has become more important and harder for working moms. Working moms won’t have enough time to keep an eye on their kids all the time, even at home. Parents either send their kids to live with their grandparents or give the job of taking care of the child to someone else. In the suggested work, a system was made for a smart crib that automatically checks on the baby. The baby tracking device checked the baby’s temperature, heart rate, quantity of gas molecules, position, and how it moved. The S.ODI board is used to connect the sensors and motors. The baby tracking system is hooked up to the cot so that the baby can have something similar to an incubator. The baby tracking device is always keeping an eye on the baby. The baby’s temperature, heart rate, and moisture levels will be shown on the smartphone app’s baby bed display. The system will monitor the baby’s vital signs and respond appropriately, such as by adjusting the temperature, activating or disabling the fan, repositioning the cradle, or playing soothing music, if any anomalies are detected. If the readings seem off, the caretaker and the parents will get an alert. The Baby’s posture and mobility may be tracked using Motion Eye OS. The prototype baby monitoring device saves valuable time for both parents and providers. This method of monitoring a newborn has been shown to be the safest and most effective. This surveillance is a highly efficient Internet of Things (IoT)-based system for true tracking that employs the greatest security mechanisms available.

Author Keywords: HT11 Digital Temperature and Humidity Sensor

articleTitle: Neural directional distance field object representation for uni-directional path-traced rendering
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Faster rendering of synthetic images is a core problem in the field of computer graphics. Rendering algorithms, such as path-tracing is dependent on parameters like size of the image, number of light bounces, number of samples per pixel, all of which, are fixed if one wants to obtain a image of a desired quality. It is also dependent on the size and complexity of the scene being rendered. One of the largest bottleneck in rendering, particularly when the scene is very large, is querying for objects in the path of a given ray in the scene. By changing the data type that represents the objects in the scene, one may reduce render time, however, a different representation of a scene requires the modification of the rendering algorithm. In this paper, (a) we introduce directed distance field, as a functional representation of a object; (b) how the directed distance functions, when stored as a neural network, be optimized and; (c) how such an object can be rendered with a modified path-tracing algorithm.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Prediction using Extra Tree Ensembling Technique with Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: To enhance the accuracy of predicting a borrower's likelihood to repay their debt to a lender, a comprehensive approach is necessary. The loan approval process involves a considerable amount of quantitative data that can be time killing and subjected to human error. To simplify this process, an expert system named CRPESGA (Credit Risk Prediction Expert System using Genetic Algorithms) has been proposed, which utilizes a genetic algorithm-based approach. To address the issue of class imbalance, CRPESGA incorporates both undersampling and oversampling techniques, namely Edited Nearest Neighbor (ENN) and Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE). Additionally, the model employs Genetic Algorithm (GA) for feature selection, which identifies relevant features for model training. The Extra-Trees ensemble bagging technique is then used for classification. The efficacy of the proposed model is evaluated in terms of accuracy and f1- score, based on 10-fold cross-validation. Moreover, CRPESGA is compared with other models that use single-classifier based approaches, ensemble models, and feature selection technique such as Minimum Redundancy Maximum Relevance (mRMR). The performance of CRPESGA is also compared with other models presented in the literature.

articleTitle: IoT Based Pulp Quality Enhancement Through Bleaching Process in ECF Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Addition of Hydrogen Peroxide (H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) in ECF (Elemental Chlorine Free) plant during Extraction of Pulp stage in SPB Ltd was conventionally done manually by measuring the flow of pulp, Temperature, pH of respective pulp processing mixer tanks, which results in uneven mixing of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and pulp thereby decreasing the brightness and production quality of the paper. To automate the Bleaching process of chemical pulping by addition of Hydrogen Peroxide into the mixer by Variable frequency driver where by inferring the Flow of Pulp, Temperature and pH of the Mixer and the amount of Pulp Bleached should be monitored through a IoT cloud. The Motto is to atomize the Conventional Addition of Hydrogen Peroxide in ECF (Elemental Chlorine Free) plant of SPB Ltd using Variable Frequency Driver and to monitor the flow of Pulp through IoT cloud. The correct addition of Hydrogen peroxide will also improve the Replacement ratio, effectiveness of chelating wash and oxygen delignification.

articleTitle: Review of Microsoft Cloud Plug-N-Play IoT Solution for Hydroponic Protected Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this study, Microsoft cloud components are described and analyzed, and a turnkey integration of essential components is proposed in order to produce a hyper-scale, highly dependable, and secure Internet of Things system that is capable of scaling industrial commercial use cases. In this article, step-by-step instructions on these important building elements are offered, enumerating research work that has previously been done in this field through a variety of reputable publications. The goal of this work is to offer seamless solutioning of Internet of Things building blocks that are now accessible in the Microsoft cloud. This is done so that users studying this work will be able to utilize the same solution and get predictable outcomes. When all of the necessary code content has been generated to completion, Visio architectural diagrams will be made available for boilerplate consumption. This will enable preferred pathways to be easily accessible, secure, and seamless for end consumers.

articleTitle: An Automatic Vehicle Speed Controlling based on Traffic Signs Recognition using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Autonomous driving systems and applications in the real time are the trending field these days. To carry out all the necessary operations in accordance with the requirements, these systems do require sophisticated algorithms. One of the most challenging constraints in performing actions by autonomous driving systems is controlling road speed. The novel method proposed for motor controlling speed in accordance with speed stipulations uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm to scan speed limit sign boards. The effectiveness of our system is contingent on CNNs' ability to properly recognize and classify objects in images, which are then used to extract speed limit information from sign boards. The pace of the robot chassis is regulated by an Arduino microcontroller using the CNN’s output. Through simulations and tests on a real testbed, we show how effective our method is and show that it can maintain the desired speed with a tolerable degree of error.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low Power Approximate Arithmetic Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Multiplication and addition are the two paramount arithmetic operations in application specific ICs and DSP processors. The power consumption, area and performance are the major constraints in scaled CMOS integrated circuits. The computation using accurate computing techniques includes overhead in terms of area and time. The accurate computation is not the constraint for data mining, big data, AI, Internet of Things, deep learning applications. In such cases, it would be more viable and cost-effective if computing is done with the results are properly accurate is called approximate computing. So, a 4-bit approximate adder and multiplier circuits are implemented in this work using energy recovery logic at 45nm technology node using cadence virtuoso. Eldo simulator is used to perform functional verification. The combined use of energy recovery logic with approximate computing achieves about 50-75% power reduction over corresponding CMOS implementations. Further, analyzed the behavior of these circuits with supply voltage scaling and technology by varying the amplitude of power clock from 0.4V-1.8V and width of the transistor from 120nm-160nm. Along with this analysis another prominent design metric in SoC applications is Area Power Product (APP), which is also computed in this work

articleTitle: Enhanced Biased Weights AdaBoost Algorithm for Diabetes Detection on Imbalanced Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The paper proposes a new approach to improve multi-fault diabetes diagnosis using ensemble learning - biased weights with AdaBoost algorithm on unbalanced datasets. The suggested technique makes utilization three distinct using machine learning algorithms like the Support Vector Machine,, Logistic Regression and Decision Trees. These models are combined using the AdaBoost algorithm with or without bias weights. The performance of the approach is evaluated using an imbalanced diabetes dataset of 2000 samples, and the results are compared to various machine learning models, namely Naive Bayes, Among the methods employed are kNearest Neighbours and Support Vector Machine with radial basis function, Artificial Neural Network, and popular ensemble learning techniques such as XGBoost, Light Gradient Boosting Machine, and Random Forest. Diabetes diagnosis accuracy is significantly improved by the proposed method, according to the study’s findings, particularly when using decision tree models and unbalanced datasets. The most elevated precision pace of 99% is accomplished utilizing AdaBoost with decision tree as weak learner, alongside unfairness loads of 0.7 and 0.4. The findings suggest that the proposed technique could be effective for identifying diabetes in clinical settings. It could also be used to create a decision support system for doctors to help them diagnose and treat diabetes.

articleTitle: Regularized Fusion of CNN with Transfer Learning for Facial Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Emotional states of a person are hard to predict accurately by machines. Facial emotion recognition (FER) has become one of the prominent areas of study, because of its various applications. The objective of this work is to enhance the accuracy of facial emotion recognition by employing regularization and fusion techniques when the profile view images, in addition to frontal view images, are considered. The fusion model (F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">net</inf>), wherein the network utilizes pre-trained models; VGG-19 and Densenet-121 has been proposed. The network we proposed is not just the concatenation of the aforementioned networks, but the fusion of all the outputs obtained; output from the VGG-19, the Densenet-121 and the Sum<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">net</inf> (model formed by concatenating VGG-19 and Densenet-121). The significance of this proposed network, F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">net</inf> lies in the fusion loss (F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">L</inf>) we developed, which aids in optimizing the model during training. The network achieves the highest test accuracy of 98.98% within 30 epochs of training. The research utilizes the KDEF dataset, consisting of 4900 images across 7 emotion classes. The study demonstrates the effectiveness of regularization and fusion techniques in enhancing facial emotion recognition accuracy, thereby improving human capabilities in perceiving and responding to emotional signals.

articleTitle: Attack and Anomaly Detection in IIoT Networks Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sensor-driven edge devices, known as things, connect with control systems like intelligent machines and analytic applications, making a network known as the Industrial Internet of Things (Industry 4.0) work synchronously and communicate. The massive amount of data is generated by edge devices, making them vulnerable to attack if an intrusion detection system (IDS) is implemented in the cloud. So an intermediate layer is required to provide seamless and uninterrupted IoT cloud services to edge (end-user) devices. The fog layer technique is a collection of servers distributed across the zones where edge devices (stationary or mobile) reside. The machine learning methods suggested in this study operate on real-time traffic data produced by the network. The algorithms are thus previously trained on a well-known NSL KDD, an improved dataset of the formerly known KDD Cup ‘99 dataset. The algorithms proposed in this paper have achieved up to 99.8% accuracy in the model. This work is showing better than the existing algorithm.

articleTitle: Multiclass Brain Tumor Recognition Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The diagnosis of brain tumors is a tough endeavor that can benefit from computer vision techniques.
