articleTitle: Unveiling the Hidden Patterns: Deep Learning Approach for Early Detection and Severity Classification of Sugarcane Brown Spot
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sugarcane brown spot (SBS) is a global fungal disease that threatens sugarcane crops. SBS treatment and yield preservation need early identification and precise severity categorization. We present a unique SBS detection and severity multi-classification method utilizing a convolutional neural network (CNN) Long-short term memory (LSTM) model. 20,000 sugarcane leaf images of various severities were gathered. Binary detection distinguished healthy and sick pictures, while severity multi-classification classified the disease into four severity levels. Our CNN-LSTM model accurately differentiated healthy and sick sugarcane leaf pictures at 98.11% in the binary detection phase. The algorithm accurately classified SBS severity levels during severity multi-classification. The model identified SBS severity with 93.87% accuracy, enabling focused illness treatment. CNN and LSTM architectures made our model work. CNN collected discriminative characteristics from sugarcane leaf pictures, whereas the LSTM network recorded temporal relationships, enabling disease progression analysis. The CNN-LSTM combination model can quickly detect diseases, assess severity, and optimize resource allocation in agriculture. This research advances automated SBS diagnosis and severity assessment, improving illness management.

articleTitle: Design a Blockchain Based Security Algorithm for IoT based Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Healthcare applications have made extensive use of smart contracts to ensure the safe and decentralized management of patient data, track medication adherence, and streamline the processing of insurance claims. Blockchain-based decentralized healthcare applications have the potential to significantly alter the healthcare system as we know it. A system's ability to offer high-quality services to its end customers is quantified by its QoS. Availability, dependability, performance, and security are all examples of Quality of Service concerns that may arise in the healthcare industry. The QoS is evaluated by how well it meets the needs of its customers. The accurate determination of QoS during medical data processing utilizing sophisticated measurement methods is a crucial criterion for healthcare applications. When providing medical treatment, it is often necessary to explain complicated concepts to patients. Therefore, it is crucial to maintain rigorous requirements for public network security and intelligence. Objective of research is enhancing the quality of service in blockchain for healthcare. Quality of service (QoS) in smart contracts, however, is essential to the widespread adoption of these technologies. Current studies on smart contracts have taken into account service quality and traditional healthcare solutions. In this research, we provide a unique method for improving QoS of healthcare smart contracts. To ascertain the state of the art and locate already established answers or methods, we have reviewed the aforementioned literature. In order to assess the efficacy of our strategy, we have devised a study question and specified our methodology. The conclusions of our study demonstrate that our method may greatly enhance the QoS of healthcare smart contracts, leading to better patient outcomes and lower overall costs. Simulation work is considering packet dropping rate, file size and accuracy. It is observed that proposed approach is providing more than 94% accuracy where as conventional approach provided accuracy of below 92%. On other hand, proposed approach has reduced the file size from 10% to 40%. Thus the packet delivery ratio of proposed work is 91% to 95 % that is 90% to 94% in case of conventional work.

articleTitle: Human Fall Detection System using Long-Term Recurrent Convolutional Networks for Next-Generation Healthcare: A Study of Human Motion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Falls can cause serious injuries and even death, especially in older adults. Therefore, fall detection systems have the potential to save lives and improve healthcare outcomes. Security and healthcare issues are of utmost concern today in a dynamic world. Accidents from falling can cause serious injury to elderly people or children, and in some cases, death can also occur. A deep learning-based Human Motion Recognition approach has been proposed to detect human falling from video, even in low resolution, and send an alert message to the other end-user without using any costly wearable device. In this paper, the Long-term Recurrent Convolutional Network (LRCN) model is practiced on our proposed FD503 video dataset. A 90% accuracy was attained using the suggested strategy. Precision and recall are 0.93 and 0.85 respectively. The LRCN model is flexible for vision-related problems involving time-varying sequences. The proposed system is highly capable of real-time monitoring to provide healthcare with an alert message.

articleTitle: WDRKNN: Weighted Distance Representation based Nearest Neighbor for Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Imagery Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification has enormous importance in the era of remote sensing and extensively sourced in a variety of promising applications. Most HSI classifications use the K-nearest neighbor (KNN) method due to its efficiency and simplicity. Although the KNN-based classification has lot of benefits, while this classification method has two big issues: firstly, the sensitivity of the k-neighborhoods affects KNN performance and secondly, moderate majority voting utilized there especially if the size of samples is quite small. To tackle these outliers, this paper suggests the weighted distance representation-based K nearest neighbor (WDRKNN) approach for improving the image classification results. In proposed WDRKNN, initially for each pattern class k nearest neighbors belongs to testing data samples are chosen and it has been employed to imply the testing data sample as their linear combinations. The localities related to the k-nearest neighbors for each pattern class represent as the weighted distance restrict their subsequent representations related constants. Decisively, the testing sample will be classified to a specific pattern class by the WDRKNN using the least representation-based distance between the classes. Experimental assessment on two HSIs: Pavia University and Indian Pines confirms that the suggested structure can significantly enhance HSI classification as compared to related state-of-the-art methodologies.

articleTitle: Throughput Optimization for RIS-assisted SWIPT-IoTs with Hardware Impairments
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A highly transformative technology termed reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs), with its competence to manipulate the radio communication environment and enhance system performance, has attracted considerable interest in the beyond 5G (B5G)/6G framework. Advent of massive connected Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices demands for higher data rate and energy saving options pertaining to specific application. This apprehension can be tackled by Simultaneous Wireless Information and Power Transfer (SWIPT) technique along with RIS. This paper explores, the power-splitting (PS) based SWIPT architecture deployed at the IoT node with non-linear energy harvesting (EH) model. An analytic phase shift model is used that showcases the variations in reflection amplitude that occur herein based on the phase of the RIS elements. We formulate rate maximization problem for optimal phase shift under Quality-of-Service (QoS) constraints. An iteration based optimization algorithm adopting divide-and-conquer methodology is used to solve the aforementioned problem. Numerical evaluation confers that to have a higher data rate, more RIS elements and its closer placement to base station and user is needed.

Author Keywords: Simultaneous Wireless Information and Power Transfer (SWIPT)

articleTitle: Automated Alzheimer’s Disease Diagnosis Using Norm Features Extracted from EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder that progresses over time and affects cognitive abilities. It is marked by symptoms such as memory loss, language and communication difficulties, and impaired judgement and decision-making. These symptoms are severe enough to affect daily life of mostly middle-aged and elderly adults. Although conventional AD diagnosis approaches, such as cognitive assessment tests, are inexpensive but time-consuming, biased, and less accurate. Hence, it is essential to develop computer-assisted automated diagnosis of AD at an early stage to minimize the symptomatic effects. In the early stages, neuroimaging (magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) or computed tomography (CT)) scans may not reveal any abnormalities, but in later stages, diffuse cortical atrophy may be observed in the frontal and temporal regions of the brain. In light of this problem, the electroencephalogram (EEG) is opted for early diagnosis of AD because of its ability to show cortical neuronal functionalities in high temporal resolution at low-cost and non-invasively. In this study, an automated AD diagnosis framework has been designed based on machine learning (ML) algorithms using EEG signals. The signals are pre-processed and decomposed into five popular EEG rhythms or bands. The norm features are extracted from each bands and trails of EEG data. Later, the extracted features are supplied as input to the popular classifiers and their classification performance are evaluated. A publicly accessible EEG dataset featuring 16-channels EEG obtained from 23 adults (11 healthy and 12 AD) is used to demonstrate the proposed methodology. An extensive comparison of different ML algorithms is done on selected EEG data, and it is found that the ensemble tree classifier shows the best results at delta band. The experimental results suggest that the proposed methodology could be a potential solution and provide a robust biomarker for effective diagnosis of AD.

articleTitle: Predicting the Cerebral Blood Flow Change Condition during Brain Strokes using Feature Fusion of FMRI Images and Clinical Features
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: By fusing clinical information with functional magnetic resonance imaging (fFMRI) pictures, this study describes a novel method for predicting changes in cerebral blood flow during brain strokes. The FMRI data and patient-specific variables, such as age, gender, and medical history, are combined via feature fusion in the proposed technique. As a result, the model developed can accurately forecast changes in cerebral blood flow that occur during brain strokes. The efficiency of the suggested strategy is shown by experimental findings. The performance of the model is greatly enhanced when FMRI data and clinical characteristics are combined as opposed to just one data source. The findings of this study have important ramifications for increasing the accuracy of stroke diagnosis and treatment and, eventually, for bettering patient outcomes. The experimental results showed that the proposed method a high level of accuracy in predicting changes in cerebral blood flow after brain strokes. The performance of the model was much enhanced by combining clinical characteristics with FMRI data as opposed to using only one of these data sources. This emphasizes the value of including pertinent clinical information in the diagnosis and management of stroke.

articleTitle: Smart System for Freshwater Pisciculture(Ornamental Fish Farming)
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent times, there has been a significant surge in the advancement of information analysis technology specifically designed for underwater environments. This remarkable progress has brought about numerous advantages for the fields of aquatic resource exploration and aquaculture. Aquaculture is the breeding and harvesting of aquatic animals and plants. The rearing and breeding of fish under controlled conditions is called pisciculture. In this research, we present an automated system to improve technical facilities in Ornamental fish farming. We focus on Fish body length and weight prediction and Water quality measuring, Fish Behavioral Patterns Identification, Predicting the harvest and analyzing data, and can know whether the fish in the tank are alive or not using Machine Learning (ML) and Image Processing techniques. And this project invents a smart device, that contains (IoT) devices and sensors to capture images (by a camera), to obtain data on Ammonia (NH3), Nitrate (NO2-), Nitrite (NO3-), Temperature, Oxygen level (O2) and pH level in the water and we use food pallet to hold and release food according to the conditions. The distinguished data will upload to a cloud system and the web application will display the expected outputs. We use Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to analyze the water quality and, to identify different behavioral patterns of fish and identity whether the fish is live or not. Length and weight prediction identified behavioral patterns, identified live or dead fish, harvest prediction and other details also display through the known web application.

articleTitle: Development of an Autonomous UAV for Seed and Fertilizer Distribution in Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Bangladesh is mostly an agricultural nation. Agriculture is a time-consuming and labor-intensive operation. Farmers must labor long and hard hours to produce a harvest. Farmers must overcome various obstacles to reap a productive harvest. The longest aspect of farming is seed planting and pest management. An attempt to minimize the time required for these two extremely critical aspects of farming will result in greater interest in farming from the country's people. With that purpose in mind, this proposal suggests using an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) to distribute paddy seeds or other seeds over wet fields and a specific nozzle to spray fertilizer, pesticide, and water on the fields. The UAV will make possible the autonomous operation. The efficiency of ArUco-based autonomous UAVs is improving through development, and by allowing UAVs to complete missions without continual human interaction, autonomous operations may increase their efficacy by enhancing their stealth and expanding their range. This system has potential applicability in the field of precision agriculture, such as seed distribution, spraying fertilizer, pesticide, and water on land, and autonomous navigation to complete assigned tasks, which will ease the work of the crop grower.

articleTitle: Embedded Systems in Industrial Automation 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Industrial automation 4.0 extensively relies upon cybernetics technologies to improve the efficiency of various industrial processes. Cybernetics technologies are the prime enablers of the industrial internet of things (IIoT), and are widely implemented in hardware in the form of embedded systems. Embedded systems play a vital role in the creation of new automated processes as well as in the development of new smart products. Industrial automation 4.0 and its embedded systems face several challenges such as scalability, information privacy, data integrity, trust, interoperability constraints, data/service security and more. This paper presents on overview of various aspects related to embedded systems from an industrial automation 4.0 perspective. Furthermore, it presents the implementation steps involved in developing smart/cyber physical frameworks using embedded technology in industrial context. Integration of a Raspberry Pi enabled workstation with IoT-based industrial automation and wireless network communication standards used in IIoT embedded systems, such as STM32H7, are also discussed.

articleTitle: Development of a Depression Detection System using Speech and Text Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Depression is a prevalent mental health condition that impacts a considerable proportion of the world's population. However, early detection and intervention are crucial for effective treatment. Current depression detection models often rely on a single modality, either speech or text data, which may lead to inaccurate results due to the limited information being considered. In this paper, we propose a novel approach for the accurate detection of depression in individuals using both speech and text data. This approach addresses the limitations of existing solutions by combining objective measures of speech and text data, providing a non-intrusive and efficient means for depression detection. In this project, two models were trained: a speech emotion recognition model using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and a text model based on the Random Forest Method. The TESS dataset was used to train the speech emotion recognition model, whereas the text model was trained on the Twitter dataset, which is accessible on Kaggle. The results indicate that our proposed approach is highly effective in detecting depression, with an accuracy of 98% achieved by the speech emotion recognition model and 95% by the depression detection model on the testing data. The outputs of both models are combined using a decision tree method, resulting in an accuracy of 100%. The proposed method employs a Decision Tree algorithm that takes the output of both the Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) model and the text-based depression detection model as inputs and applies a set of rules to classify users into one of three categories: depressed, mildly depressed, or not depressed. Then a webpage was developed where users can input their speech and text data and receive a prediction of their depression status based on the integrated output of both models. Overall, the results demonstrate that the proposed system provides an assuring solution for the early diagnosis of depressive symptoms.

articleTitle: An Intelligent IoT Based Smart Stick For Visually Impaired Person Using Image Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Visual impairment is a global concern affecting millions of people worldwide, with a significant proportion classified as blind. The traditional blind stick, while widely used, presents limitations such as skill requirements, costs, and extensive training. However, recent technological advancements have paved the way for innovative solutions to aid visually impaired individuals in navigating their surroundings effectively. This paper explores the development and potential of smart blind sticks, which leverage sensors, cameras, and artificial intelligence algorithms to provide enhanced assistance to users. These devices offer obstacle detection, auditory and tactile feedback, and even GPS navigation, empowering visually impaired individuals and improving their mobility and quality of life. Several research initiatives worldwide are actively contributing to the design and development of user-friendly, affordable smart blind sticks that require minimal training. With the use of an IoT stick, this research hopes to create an image of opportunity, autonomy, and certainty. To swiftly complete their everyday tasks, the proposed smart stick is designed with an obstacle recognition module, a worldwide positioning system (GPS), pit and flight of stairs detection, water detection, and a global system for mobile communication (GSM).

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Traditional Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER) serves as a rapidly developing and important research space in the domain of pattern identification. Nonverbal communication plays a big part in daily life, and it accounts for roughly 55% to 93% of all communication. Robotics, video footage, expression recognition, home automation, electronic games, patient monitoring, mood disorders and anxiety diagnosis, psychoanalysis, and paralinguistic communication are all effective applications of facial expression identification. A thorough analysis of FER is provided in this paper. The literature is compiled from a variety of credible studies that were released during the most recent ten years. In this review, a variety of deep learning techniques are employed in addition to traditional machine learning methods. In addition, a number of freely available FER datasets are analysed, and standard outcomes are contrasted with them. In order to point out the subsequent research needed in this field for future researchers, this study provides an in-depth analysis of FER using conventional machine learning and deep learning strategies. Finally, by providing an overall comprehension of the latest cutting-edge techniques, this research study serves as a manual that is extremely beneficial for both experienced researchers looking for fruitful directions to pursue in the future and academicians in the FER field.

Author Keywords: LSTM (long short-term memory) facial expression recognition (FER)

articleTitle: Segmentation and Classification for Bruise Severity Detection Using Infrared Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Identifying bruises in apples is one crucial step in defining the quality of fruits. The quality of apples available for sale might be significantly improved by having a detection system that can identify and remove damaged apples, which could then benefit the entire fruit economy. In this paper, we proposed a framework for classification of bruises in infrared images of apples in three major categories (i.e., slight, moderate, and severe bruises) depending on the analysis of the segmented bruised regions. For segmentation of the bruise regions, an encoder-decoder network-based segmentation method is incorporated in our proposed framework. Also, the influence of various backbone convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on encoder-decoder framework for precise bruise regions segmentation from the holistic infrared images is also investigated. After that, morphological shape features are extracted from the bruise regions for classification of bruises in apples using the well-known machine learning classifiers. The entire experiment is conducted in our own created dataset comprising of infrared images of fresh and bruised apples. Experiment results reveals that precise segmentation of the bruise regions and extraction of morphological shape features from the segmented regions can well predict the severity of bruises in apples (i.e., in three major categories including slight, moderate, and severe bruise) with an average accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity of 90.96%, sensitivity 91.37%, and 90.71% respectively.

articleTitle: An empirical review of Machine Learning models for Energy Optimizations in IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has transformed how users interact with their devices and enabled the accumulation of enormous quantities of data from various sources. There has been an increase in energy consumption due to the expanding use of IoT devices, resulting in environmental concerns and higher operational costs. The use of Machine Learning (ML) algorithms to optimize energy consumption in IoT networks is widespread for different scenarios. This paper empirically analyzes the most widely used machine learning models for energy optimization in IoT networks. The researchers evaluate the efficacy of various ML models regarding energy efficiency, precision, and scalability. The review includes a summary of the most recent research in this field and a comparison of different algorithms, including Decision Trees, Random Forests, Support Vector Machines, Neural Networks, and Deep Learning methods. In addition, this paper discusses the difficulties and limitations of ML-based energy optimization in IoT networks, including data acquisition and processing, model selection, and scalability levels. Finally, this paper presents recommendations for future research and prospective machine-learning applications in energy optimization for IoT networks. This review emphasizes the potential of machine learning (ML) models to reduce energy consumption in IoT networks. It provides researchers and practitioners with insight into this field under real-time scenarios.

articleTitle: Symbolic Deterministic Finite Automata-based Automated Fertilizer Prescription
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sustainable agriculture requires the use of an adequate amount of fertilizers. In this research work, initially, an attempt was made to classify soil fertility using machine learning-based classifiers. To overcome the drawbacks of machine learning-based classifiers, this research uses Symbolic Deterministic Finite Automata (SDFA) for soil fertility classification. The proposed method classifies soil fertility as LOW, MEDIUM (MED), or HIGH using the levels of four soil parameters, including pH, Electrical Conductivity (EC), Organic Carbon (OC), and Nitrogen (N). The proposed approach was assessed using Sentinel-2 remotely sensed data and laboratory-measured soil-health data. The experiments’ outcomes show that the proposed approach effectively classifies soil fertility. The accuracy achieved using Sentinel-2 data was 100%, while the accuracy gained using laboratory-measured data with four and twelve soil parameters were 100% and 98.37%, respectively. The results of soil fertility classification were used to recommend fertilizers.

articleTitle: Generation of Synthetic ECG Signal Using Generative Adversarial Network With Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Heart diseases are a severe hazard to human health. By capturing the heart activity, electrocardiogram (ECG) tests were used to help diagnose cardiac illness. Nevertheless, the utilization of computer-assisted medical diagnosis necessitates a substantial volume of clinical data from the patient. This becomes an empirical challenge because of privacy concerns. Since the clinical data were unavailable, we present a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), consisting of a generator composed of a transformer, a convolutional neural network (CNN), and a discriminator consisting of a transformer. Electrocardiogram information from the MIT-BIH dataset was used to train the generative adversarial network. The evaluation of the model was performed by calculating statistical parameters like RMSE, FD, and PRD and comparing them with existing published models. The results showed that the synthetic ECG produced by our generative adversarial network performed better than the existing models and had better morphological similarity to the actual ECG recordings

articleTitle: Edge Computing Enabled Smart Warehouse Management System for Food Processing Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Food safety is a primary concern across all global platforms, and food storage is a crucial and essential part of management. This clarifies that food warehousing should be fully automated or has some management system. Good food storage plays a vital role in food security, which is affected by food waste and food loss. As a result, it is critical to identify and remove microbial contamination before it spreads to other items. To end that, we propose an edge computing-enabled intelligent warehouse system with an ESP32 microcontroller and micropython. The food commodities studied in the other papers were fish, dairy, fresh food products, crop-field cucumber, seafood, wine, and pre-packaged food. The various gas sensors are used to detect microbial growth, food decay, and shelf life. Humidity and temperature sensors are employed to monitor the warehouse environment, along with RFID technology to track food items. Multiple nodes accessible via Telegram and dashboard notifications will be put in the building to enable law enforcement collaboration. These nodes will exchange information on the building's structure. Compared to the traditional warehouse management system, the proposed edge computing-enabled IoT warehouse shelves reduce waste and contamination in fruit and vegetable chambers. Designs are experimented with different sets of fruits and vegetables. Continuous live monitoring and an alert system demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed innovative framework compared with an existing management system.

articleTitle: Career Prediction System using ANN MLP Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The selection of a career field is a vital factor for students. In contrast, engineering students face multiple career fields in the IT industry, such as web development, software development, software testing, etc., during their studies. The students have to choose one of them, although a lack of knowledge of these fields often leads to a wrong selection. The proposed career prediction system aids engineering students in deciding which sector or job profile would be most suitable for them, given their current knowledge and expertise. In this research paper, we propose a novel approach to career prediction using an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) classifier, which gives an accuracy of 95.332%. The objective of our study is to develop a system that can accurately predict suitable career paths for individuals based on their personal attributes, qualifications, and interests.

articleTitle: Post Quantum Blockchain Based Lightweight Edge Server Handover Authentication Key Agreement Protocol for Vehicular Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: We have designed a safe and portable vehicle to infrastructure handover authentication using blockchain technology. In this protocol, blockchain technology provides benefits for data sharing since it can guarantee data quality, transparency, and provenance. To get information for handover authentication, road side units can act nodes of the consortium blockchain. Furthermore, transactions on the blockchain cannot be falsified since they include an road side unit signature and cannot be updated due to blockchain technological features. As a result, other road side units may verify the authenticity of vehicles by utilizing the data stored on the blockchain. For authentication phase, we have used lattice based cryptography that plays a very important role in authentication and key exchanges that protects against the threat of quantum attacks. The proposed protocol ensures both securities against quantum attacks and efficiency due to simple algebraic operations that are polynomial addition and multiplications.

articleTitle: Determining factors influencing adoption of digitalization in the Middle East construction industry
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study aims to determine factors influencing the adoption of digitalization in the context of Middle East construction industry. Existing literature establishes the importance of construction industry to the overall economy, society, and the environment. While it also highlights the slow pace of adoption of technologies in this industry. The issues plaguing the construction industry such as low profitability, huge carbon footprint, cost and time overruns require innovation and adoption of new technologies, multiple digital technologies exist at different levels of maturity, which if implemented in a structured manner, could bring great benefits for the construction industry and thus to the entire society and environment. As in the case of any technology adoption, various factors interplay at individual, organization and environmental levels leading to adoption, this study aims to identify these factors and statistically test the relationships between them through a structural equation model. This model could help to conduct further studies in the area of digitalization and technology adoption in the construction industry.

articleTitle: Improving Accuracy for Flight Fare Prediction using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The aim of this study is to develop a flight fare prediction model using the Random Forest algorithm. The model is designed to provide accurate and reliable predictions of flight fares based on several input features such as flight route, departure and arrival times, airline carrier, and other relevant information. The Random Forest algorithm is chosen due to its ability to handle complex datasets and its robustness against overfitting. The training process of the model utilizes a vast collection of past flight prices, and multiple measures such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) are utilized to evaluate its performance. The results show that the Random Forest model provides a high degree of accuracy in predicting flight fares and outperforms other machine learning algorithms such as linear regression and support vector regression. The proposed model can be used by airlines and travel agencies to make informed pricing decisions and assist customers in planning their travel budgets.

articleTitle: A CNN-based Prediction Model for Age, Gender, and Ethnicity Using Facial Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A computational model can examine multiple critical demographic factors at once, including age, gender, and ethnicity. This is useful when cognitive robots need to execute multiple computer vision tasks at once and GPU and memory resources are limited. Multi-task learning allows a solitary model to proficiently handle multiple tasks simultaneously to do several classification and regression tasks by mastering single low-level representation in an effective method for doing this. An assumed relationship between age, gender, and ethnicity is taken care of using the combined estimation approach. In the current study, gender, age, ethnicity, and mood are predicted from facial photographs in real-time user profiling using a multi-task convolutional neural network. Three different architectures were looked at to see which one struck the optimum balance between accuracy and speed. The multitasking CNNs outperformed equivalent single-task CNNs in accuracy, execution speed, and memory use. This approach is particularly suitable for overcoming the processing resource constraints particular to such applications, and it can be used in real-world situations like embedded systems and smart cameras.

articleTitle: Improved Deep Maxout for IoT Botnet Attack Detection with LDA based Selected Feature Set
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: As the Internet of Things (IoT) grows in reputation and prevalence, concerns regarding its vulnerability to cyber-attacks persist. One significant security issue affecting IoT is the presence of botnets. While several studies have utilized machine learning (ML) techniques to detect botnets, existing approaches have limitations, particularly in terms of detection accuracy. This research paper proposes an improved approach for botnet attack detection by employing optimal features by utilizing the Improved DeepMaxout approach. This methodology enhances overall efficiency and accuracy in botnet detection. The findings of this study contribute to advancing the field of IoT security by addressing the limitations of previous research and providing a more practical approach to detecting botnet attacks.

articleTitle: Packetenizer - Modern PCAP Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Packet analysis is one of the main methods of traceback when dealing with network forensics. This technique is used to uncover evidence of suspicious activity online, such as data breaches, unauthorized website access, malware infections, and intrusion attempts. We have developed Packetenizer, a tool that can analyse and give insights on network traffic. This tool would be immensely beneficial for system administrators and security specialists within an organization. Our aim is to showcase this data in a comprehensible and straightforward format. We intend to graphically depict the data and present a thorough breakdown, including a summary of the network and an analysis of any security incidents occurring within it. The paper provides an in-depth analysis of the tool’s functionalities, design, and implementation. Overall, Packetenizer presents a useful tool for network administrators to analyse and secure their networks efficiently.

articleTitle: New Histogram-Based User and Item Profiles for Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A recommendation system is used as a tool for data filtering that works on the principle of discovering patterns in data on customer behaviour to suggest the most relevant items to a user. Based on the existing trend- content based, collaborative filtering, hybrid model are the most popular techniques that are used for recommendation systems. By using Symbolic Data Analysis (SDA) [9], we extended the approaches of the content-based and collaborative filtering techniques in our work. Standard data analysis has been enhanced by SDA, that takes symbolic tables as input and results in symbolic objects as output. The symbolic data is highly used to aggregate and reduce the loss of data. The similarity scores will be generated for each technique and the NDCG metrics is used to evaluate the performance of these models. Finally, we have observed that SDA is significantly helpful for understanding and modelling of the histogram data in optimizing the performance and generating the recommendations accurately.

articleTitle: Enhancing Diabetes Detection through a Hybrid AI Model Utilizing Wearable Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetes is a persistent condition that affects a significant number of individuals worldwide and can lead to severe complications if left untreated. Timely identification of diabetes can greatly reduce the risk of complications and improve overall outcomes. In recent years, the emergence of wearable technology has shown promise in disease detection and monitoring. Smartwatches equipped with IoT sensors allow for continuous and painless monitoring of vital signs, making them well-suited for diabetes screening. This study introduces a novel system that utilizes patient data to develop a hybrid AI model for detecting diabetes. The system combines vital sign measurements obtained from a smartwatch and an IoT sensor to gather accurate and continuous information about the wearer's health status. By integrating deep learning and traditional AI algorithms, the hybrid model achieves exceptional accuracy in identifying diabetes. The system collects various vital sign data, including heart rate, blood pressure, and skin conductance, which are closely associated with diabetes. After preprocessing the collected data, it is used to train the hybrid model. The deep learning algorithm extracts high-level features from the raw data, while the traditional AI algorithm classifies the data into diabetic or non-diabetic categories. This hybrid model is specifically designed to improve the precision of diabetes detection by harnessing the strengths of both deep learning and traditional AI techniques. By combining these approaches, the system aims to enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of diabetes diagnosis, ultimately benefiting individuals at risk of this condition.\

articleTitle: Survey: Garbage collection and segmentation system using Mask-RCNN based Deep learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Developing countries are experiencing a significant problem with waste pollution. There is well-known importance to recycling, both economically and ecologically, and the industry demands high efficiency. Because there are no benchmarks and widely accepted standards regarding the metrics and data used in current studies regarding automatic waste detection, they are hardly comparable. It is a relatively new field of research that has attracted a lot of attention recently. It has emerged as a powerful tool for revealing hidden patterns, determining correlations, or uncovering hidden patterns that traditional approaches cannot reveal. It summarizes and presents the results of previous studies on the presented datasets as well as the authors' own experiments. In this systematic literature review (SLR), 10 studies have been compiled from journals and conferences published between 2018 and 2022. In these studies, Deep Learning models were implemented and analyzed in various Solid Waste Management areas. Research studies were selected based on various criteria and quality assessment processes defined in this paper.

articleTitle: DeepPose: An Integrated Deep Learning Model for Posture Detection Using Image and Skeletal Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Identifying human actions and postures presents significant challenges for computerized systems. The categorization of these tasks holds particular relevance in the fields of health and robotics. Leveraging artificial intelligence technologies, it becomes feasible to define and classify recurring physical movements and postures accurately. Proper posture is further essential for the rehabilitation of patients because it affects the effectiveness of exercise training. Unfortunately, patients fail to follow the correct sequence when performing the exercises. To pursue the problem, a new method is proposed for posture recognition and pose estimation that does not require wearable devices. The proposed model utilizes 2D coordinates derived from the 2D poses as inputs with 18 joints of the human body as key points, along with an image dataset, to accurately classify various postures. This study involved training a custom CNN named DeepPose using both image and keypoint datasets and conducting a comparative analysis with the performance of two other pre-trained models. The result shows that the proposed model with the keypoint dataset outperforms over image dataset.

articleTitle: Sensory Perception of Haptic Rendering in Surgical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The essential ideas behind haptic technology, including haptic interface and haptic rendering methods, as well as its application to surgical simulation, medical education, and other diverse topics, are presented in this paper. In empirical psychology and physiology, this refers to the sense of contact. The process of analyzing and developing capabilities in response to user interactions with virtual entities is elaborated as haptic rendering. Haptic may indicate haptic transmission, haptic perception, and haptic technology. Humans and other animals can respond to one another by using their feelings through haptic technology. Haptic perception is the process of recognizing objects through touch.Haptic implies tactile response, which means it delivers feedback in the state of sensation as we may sense the material properties and motions of virtual objects devised by a computer. The use of haptic technology in the medical profession has proven extremely beneficial, and it has a wide range of applications in many different industries. Providing effective exchange via virtual reality helps to ease the surgeon’s obligations. Amplify a person’s experience in the virtual environment. The haptics ability ranges from computer graphics to psychophysics, cognitive science, and neurosciences.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning to Predict Patient Health Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Predicting patient health outcomes accurately is a key challenge in modern healthcare, significantly impacting treatment planning, patient management, and healthcare resource allocation. In this study, we propose an innovative approach for predicting patient health outcomes using federated machine learning (FedML), a novel machine learning technique that enables collaborative learning from decentralized data sources while ensuring privacy. This research advances current methodologies by enabling data analysis across diverse health institutions without explicit data sharing. The goal is to develop a robust model capable of capturing a wide spectrum of health factors impacting patient outcomes, thus potentially leading to more accurate predictions. Our approach integrates data from multiple healthcare institutions to train a global predictive model, iterating between local model training and global model aggregation until convergence. We also employ a privacy-preserving mechanism to ensure the sensitive health data remains within the original institution, alleviating privacy and data security concerns inherent in traditional centralized learning methods. We assessed our federated learning strategy in contrast to well-established machine learning techniques such as deep learning, support vector machines, and random forests by using a range of patient datasets. Our technique has been shown to increase prediction performance, generalizability, and scalability while maintaining data privacy, as shown by the results. The study concludes by discussing the potential of federated learning in transforming predictive modeling in healthcare and addressing key challenges in implementing this approach. This research contributes to the body of knowledge in predictive health informatics and provides a roadmap for implementing federated machine learning in healthcare applications.

articleTitle: Non-Local Bayesian based Denoising of Magnetic Resonance Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging is a non-invasive and efficient technique to visualize the various parts of the body. One of the major problems facing MRI as with any other medical imaging techniques is the noise and artifacts that affects it. This in turn can affect the accuracy of the diagnosis. Denoising is therefore an important part of medical image analysis. Denoising is a post-processing imaging technique aimed to achieve better diagnostic interpretation of medical images. Non-local Means is an efficient image denoising technique that exploits the self-similarity in images. Non-local Bayesian denoising combines non-local means denoising with Bayesian inference. This paper expands upon this approach for Magnetic Resonance Images. The performance of the method is measured quantitatively by means of Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio(PSNR). In this patch-based approach, the number of patches taken is varied and the PSNR is calculated for different standard deviation of Gaussian noise. Other parameters like search radius and patch size are also varied to evaluate their effect on the performance. An empirically obtained patch count and search radius has been shown to provide optimum denoising results for Magnetic Resonance Images.

articleTitle: The Exploitation of Artificial Intelligence in Developing English Language Learner's Communication Skills
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Today the world run only with the English language. To learn English there are many reputed applications for the peoples to make use of it. But most of it are paid, if it is of free then the content provided is not a satisfiable one to get the language entirely. In order to provide a useful and beneficial learning for free of cost we proposed a way with the utilization of Artificial Intelligence. A website is developed with the Artificial Intelligence to monitor the performance of the peoples who enrolled in it. Website is developed on game based for bringing interest to learn the language. There are multiple levels to be unlocked with interesting challenges and question solving. By this, peoples start to develop their English knowledge with cracking the levels. Here the Artificial Intelligence play a major role in building the question set and the level difficulty for each individual while crossing each level. This is done by analysing the marks obtained in each level. The database is stored and then fed into the Artificial Intelligence model to make evaluation of the individual performance. According the analysis made by the intelligence the level difficulty is set up. So, by this the individual stats to understand the meaning and usage of the word in each scenario. Compare to the proposed methodologies of existing website there is no such involvement of Artificial Intelligence for the analysis making and for building the levels. This era has a lot of development in the technologies with the Artificial Intelligence. Working with Artificial Intelligence make each individual to be strong and confident in their domain. This website will develop the individual to become confident person on speaking with the English language.

articleTitle: Novel Approach of Facial Expression Recognition for Cross-Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Facial expression recognition plays a vital role in various domains, including human-computer interaction, affective computing, and psychological research. However, achieving robust performance across different datasets remains a significant challenge due to variations in image quality, subject demographics, and annotation protocols. This research paper presents a novel technique for facial expression recognition based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) that achieves significant results on cross datasets. By employing transfer learning and database-independent training strategies, the proposed method is trained on the FER-2013 dataset and demonstrates good performance on FERG-DB, CK+, FER-2013, and JAFFE datasets, respectively, of 92.05%, 89.93%, 72.16% and 85.71%. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the technique in achieving database independence and satisfactory performance on diverse datasets.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Bengali News Headline Categorization
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A huge amount of information and data is now available in seconds through the internet. Due to the availability of internet in the world, as the amount of online news is increasing on the one hand, people are interested in reading news from online news portals i.e., Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, blogs etc. Along with the increase in the amount of digital data in news portals, the number of readers is also increasing, thus the need for data classification for digital data is also increasing day by day. There are various methods of data classification, such as machine learning, deep learning, etc., as well as various data mining algorithms. Data is classified using these algorithms, so that people can make sense of the news just by reading the news headlines. Natural language processing methods are used to classify data in any language for such problems. In this paper, Bangla news is classified into 6 categories using deep learning algorithm. The categories are International, National, Sports, Entertainment, Politics and IT. In deep learning, BiLSTM and GRU algorithms have been used to classify. BiLSTM has an accuracy of 83.42% and GRU has an accuracy of 80.01%. BiLSTM has been found to have the highest accuracy among deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation in Broadband MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The use of MILLIMETER wave (mmWave) communication has gained attention of advanced technology due to high bandwidth channels., which could potentially enhance data transmission rates. However, utilizing higher bandwidths poses a challenge to the ADC’s. Finding ADCs with sufficient bandwidth and precision for mmWave systems may not be feasible, devices.The goal of this project is to create a broadband estimation of channel algorithm for MIMO systems in the mmWave frequency range that use few-bit ADCs. To solve the noisy compressed sensing problem, efficient Approximate Message Passing (AMP) algorithms will be applied. The expectation maximization algorithm will be used to achieve an approximately minimum mean square error. Additionally, training sequences with FFT will be used to minimize the peak-to-average ratio.Simulation results will be used to compare the performance of 1-bit and few (4-bit) ADCs with infinite bit ADCs at different SNRs, training lengths, ADC resolutions, MSE, and mutual information. The results show that 1-bit and few (4-bit) ADCs have minimal performance losses at low and medium SNR.

articleTitle: A Brief Review on Optimal Routing in Vehicular Ad-hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANET) are rapid and reliable networks that transmit safety messages between vehicles to vehicles and vehicles to infrastructure in a multi-hop manner. However, it seems to have some limitations in complex road scenarios, less performance, and issues related to routing strategy and fault tolerance. Thus, many routing protocols are developed to enhance the efficiency of VANETs with highly efficient and reliable routing protocols. This paper gives a brief review of 35 papers on optimal solutions for VANET routing protocol and analyzes various proposed protocols and the performance of these routing protocols. On the other hand, the analysis of link breakage handling for VANET, simulators used for VANET protocols, and the measurements of QoS parameters are evaluated to find the efficiency of each routing protocol. As well as limitations of these routing protocols are also described in this work to pave the way for an efficient and reliable routing protocol for VANET.

articleTitle: Analysing and Predicting Student’s Performance Using their Surrounding Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Educational institutions strive to provide students with a top-notch education, but it is challenging to anticipate a student's academic achievement due to many factors. It is important to analyse a variety of student-related criteria. This study examined the student's surrounding data to forecast their performance. Data mining is a popular method used in education to evaluate student performance, helping students increase their academic performance and focus on their intended careers. This study of ours have used machine learning techniques to predict student performance, using Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbor, and Naive Bayes classifiers. Data from a student data set was used to forecast progress. Our goal is to present a clear picture of data mining methods while also identifying the key characteristics of student data that were compared to forecast student careers. The outcome demonstrates machine learning can be used to forecast a student's career based on their surrounding data, and the variable importance factor method was found to be more effective for examining student performance.

articleTitle: LBGM Classifier-Based Automated Identification and Prediction of Epileptic Seizures
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Epilepsy is a neurological disease of the brain that causes repeated seizures. Neurologists utilize electroencephalography (EEG) to record epileptic seizures. Automated seizure identification is a crucial step in the diagnosis of epilepsy overcoming the limitations of visual diagnosis. This study makes use of the Children’s Hospital of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Boston (CHB-MIT) dataset. The seizure detection system implemented in this research utilized the variational mode decomposition (VMD) method and Light Gradient Boosting Classifier (LGBM). The seizure and no seizure signals are separated using the K-fold cross-validating technique after the linear and non-linear properties are recovered from the band limited-intrinsic mode functions (BL-IMFs). This approach performance is evaluated with the sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy metrics and achieved an average of 82.32%, 86.49%, and 90.53% respectively for all patients in the dataset.

articleTitle: Hilarious or Hidden? Detecting Sarcasm in Hinglish Tweets using BERT-GRU
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sarcasm is the manner of usage of words that contradict the actual context of a sentence. Sarcasm detection in multilingual contexts poses unique challenges due to the complex interplay of languages and cultural nuances. Inside this research paper, we propose a novel approach for sarcasm detection in Hinglish, a code-mixed language blend of Hindi and English. Our approach combines the power of BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) and GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) neural networks to capture the contextual and sequential information necessary for accurate sarcasm detection. We evaluate our approach on a code-mixed dataset, comparing it with several baseline models and achieving remarkable results. The proposed BERT-GRU model achieves an impressive accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score of 0.96, bespeaking its effectiveness in sarcasm detection in Hinglish code-mixed text.

articleTitle: Unified Multi-Layered Model To Secure Computing Environments Against Cryptomining Malware
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cryptocurrencies have transformed our financial system from centralized to decentralized. Cryptojacking is a mechanism by which the attacker utilizes the resources of an anonymous system without the consent of the owner to mine cryptocurrency. Cryptojacking can occur via malware or as an in-browser attack. Malware-based cryptojacking is more dangerous and this type of attack is still prevalent, as attackers constantly develop new obfuscation techniques to exploit infrastructure. This paper focuses on the analysis and detection of malware-based cryptojacking attacks. Hybrid analysis is used to understand the structure and behavior of the malware file and accordingly, a unified multi layered machine-learning model is developed based on multiple datasets and achieved 0.996 accuracy. The novelty of the proposed work and scale of cryptojacking threat, is an eye opener for further research in this area.

articleTitle: SafeRoute: Analysing Online Websites To Indicate Crime Zones Using Machine Learning And Suggest Safe Route
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The safety and security of citizens is a fundamental concern for any society, and the rising crime rate in India is a cause for serious concern. This has led to a growing demand for tools and technologies that can help citizens stay informed and protected from crime. Various news outlets frequently report on criminal incidents, providing information about the nature of crime, location, details about the suspects involved and information on the investigation process. In this paper, we propose a system to extract crime-related information from online news articles focusing on Delhi and Mumbai to provide citizens with valuable information on crime-prone areas and enhance their safety. The proposed system utilizes K-Means clustering algorithm to calculate the danger index. The end product is an application to provide valuable insights on crime-prone areas, advise safety precautions and provide emergency contact options to ensure the safety of the user. With this system, users can be aware of the areas that are more susceptible to crime and take necessary precautions to stay safe. We believe that the proposed system can play a crucial role in promoting a safer environment for citizens in India.

articleTitle: Evaluating the BER Performance for M-ary QAM in AWGN, Rayleigh, Rician, and Nakagami-m Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Wireless communication systems have made tremendous advances, using various modulation schemes considering different channel environments substantially influencing their performance. Data may be conveyed effortlessly and with low errors by using appropriate modulation algorithms and capitalizing on favorable channel characteristics. As a result, it is critical to build highly efficient communication systems that reduce error rates during data transfer. Power efficiency, bandwidth efficiency, and error rate are all performance aspects of modulation methods in communication systems. M-ary Phase-Shift Keying (M-PSK) and M-ary Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (M-QAM) are now two frequently used modulation systems in wireless communication. These methodologies are critical in the study and verification of wireless communication system performance, particularly in fading channel conditions. We compare the Bit Error Rate (BER) performance of M-QAM modulation schemes in various channel circumstances, including Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN), Rayleigh environment, Rician fading, and Nakagami-m fading, in this study.

articleTitle: Analysis of Sub-threshold Leakage Reduction Techniques for High-Speed Low Power VLSI Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: VLSI Technology has revolutionized the field of electronics by enabling the development of complex and powerful electronic devices. It allows for the integration of thousands, millions, or even billions of transistors onto a single chip, leading to smaller, faster, and more efficient electronic systems. Scaling is achieved through advancements in semiconductor manufacturing processes and techniques. It involves shrinking the dimensions of transistors, interconnects, and other components on the chip. However, as technology approaches the physical limits of scaling, several challenges arise such as leakage currents, manufacturing complexities and signal integrity. To overcome these challenges, new technologies and approaches are being explored, such as modified structures, new materials, and alternative computing paradigms. Leakage current is the main component in the contribution of high power dissipation. The motive of this paper is to discuss the electrical characteristics to decrease the OFF current of the device. The Poly-Silicon gate conductivity can be increased either by increasing the work-function of the gate or by depositing the titanium silicide at a particular time and temperature or by doping of different n-type materials. The optimization techniques to reduce the leakage current of the device have been discussed in this paper. The design, virtual fabrication, and analysis of 45nm NMOS devices have been performed by using ATHENA and ATLAS modes of SILVACO device simulator. The substrate current, drain current characteristics, sub-threshold slope, DIBL, and Sheet resistance have been extracted from simulation results. The extracted threshold voltage is 0.22V at work-function 4.12eV and leakage current is 6.06159nA with silicide process.

articleTitle: Aspect Based Analysis of AWARE Dataset using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The use of application specifically the mobile application has increased manifold in the past few years. The reviews are important for the businesses to help analyse the product. The Aspect Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) helps to analyse the various aspects of the product which can help improve the specific aspects of the product and further increase the market of the product. The sentiment classification of the aspects will help to analyse whether certain changes in aspect will help to improve the overall features and market of the product. Also, the category classification of aspects will help to improvise the various factors like cost which can further be beneficial for the business. The reviews are generally extracted of multiple products belonging to different domains, so the classification helps us to find the domain of the application as well. Thus, all this leads to an overall improved analysis of the application. In this paper, Aspect Sentiment Classification (ASC) and Aspect Category Classification (ACC) and Domain Classification (DC) is performed on the AWARE dataset with the objective to overall improve the analysis of reviews in terms of aspect and their categories and their domain. Machine learning algorithms for used for the same in case of Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm the results were improved as compared to the accuracy values provided for the AWARE dataset.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of a Drone Communication System using Truncated Markov Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Reliability analysis of the drone communication system is proposed in this paper using the truncated markov analysis technique. Markov analysis is a dynamic risk analysis technique that is widely used to do reliability analysis as it explores all the states in detail but exploring all the system’s states for a larger and more complex system may reach to state-space exploration problem. To overcome this challenge, truncated markov analysis is proposed considering only the communication system of the drone system. Failure analysis of the communication system is performed using fault tree analysis prior to implementing the truncated markov analysis, and it is later transformed into a reliability block diagram for further study. Truncated markov analysis is used to gain a grasp of the number of working states and the probability of being in each state to ensure the drone system’s safety and reliability. In this paper, the generation of the differential equations from the truncated state transition diagram is studied by applying Laplace’s transformation. Through reliability analysis, failure analysis can be established. To do the reliability analysis, only failure data of the components from the NPRD-2016 dataset are considered. The study aims to focus on the reliability of the drone communication system considering the truncated states.

articleTitle: Improving Analogy-Based Software Cost Estimation Based on Nature-Inspired Algorithms for Feature Weighting: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Estimating software cost and time is one of the important aspects of software project management and a serious concern for software project managers. So far, various methods have been proposed for accurately estimating software cost, each of which has been developed based on a specific perspective. One of the most important methods is analogy-based estimation, which is commonly used today based on different algorithms. The main objective of the current study is to compare various nature-inspired algorithms for improving the accuracy of feature weighting as a step in the analogy-based method. The results indicate that these algorithms can increase the accuracy of software cost estimation from this perspective. Moreover, among the different available algorithms, the learnable evolution model and the artificial bee colony algorithm were able to outperform other algorithms due to their special internal structure.

articleTitle: An Efficient Method for the Data Monitoring of Photovoltaic Solar Panel
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The world’s attention is now being drawn to renewable energy as a result of rising energy needs, unstable energy resources, and harmful gas emissions. As a result, the world’s attention is currently focused on renewable energy sources. In addition, thanks to advancements in software technology, we can now monitor data from any system in real time. The most effective way to gauge how well your solar power system is doing is to monitor solar panel output. This paper uses an arduino and labview-based live monitoring system to offer information about the performance of a PV panel. Additionally, various performance metrics and each panel’s power are determined for real-time monitoring. PV module, Arduino UNO board, voltage and current sensors are among the hardware components. The system design software includes Arduino IDE, LabVIEW, and LIFA.

articleTitle: Design And Development of Cerebral Stroke Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Brain stroke is one of the leading non- communicable diseases causing disabilities with a high mortality rate. Early screening of stroke is of utmost importance as the onset of the disorder with delayed diagnosis may cause irrecoverable damage to the brain and the nervous system. The present study aims to predict the onset of cerebral stroke through non-invasive load cell sensors and strain gauges. Further, a quantitative estimation of the degree of nerve/muscle weakness was achieved from the contralateral sides of the lower and upper limbs that check the body imbalances through the numerical display. Thus, the designed stroke prediction system could be used as a cost-effective screening system for massive community-based health screening.

articleTitle: Safe Design of Motorcycles Using Fuzzy Logic, Global Navigation Satellite Systems and Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A novel device and algorithm were created for the early detection of two-wheeler accidents. It used multiple acceleration sensor, geomagnetic sensor proximity sensors and gyroscope. Combination of GLONASS, GPS, GALILEO, BEIDOU, QZSS and IRNSS was used for more accuracy and reliability. They could also track speed altitude and direction. Various cases were studied for example, going underground and riding in the mountains. Fuzzy logic was used to analyse the most common possible cases. The novel technology can automatically send message to emergency services for example ambulance and fire brigade. Message first went to friends and family. They forwarded the same to emergency services if required. An analysis of extreme cases was made. Analysis of fake positives and fake negatives was done to enhance accuracy. Thus, making rescue faster. Issues of large-scale installation and ease of installation were addressed. The main aim was reducing the suffering of accident victim. Various parameters such as the sudden drop in speed and angle of inclination were used to detect an accident. The device could work even with the engine turned off post-accident. Practical implementation issues were addressed.

articleTitle: Securing the Future of IoT: A Comprehensive Framework for Real-Time Attack Detection and Mitigation in IoT Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Increased security complexity and variety come with IoT devices. Existing security solutions generally fail to handle multiple difficulties, particularly in real-time attack detection and response. This research introduces a novel, comprehensive architecture that synergistically incorporates various cutting-edge security measures to protect IoT networks from all cyber threats. The proposed framework incorporates NodeMCU ESP8266-based real-time response, safe boot, hardware-based security modules, and zero trust architecture. It recommends incorporating blockchain for security, real-time logging and monitoring, machine learning-assisted intrusion detection, and indicators of compromise (IOCs) for incident response. For improved malware analysis and threat mitigation, integration of APIs for smooth communication with third-party services such as VirusTotal and Hybrid Analyzer is suggested. This paper also discusses data encryption, updates and patching, identity and access management, risk assessment and threat modelling, incident response and recovery, and privacy. This holistic approach to IoT security provides a robust, flexible, and scalable framework to address the changing threat landscape and growing complexity of IoT ecosystems. The proposed methodology defends IoT networks against sophisticated cyberattacks through careful analysis and empirical validation. In an increasingly interconnected world, this research could be useful for practitioners, academics, and stakeholders aiming to strengthen IoT infrastructure resilience.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach to Point Labeling Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The point feature labeling problem is a very wellknown problem where a set P = {p<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, p<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, •••, p<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>} of point sites are given along with their labels. The objective is to maximize the number of labels for points on the map so that no two placed labels are mutually overlapping. Here, we investigate a special class of the point site labeling problem where the label of a point p<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf> touches the point either at one of its four corners (Corner model) or at the middle of one of its 4 edges (Middle Edge model). We assumed that only the height (but not the length) of the labels of all the points are same. This maximum point site labeling problem is known to be NP-hard. We first provided an $O(n\sqrt n )$ heuristic solution for point labeling in the Middle Edge model. On analysing the benchmarks, we felt the need of applying labeling solution simultaneously in Corner model and Middle Edge model for any problem instance. We thus provided an integrated approach for the point labeling problem in two models together. Experimental result show significant improvement (14%) in the number of points being labeled in our integrated approach compared to the existing Corner model of labeling. Our solution for Middle Edge model always take less time than the Corner model, and it also provides a nice trade-off between the solution quality and the runtime across two models.

articleTitle: Analysis of Underlying Emotions in Textual Data Using Sentiment Analysis Which Classifies Text In to Positive, Negative or Neutral Sentiments
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Analysis of underlying emotions in textual data can provide important insights and has been the focus of much research. Sentiment analysis is a popular technique which classifies text into positive, negative or neutral sentiments based on polarity and subjectivity. But this fails to extract actual emotions represented by text. This can be achieved by analyzing the occurrence of particular words, symbols and emojis in text. For emotion classification, machine-learning and deep-learning techniques Peng et al.(2022) are also used. These models classify textual data into only a small subset of the broad spectrum of emotions. Subtle variations such as "disappointment" and "grief" are lost and text is simply classified into "sadness". Extracting such subtle emotions from texts present some unique problems as one single sentence may represent multiple related emotions. Thus we have explored various Deep learning models based on convolution Neural NetworkO’Shea and Nash (2015) and Long Short Term Memory Staudemeyer and Morris (2019) for classifying textual data into one or more of 27 different fine grained emotions.

articleTitle: OCR based Tapal (Postal Service) System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
