abstract: Tapal are letters that are sent and received for official purposes. They are usually used between various government agencies or among higher authorities. Currently, the entire procedure is carried out physically. A register contains the data linked to Tapal, such as sender, receiver, subject, recipient department, etc. Consequently, the activity becomes tiresome and challenging to handle as a result of manual processing. The information cannot be immediately accessed. Therefore, this process may be digitized to simplify the administration of registers and can also be utilized for data analysis. The texts on the covers of received letters must first be scanned using OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology for this automated system. Additionally, the automated system will improve data analysis by making the information easily accessible for further analysis. Also, the automated system will improve the speed of processing Tapal letters, ensuring that they are handled in a timely and efficient manner. Finally, by implementing an automated system, government agencies can streamline the process of handling Tapal letters, making it faster, more accurate, and more efficient, leading to better decision-making, improved communication, and more effective governance.

articleTitle: Uplink MU-MIMO Systems with Low Complexity ZF and MMSE Detectors for Time-Varying Active Users
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The foundation of traditional multi-user detection (MUD) techniques like Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) receivers and Zero-forcing is the consistent and well-known presence of present users (ZF). The receiver could experience a significant performance loss if it doesn't react quickly to changes in the number of active users. The difficulties of automating the evaluation of the well-known ZF and MMSE detectors for MU-MIMO systems with a time-varying channel user density are examined in this study. This will offer a low-performance, simple calculation method. The matrix inverses needed by the Minimal Mean Square Error (MMSE) and Zero-forcing (ZF) detectors are not computed directly in the offered solutions. Additionally, to evaluate the performance losses brought on by the employment of ZF, the outcomes of Monte-Carlo simulations are used.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-Band Ā-Shaped Patch Antenna for 5G at 27/34 GHz using FR4/RT duroid Material
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The present paper presents an innovative structure for an A rectangular shape Microstrip Patchy Antennas (RMPA) that is energised by microstrip lines and fine-tuned for deployment across the Ku/Ka and 5G technological frequencies spectra. The slotted configuration of the antenna endows it with a broader bandwidth, thereby rendering it versatile for deployment across a gamut of applications such as 5G communication, wireless and serviced communications via satellite, radiolocation, radionavigation, and research in space. Specifically, the antenna is optimised for the frequency range of 28-34 GHz. The antenna under consideration has been fashioned utilising a substrate material composed of FR4 and Rogers RT6202, possessing a permittivity with a relative value of 4.4 and 2.94, respectively. The substrate has a thickness that is 1.6 mm. The simulation of the slotted RMPA has been conducted through the utilisation of the advanced microwave studio CST 2022 software. The outcomes of this simulation have been meticulously scrutinised and deliberated upon. The designed antenna operates between 28 and 34 GHz with a return loss of below -10 dB and a VSWR of less than 2. The implications of this observation indicate that the antenna exhibits a high degree of compatibility with 5G connectivity, communication through satellites, and other programmes in the Ku/Ka bands of frequencies. The antenna's condensed configuration renders it a compelling option for assimilation into diverse communication frameworks.

articleTitle: Remotely Controlled Electronic Noticeboard Using NodeMCU
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today's digital age, traditional notice boards are being replaced by more dynamic and interactive solutions. This research paper presents the design and implementation of a remotely controlled notice board using the NodeMCU ESP8266 microcontroller and an 8x8 matrix display. The system allows users to remotely update and display messages or notifications in real-time, enhancing communication efficiency and flexibility. By leveraging the capabilities of the NodeMCU ESP8266 and the visual output of the 8x8 matrix display, this solution offers an innovative approach to notice board management. The paper discusses the hardware and software components, the communication protocol, and explores the potential applications of this technology in various settings such as educational institutions, offices, and public spaces. The findings demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed solution and emphasize its significance in improving communication processes. This research also highlights potential future enhancements and expansions, paving the way for further advancements in the field of remotely controlled notice boards.

articleTitle: Network Analysis and Throughput Estimation for MmWave Communication in an Autonomous Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Vehicular communication has numerous advantageous features including autonomy safety, communication skills with other vehicle or pedestrian or an infrastructure. mmWave communication in a type of wireless communication which comes under the 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> generation of wireless communication (5G), hat uses high frequencies ranges from 30 to 300 GHz, which is mainly known for its high data rates and very low latency. In this paper, using mmWave technology, how it can be used to communicate in a limited spectral boundary and pass the information to the neighboring vehicles for enhancements of vehicular safety. At present, the most common sensor used in vehicles is automotive radars and visual cameras and ultrasonic sensors. The major challenge associated with these sensors are limited sensing range (360 degree of view, low-light situation, communication with the infrastructure, etc.) and the limited ability to share the crucial situation with the neighboring cars. The vehicle connectivity has two potential benefits – firstly, if a suitable carrier frequency is chosen then cars can communicate in non-line-of sight conditions. Secondly, if a higher bandwidth is implemented, it can increase the data rate transmission between the vehicles, by which an "Intelligent connected autonomous vehicle" (ICAVs) can be created. The major advantage of the ICAVs is that they can work independently and train themselves in avoiding vehicle accidents caused by human errors. The simulation was illustrated with the help "Network Simulator -3" (NS-3) in ubuntu software. Five scenarios are taken, explain the possible V2V communication between the vehicles. The carrier frequency taken for consideration in 70GHz and a bandwidth of 100 GHz. The throughput was also calculated using NetSim tool by varying the distance between the base station and user equipment.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Clustering Protocols for WSN Assisted IoT Network
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) links several capabilities in a broad sensing domain, including sensing, communication, networking, or cloud computing. Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is the most appropriate infrastructure for Internet of Things apps to analyze the network. These networks suffer from drawbacks of excessive energy consumption. Energy-efficient Cluster Head (CH) algorithms are created with the goal of improving the lifespan of sensor nodes used for sensing. This research paper analyzes three clustering based protocols namely Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy Protocol (LEACH), Gravitation search optimization and Firefly Optimization and discusses their performance in detail. They have been simulated in MATLAB and their performance was analyzed following which Firefly optimization was found to be better among the all in terms of network lifetime and throughput.

articleTitle: Person Image Generation To Enhance The Input Training Image For Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The process of recognizing a person from photos or videos taken with a different camera is called re-identification (reID). In today’s world, the widespread use of extensive networks of CCTV and security cameras makes it difficult for a human operator to trace a person. This is where re-identification technology comes into play. However, person re-identification in real-world applications is very challenging due to the size of the existing dataset, the lack of human motions, and the inability to supply enough training samples. In this paper, proposed a method for person image generation using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). GANs allow us to build additional person images that look as realistic as possible.

articleTitle: AI-powered Chatbot for Improved Customer Feedback Management using NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has revolutionized the way businesses operate and make decisions. One of the key areas that AI has made a significant impact on is feedback management. With the help of AI, businesses can now analyze reviews in real-time, uncovering valuable insights that were previously hidden, and drive growth. In this paper, we have presented numerous ways by which we have worked towards analyzing data received by a paper manufacturing and distribution company and maximizing their profits. Here we have described our approach for developing a smart chatbot in extensive detail. With the help of Natural Language Processing, we have been able to classify the customer enquiry comments into 12 unique classes with 91.35% accuracy using Gradient Boosting Classification model. Furthermore, we employed the Random Forest Algorithm, Support Vector Machines, K Nearest Neighbors, and the Decision Tree Algorithm to make predictions based on the text data and have compared their performances.

articleTitle: Urban Mobility: Leveraging AI, Machine Learning, and Data Analytics for Smart Transportation Planning- A case study on New York City
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper explores the utilization of AI, machine learning, and data analytics for smart transportation planning to achieve sustainable urban mobility. The study aims to address two key research questions: (1) How can these advanced technologies be leveraged to optimize urban transportation systems? (2) What are the potential benefits associated with their implementation? The research methodology involves collecting relevant transportation data and applying statistical analysis techniques to uncover patterns and correlations. Additionally, a simulation model is developed and calibrated using real-world data to evaluate different transportation scenarios. Performance evaluation metrics, such as travel time, congestion levels, and environmental impact, are employed to assess the effectiveness of the strategies. The findings of this research demonstrate improved transportation efficiency, reduced congestion, and enhanced sustainability in New York City urban areas. However, limitations include data availability, assumptions made during modeling, and the context-specific nature of the results. These findings contribute to evidence-based decision-making in civil engineering, offering valuable insights for stakeholders and urban planners in their efforts toward sustainable urban mobility.

articleTitle: Multi- Noise Reduction Technique Using Triangular Fuzzy Membership Function
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Image noise is a random shift in the brightness or color information in images, and it is sometimes confused with electrical noise. It is an unwanted by-product of image capture that obscures the information that should be seen. De-noising contaminated images through the use of essential image processing technologies in various methods, resulting in the retrieval of lost information to improve and analyze images greatly. A fuzzy-based logic is proposed in this paper as a method for effective image filtering; specifically, it is used to de-noise an image by replacing noisy pixels with non-noisy ones based on the degree of membership of neighboring pixels within a filter mask. Results from experiments show that the triangular fuzzy-based membership filter outperforms competing filters in removing multiple kinds of image noise, including Speckle noise, Gaussian noise, Salt & Paper noise, and Poisson noise.

articleTitle: Big Five and Virtual Reality Marketing Adoption in Morocco: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the recent expansion of Head-mounted virtual reality (VR) screens for consumers, many sectors of industry have begun to recognize the high potential of VR. However, there has been a lack of research into the adoption of VR technology in retail from the perspective of user acceptance. Therefore, the adoption behaviors of users were rigorously analyzed, with the addition of perceived enjoyment (PE) to the basic big five model (BFM). The model has been evaluated by employing a hybrid Partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) with artificial neural network (ANN). The results of this paper indicate that openness to experience (OP), extraversion (EXTRA), agreeableness (AGREA), neuroticism (NR) and PE significantly affect intention to use VR, while no significant effect is reported regarding conscientiousness (CONS). The ANN results showed that OP and EXTRA are the most important factors in predicting intention to use VR in shopping. The paper provides various theoretical contributions and highlights many practical ramifications for the most appropriate marketing approaches for VR technology.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Traffic Lights
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In India's major cities, the average travel time has risen significantly during peak hours. The standard traffic signal operates on a continuous set of commands that are stored in its memory. It does not consider the current traffic conditions. By building AI-based smart traffic lights, information such as the number of vehicles in each lane can be used to switch on/off the signal. This system will assist in clearing congested traffic and shortening commute time. This technological advancement will also benefit emergency vehicles such as ambulances by giving high priority to their lane. This project's main objective is to develop an AI system that will operate the traffic light at the intersection of four roads, each of which has three lanes. The results showed that AI-based traffic signal systems outperformed traditional traffic signal systems. The average vehicle waiting time has been reduced by 42%.

articleTitle: Wireless network for Industrial application using ESP32 as Gateway
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Modern lighting systems in industrial environments harness the potential of IoT technologies and intelligent industry concepts, facilitated by robust WiFi networks. These systems seamlessly incorporate WiFi-enabled LED lighting, intelligent controls, and real-time monitoring capabilities. By capitalizing on the data transmission capabilities of WiFi networks and employing advanced analytics, industries can make informed decisions, implement predictive maintenance strategies, and optimize operational efficiency. The seamless integration with other smart industry components, facilitated by WiFi network connectivity, allows for comprehensive optimization and fosters sustainable practices. Ultimately, these cutting-edge lighting systems establish interconnected workspaces, empowered by WiFi networks, that enhance productivity, improve well-being, and demonstrate a steadfast commitment to environmental stewardship. In this paper WiFi network is design using ESP32 for smart industrial application, All ESP32 node are behaving like Gateway .

articleTitle: A Comparative Sentiment Analysis on ChatGPT Reviews using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a field within natural language processing that seeks to recognize and extract personal and emotional data from textual information, including feelings, viewpoints, and attitudes. Reviews have now turned into an indispensable data source for both consumers and businesses. Analyzing the sentiment of such reviews can offer valuable ideas into customers' likes, contentment, and discontentment. In recent times, Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer (ChatGPT) has paved new paths in the area of Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing. In our work, sentiment of people is analyzed through reviews taken from people of various age groups from different educational backgrounds to understand the efficiency of ChatGPT. A comparative analysis was carried out by using four different machine learning models and two hybrid models using SVM + Decision Tree and Random Forest + Logistic Regression. The survey also analyzed various effects of using ChatGPT and how it contributes in making people lethargic and decreases logical thinking ability and problem-solving skills.

articleTitle: Air-Quality Index Prediction Using Auto Ml Library, TPOT
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Air pollution nowadays is one of the most important causes of severe diseases. Early analysis of air pollution helps us control pollution levels and keep human health at utmost importance. To solve this problem, a real-time model is required to be constructed that can help us solve this air pollution problem. We're studying how we can use a variety of machine learning models for forecasting air quality index 'AQI' in this paper. The data collected by the air quality sensor are taken and averaged to obtain an AQI. The gathered metrics are analysed using automated library TPOT.

articleTitle: AI based parameter estimation of ML model using Hybrid of Genetic Algorithm and Simulated Annealing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this study, parameter estimation of ML models, here specifically, random forest classifier was conducted on a heart disease dataset. We have suggested a new approach to machine learning that hybridizes genetic algorithm with simulated annealing for estimating the hyperparameters of the random forest classifier. The workings of genetic algorithm are modeled after the process of natural selection to evolve a population of candidate solutions towards a better one and solve complex optimization problems effectively. Simulated Annealing is a probabilistic optimization technique, where the solution is iteratively improved by accepting moves that lead to a worse solution with a certain probability, this avoids getting stuck in local optima, and can handle optimization problems with many variables and noise. This application of hybrid optimization helped in increasing the accuracy of the machine learning model by 10% and is very promising in comparison to various different classification methods for this same problem.

articleTitle: Automated Diagnosis of Lumpy Skin Diseases based on Deep Learning Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Lumpy skin disease, a tremendously contagious viral disease of cattle and buffalo caused by a Poxviridae family virus commonly referred to as the Neethling virus, has a low fatality rate. The lumpy skin disease has wreaked havoc throughout India. The lumpy skin disease virus (LSDV) infects cattle with lumpy skin disease (LSD). The tremendous economic impact of LSDV in cattle makes it one of the most important animal poxviruses. As a result, precise detection and classification are crucial in lumpy skin disease therapy to avoid its spread, enable timely treatment, minimize economic losses, and ensure the well-being of affected animals. Numerous research strategies based on traditional machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) have been introduced for LSD detection and categorization. Traditional ML classifiers necessitate hand-crafted features, which is time-consuming. On the contrary, DL is particularly robust in feature extraction and has recently been widely employed for classification and detection. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a model based on the fusion of Resnet-50 and VGG-19 deep learning features to detect lumpy skin disease. The dimension of the feature vector has been reduced by the principal component analysis (PCA). To categorize diseases, this reduced feature is provided as input to different classifiers such as Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and KNN. The performance of the model is evaluated at several phases, and the findings demonstrate that the suggested model outperformed the existing models for lumpy skin classification by obtaining an accuracy of 99%.

articleTitle: Analysis of the smoothing and payload distribution method on reversible audio steganography
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Along with the rampant theft of confidential data, technological security systems are the most important thing in the digitalization era. Data cannot be said to be safe from third parties, even though it is private or confidential when transmitted through the public network. Several studies have proposed methods of hiding data using steganography to improve data confidentiality. However, it still has quality and capacity results that are relatively inversely proportional. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze several methods to determine which can produce the best capacity and quality. The focus of this research is to seek an understanding of some recently proposed methods concerned with the smoothing and payload distribution on reversible audio steganography and provide an overview of methods suitable for use in steganography with maximum capacity and quality results.

articleTitle: Plant Pathology Detection for Massive Heterogeneous Data Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The manual inspection of plant disease is a difficult and time-consuming task that requires expertise in the area of plant pathology which is not always available. Deep learning models have shown significant efficiency in solving image classification problems. They can be used in the field of precision agriculture for disease management tasks. State-of-the-art deep learning models are used in several studies to automatically detect diseases based on the plant leaves symptoms. Most of the studies have been carried out on single or limited plants. In this study large dataset having a total number of 1,02,113 images is created by combining 16 openly available datasets. A comparative performance analysis of three CNN models, ResNet50, MobileNetV2, and InceptionV3 has been carried out after training with the dataset. InceptionV3 has achieved the highest classification accuracy of 0.90. MobileNetV2 has less training time compared to others.

articleTitle: Seven Convolutional Nadam Optimized Deep Convolutional Neural Network based Cucumber Leaf Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The leaves of cucumber plants can develop diseases classified as cucumber leaf diseases. These ailments can reduce cucumber yields significantly and have a detrimental effect on cucumber quality. Powdery mildew, downy mildew, and angular leaf spot are a few typical diseases that affect cucumber leaves. Early detection and timely treatment are essential for the effective management of cucumber leaf diseases, but this can be difficult for farmers without access to specific expertise or tools. With this background, this paper proposes a novel Seven Convolutional Nadam Deep Convolutional Neural Network (7N-DCNN) to forecast the cucumber leaf disease with maximum accuracy. The model utilize the Cucumber leaf dataset retrieved from the KAGGLE machine-learning repository. The Cucumber leaf dataset contains four disease classes as Powdery mildew, downy mildew, and angular leaf spot and Healthy with 2400 cucumber leaf images and preprocessed for improving the image eminence. The proposed 7N-DCNN had implemented with single input, dense, average pooling and output layer. The cucumber leaf dataset was divided into 2000 training photos, 200 validation images, and 200 testing images. For the purpose of evaluating performance indicators, the Cucumber leaf training dataset was applied to the proposed 7N-DCNN model as well as to the VGG, Resnet, MobileNetV2, DenseNet, Inception, Xception, and NASNet Large models. Experimental results shows that the proposed 7N-DCNN shows the maximum accuracy of 98.95%, Precision of 98.32%, Recall of 98.65% and FScore of 98.57% when compared with other existing convolutional neural network models.

articleTitle: Software Effort Estimation using Multi-objective Binary Rao Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Software effort estimation depends on the standard of features that are considered. Considering irrelevant features will effect the model by degrading its performance. Most Research studies focus on Single Objective optimization for feature selection. A Multi-Objective Binary Rao Algorithm for Feature Selection is proposed in this work to estimate software development effort. We have validated the performance of proposed approach using four bench mark datasets and compared with single objective Binary Rao algorithm and NSGA-II algorithm. It is observed that our approach is able to provide better performance than the compared models.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Multi-Filtering Techniques on Comprehensibility Improvement of Spaghetti Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: While approaching the process enhancement, discovery algorithms become the initial step with event-log-driven techniques. Process discovery techniques work with the aim of finding a model from the logs that can accurately describe the observed behaviour. The process model’s fitness increases with the amount of data it can capture. However, due to the very complex event log, the resulting output is a complex web-like unstructured model, also known as the spaghetti model. Resolving this into a simple model, also known as the lasagna model, is critical to the process model’s comprehensibility. Range filtering is one of the methods suggested to address the issue with unstructured models. In this paper, we evaluate the efficacy of a multi-range filtering technique for improving the comprehensibility of the spaghetti model. We utilize a Python-based library to evaluate multirange filtering on BPI challenge 2013 and clinical dataset. Process conformance is measured using various quality measures such as fitness, precision, generalization, and simplicity by applying alpha, inductive, and heuristic mining algorithms. The analysis suggests that multi-range filtering techniques produce models that can significantly vary in quality and deviate from generally perceived notions about these algorithms. We conclude that data preprocessing, like cohort analysis, would be helpful before applying any filtering technique. Furthermore, region-based mining algorithms may provide a lossless way to improve comprehensibility.

articleTitle: Comparing Different Sequences of Pruning Algorithms for Hybrid Pruning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Most developers face two significant issues while designing the architecture of a neural network. First, the available dataset for many real-life problems is relatively small, leading to overfitting. Second, When a dataset is large enough, the computation cost to train the model on a given dataset is enormous. Thus most developers use transfer learning with a standard model like VGGNet, ResNet, and GoogleNet. These standard models are memory and computationally expensive during inference, making them infeasible to deploy on resource-constrained devices. The recent research trend is to compress the standard model used for transfer learning to reduce memory and computing costs. In CNN, approximately 10% parameters are present in the convolution layer, contributing to 90% of computational cost, while 90% parameters are present in dense, contributing 10% of computational cost. This paper focuses on the structure pruning of parameters in the convolution layer to reduce computational costs. Here we explore and compare the following pruning technique, 1) Channel pruning with a quantitative score, 2) Kernel pruning with a quantitative score, 3) Channel pruning with a similarity score, and 4) Kernel pruning with a similarity score. Finally, as mentioned earlier, we try several combinations of pruning to form a hybrid pruning.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Tweets during Covid-19 Lockdown in India
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis has become most important and most popular field of natural language processing(NLP). Emotions can be extracted out of text using sentiment analysis. Everyone is using social media to receive and communicate different information on a big scale during COVID-19. The evaluation of such type of content is helpful for decision maker authorities. In this work, the sentiments of Indians during Lockdown are analysed using NLP and Machine Learning models. Tweepy API is used to extract data from Twitter and annotation is done using TextBlob and VADER libraries. Data preprocessing is done using NLTK. The experimental results show that Ensemble model with unigram has good performance. After analysing the sentiments of Indians, it is found that major people are in favour of lockdown decision made by the Indian government.

articleTitle: Maze Solver: A Federated Reinforcement Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today’s era where Machine Learning and Deep Learning are household names and Artificial intelligence is rapidly evolving people are neglecting a basic issue in this type of setting the privacy issue. The Machine Learning and Deep Learning models need a large amount of data to train and while they use the data from the internet, they also use the data collected from the users. All the data used for the training of such models are saved on a single server prone to lots of cyber-attacks such as SQL injection, DDOS, Data leakage, etc.… In order to solve this issue in 2016 Google released a new way to train a Machine Learning or Deep Learning model this approach is known as the Federated Learning letter Google implemented the same framework on a Google Keyboard to create a next-word prediction model without saving any user data on their central server. This framework proved to be a privacy-preserving as well as performance-boosting framework. In order to harness the power of multiple IOTs and edge devices in rather computational resources-hungry tasks such as reinforcement learning researchers started to move the focus to Federated Reinforcement Learning. In this research work an implementation of Q learning a reinforcement learning technique is done in a Federated Environment. Letter the results from both Q learning and Federated Q Learning are compared and analyzed to find out the advantages Federated Reinforcement Learning has over centralized Q Learning or any reinforcement Learning technique.

articleTitle: Anomaly-based Intrusion Detection System for ICS
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Industrial Control Systems (ICS) become a crucial target for hackers as these devices are unsupported in terms of storage, complex computations, and security. On the other hand, providing security for these devices are very difficult. Because small downtime of these devices will lead to financial loss and reputation loss for the industry. Sometimes, even it may lead to a disaster. We should also ensure that there are no heavy workloads present in this Operational Technology (OT) network. Hence, the intrusion detection systems for ICS should operate with high levels of accuracy utilizing resources as low as possible. In this paper, an anomaly-based ICS intrusion detection system is proposed. The proposed model uses Pearson Correlation for feature selection and Deep Neural Network for detection. The suggested solution is put to the test using an HIL-based Augmented ICS security dataset. The results show that the proposed model has a good fit and achieves a higher accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction Techniques for Deep Learning based Speech Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The process of classifying audio data into several classes or categories is referred to as audio classification. The purpose of speaker recognition, one particular use of audio classification, is to recognize a person based on the characteristics of their speech. The phrase "voice recognition" refers to both speaker and speech recognition tasks. Speaker verification systems have grown significantly in popularity recently for a variety of uses, such as security measures and individualized help. Computers that have been taught to recognize individual voices can swiftly translate speech or confirm a speaker’s identification as part of a security procedure by identifying the speaker. Four decades of research have gone into speaker recognition, which is based on the acoustic characteristics of speech that differ from person to person. Some systems use auditory input from those seeking entry, just like fingerprint sensors match input fingerprint markings with a database or photographic attendance systems map inputs to a database. Personal assistants, like Google Home, for example, are made to limit access to those who have been given permission. Even under difficult circumstances, these systems must correctly identify or recognize the speaker. This research proposes a strong deep learning-based speaker recognition solution for audio categorization. We suggest self-augmenting the data utilizing four key noise aberration strategies to improve the system’s performance. Additionally, we conduct a comparison study to examine the efficacy of several audio feature extractors. The objective is to create a speaker identification system that is extremely accurate and can be applied in practical situations.

articleTitle: Vehicle Number Plate Detection using YoloV8 and EasyOCR
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The number of vehicles on the roads is increasing in proportion to the economic revolution and economic growth. Using a large number of vehicles will increase violations of the law, cause accidents and lead to crime. Traffic flow monitoring is needed to overcome these problems. Intelligent machines can play an important role in traffic management by identifying the bus. In this research study, a project has been developed for license detection and recognition utilizing convolutional neural network (CNN) which is a deep learning method.The system consists of two parts: License area verification and license characters verification. During the search, images of the vehicle were recorded on digital cameras. The system then distributes the license area of the image frame. After removing the trace area, a method is adopted to convert the low image to high image. This technique is used with CNN layers to rebuild the quality of pixels of the input image. Segment each character on the board using the bounding box. In the recognition process, CNN technology is used for extraction and classification.

articleTitle: Prediction of Global Sea Water Level using Linear Regression and Gradient Descent
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A sea level graph was published online in April 2022. "Climate Change: Global Sea Level" seems to be the current name for it. However, it contains little to no anchoring in provable facts. This paper examines a real-world situation. Real worldwide sea level fluctuations range from 0.0 mm/year to +1.0 mm/year on an international scale. The average global sea level has increased by 21 to 24 centimetres (8 to 9 inches) since 1880, according to measurements made from 1880 to 2013. In this study, we are developing models to forecast future seawater levels at the global sea level. In addition, we can observe the significantly rising sea level since the year 2000. The models are developed using JupyterLab Simulation Software, which is combined with the Python programming language to produce a graphic user interface (GUI). The results of the simulation show that the water level of the global sea will keep rising in the years to come. The study’s findings indicate that up until the year 2050, the global sea level will continue to change.

articleTitle: Advanced Powerplanning Strategy Utilising Aprisa - Image Edge Detector
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A good powerplanning is a must to provide power to every macro, standard cell and other cells in the design.With the advancement in technology and the chip sizes reducing day by day we need faster RTL to GDS flow for the design of a chip , so powerplanning being a part of this stage should not take major part of time in the full flow design so we need to switch to automated approach of powerplanning rather than a Conventional one (which is time consuming as the chip sizes get smaller and smaller).A good powerplanning and that also done in less time has great benefits in the routing stage for the design.The design of an Image Edge Detector is done using the library and liberty files of 90 nm technology node. In a Conventional power ground (PG) script various parameter challenges are to be faced and in order to find them ,it is a hectic task. Thus to overcome this challenge of runtime and complexity issues related with the Conventional PG scripting,we have come up with the Auto power ground (PG) script approach. In this approach we write a script which focuses on just 4 parameters i.e width,group step,siblings number and siblings step majorly for the powerplanning of the design.We find the DRCs related with the design using Conventional PG is 5.9 lakhs compared to the count of just 148 for Auto PG. Whereas the IR drop for VDD is 1.44% for Conventional PG and 1.27% for Auto PG, also for Ground net the IR bounce is 4.18% for Conventional PG and 3.75% for Auto PG.

articleTitle: Swguard: Mitigating Flow Rule Modification Attack in P4 Switches
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A Flow table is used to process the packets in P4 switches. The Flow table in P4 switches is prone to attacks, which leads to poor packet processing behavior and network monitoring. Unfortunately, runtime verification of Flow rule modification in a network is a challenging task. This letter proposes, SwGuard: a P4-driven solution for Flow rule modification attack detection and mitigation mechanism in a switch. Typically, SwGuard keeps track of the packet_in request sent to the controller to detect and mitigate the attack by blocking the attacker’s interface. Our solution was implemented using BMv2 switches, improved the packet dropping rate to 70%, and reduced the controller overhead by 31.4%.

articleTitle: Water Quality Prediction using AWS
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The management of water resources is a crucial issue for humanity as scarce natural water resources including lakes, streams, and estuaries are getting depleted. The pollution caused by human and industrial waste on these water resources has far reaching consequences. Hence, real time water quality prediction is essential in addressing the after effects of water contamination. Although this issue has been well studied, additional attention is to be drawn related to various factors like efficacy, dependability, accuracy, and evaluate current water quality management practices. This work makes use of cloud based storage and data analytic services such as Amazon SageMaker, simple storage service and API gateway in order to predict the water quality. The main objective of this work is to create a water quality prediction model using the dataset and deploy the model to predict.

articleTitle: Optimization of Parameters for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The altitude at which an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) is deployed has a great impact on the coverage range and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in 5G communication systems. The optimum value for height of UAV and sum of SNRs are found using the proposed algorithms. In this paper, the obtained results show that, with the increase in UAV altitude there will be an increase in path loss of the signal which leads to a lower SNR. However, a higher altitude may provide a better line of sight to the ground user and reduce the impact of obstacles which results in improved communication performance. This paper also gives valuable insights about the effects of height variation in UAV communications which helps in the design of 5G communication systems using UAVs.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach for Enhancing Traffic Signal Control with Computer Vision and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The surge in traffic density has exceeded the capacity of current traffic signal management techniques. The existing traffic management technique is to change the traffic signal on a fixed interval according to a predefined sequence. Such a predefined sequence doesn’t take into consideration the various parameters of real-world traffic intersections such as real-time traffic, lane capacity, and pedestrian density. If the aforementioned variables are considered when switching the traffic signal, the waiting time for vehicles at intersections can be greatly reduced. In recent research, technologies such as object identification and deep learning have been put to the test to develop a traffic management system that does not overlook the above-mentioned parameters of an intersection. However, most existing research and implementation either employ a single technology or partially combine many techniques. Furthermore, several studies attempt to reinvent object-detecting methods that have already proven themselves. In order to accurately represent real-world traffic intersections and optimize vehicle flow through them, we have suggested a method that combines Reinforcement Learning (RL) with already-developed object detection and tracking algorithms.

articleTitle: Radio Frequency Energy Harvesting Rectenna System for Ultra-Low Power IoT Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper deals with the simulation and optimization of a Radio Frequency (RF) energy harvesting rectenna (Antenna + Rectifier) system for ultra-low power Internet of Things (IoT) sensors. Keysight Agilent Technologies Advanced Design System software is selected to simulate and optimize the rectenna system. The performance of the Villard single-stage voltage multiplier circuit has been studied with matching and without impedance matching. The GSM 900 frequency band serves as the RF input source to the rectenna system. The proposed rectenna system operates at 950 MHz. At -10 dBm, RF input power at rectenna without impedance matching the output voltage and RF to DC conversion efficiency obtained was 0.3 V and 38 %. At -10 dBm RF input power, the rectenna with impedance matching the output voltage and RF to DC conversion efficiency obtained was 1.15 V and 72 %. The resistance of 25kΩ acts as a load for computing RF to DC conversion efficiency and output voltage. The enhanced rectenna operates at low RF input after impedance matching.

articleTitle: Prediction of Chronic Liver Cirrhosis Using Ensemble Classification Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Liver cirrhosis is a chronic and irreversible condition where the liver tissue is replaced by scar tissue. It is a critical condition that can create potential life-threatening complications. Liver cirrhosis is primarily seen in patients who consume excessive alcohol or have been infected with viral hepatitis. There is no cure for liver cirrhosis, but treatments can help manage the symptoms and complications. In few medical cases where the treatment process is insufficient, a liver transplant is recommended. As it is a life-threatening disease, it must be treated soon at the possible earliest. There are numerous machine learning algorithms like Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest (RF),k nearest neighbor(KNN) etc., are very much useful in the prediction of diseases. Among these machine learning algorithms, the proposed project has used an ensemble classification approach called ‘Extra Trees Classifier’ that has outperformed them in terms of accuracy by showing remarkable 92% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Single Image Super-Resolution Network with Enhanced Octave Convolution for Separating Image Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning-based algorithms for image super-resolution (SR) have been increasingly thriving. However, in most existing algorithms, the model takes the whole low-resolution (LR) image as input and treats the low-frequency (LF) and high-frequency (HF) contents in the image equally. Considering the nature of Bicubic down-sampling, which is the most used degradation in SR models, high-resolution (HR) and LR images share the most part of the LF in the image while differing in HF. To this end, this paper proposes a model that separates frequencies in the image with an enhanced octave convolution (EOctConv) layer. EOctConv applies channel attention to highlight HFs in the image while considering the relation between the weighted HFs with LFs, respectively. Separating image frequencies not only eases the learning of the relation between LR and HR images, it can significantly enable the model to focus most of the computation on recovering the lost details. The proposed model incorporates significantly fewer numbers of parameters which is indeed a remarkable factor to considerably reduce the computation time and complexity yet compares favorably with recent results in literature qualitatively and quantitatively on benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: Review on Air Pollution Monitoring using AI
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Air pollution could be a major issue influencing not as it were the environment but moreover wellbeing of human due to contamination and it can cause respiratory issues such as heart infections and indeed cancer. It too hurts encompassing and environments which causes contaminated discuss in various, counting transportation, industry, and common occasions like fierce blazes and tidy storms. Tending to discuss contamination require a multifaceted approach that incorporates lessening destructive substances from industry and transportation, advancing vitality sources which is renewable, and actualizing arrangements and directions that prioritize open wellbeing and natural assurance. As a society, we must take quick activity to address discuss contamination and work towards a cleaner, more beneficial future for all. articleTitle: Machine Learning Technique to Assess the Clearance of a Satellite Launch Vehicle Lift Off for a Measured Wind
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Day of launch wind biasing strategy is followed for satellite launch vehicle missions to reduce loads acting on the vehicle and to minimize the control force requirements. For this purpose prevailing wind at the launch site is measured very close to launch (T-1hr) and the launch vehicle trajectory is designed considering the wind. Multiple Rigid body, Flexible body, and Monte Carlo simulations are carried out for evaluating the launch clearance for the prevailing wind and for the newly designed trajectory. This work aims to develop machine learning (ML) models, to predict a GO/NO-GO for launch by taking the Day of launch (DOL) measured wind as input. This work serves as a proof-of-concept on how ML models captures the intelligence of various mission sub-systems performance analysis. As ML models are data driven, large set of measured/ synthesized winds that inherently has the signature that lead to launch clearance or no clearance was collected /generated for the typical launch vehicle. Different ML, Deep Neural Network (DNN) and hybrid models under supervised settings have been applied on the data. This paper describes the various ML models developed and the results and its comparison.

articleTitle: Long-Range Stealth Mode Wi-Fi Surveillance and Interception System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ubiquitous presence of the Internet in all aspects is a necessary component of modern-day living. It is very easy to access the Internet through free public Wi-Fi, which can be found in various places such as malls, restaurants, cafes, and hotels. Public Wi-Fi hotspots play a dominant role in many illegal activities on the Internet. Monitoring and eavesdropping systems are required to sure veil users on the network and sniff their data traffic. A Wi-Fi surveillance system is used to intercept traffic between a user and the Wi-Fi access point (AP). Such systems are used by law enforcement agencies to spy on the data of criminal suspects while they are connected to Wi-Fi networks. Existing systems that have hitherto been commercially available, can operate within a few feet of the operator to the target and are large in size. This impacts portability, making the operator more vulnerable to attacks by suspects or unable to connect devices to Wi-Fi or the chance of suspects getting evaded. In this research, we build an interception system using Wi-Fi Pineapple, which can create rogue APs by scanning distant Wi-Fi networks with custom directional antennas and intercepting traffic from targets.

articleTitle: Designing Graphene Based Perfect Absorber Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Graphene has been extensively researched for different application for various application because of the plethora of interesting properties it exhibits including electrical, thermal, and mechanical properties. One such field of its application is graphene-based metamaterial. In this work, we have first generated the dataset for training the machine learning by doing multiple simulations on COMOSL Multiphysics then the generated dataset has been used to train different ML algorithm like Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, K-Nearest Neighbor and Decision Tree. Based on its R2 value we selected the best performing algorithm and used it to perform different machine learning based analysis.

articleTitle: An IOT based Model for Monitoring Health Parameters using Arduino Mega
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In smart healthcare, the use of technology in monitoring real-time health parameters, as well as remotely attending patients is desirable. The inability to monitor patients in real-time may causes delays in the diagnosis and treatment planning of the patient. Wearable devices including smartwatches and fitness trackers may track some of vital signs. But they are limited to certainly few parameters. They are also fairly expensive and not-feasible by the deprived. The lack of physicians in remote areas further deuterate the situation. To address the problems-on-hand, we suggest an Internet of Things (IoT) based model using Arduino Mega for monitoring different health parameters, such as: heart-beat rate, blood oxygen level, temperature, heart rhythm as Electrocardiogram (ECG), etc. The model is designed on an Arduino Mega board connected to different sensors for obtaining the health parameters. It is further connected to cloud subsystem through IoT server for monitoring the real-time health parameters from remote location. The model is tested with multiple persons of different age with different health conditions. The test results show the efficacy of the suggested IoT based healthcare monitoring system.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Based Controllers for Dynamical Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Designing controllers for dynamical system poses a challenge, as besides keeping in mind the changing state and input conditions, another secondary objective of either minimizing the cost function or maximizing the reward must be kept in mind. While most modern methods require a model of the system, this paper proposes a reinforcement learning based method which is model free. Under reinforcement learning, the Q-learning algorithm has been used. This algorithm is apt for state spaces with discrete states and actions. Here, Q-Learning is applied to discrete-time linear systems with the intention of finding the policy which is optimal. The environment is broken into discrete states and the actions are defined as well. This paper delves into the design of a Q-learning framework and working out a reward function that helps a system with the given dynamics in behaving optimally. The results obtained from the simulation are shown in order to assess the efficacy of the algorithm that is being developed.

articleTitle: Pothole Detection on Roads using Image Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The importance of road infrastructure for society could be compared with the importance of blood vessels for humans. To ensure road surface quality, it should be monitored continuously and repaired as and when necessary. One of the major problems in developing countries is the maintenance of roads. Over 95% of the people use road transportation in India. Due to this peak usage of road transports, there are many possibilities of potholes on roads which lead to accidents. Potholes are an unavoidable obstacle that every motorist in India faces mainly during the rainy season. To solve this problem, various techniques have been implemented ranging from manual reporting to authorities to the use of Image processing techniques. In manual reporting, the detection of potholes present on the road will only be monitored by some government officers and it will consume more time to detect for the specified area and have more complexity and waste of energy. In the proposed method, the Raspberry Pi, Pi Camera, GPS module and OpenCV library are used to detect the pothole. The Raspberry Pi is connected serially to the GPS and it connects the google map over cloud internet. Once a pothole is identified, the captured image of the pothole and the geographic location, that is, the longitude and the latitude of the region will be sent to the concerned government authorities mail. The authorities can see the image and go through the location of the detected pothole in the google maps by accessing the document attached along with the mail. Also, simultaneously the google map will get updated according to the information gained.

articleTitle: Abstractive Multi-Document Summarization: Exploiting Maximal Marginal Relevance and Pretrained Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The increasing demand for effective multi-document summarization (MDS) due to the rapid expansion of information availability has triggered this investigation. Focused on the fusion of Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) with pretrained models, we circumvented the often-cumbersome fine-tuning process, and introduced a novel methodology. We applied this to various text datasets like Multi-News and WCEP, and it resulted in significant improvement of ROUGE scores, illustrating promising results. For example, the ROUGE-1 score of our method on the Multi-News dataset was 46.23, and the ROUGE-1 score on the WCEP dataset was 30.74.In this discussion, the research implications, including better n-gram optimization and model selection strategies, were brought forward. This study had substantial implications for natural language processing, propelling us toward more advanced text summarization applications, presenting potential avenues for future research, such as refining the role of n-grams in summaries and optimizing model selection processes.

articleTitle: Empirical Mode Decomposition Techniques: A Simulated Review
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Empirical mode decomposition, better known by its acronym EMD, has developed into a scale-based modal decomposition technique that is increasingly scale-based as well as adaptive, versatile, and multipurpose. The EMD algorithm’s ability to detect both the upper and lower envelopes is undoubtedly its most valuable feature. The determination of the sizes of the envelopes comes with a significant amount of additional computational work. In recent years, several different algorithms have been suggested as potential improvements to the EMD method that would make it faster and more effective. The purpose of this research is to present a picture of the development of empirical mode decomposition approaches that is both comprehensive and easy to understand.

articleTitle: Detecting Public Hate Sentiment Using Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research explores the application of deep learning techniques, specifically BERT and DistilBERT models, for detecting public hate sentiment in text data. Through a systematic analysis of the literature and a thorough understanding of the subject matter, we developed a groundbreaking method that leverages the power of these advanced models. Extensive experimentation and evaluation were conducted using a carefully curated dataset, employing techniques such as tokenization, padding, and truncating for preprocessing. The results demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, achieving high accuracy and precision in identifying and classifying hate sentiment. This research contributes to the field of natural language processing and provides valuable insights for effectively addressing and mitigating hate speech in online platforms.

articleTitle: Malicious URL Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Phishing costs Internet users a lot of money every single year. It means taking advantage of user-side vulnerabilities, which are susceptible to such assaults. The phishing issue is severe, and there isn't just one way to reduce everything. Several strategies are used to address security flaws successfully. By using various methods, we analyze URLs by extracting their features. We evaluate these different URL properties using machine learning approaches and algorithms. In this paper, an outline of these strategies is provided.

articleTitle: Analysis of Radio Specifications in an Adaptive Enhanced Range Dual-Mode Communication System for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs)
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents and analyzes a low-cost adaptive dual-mode communication system for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). The system includes both a high data-rate mode for transmitting in applications like real-time video streaming, and a high range mode for extending the distance the UAVs can travel while still being connected with the ground station. In addition, an improved antenna pattern is analysed to extend the communication range beyond what is achieved by existing networks. Moreover, the average power consumption of the two mode system is optimized by selecting the lower-power mode whenever high data-rates are not needed, eliminating any unnecessary wasted power.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Employee Feedback Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Emotional analysis is the disclosure of data on products that aids a company in comprehending the public's perceptions of its product, product, or service. The goal of this work is to develop an emotional analysis model that aids in identifying positive and negative emotions in the textual reviews provided by the CMR Institute of Technology, Bangalore. The polarity is compared using the Python-based Text Blob and Vader sentiment analyzers. For evaluation, a variety of machine learning techniques are applied. A thorough evaluation of the college's success will be possible with the aid of the intellectual response analysis.

articleTitle: Fuzzy System based Weights for Energy Detection in Cognitive Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: VANET is an ad-hoc network in which vehicles are connected over a wireless medium which is allocated 75MHz of bandwidth for vehicular communications. The present radio channels designated for VANET applications are a result of advancements made in wireless applications for vehicles. There are seven channels in the spectrum each with 10MHz bandwidth which are prone to congestion when numerous vehicles are aiming for the common medium. Cognitive Radio technology has been a promising solution which can improve the performance of vehicular communications. In cognitive radio network, a transceiver can discern between channels that are actively being used and those that are not. Unlicensed users can utilize the channels when there are holes in the licensed spectrum by performing spectrum sensing. Spectrum sensing in vehicular networks has many challenges, including the high mobility of cars, the existence of obstacles, shadowing effect, and the dynamic nature of the transmission medium. As a solution to these problems, a weight-based energy detection method has been proposed that makes use of a fuzzy inference system which is used for calculating weights in decision-making circumstances when the input data is uncertain or imprecise. The SNR, vehicle’s distance from PU, time, and vehicle’s speed are the parameters considered in the fuzzy system. These weights are used with the local choice made by vehicles to define the channel state more precisely. Each parameter is defined in the fuzzy system using membership functions which generates output weight value based on the reliable conditions. The simulation results produced using Matlab demonstrated improved detection performance over local spectrum sensing.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Biological Spiking Neuron Models for Classification Task
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) have shown promising result in many applications, but if compared with biological neural networks (BNNs) it still lags behind in many ways. By exploiting biological plausible neurons, spiking neural networks(SNNs) works to fill the void between ANNs and BNNs. In the field of machine learning, the spiking neural network has gained significant attention due to its potential for achieving high-performance computing with low power consumption. In this study, a comparative analysis of different biological spiking neurons for a classification task of handwritten digits from MNIST dataset has been presented. Specifically, the performance of four different neuron models has been compared and found Leaky Integrate-and-Fire neuron is giving best results with 98.04% accuracy with only one hidden layer in the network. These findings provide valuable insights into the use of different biological spiking neurons for classification tasks and can aid in the development of more efficient spiking neural networks for various applications.

articleTitle: A Novel IoT Based Smart Parking Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With an increase in the population, there is a lot of increase in vehicles and road congestion is a major problem. The driver usually wastes his time and efforts in search of the availability of free parking space in a specified parking area. This project helps us to provide an efficient and smart way to automate parking space management. The proposed project consists of an on-site deployment of an IoT module that will be able to monitor and signalise parking space availability. A web application is also developed to allow an end user to see the parking scenario and check the availability of the parking slots at a particular date & time and pre-book a parking slot if it is empty. A smart payment service is also provided to collect charges from the user for parking. A Pi camera is interfaced with the raspberry pi in order to capture the image of the car and extract the number plate of the car and check whether it has a reservation slot or not.

articleTitle: Mining Opinions by Means of User Reactions
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Nowadays, the social network is enhanced through people interacting with each other and sharing feelings, comments, views, experiences, opinions, and comments about anything. Since there are so many web resources available in digital form for expressing one's viewpoint, like review sites, blogs, and forums on discussion, the importance of sentimental analysis and opinion mining has significantly grown up. Sentiment Analysis is a subfield of Natural Language Processing that is concerned with determining the views of individuals about an article or subject. Sentiment Analysis, frequently recognized as Opinion Mining, is the process of gathering and analyzing customer opinions on a product expressed in blog posts, comments, or reviews. At present, there are some challenges in opinion mining techniques. Firstly, is an opinion that is taken as good in a situation but can also be considered bad in another circumstance? Secondly, the public doesn’t usually put forward opinions in an alike manner. This paper presents an overview of the work done in the past and also about the proposed work.

articleTitle: NARX Model Based Estimation of State of Charge of Lithium-Ion Batteries in Electric Vehicles under Varying Temperature Ranges
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries are a viable option for automotive applications due to their high energy density and low self-discharge rate. The device's longevity and security may be estimated based on its state of charge, which reflects the available energy. A Dynamic Nonlinear Auto-Regressive model with Exogenous Input Neural Network (NARX) Model is proposed and tested to estimate and predict the state of charge (SOC) of the Lithium-Ion Battery, which affects EV performance, range, and safety. In this research, we examine the efficacy of several model-training techniques based on the input characteristics they utilize to build models. The NARX Model with 5 Input Features and Levenberg Marquardt Training (LM) algorithm is selected to train the given model with the least Mean Square Error (MSE) of 1.79E-06 with 606 epoch value.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Microstrip Antenna array with Improved Gain for 5G communication
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this study, a microstrip array antenna for 5G communications is presented. Because there are so many satellite resources available and there is such a high demand for satellite communication, there is a need for extending the S band of the satellite frequency band in the communication industry. The attributes of the proposed antenna design, a rectangular and circular slotting in ground plane with circular and diamond slotted microstrip patch antenna. It operates at frequencies range of 2GHz and 4GHz (centered at 2.5GHz), with gain and directivity is 4.05dbi ,7.65dbi respectively. The patch is compact, inexpensive, and ideally suited for miniaturized equipment. It is made up of a copper (annealed) patch, a PEC, and a FR-4 (lossy) substrate with a loss tangent of 0.002 and a standard height of 1.6 mm from ground. The employed materials are a patch measuring 37mm by 28mm and a substrate measuring 65mm by 95mm. The technique of Microstrip feeding is employed. One technique for achieving this goal is Defected Ground Structure (DGS), One of the original methods for reducing the antenna size is the flaw in the ground. This antenna design is simulated at CST Microwave Studio. As a result, when designing an antenna with a defective ground construction, the antenna size is less for a given frequency than it would be with a perfect ground structure.

articleTitle: Assessment of Infrastructural and Operational Resilience of Transmission Lines During Dynamic Meteorological Hazard
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The occurrence of extreme meteorological dynamic hazards has endangered the operation of power system and its components in the past few decades, emphasizing the need to create efficient methods and models to assess the resilience capability of the critical system infrastructure and the impact of such hazards on the system in future. In this paper, resilience metrices based method is proposed for assessment of infrastructural and operational resilience of the transmission lines during hazardous weather events such as severe cyclonic windstorms. A sequential Monte Carlo (MC)-based time-series model is used to determine the weather effect on the transmission networks. Weather data is mapped with the fragility curve of the transmission line to obtain the failure status of the transmission line. The proposed study is investigated on the standard IEEE 30 bus system for determining the vulnerable transmission lines lying in the path of cyclonic windstorm. The findings may be helpful in planning and operation of power system by determining the impact of such hazards and establishing an early warning weather hazard system to avert substantial system component damage.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Early identification is essential for efficient management and prevention of one of the main causes is heart disease of death globally. Accurate and precise diagnosis and prediction of cardiac disorders are critical, as even the slightest error in judgement can lead to severe complications and even death. Predicting heart diseases requires expertise and knowledge, making it a challenging task. However, the use of large datasets from various sources has made it possible to address real-world issues. In this course of present investigation, we aim to Assess the effectiveness of the algorithms in predicting the potential for cardiac disease is an important task, as it can help in early detection and prevention of heart-related problems.

articleTitle: Cyber Protection & Awareness For Females in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cybersecurity is the application of technologies to protect data from attack, damage, or unauthorized access, and is a major cyber threat for women due to the revolution in Information Technology. Women are facing a major cyber threat due to the revolution in Information Technology, which has caused them to lose their privacy. Alarmingly, young women and girls in Bangladesh have been victims of cybercrime. The privacy of young girls and women has been put at risk due to the accessibility of social media without knowledge of security measures. Bangladesh has fallen behind in raising youth awareness. The measurement of the present degree of cyber-security awareness is the main emphasis of this research. Moreover, the primary results are according to statistics. The authorities claim that 70% of women experience cyberbullying but do not report it. When the machine learning algorithms were applied to the cybersecurity dataset, the accuracy scores of the SVM, XGBoost, and Catboost methods were 93.6%, 93.7%, and 94.07%, respectively. Our CatBoost classifier produces the best outcome. The precision of CatBoost is 94.87%.

articleTitle: Average Probability of Error Analysis of Multi Antenna Decode-and-Forward Cooperative Relaying System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cooperative relaying with multiple input-multiple output (MIMO) is a sort of cooperative communication that uses transmitters, relays, and receivers with multiple antennas to improve coverage, increase data rate, and conserve energy, among other things. The end-to-end performance study of a multi-antenna relay-aided communication system is the main subject of this research. We set out to develop the theoretical average probability of error (APE) expression and to validate it using Monte-Carlo simulations. Additionally, we are evaluating the suggested system's APE at high signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) and contrasting it with the established approaches.

articleTitle: Realization of Gm Enhancement Current Reuse LNA for High Frequency Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper presents the design of a Low-Noise Amplifier (LNA) with high gain and low noise figure over a wide bandwidth of 2.9 GHz. The realized LNA utilizes current reuse technique, g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> enhancement, and transformer coupling to achieve these performance characteristics. Simulation results using Cadence Spectre RF tool show that the proposed LNA has a maximum gain of 15.25 dB and a noise figure of 6.5 dB. The current reuse technique enables low power consumption, while the g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> enhancement increases the transconductance of the device, resulting in higher gain. The transformer coupling provides impedance matching and improves the input and output matching networks of the LNA. The realized LNA has potential applications in wireless communication systems, such as WLAN, WiMax, and LTE, where high gain is essential for reliable and efficient communication.

articleTitle: Kernel Size Dependent Outlier Separation in Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The ability of a novel filtering technique to separate outliers of different scales is demonstrated in a systematic way. The filter utilizes a kernel level modified Z distribution to find outliers separating the input image into a filtered image and an outlier image at the end of every iteration. The length-scale of outliers extracted in the outlier image at every iterarion is shown to depend on the kernel size used in the filtering process. The outlier image, formed of the outlers flagged by the filtering process is shown to contain valuable information about the input image. The ability to detect outliers at different length scales even under low contrast scenarios can be significant in discovering early stage calcifications and nodules as outliers in tissues.
