The ability of a bimetallic strip and heating assembly to produce and expel heat under typical circumstances, that is, when it is carrying current, is examined in this work. On ANSYS software, the thermal performance is initially assessed using the thermal-electric finite element approach, and it is subsequently confirmed through experimental testing. Equations are used to compute the bimetal’s deflection with the aid of the temperature analysis.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity Awareness Assessment Based on Bangladeshi People Perspective Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The demands placed on cyber security continue to rise. When data is compromised from a company, organization, or individual, we realize how crucial it is to have a basic understanding of cyber security. The company should provide their employees with training on how to stay secure online. In light of the current circumstances, it is very important for everyone. Those who have less awareness on it are contributing to a rise in cybercrime. The most significant cyberattack against a developing country. As a result of this, hackers and spammers target individuals in order to execute out attacks, and Bangladesh is vulnerable to an excessive number of attacks on its online and mobile banking transactions. In essence, they apply a social engineering approach in order to get the password. In this study, we gathered data from a survey in which we asked certain questions about fundamental levels of awareness. This research has a total of 456 participants who have answered the questions. In order to get the highest level of accuracy, we employ a machine learning method.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection and Localization from MRI Scan Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A tumor is a tissue mass produced by an accumulation of uncontrolled cells that keeps growing. A brain cancer is a tumor that is either framed in the cerebrum or has spread there. In this research, a model is proposed that can accurately segments pictures using the PSO methods, extracts features using the PCA strategies, and classifies tumors using the CNN. A mind cancer is a growth which is either framed in the cerebrum or has relocated No essential driver has been recognized for the arrangement of growths in the cerebrum till date. However, cancers in the mind are not extremely normal (Worldwide cerebrum growths make up just 1.8% of complete detailed cancers), the death pace of threatening cerebrum cancers is exceptionally high because of the way that the growth development is in the most basic organ of the body. Subsequently, it is of most extreme significance to precisely recognize mind cancers at beginning phases to bring down the death rate. We have accordingly proposed a space variation based Deep Neural Network which will evaluate cerebrum growths from MRI checks for the administration of mind cancer conclusion. In this review, we have executed a model that identify the pictures by utilizing ResNet based profound brain network which has previously been prepared on huge picture datasets and move this preparing information into our own information. To augment the presentation, I have additionally tweaked it in light of our concern set.

articleTitle: Development of Deep Learning-Based Dynamic Road Traffic Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dynamic traffic management is necessary to reduce congestion levels and the wait time for vehicles. In this paper, Deep Learning architecture is adopted to implement a dynamic traffic control management system where the vehicles can be detected and classified using object detection. The YOLO algorithm, which uses CNN as its base architecture is used for object detection and classification. The pre-trained model is obtained by training the COCO dataset with YOLO which contains 79 classes. A custom dataset for the ambulance class is created and this dataset undergoes training to create a model. Image augmentation is performed on the ambulance dataset to obtain a better model with a precision of .88. The traffic density and traffic signal timings for each lane are calculated empirically. The algorithm is tested for two different scenarios, the first one with normal vehicles and the second one with one of the lanes having an ambulance. A server is used for object detection and the calculation of the traffic signal timing. A Raspberry Pi acting as the client is used for actuation. Through the experiment, the system was observed to be approximately distinguishing the differences between the available civilian vehicles. Therefore, this integration of deep learning and an intelligent traffic management system optimizes traffic flow and ensures a prompt emergency response

articleTitle: Sentiment Driven Reinforcement Learning Trading Strategies to Enhance Market Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research paper seeks to present a comprehensive examination of algorithmic trading algorithms, encompassing a range of techniques that extend from supervised learning to sentiment-aware reinforcement-based trading algorithms. The study further investigates the transformative potential of artificial intelligence (AI) in the field of stock trading, emphasizing the advantages of leveraging AI within this domain. Furthermore, the paper explores the incorporation of natural language processing (NLP) algorithms to account for the influence of news on algorithmic predictions. Subsequently, a comparative analysis of the algorithms' performance is carried out based on the profits generated by each. Lastly, the paper outlines the future implications of the subject matter and concludes by summarizing the obtained results.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Models for Federated Learning Based Parking Space Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The world has switched to digital from the physical. Still, in many cases around the globe, there are some which are yet to be solved because data privacy remains a significant concern regarding alternate digital solutions. One such solution is a federated learning-based parking space estimation which can replace the traditional approach. The proposed approach estimates parking space without getting data from the parking lot operators. In traditional machine learning, the data goes to the computation, but in federated learning, the data remains with the clients, and only the computation parameters move. Acquiring the data to train and adding new parameters was the initial step. The later steps involved testing several deep-learning models, such as a basic artificial neural network, convolution neural networks, and long short-term memory. These were used to get the best model for federated learning. All the models were later federated to see how quickly the data converged with respect to rounds and epochs. Experimental results have been provided in both traditional and federated approaches.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Based Approach for Diagnosis of COVID-19 From Chest X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The COVID-19 epidemic has wreaked havoc on people's daily lives and damaged several businesses around the world, killing thousands of people so far. Investigations into COVID-19 have found that elderly patients and individuals with multiple medical conditions, particularly a history of pneumonia, are more likely to develop serious complications from COVID-19. Because pneumonia is a serious infection that develops through the lungs, doctors usually use chest X-rays to locate diseased areas. The proposed work uses artificial neural networks to differentiate chest X-ray images into normal, covid-19 and pneumonia category. The proposed model predicted covid-19 and pneumonia with accuracy scores of 96.43% and 94.72%, respectively. In addition, the proposed model effectively reduces the training losses and improves accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimal Control of Rotary Inverted Pendulum Using Continuous Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work presents a continuous Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) controller based on the optimal control strategy for swinging-up the rotary inverted pendulum and maintaining an equilibrium in the vertical upward position, both using simulation and experimentation. The trajectories and optimal control with sufficient weights are approximated using numerical method. Gradient descent and algebraic descent are the numerical methods used for obtaining optimal control function. Experimentally, swing-up are to be controlled with ad hoc strategies: energy shaping and exponentiation of the pendulum position. The equilibrium at the upward position, achieved by the linear controller, can be easily disturbed by a small perturbation. So, the region of stability where equilibrium can be maintained for maximum input voltage is found on the basis of binary search algorithm.

articleTitle: Solving Arithmetic Word Problems Using Block Recurrent Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recent improvements in deep learning techniques have shown promising results in solving arithmetic word problems. The Block Recurrent Transformer (BRT) is a neural network architecture that coagulates the benefits of transformers and recurrent neural networks (RNNs). This paper investigates the use of BRT for arithmetic problem-solving and compares its performance with other state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, a detailed description of the methodology that evaluates the performance of BRT on a dataset of arithmetic word problems is given. Our results show that BRT outperforms other methods and reaches state-ofthe-art performance.

articleTitle: Malware Detection Using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Malware is a major concern for internet users, and the emergence of polymorphic malware has made it even more challenging to detect and combat. In order to identify and mitigate these malicious threats, we employed Random Forest machine learning technique. The confusion matrix provided valuable insights by measuring the number of false positives and false negatives, thereby assessing the system's effectiveness. Our study demonstrated the potential of using Random Forest for malware analysis and detection, thereby enhancing computer network security. Particularly, the results showcased the effectiveness of Random Forest algorithm, which achieved a 98% detection accuracy and displayed a reduced false positive rate in the dataset provided.

articleTitle: Density Functionality Theory Study of Gold Functionalized CNT for Acetone Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The electrical properties of a (5,0) zigzag single-walled carbon nanotube (SWCNT) functionalized with gold and its potential for acetone sensing are investigated in this study utilizing density functional theory (DFT) calculations. We choose the well-known Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functional due to its accuracy and computational effectiveness. The choice of exchange-correlation function is crucial in DFT calculations. We perform both band structure and density of states (DOS) calculations using Visualization of Electronic and STructural Analysis (VESTA) and Quantum ESPRESSO (QE). We observe the band gap for CNT, Au-CNT, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>O-CNT, and Au-CNT-C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>O are 0eV, 0.54eV, 1.12eV, and 0.35eV. Our research enhances knowledge of functionalized carbon nanotubes for use in gas sensing applications and emphasizes the use of the PBE functional, as well as the software suites VESTA and QE.

articleTitle: Predicting Student Placement using PCA and Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Student placement plays a crucial role in educational institutions, as it is a factor measure to identify the performance of an institution. Timely identification of student’s CGPA range can reduce concerns about students’ academic life and it will help to improve success and avoid risks. Recently, there has been an upsurge in the use of machine learning techniques for prediction, this research focuses on random forest for student prediction. This paper focus on the prediction of student placements based on criteria like attendance, backlog, communication, programming skill, verbal and aptitude exam over more than 500 samples, then the PCA technique is used to reduce the dimensionality of the dataset and to pinpoint the key elements that influence the prediction of student placement.The most crucial elements that influence a student’s likelihood of finding employment after completing their studies can be determined. Used PCA to identify the most important features that contribute to the probability of pupil placement. PCA works by modifying the initial dataset to a fresh set of variables, and principal elements, which identify the most significant patterns and variations in the data to increase the accuracy. The random forest algorithm is then used to build a predictive model and achieved 97 percentage of accuracy,that is trained on the reduced feature set to Identify the probability of a student being assigned to a job.By simplifying the dataset and focusing on the most important factors that affect the prediction, this method has been demonstrated to increase the efficiency and accuracy of student placement prediction. It is crucial to remember that the Random Forest model’s accuracy depends on the calibre and relevance of the input data. Additionally, it’s crucial to make sure the model is applied ethically, fairly, and without any prejudice or discrimination.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach to Recognize Bangladeshi Shrimp Species
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Shrimp, the most popular shellfish in Bangladesh, is a good source of protein, minerals, vitamin D, and iodine that promote a healthy body and balanced nutrition. In Bangladesh shrimp is referred to as white gold. It consumes about 70% of exported agricultural food. In our country, about 56 species of shrimp are found. Most people do not know all of the species very well. Ordinary people even the fisherman are sometimes confused about different species because of looking like the same. To solve the problem in this work we introduced an intelligence mahine that can help people to concede Shrimp species accurately. We expect this work also help the export sector to differentiate the shrimp species monitoring. To achieve the goal, we build a custom CNN algorithm for image processing and feature extraction. We build three different CNN architectures and differentiate them by hyperparameter and number of convolutional layers. Model 1 and Model 3 both obtain an accuracy of 99.01%, however Model 3 was chosen as the final model for Computer Vision integration. Though both models generated the best accuracy why do we use model 3 as the final model? In this work, we will also describe with appropriate reason.

articleTitle: A Novel Model Using Multiple Bagging Ensemble Method For Measuring, Inferring and Predicting the Quality of Continuous Assessment Question Papers
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Predictive Machine Learning techniques provide mechanisms for the computing machines to analyze and understand the knowledge inherently embedded in the given dataset. This unique technique can be effectively used in understanding the quality of the question papers compiled for Continuous Assessment Tests (CATs). Understanding the quality of the question papers requires a systematic and software engineering-based approach. In this research work, a few of the CAT question papers have been carefully picked and used for applying the proposed methodology. Well, defined set of features, properties, and quality attributes have been applied in the proposed model and mapped into each other for providing a better understanding of the question paper's quality. Using metrics the analysis of quality for the given CAT paper is attempted. Based on the application of the model, it was able to clearly predict and understand the quality levels of the given set of question papers.

articleTitle: Detection And Tracking of Multiple Pedestrians Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Recent advancements in deep learning and computer vision have benefitted security systems. Recent object tracking algorithms, in example, have incorporated deep learning in a variety of methods to enhance tracking performance. Object tracking and security systems continue to provide a number of difficulties. This work will first identify the several challenges related to the object tracking for an autonomous system and further the object tracker system will be evaluated in a simulated environment for multiple objects like pedestrian, moving or stationary object. This research paper is all about designing the tracking algorithm for multiple pedestrians. This research employed YOLO V3 with a Deep Sort architecture. In order to get heightened accuracy different kind of scenario is used for preparing the test data. As a result, precision is 93 %, Recall is 98% and accuracy is 96%.

articleTitle: Analysis and Thermal Performance Implementation of MCCB with Aluminium Busbar and Enclosure
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Molded Case Circuit Breaker is a low-voltage power system protective device capable of making, carrying, and breaking currents under normal circuit conditions and making, carrying for a specified time, and breaking currents under specified abnormal circuit conditions. During normal operation, the current passing through the conducting components of the MCCB generates heat. The heat generated raises the overall temperature of MCCB. This temperature must stay within the bounds set forth by the standard for an MCCB to operate safely, and efforts must be taken to lower it to improve its performance. This study examines the capacity of MCCB to produce and release heat when operating normally, i.e. when it is conducting current over copper busbars. A three-dimensional thermal model is first analysed using a Finite Element Analysis ANSYS software using the thermal-electric tool, and then it is validated using experimental trials. The experimental and simulated results have a strong correlation. This paper also covers the thermal performance of the MCCB with aluminum bus bars and the effect of heat generation inside an enclosure.

articleTitle: Use of Propositional Logic in building AI Logic and Game Development
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Logic is the foundation of most computer programming and now is an integral part of the development of New Age Artificial Intelligence. Logic helps AI and ML in fields with very little or more data. As logic is something very close to human behavior, it is safe to say that logic-integrated AI systems are of High-level programming. Their main aim is to encode human knowledge and input it into machine-understandable data. In this paper, we have discussed deeply the use of propositional logic in the development of games, solutions to these games, and also how important they are in AI. Considering games such as Sudoku, Knights and Knaves, and Game of Bluff.

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis of Stainless Steel Plate by Gaussian Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The harmonic analysis of stainless-steel plates is a crucial step in quality control and defect detection in the manufacturing process. This study presents a novel approach to harmonic analysis of stainless-steel plates using a Gaussian filter. The signal data of the plates were collected using an accelerometer and processed using a Gaussian filter to enhance the harmonic analysis by removing noise. The resulting data were analyzed using Fourier transform techniques and Gaussian filter and compare with Finite Element Analysis (FEA). The analysis shows that the Gaussian filter effective for the harmonic analysis. The percentage error by FFT is 9.30% while Gaussian filter percentage error is 5.92%. The results indicate the suggested method has the capability to enhance the accuracy.

articleTitle: Transformer-based Multiclass Classification of Cervicogram Images for Improved Cervical Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cervical cancer is a primary health concern that affects women worldwide. Additionally, it is a significant factor in mortality from cancer. On the other hand, when detected early and thoroughly controlled, it is one of the most efficiently treated kinds of cancer. The Human Papilloma Virus (HPV) causes this type of cancer, which promotes abnormal cell proliferation in the cervix region. The Papanicolaou (Pap) smear analysis is the most commonly used method for detecting cancer early. In developed countries, it has had a significant impact on reducing deaths related to cancer. However, underdeveloped countries still struggle to provide affordable solutions owing to a lack of easily accessible medical facilities, and the detection process is time-consuming, irritating, and expensive. Cervicography, on the other hand, may be utilized for mass screening since it is easily accessible, painless, and takes less time. This study proposes an automated cervical cancer diagnosis approach based on Deep Learning techniques in medical image processing to enable mass screening and make cervical cancer detection accessible and affordable to the public. Vision Transformer (ViT) with pre-trained checkpoint from DINO retrieves deep-learned features from cervicogram images delivered into the model by leveraging transfer learning and fine-tuning. This classification project uses the Kaggle Intel and MobileODT dataset. The Kaggle dataset’s three-class classification accuracy rates are 78.7 % (train), 54 % (valid), and 57.9 % (test), respectively.

articleTitle: Camera to Cloud: A Robust Solution for Seamless Video Data Integration for OTT and Film production
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Camera-to-Cloud technology is the first step toward transforming OTT and film production via cloud-powered disruptions, which enables filmmakers to analyze video as soon as cameras stop recording. The camera-to-cloud workflow and its effect on OTT and cinema production concerning the post-production procedure is analyzed. The camera-to-cloud workflow records media with cameras or other external recording equipment, uploads media files to cloud storage and works remotely on post-production activities with cloud-based sound design, visual effects, and editing software. The technical components of establishing camera-to-cloud workflows, like data transmission protocols, cloud storage choices, integration with current processes, and utilization of cloud-based software programs, are covered.The results demonstrate the potential of camera-to-cloud workflows in motion picture production, offering knowledge to professionals in the field and paving the way for more effective and cooperative post-production procedures. The study also covers the challenges when implementing camera-to-cloud processes, including the need for internet speed, data security and privacy issues, and potential restrictions on remote editing capabilities and opportunities. Their advantages include adaptability, scalability, remote collaboration, quicker turnaround times, cost savings, increased security, and integrated asset management. The research is limited to this field, and OTT and film production industries will gain insights from this paper.

articleTitle: Enhancing Accuracy and Correlation Coefficients of Cancer epitopes through Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Determining the epitope’s binding regions is incredibly difficult. Scientific research on epitopes in folded proteins is still challenging and time-consuming. Various services have been created in the past to forecast B-cell epitopes. Due to the diversity of datasets and the fact that the same technique does not produce acceptable accuracy for all window lengths, the server's accuracy has only made moderate improvement despite tremendous effort. In this study, two models were subjected to machine learning approaches. Using several models, such as IBK and Nave Bayes, both models are trained to distinguish between epitopes and non-epitopes. For Model 2 we achieved an improvement in Mathew's correlation coefficient in the range of 0.9-1.0 and for Model 1 in the range of 0.5-0.6.

articleTitle: Enhancing Multi-Label Image Recognition through Class-Specific Residual Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Researchers in the field of computer vision encounter challenges like label sparsity, label dependency, imbalanced label distribution, and feature representation when trying to address the problem of label recognition inside a single image containing several labels. Class-specific residual attention (CSRA) aims to highlight discriminative areas connected to each label by recording attention maps specific to each label. We improved the CSRA model by including two additional representative characteristics to describe the connection between labels and the various spatial regions occupied by entities from different categories. This helps to get more nuanced descriptions of the connections between the labels and the multiple locations in which things from different categories reside could be made. These enhancements have been incorporated into the updated model. Experimental results suggest that the representative matrices with the least variation have the greatest impact when it comes to expressing features. The least-variance feature is second only to the channel-average mean in terms of significance. Getting an accuracy of 90.03% when adding the minimum variance feature while accuracy is reduced to 89% when adding other features.

articleTitle: Symmetric Key Cryptography: Review, Algorithmic Insights, and Challenges in the Era of Quantum Computers
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In an increasingly digital world, security has become paramount. Whether it's personal information, financial transactions, or sensitive communications, the need to safeguard data from unauthorized access and malicious activities has never been more critical. Security plays a vital role in protecting individuals, organizations, and even nations from potential threats and risks. In this context, cryptography emerges as a fundamental tool for ensuring security in digital systems. Cryptography involves the use of mathematical algorithms and techniques to encode information, making it unintelligible to unauthorized parties. To secure the information symmetric key cryptography algorithms and asymmetric key cryptography algorithms are implemented from last five decades. This review examines symmetric key cryptography algorithms and the challenges they face in the era of quantum computing. Symmetric key cryptography relies on the computational complexity of mathematical problems to secure sensitive information. This review aims to provide valuable insights and awareness to researchers and practitioners in the field of cryptography, enabling them to address these challenges effectively and maintain the security of sensitive information in the quantum era.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of English to Bodo Neural Machine Translation System with Varying Model Architecture and Vocabulary Size
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper is about a work done on Neural Machine Translation of English-Bodo language pair using deep learning technique. Bodo is a language of northeastern part of India particularly in the state of Assam. The experiments are performed using English-Bodo parallel data collected from open sources, as well as created inhouse using expert linguists. The dataset was subjected to data filtering and cleaning. IndicNLP library and Mosesdecoder are used for tokenization for Bodo and English respectively. After tokenization, Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) technique was used for subword tokenization. Two transformer encoder and decoder models are built using different architecture. OpenNMT-py framework is used for building our models. Experiments have been performed on the two models using two different vocabularies of 8000 and 16000 sizes. Highest BLEU score of 10.43 was achieved on the testset from training Model 2 with 8000 vocabulary. The details of the results are analysed against different models.

articleTitle: A APOD PWM based Seventeen level Inverter with less Total Harmonic Distortion
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In high-powered solar PV arrangements, conventional multi-level inverter (MLI) topologies have drawbacks such as significant total harmonic distortion (THD) and the requirement of several switching components, which raises the overall cost. The size and price of the inverter rise even if adding a large filter component to the input side may greatly decrease THD. Thus, attaining output AC sinewave with reduced THD is a major challenge for MLIs present in literature. A proposed MLI addresses these issues by modifying the cascaded H-Bridge assembly and using Alternate phase opposition disposition (APOD) PWM method to decrease THD at the output. The suggested inverter does not need any extra voltage balancing capacitors or clamping diodes since it contains 6 unidirectional switches and 2 bidirectional switches. For the purpose of producing gate pulses, the switching states and APOD PWM operation are thoroughly discussed. The proposed Multi-Level Inverter (MLI) is analyzed through waveform plots, equations, and mathematical analysis. A steady-state examination reveals that the MLI uses only four DC sources to provide an output voltage with 17 levels. In comparison to current MLI topologies, simulation results of the inverter in three and single phase assemblies show that the proposed MLI performs better and has a much reduced THD. According to the simulation findings, the suggested MLI has a THD of 0.98%, which is much less than the THDs of four standard MLIs, which are 6.1%, 6.63%, 7.3%, and 9.93%. Furthermore, although typical MLIs use more than 10 Switches to create 15 voltage levels, the suggested MLI produces 17 voltage levels with only 8 switching devices.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of PAPR reduction techniques for FBMC-IM and OFDM-IM systems in generalized fading channels
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: FBMC (Filter Bank Multicarrier System) is a multi-carrier modulation technique that is derived from OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) in order to remove the disadvantages of cyclic-prefix used in OFDM. It is used in high data rate cellular and wireless communication. High Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR) is one of the most significant drawbacks of multi carrier modulation systems like FBMC and OFDM. In this case, statistics is used to characterize modulated signals: like CCDF (Complementary Cumulative Distribution Function) is useful for determining design parameters for multi-carrier modulation. In this paper, some methods to reduce PAPR such as: Clipping and Filtering, PTS, SLM , TR, TI etc are described and the comparison of these reduction techniques for both of OFDM-IM and FBMC-IM systems in generalized fading channels are briefly discussed here.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach Towards Photorealistic Image Stylization
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Photorealistic image stylization — a technique which involves transferring the artistic style from one image onto another, while simultaneously preserving the inherent content of the target image. Numerous methods for achieving photorealistic image stylization have been developed, however they produce stylizations that are spatially inconsistent with noticeable artifacts and distortion in output images which are not present in captured photographs. We propose novel advancements to address these problems and enhance photorealism to improve the existing methods by incorporating both content and style loss in the optimization process. We propose two key enhancements: activation function enhancement and learning rate optimization. In the activation function enhancement,the conventional ReLU activation function is replaced with the Exponential Linear Unit (ELU) activation function. Furthermore, we conduct a comprehensive learning rate optimization study to customize the learning rate for our method. Both enhancements lead to improved convergence speed and solution quality, resulting in superior photorealistic images. The dataset used in this research paper is the Deep Photo Style Transfer(DPST) dataset which contains a collection of content and style images that can be used to train neural networks to perform photo style transfer and the evaluation of this model was done using several metrics, including perceptual quality, visual similarity, and structural similarity. Through rigorous evaluation and comparison with existing methods, our enhanced approach achieves remarkable and visually appealing stylization results that are more preferred by human subjects. Our novel approach achieves a higher SSIM score (the higher the better) as discussed in Table 1 than other existing methods. It also opens up new possibilities for integrating desired artistic styles into images while preserving their original content.

articleTitle: Machine Vision based automated 3-DOF Articulated Robot for fruit defect Identification and Segregation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The automation scenario in the current industrial as well as domestic applications has seen an exponential growth over the decade. Robot plays an important role in industrial automation but in some cases, it needs some extent of human intervention in quality inspection. This paper focuses on solving problems related to defect identification and segregation of fruits using 3-DOF articulated robot configuration with the integration of machine vision system and deep learning algorithms. To perceive the features of object, A USB camera is utilized. The machine vision algorithm will next use a variety of methods for processing digital images to extract the relevant data and decide whether to continue processing the product, redirect it to a different stage of production, or just throw it away. In recent days, the advancement in deep learning leads to the phenomenal growth in computer vision. There are many state-of-the-art object detection algorithms available in deep learning technology and we are using Inception-V3 algorithm that can be used for the machine vision operation in our solution. Based on the results from the algorithm, segregation operation is carried out successfully.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Seg-Net and U-Net Algorithms for UAV Multispectral Imaging of Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, the use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in multispectral imaging analysis of plants has become increasingly popular in the fields of precision agriculture. The Seg-Net and U-Net models have emerged as popular choices for image segmentation in this domain. In this study, compare the performance of these two models for UAV multispectral imaging analysis of plants. The dataset used in this study consists of multispectral images of corn field captured using a UAV. We trained both Seg-Net and U-Net models on this dataset and evaluated their performance in terms of accuracy. We also compared the time required for training and testing each model. Our results indicate that the Seg-Net model outperformed the U-Net model in terms of accuracy. However, the U-Net model required a longer training time compared to the Seg-Net model. The testing time for both models was similar. In conclusion, the Seg-Net model is a better choice for UAV multispectral imaging analysis of plants, given its superior performance metrics. However, the longer training time required by the Seg-Net model should be taken into consideration when choosing a model for this task.

articleTitle: Prepaid Electric Meter With Theft Alert
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The study emphasizes pre-payment metering system, which would reduce the time and effort consumed by meter reading, bill processing, power transmission, and payment processing, making the power utilities to enhance the effectiveness of revenue collection in order to provide consumers with the greatest service possible. This paper introduces prepaid electricity systems to automatically limit electricity usage if the bill is unpaid and eliminate queues at electricity billing counters. The proposed model uses a message-sending module to establish a connection with authority. This smart wireless technology-driven model does not require a prepaid card to be installed, also it not only shows automated meter reading (AMR) but also opposes theft. Monitoring of pulse rate, total units consumed, and Energy is possible. The Meter parameters are discussed and the pulse power rate has been calculated. 1.04 watts is consumed in each pulse in the proposed model. The suggested approach prevents billing errors, late payments from customers, meter manipulation, and bypassing. The average home may lower their energy use by between 5 to 10% by utilizing prepaid electric meters.

articleTitle: Exploring Big Data Analytics in Social Networking Sites
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Over the last few decades, humongous amount of data is being created by humanity owing to heavy usage of social networking sites. Explosive growth of social networking sites such as Facebook, twitter, YouTube WhatsApp generates massive amount of unstructured data. Major challenge faced in this research domain is to convert this huge community data into data which can be analyzed and secured and easily available. In this paper, various tools and frameworks like Hadoop, Spark, Map Reduce, HIVE and MongoDB have been studied in detail for their suitability to analyze large volume of variety of data. The tools have been studied in view of the three characteristics of data. First characteristic is based on nature of data i.e. whether data is historical or live streaming. Second characteristic considered is mode of analytical application i.e. batch or online. Third characteristics is data type whether data is structured, unstructured or semi-structured. From review of the papers, it is observed that in case of historical data, structured type and batch mode analytical application, HIVE is most appropriate on Hadoop framework. In case of live streaming data and online analytical application, MongoDB on Spark framework is appropriate. In case of semi structured and historical data, Mapreduce is appropriate in Hadoop framework. For analyzing data generated from social networking websites, Hadoop with HIVE is observed to be most suitable. This paper discusses commonly used tools and their comparison on these three characteristics.

articleTitle: Triple-Output current-mode on-chip Filter Design and Analysis for VHF-band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Continuing the research and analysis in the field of analog filter designing, researchers have reached a place where robust miniaturized integrated circuits are of utmost demand in the area of wireless communication. RF communication requires all types of filter action and in lieu of that, a novel current-mode 11 MOSFET-based triple-output filter circuit is designed to provide band-pass, high-pass, and low-pass output for a sine wave of amplitude 20 μA and a frequency of 60 MHz. AC and transient analysis are carried out to show the filter circuit’s behavior. The operating frequency is in the range of a few tens of MHz, which covers sophisticated applications such as weather broadcast, aviation, AM radio and navigation, and VHF television.

articleTitle: Botnet Attacks Detection using Image Processing Approach: Sequential Neural Network and Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Botnets are networks of compromised computers that are controlled by an attacker for malicious purposes such as spamming attacks, DDoS, or data theft. Botnet attacks detection is a challenging task due to their distributed and covert nature. Botnet attacks are a major security concern for organizations and individuals alike. In this paper we proposed a botnet attacks detection using image processing approach. We propose an AI model architecture using Sequential Neural Network and feature selection. There are two methods for converting raw data into image data. First method using predefined categorize for choosing features. The second method uses Pearson correlation value between features in dataset and the label. Predefined categorized features have successfully increased the performance of proposed AI model for botnet attacks detection as well as Pearson correlation value.

articleTitle: Cyber-Attacks Detection Using Intelligent Intrusion System (IDS) Along With Deep Learning: Novel Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In present scenario network congestion problem occurs during data transferring and receiving on any networks. The various reason of slowing down of this data flow is due to various kind of cyber-attacks occurring at a rapid speed. The cyber-attacks work internally and damage the server system, it is very dangerous to run system while it is prone to cyber-attacks which may interrupt the smooth flow. This research paper presents various kind of cyber related attacks and its detection through machine learning approach by the help of various simulation tools. the various kind of attacks like DDOS, UDP, ICMP, TCP, many more attacks finding out by suing simulate machine learning algorithms. The machine learning techniques perform generalise data set on the other hand data mining techniques perform specific data set and detection of cyber-attacks the objectives of cyber-attacks detection and categories along with simulation process also elaborate. [3]

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of active power filters for power quality improvement in a distribution system
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: It is possible for a power system to experience various power quality (PQ) problems due to the application of Non-linear load (Man made cause) or fault, equipment failure (Natural cause). To overcome these non-linearities , power filters (PFs) are the best possible solutions .The main objective of this article is to mitigate different voltage and current based PQ issues such as voltage sag, swell, load unbalancing, power factor correction (PFC) etc by the implementation of series active PF (SAPF) and shunt active PF(ShAPF) respectively on a distribution system .A traditional control technique associated with Proportional integral (PI) controller is devised which minimizes the error between reference and actual value of the variables and gives required pulses for the operation of filters . The whole system along with PFs and its control techniques are simulated through MATLAB /SIMULINK and the results are also verified.

articleTitle: Screening of type II diabetes mellitus based on non-contact infrared temperature sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetes is a highly prevalent metabolic disorder. The conventional method of diagnosing type-II diabetes involves blood sample extraction, which is a painful procedure leading to increased undiagnosed diabetes among the population. Therefore, a non-invasive screening tool is the need of the hour for diagnosis of diabetes. Our aim is to design and develop a non-contact infrared temperature sensor based screening tool to detect the blood glucose level. Infrared-based non-contact temperature sensor using MLX90614 is designed to study the metabolic variations in the form of temperature changes at the contra-lateral regions of the knee and carotid area of the neck region. A portable, compact non-invasive screening tool was developed to estimate the non-invasive blood glucose (HbA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1c</inf>) with AUC: 0.919. The Sensitivity, Specificity, Positive predictive value, Negative predictive value and accuracy were measured (86%, 92%, 90%, 89%, 89%) respectively. The developed screening tool is cost effective, reusable and is able to study the subjects are under diabetic or control state.

articleTitle: A Novel Cryptographic Encryption Technique for the Security Enhancement of Electronic Transactions
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cybersecurity has been a trending topic for years now, different propositions, studies, and work have been suggested in various forms by other authors all over the world, but the impact of crime is still around us. In the present area, we cannot say that data is safe when it is hidden from an unauthorized person, but it is safe when the intruder cannot understand it, hence encryption is the suitable solution at the moment. Encryption is one of the techniques that we use to protect our data from unauthorized persons. In this technique, we do not stop the unauthorized person from accessing our information, but we made our data appear in an incomprehensive form to the intruder, only the person with the correct key can decrypt the encrypted message. Many encryption techniques are available, and the commonly used and modern ones are RSA, AES, and HAS, each of them is suitable for different scenarios and are all helpful for cyber security. In this paper, we will propose a framework that provides an additional layer of security for any sensitive information in general and those in the banking sector.

articleTitle: Volume Controller using Hand Gestures
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work presents the development of a volume controller using hand gestures as the input to control the system.This system uses the OpenCV module to detect and control gestures. The application captures images and videos from the webcam, and based on the user's input, it controls the volume of the system.Hand gesture recognition systems have a wide range of applications, including volume control, navigation, gaming, and sign language interpretation.In this project, we are developing a hand gesture volume controller system. The system uses a high-resolution camera to detect hand gestures, which are then used to control the volume of a device. The system is developed using the Numpy, OpenCV, and Python packages.The system is designed to be intuitive and easy to use. Users can simply make a gesture with their hand to control the volume of the device. The hand gesture volume controller system has the potential to revolutionize the way we interact with devices. By allowing us to control devices with our hands, hand gesture recognition systems can make our lives easier and more convenient.

articleTitle: A fuzzy approach with sensor array for assessing Banana Ripeness
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Banana is one of the most widely consumed fruit worldwide and its ripening stage significantly impacts its quality and consumer acceptance. Traditional methods of ripeness assessment rely on subjective human judgment leading to inconsistencies and inaccuracies. Furthermore, existing methods of automation are inadequate to objectively asses the ripening stages of banana, therefore, in this paper, we propose a fuzzy approach, based on fruit natural hormones, Ethylene gas and Odor by exploiting sensor array. Moreover, we exploit DHT22 (digital temperature and humidity sensor) temperature sensor to measure the temperature and humidity effect also. Extensive experimentation and comparative studies demonstrate the effectiveness, efficacy, and reliability of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency PricePrediction using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper focuses on utilizing the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) algorithm to forecast the prices of cryptocurrencies. that is implemented through the model, which will allow us to keep tabs on the fluctuating prices of the various coins that are available. As various cryptocurrencies are available for trading and investment and they are regarded as a type of digital asset. Because trading and investing should be done after the knowledge of the market and trends, So, to solve this problem there should be analysis before trading any pair. Our goal is to present accurate prediction based on the dataset of the selected cryptocurrency. Hence, the proposed model is built and it concentrate mostly on technical analysis of the crypto coins which is the major indicator and most suitable for the prediction models. The proposed LSTM model achieves a variance regression score of 0.95 on test data of the Bitcoin which serves as a representative cryptocurrency that is used in the model.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the effectiveness of ML and DL techniques for classifying Face Masks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In 2020, COVID has grown to be a significant public health concern. The virus's contact-transparent properties caused it to propagate quickly. Wearing a mask that stops the transmission is the most effective strategy to prevent this. The first step in lowering the danger is to wear a mask, which cuts the likelihood of contracting the infection by 70%. To resolve this problem, we need the system to keep an eye on the facial mask. This work can be facilitated by a face mask detector based on deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) models can make this task easier. Here, we do face mask categorization utilizing several ML and DL techniques. Here, we experimented with various methods such as CNN, Resnet50, Gabor filter, GLCM, SVM, KNN for extracting features and classifying faces with mask and without mask. From the accuracy we got for each model it says CNN performs well on the dataset we took.

articleTitle: Wearable Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) Iris Band Pass Filter (BPF) over Jeans Substrate
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper explores the designing technique of body wearable iris band pass filters over substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) by opting jeans as a substrate material with relative permittivity of 2.72, thickness 2mm and dielectric loss tangent of 0.002. Simple microstrip to SIW feeding technique is used for impedance transition. A number of iris configurations are studied and presented with simulated outcomes. All configurations are compared and presented with vital filter characteristics. The filters have been developed targeting body wearable trans-receiving systems in microwave X-bands in terrains where installation of bulky components produces transport challenges. All simulations are carried over Ansoft HFSS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TM</sup>.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking of a 2-DOF Helicopter System Using fuzzy systems with various membership functions
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study aims to follow a 2-DOF helicopter system's desired yaw and pitch axis trajectories. For this, a fuzzy system with membership function parameters is used, and the system's effectiveness is compared to that of a conventional control method, namely an LQR controller. The suggested fuzzy system is tailored to offer the benchmark unmanned aerial vehicle with the best fuzzy model possible by configuring the membership functions at the antecedent portion of the fuzzy rules (2-DOF Helicopter). When using fuzzy systems with membership function parameters, only the parameters that follow the fuzzy rules are changed, leaving the fuzzy rules' antecedents still have the exact requirements. The most common strategy in fuzzy methods for creating an ideal fuzzy model is to adjust the membership function's settings in the fuzzy rules' antecedent section. The knowledge offered Due to this adjustment process; these membership functions could be lost or misinterpreted. Instead of changing the membership functions' specifications, this problem is resolved by changing the parameters of the membership functions.

articleTitle: A Novel approach to denoise an image using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Due to a variety of environmental and human factors, real-world photographs frequently contain noise. De-noising is a method for taking out noise from an image. De-noising images faces significant challenges because of the sources of noise. Gaussian, impulse, salt-and-pepper, and speckle noise are some examples of complicated sources of noise in imaging. In the realm of visual de-noising, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) have attracted an increasing amount of interest. Several CNN approaches can be used to denoise images. For the evaluation of these approaches, various datasets were used. The various CNN algorithms used for image de-noising are studied in this study. Many CNN architectures have been used over the years to denoise digital images. RIDNet and Autoencoder, two cutting-edge CNN architectures, are used here.

articleTitle: High Operating Frequency, Low-Power PFD for PLL Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This research introduces a novel sequential type Phase-Frequency Detector (PFD) that is appropriate for low-power and high-frequency PLL applications. This PFD uses a modified True Single Phase Clock (TSPC) based DFF logic to make the above applications worthwhile. The simulation of the proposed PFD is done on cadence software using 90nm CMOS process. The proposed PFD's maximum power consumption is 471.71µW which is achieved at an operating frequency of 1GHz, which shows the efficiency of the designed PFD. The determined phase-noise value is - 140.28dBc/Hz@1MHz offset, which makes the proposed PFD ideal for low-noise PLL applications as well.

articleTitle: CNN based Non-Invasive Technique for Diabetic Detection from Conjunctival Image
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus, also known as diabetes comes under the endocrine disease. It can be characteristic by sustain high blood sugar level. The basic detection of diabetes began virtually by the physician seeing the color of anterior conjunctiva later assuring with an encroaching (invasive) blood test. In this research paper a mechanism for the automatic diabetes detection by a non-invasive optical system is proposed. It comprises the detection of diabetes by analyzing the eye pallor and conjunctival anterior. Medical image of the eye of the both diabetic and non-diabetic subjects have been used for analysis. CNN based prediction model is built for detection. Accuracy of the model can be increased significantly by using optimizer such as Adam and SGD. This research gives a computerized non-invasive cost effective and user friendly, portable, basic screening test for diabetic detection.

articleTitle: Towards Automated Claim Detection In Fact Checking
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The spread of fake news has an adverse effect on the audience as fake news can influence people to the extent that it may become a threat to their own life. Therefore, to verify a news article, we perform a claim detection task on the article to identify what it claims. In this work, we curate a dataset of 183 fact checked articles from India Today as well as make use of a benchmark dataset, FactDrill. We use both datasets to train model using conventional techniques namely Decision Tree(DTree), Naive Bayes(NB) and Support Vector Machine(SVM) with term frequency-inverse document frequency approach to extract features and out of which the Support Vector Machine(SVM) classifier outperforms with the F1-Score of 0.40 and 0.87 for Claim and Not Claim category on our dataset and F1-Score of 0.73 and 0.72 for Claim category and Not Claim category on FactDrill dataset, respectively. This is the first study to date that employs the FactDrill dataset for model training and testing using conventional methods.

articleTitle: Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna with Partial Ground for WLAN, WiMAX, C-band, and Sub-6GHz Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a microwave frequency band functioning monopole antenna with frequency reconfigurability. On an FR-4 substrate with a relative permittivity of 4.4 and a height of 1.6 mm antenna can be printed. An antenna can operate in various modes by placing two RF (PIN diode) switches between radiating patches. The antenna working in three modes that covers six different bands, with two dual bands of 3.8 GHz / 7.5 GHz, 3 GHz / 7.1 GHz in Modes 1 & 2 respectively, and 2.8 GHz / 6.7 GHz in Mode 3. The antenna has good Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) for all working bands. The gain at comparable resonant frequencies ranges from 1.74 to 4.75 dBi. At each frequency, the achievable bandwidths range from 8.8 to 46.6 %. The structure is designed in High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS). The antenna can be used in WiMAX, WLAN, C-Band, 5G, and Sub-6Hz wireless communications.

articleTitle: Interactivity Development Using Unity 3D Software and C # Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Unity provides a powerful tool for game designing and 3D development. This project explained how to interact with 3D design models using Unity. This article represents Unity Essentials and how to build applications for mobile. Using Unity 3D, we can create applications for AR and VR devices like Oculus, HTC vive and Google Cardboard etc. For creating any game in unity used a programming language, C Sharp. C# is popular and very powerful language used for development in Unity 3D. In this paper we will discuss about interactivity development project where we will learn about unity with C# code and we will create a driving simulator prototype where the user can steer a vehicle down a road to avoid obstacles in its path. This would be done by importing assets and adding objects to the scene window in unity and later on customization of the layout and creation of C# Script for each component would be done in the project window.

articleTitle: Mitosis Detection In Breast Histopathology Image Using Ensemble Features Fed CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Breast cancer is acknowledged as the second leading cause of women’s cancer-related deaths. Quantifying mitosis in pathology sections can provide invaluable insight into both the prognosis and tumor aggressiveness. The task of detecting mitotic cells in histopathology images, which is crucial for predicting the grade and aggressiveness of breast cancer, poses a demanding and time-consuming challenge for pathologists. In this work, we establish an automated approach for detecting breast cancer based on the identification of mitotic counts from histopathology images. In CNN approaches, the generation of features is predominantly unsupervised, and handcrafted features are aimed at modeling domain-relevant attributes. Consequently, a hybrid feature dataset is constructed by incorporating handcrafted features. This dataset can be reorganized and utilized as input for a CNN architecture to classify feature values as either mitotic or non-mitotic. Subsequently, various data combinations are employed to train the CNN model for classification, and the most accurate feature set is chosen to optimize prediction accuracy. In our study, the shape feature has an F-score of 0.87.

articleTitle: A Palm Index and Hand Gesture-Based User Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Hand gesture recognition has emerged as an exciting technology that offers a more authentic and interpersonal way of human-machine interaction. This work proposes a new authentication method for Internet of Things (IoT) devices based on palm index and gesture recognition. The aim is to explore the possibility of a contactless authentication approach that overcomes the limitations of traditional methods like PIN passwords. The proposed approach involves capturing a series of palm index photographs and using the length between the palm index as the user’s password. At first, a password is created for a user using the length between his palm index. The user’s authentication is confirmed by the recognized hand gesture, where the password previously generated from the palm index is verified. If the password is matched, the system is unlocked for the user. Therefore, the proposed mechanism has a much stronger password strength compared to traditional PIN passwords. Moreover, the proposed authentication method is also resistant to physical observation threats. The performance of the proposed model is analyzed through a Raspberry Pi-based real life implementation, where it is observed that the user authentication can be performed correctly.

articleTitle: SWAYAM MOOC Reviews: Assessing Acceptability through Sentiment Analysis using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) have been granted a place in pedagogy as a result of the paradigm change occurring in higher education. The user base of the Indian MOOC platform SWAYAM has grown to over 18 million in only a few years, making it third only to Coursera and edX in terms of total users. This study gathered 4029 reviews from participants in 247 SWAYAM MOOCs and applied sentiment analysis with machine learning approaches to measure student acceptability of MOOCs on the SWAYAM platform. The Orange tool and the rule-based sentiment analysis method VADER were used to analyze the user reviews. Box plots of compound scores and chi-square tests of independence were calculated to identify patterns and trends in user sentiment toward MOOCs. The study found that overall user sentiment towards SWAYAM MOOCs was positive, with users expressing appreciation for the course content and delivery quality. Additionally, the study suggests that sentiment analysis may be a helpful tool for determining the quality and acceptance of MOOCs, and it can also be used to develop courses, advise policy, and assist in decision-making. The research also emphasizes the use of machine learning approaches in sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Development of Face Recognition-Based Smart Door Lock System with Remote Servo Control Authentication
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Security in the home is more crucial than ever for safeguarding personal belongings and avoiding identity theft. Key loss or theft occurrences have been shown to be vulnerable to traditional access control measures like keys, security cards, passwords, or patterns, which can result in major security breaches. To solve this problem for more effective and safe door access control systems, a novel method based on face recognition employing machine learning and IoT technologies have been presented. A camera records photographs of people trying to enter the building, and the Raspberry Pi, a small programmable computer board, acts as the main controller for the face recognition, youth system, and locking system. IoT technology enables users to manage door access and keep an eye on activity from a distance. This novel approach boosts protection, lowers the danger of theft, and provides a practical, adaptable, and scalable solution for a variety of home security applications.

articleTitle: Retinal Optical Coherence Tomography Image Denoising using Convolutional Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) is an imaging modality that is frequently used to monitor and diagnose retinal diseases. However, speckle noise in the acquired OCT images makes them difficult to interpret and analyse. In this paper, we present convolutional autoencoder (CAE) architecture for denoising retinal OCT images that incorporates an encoder and a decoder. Encoder extract relevant features of OCT images and subsequently decoder reconstruct the denoised images using the extracted features. To assess the efficacy of the proposed CAE, we used Mean Square Error (MSE), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), and Equal Number of Looks (ENL) as evaluation metrics. Furthermore, the denoising efficacy of the presented model was compared against conventional image denoising methodologies, namely Block-matching and 3D filtering (BM3D), Non-local Means (NLM), Median, and Bilateral filtering. The superiority of the proposed denoising model on OCT image is indicated by the evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Dissimilar High Electron Mobility Transistors and Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: High Electron Mobility Transistors (HEMTs) are advanced semiconductor devices that have gained significant attention in recent years due to their exceptional performance in high-frequency and high-power applications. This comparative analysis investigates and compares the characteristics, material compositions, and applications of dissimilar HEMTs. The study focuses on two primary types of HEMTs: GaN HEMTs and InP HEMTs. Overall, this comparative analysis contributes to understanding dissimilar HEMTs and highlights their diverse applications, paving the way for advancements in high-performance semiconductor devices and enabling the development of innovative technologies in multiple industries.

articleTitle: Automatic Performance Verification of Industrial Gateway using Python Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The growing digitalization and datafication of society are accelerated by the IoT movement in different new and amazing ways. Data security is essential because it plays such an important role. Malware attacks are also more frequent on Internet networks. It is a very complicated system, which includes several protocols, more than one layer, and more than one device. As a result, there is a need to review the entire IoT system. There are many test methods for IoT systems, but not one of them can test the entire complex IoT system. Many internal and external libraries available in Robot Framework can be used to test IoT systems. For example, the Selenium library can automate web-based IoT interfaces, while the request library can be used to interact with APIs or web services connected to the IoT system. Custom libraries can also be created to interact directly with IoT hardware using protocols such as MQTT or CoAP.

articleTitle: Automatic Voice Recognition of Human Voice with Noise and Echo Removal
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In signal processing applications, the main task is to remove noise from the signal. To remove noise from a signal, an adaptive filter employs a number of algorithms. The Wiener filter and adaptive filter methods are used in this research to cancel the noise present in the signal and these filters are known as least mean squares (LMS), recursive least squares (RLS) and Butterworth algorithms. Convergence rate, mean and variance of noise, mean square error, signal to noise ratio (SNR), and other characteristics are used to compare all of these approaches. A two-stage approach is then used: feature extraction and classification. Firstly, features of noise removed signal are extracted using Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC). Secondly, the Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) are used as the main classifiers since they are most common technique in the field of voice recognition.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-based Feature Selection Approach for COVID-19 with Machine Learning Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Covid-19 is one of the deadly diseases that spread among many countries of the world. In Conventional method of covid-19 testing, people felt a sharp pain which also causes headaches,nose bleeds and some may be fainted. To overcome this, the predefined CNN models are trained with the chest x-ray of the people and the model is used to extract features and machine learning models to classify them which will be less painful and avoid those sufferings mentioned above. In the proposed system, pre-trained CNN models are utilized as feature extractors, and they receive the pre-processed images as input. On the basis of the classifier’s evaluation findings, the features were extracted. And further the best deep features are combined, and the merged deep features are then fed into ML classifiers to determine the result.The ResNet with Random Forest Classifier and the VGGNet with Stochastic gradient descent gives the highest accuracy for covid19-radiography-database as 91.87 % and 97.75 % respectively and for covidct dataset both as 100% accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of a Dynamic Propeller Holographic Display For Educational Purpose
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The integration of ICT tools in education systems has revolutionized the way learners comprehend and internalize complex concepts. By leveraging smart classrooms, even in rural areas, students gain access to a wealth of educational resources, albeit with certain challenges such as financial constraints and technical limitations. To address these issues, a groundbreaking solution is proposed: the propeller holographic LED display. This innovative design surpasses existing alternatives in terms of Persistence of Vision (POV) and power efficiency. A single strip of LED is utilized, which displays captured images with exceptional resolution when rotating at a consistent speed of 13000 RPM. To ensure optimal performance, the speed of rotation is precisely controlled using a Hall sensor. This advanced mechanism guarantees superior quality and fidelity in image projection. Through a comprehensive analysis of both speed and power consumption, the proposed method demonstrates remarkable enhancements in quantity, thus improving the overall user experience and functionality. This novel approach has the potential to revolutionize visualizations in education and other fields, paving the way for a more immersive and engaging learning environment.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Ethernet Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The MAC (Media Access Control) service on the Ethernet standard is implemented by the hardware module known as IP (Intellectual Property for Ethernet Interface). This IP module's objective is to make it simple to create new devices that can connect to an Ethernet LAN (Local Area Network). This IP module with an interface to Ethernet LANs is reusable for many designs due to the standard protocols employed. Verilog is used to simulate and describe the Ethernet Interface IP. The existing Ethernet Protocol uses Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC). We have improved the error correction and detection approach in the existing ethernet protocol design architecture by utilizing redundant matrix coding. The tool used for designing Ethernet Protocol is Questa Sim.

articleTitle: Fraud Detection System Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The study's results suggest that employing the ISOMAP technique holds significant promise in the field of fraud detection systems, particularly in reducing the complexity of datasets. ISOMAP was found to preserve the inherent data structure, retaining essential information for spotting fraudulent transactions. By using ISOMAP to lower data dimensionality, computational demands were reduced, a crucial factor for real-time fraud detection applications. When compared to traditional methods, the effectiveness of the fraud detection system based on ISOMAP was evaluated. The outcomes showed that ISOMAP surpassed traditional methods in terms of accurately detecting fraudulent transactions. This improvement in performance can be attributed to ISOMAP's ability to capture non-linear data relationships. Furthermore, the study's findings have significant implications for implementing fraud detection systems in various sectors, including banking, insurance, and online retail. The application of ISOMAP for dimensionality reduction can enhance system accuracy and reduce the occurrence of false positives, thereby mitigating potential financial losses for businesses. To sum up, the project successfully demonstrated the efficacy of using ISOMAP for dimensionality reduction in a fraud detection system. The results showed that utilizing ISOMAP effectively captured the underlying data patterns, leading to improved accuracy in identifying fraudulent transactions. This research provides valuable insights into how ISOMAP can enhance the performance of fraud detection systems, highlighting its practical relevance in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Image Classification of Diseases in Wheat Crop Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Farmers every year face economic loss and crop waste due to various diseases in the wheat plant, which is among India’s top 5 most cultivated crops. Numerous plant diseases have distinctive visual symptoms that can be used to recognize and categorize them. Finding flaws in agricultural goods, especially wheat, requires the use of machine vision and image processing techniques. The use of image processing and artificial intelligence in agriculture for the classification and identification of plant and fruit pests and illnesses has grown, and work in this area is still ongoing. Deep learning enables the use of a disease classification algorithm for different plants, such as wheat, that makes use of these distinctive looks and developments in computer vision. The technique employs a deep convolutional neural network that has been trained to separate data into classifications, including many illness classes and a class for healthy wheat. Yellow rust, Septoria, Brown rust, and other diseases are among those that can affect wheat harvests. The wheat photos in the study's database, which included various cultivars, sizes, and illnesses, were painstakingly collected, categorized, and labeled by specialists.
