A system is a valuable tool in increasing the efficiency and accuracy of disease detection in cotton crops, leading to higher crop yields and better overall crop health.Here, the data will be collected as a large dataset of images of cotton crops, which is then used to train a deep learning model. Once the model is trained, it can be used to accurately identify cotton crops in new images. This type of system has the potential to greatly improve the efficiency and accuracy of cotton crop monitoring and analysis.

articleTitle: Optimal Design and Performance Evaluation of Software-defined Solar PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: To obtain the maximum solar radiation from sunrise to sunset, a robust and dynamic tracking system is required for solar photovoltaic (PV) panels. However, existing solar tracking systems encounter several issues, such as additional cost and power consumption, complexity in installation and integration, susceptibility to environmental conditions, tracking accuracy, compatibility, reliability, and scalability problems. To address these challenges and to provide an efficient, reliable, and cost-effective solution, a software-defined networking (SDN)-assisted tracking system can be deployed. Therefore, this paper proposes an SDN-enabled solar tracking system that can provide a more scalable, secure, and adaptive tracking platform for solar PV panels. In addition, this proposed framework allows centralized control and real-time monitoring, and virtualized architecture rather than a conventional hardware-based tracker. Besides, a robust panel adjustment algorithm is also developed and MATLAB’s Simulink module is utilized to demonstrate its effectiveness based on I-V and P-V characteristics. Interestingly, simulation results show that our proposed framework has outperformed the traditional tracking system and offers 22% improved energy generation as well as provides a software-based real-time tracking platform.

articleTitle: Real-Time Temperature Based Food Recommendation using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is a revolutionary feat in the world of technology. It is set to become a core component of all modern software over the coming years and decades. One of the domains where AI can play an important role is that of nutrition. Many factors influence an individual’s health, such as physical exercise, sleep, heredity, and pollution but food and nutrition are some of the most important factors being a daily individual need. Food varies greatly based on a person, the season, and the time of day. With the variations in personal food requirements and preferences, this research paper aimed to create a fuzzy logic and machine learning model to create a recommendation engine for food items based on the weather outside.

articleTitle: Efficient FPGA Floating-Point Multiplier with ATM and XOR-MUX
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient implementation utilising a 32-bit approximative truncated multiplier of a floating-point multiplier and XOR-MUX logic. The design covers a 23-bit exponent, 8-bit mantissa, and 1 sign bit. In order to decrease the output size of the multiplication operation, the carry-save multiplier is replaced in the proposed architecture with a roughly truncated multiplier. Additionally, it uses XOR-MUX logic to reduce the number of logic gates in the floating-point multiplier design, which lowers the number of full adders and full subtractors. The proposed architecture uses the normalized rounding method to reduce area, delay, and power. To illustrate optimised logic size, delay, and power, the error difference is studied using Model Sim software, and the proposed design is contrasted with an existing multiplier. Results reveal that the proposed design performs better than previous designs.

articleTitle: Classification of Retinal Fundus Images using VGG16 and Inception V3
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The objective of this study is to develop a framework for the classification of retinal fundus images and automatic detection of multi diseases related to the eye as well as other human organs using retinal fundus images. With the development and advancement, early multi diseases detection is possible using retinal fundus images and transfer learning models. VGG 16 and Inception V3 transfer learning models are strong models that have contributed significantly to medical image analysis. Evaluated these two models with the retinal fundus image dataset. Trained the models and obtained outcomes for training accuracy, validation accuracy, training loss, and validation loss. The trained model was performed on the test dataset and obtained Area under. Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUROC) curve of 0.913 of VGG 16 and AUROC 0f 0.942 of Inception V3 model. The performance of Inception V3 is better than VGG 16 on the RFMiD dataset. RFMiD consists of retinal color fundus images.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Skin Lesion Classification Using Dermoscopic Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Skin cancer ranks among the most widespread forms of cancer globally, according to the World Health Organisation (WHO). While the majority of skin cancers are not typically life-threatening, it is important to note that they can exhibit aggressive behavior and, if left untreated during their early stages, may result in fatal outcomes. The manual screening of dermoscopic images poses challenges as it takes more time and can occur some errors due to its reliance on the dermatologist’s experience. Additionally, the task of classifying skin lesions in dermoscopic images is exceptionally difficult due to visual resemblance within classes and limited contrast between the lesions and normal skin. We are doing a comparative study of skin lesion classification using dermoscopic images. In this study, We are incorporating the ConvNeXt model for the classification of dermoscopic images and comparing the proposed model with other models such as GoogleNet, DenseNet201, CSLNet, and Swin Transformer that are used for the classification of skin lesions in other studies in terms of Accuracy, Sensitivity, and Specificity and finding the best model for the skin lesion classification. We used International Skin Imaging Collaboration (ISIC) 2019 Dataset for this study. This proposed method attains 87.37% Accuracy, 89.06% Sensitivity, 87.37% Precision, and 98.08% Specificity. With this study, we can help dermatologists make proper decisions and provide better treatment to patients.

articleTitle: A Completely Distributed Cloudlet Framework Using 410c SoC
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the emergence of IoT, new computing paradigms have also emerged. Initial IoT systems had all the computing happening on the cloud. With the emergence of Industry 4.0 and IoT being the major building block, clouds are not the only solution for data storage and analytics. The term cloudlets was introduced first in 2011, but research in this area has picked up only over the past couple of years. In this paper, we propose a complete novel distributed architecture for cloudlets, and also we are proposing algorithms for data storage and task allocation across various nodes in the cloud. This cloudlet system was built using Qualcomm Snapdragon 410c. We have analyzed the architecture and the algorithm for varying workloads, bandwidth and data storage. The primary aim of the algorithm and the architecture is to ensure uniform processing and data loads across the nodes of the system.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Real-Time Indian Sign Language Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: for deaf and mute people to communicate with other people and with themselves, sign language is crucial. People frequently overlook the value of sign language, which serves as the sole means of communication for the deaf and mute cultures. Sign language interpreters are one of the services they use for communication. However, it is highly expensive to hire professional translators, thus finding an inexpensive solution to this problem is necessary. To interpret the visual data in textual information, we, therefore, suggested a method using MobileNet and LSTM-CNN model that recognizes alpha-numerical gestures and eight emergency words of Indian Sign Language in real-time.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Fusion Approach for Automatic Diagnosis and Grading of Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy, a severe complication arising from diabetes, exerts its impact on the retina. Timely identification plays a pivotal role in facilitating successful treatment. In this regard, this study explores the utilization of 3 state-of-the-art CNN architectures and proposes a fusion based approach to enhance the accuracy of diabetic retinopathy classification. The CNN models, namely EfficientNet-B0, MobileNet, and ResNet50 are explored on a public dataset of retinal images, MESSIDOR. The proposed approach achieves better performance than previous methods. On MESSIDOR, it achieves 82% accuracy for referral/non-referral binary classification and 63% accuracy for multi-class classification.

articleTitle: Food Recommendation Systems Based On Content-based and Collaborative Filtering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: On the internet, numerous options are available for a specific type of product. It is tough to manually go through every product in a particular type when a user is trying to choose the best one. Because of this, manual searching is not very efficient. The recommendation system is crucial in recommending the best product in that situation. A food recommendation system is developed in this research paper using K-nearest neighbor’s methods. The food data set is taken from Kaggle. We used Python programming language to implement the system. Our proposed recommendation system recommends food based on food name, food id, cuisine type, diet type like veg or non-veg in the case of content based filtering recommendation. For recommending the food with help of collaborative filtering we have used user id, food id and rating as an attributes.

articleTitle: Parkinson’s Disease Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Parkinson's disease is a progressive, central nervous system disorder that impairs mobility and includes tremor-like symptoms. Typically, brain scans from clinical checks are used to diagnose Parkinson's disease. Nearly 0.58 million people are suffering from Parkinson’s disease as estimated in 2016. The identification of Parkinson's disease (PD) results in mistakes, huge amounts of medical expenses, and could cause trouble for the patients. Telemonitoring is using technology to remotely diagnose, treat, or consult with a patient. This addresses the problems with the clinical verification of Parkinson's illness. Patients with this illness may get treatment based on their motor-related symptoms, voice fluctuations from speech processing, or CAD-based image processing. Voice has lately been found to function as a biomarker for several neurological illnesses [1][12]. So, to reduce the risk and detect the disease at an early stage, we are trying to create a model using speech features and machine learning techniques. In order to detect the people suffering with Parkinson’s disease, we propose to use various techniques like Naïve Bayes, SVM, KNN, and Decision tree classifier. Such models can help people in the medical field to identify if an individual is affected by Parkinson’s disease at an early stage. We are driven to make substantial progress in this area because there isn't an early detection system created exclusively for persons with Parkinson's disease. The entire model was developed by using machine learning models and CNN [2].

articleTitle: Forecasting cumulative oil recovery from waterflood using a deep proxy model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The fluid injection rate, injection period, and well placement during waterflood govern the fluid displacement from the reservoir. In general, the available traditional reservoir simulators are utilized for attaining near-optimal environments to maximize oil recovery. However, this approach desires numerous iterations of long simulation runs which in turn, consume significant time and increase cost. In this context, a deep learning proxy model consisting of long short-term memory and densely connected neural networks has been proposed to predict cumulative oil production in the Waraga field, Uganda. The proposed model uses minimal information including the injection rate, injection period, and well pattern. One hundred and twelve cases validate the model's performance with only 1% average relative prediction errors. The proposed method allows for selecting the best field development scenario within minutes compared to several hours to days using the traditional approach.

articleTitle: Cyberbullying Text Classification for Social Media Data Using Embedding And Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the world moving towards an almost digital lifestyle, especially after the covid-19 pandemic, people are extensively using social media platforms to express their views. The comments and chats on these platforms are often observed to be raw and direct, to the extent that it can become an act of bullying. Increase in suicide attempts, anxiety and depression cases reported on account of cyberbullying highlights the importance of developing automated systems for identifying cyberbullying oriented content. The proposed work deals with the classification of comments on social media oriented as cyberbullying or not. The work explores various deep learning classifiers in combination with varied word embedding inputs on five different social media datasets for classification. The model evaluation reported that Glove embeddings when input to an attention based Bi-LSTM classifier with GRU was the best performer across most of the experimented datasets with a micro-average F-measure ranging from 0.8 to 0.97.

articleTitle: Uplink Performance Analysis of PD-NOMA System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) is one of the potential radio access methods suggested for 5G networks to improve the performance of 5G users. This research presents the work made on the 5G PD-NOMA system. The objective of the research is to analyze the bit error rate experienced by UEs under different channel models, different encoding techniques, and different modulation schemes. The MATLAB-based Uplink system model for PD-NOMA is developed to make in-depth studies on channel parameters, a path loss model, modulation techniques, and encoding techniques. This research utilizes BPSK modulation, lognormal, two-ray, and free-space channel models, convolutional encoding, and low-density parity check (LDPC) encoding techniques for investigation purposes. From the research obtained, it is found that LDPC code exhibits a lesser probability of error compared to convolutional coding on BPSK modulated data.

articleTitle: Determining of the degree of intelligence of artificial intelligence systems
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work presents the factors that determine the degree of intelligence of artificial intelligence (AI) systems. A methodology for determining the degree of intelligence of AI systems is proposed. The concepts of intelligence quotient of artificial intelligence systems (AISIQ), average level of intelligence of AI systems, and correction factor for the age of an intelligent AI system, are defined. Determining the degree of intelligence of AI systems will allow assess the ability of an AI systems to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This can be useful for evaluating the efficiency and reliability of the system and for identifying areas where it can be improved. Determining the degree of intelligence of an AI system can help in decision-making for implementation in various fields, as well as in assessing the potential risks and benefits of its use.

Author Keywords: Intelligence quotient of an artificial intelligence system

articleTitle: Communication between Energy Meters and PLC Based on Modbus Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The widespread use of tools and machines in the workplace as a result of industrialization has led to steady increase in their quantity and complexity. PLC are used in industrial automation to improve system performance and reliability while reducing the necessity for human operators and minimizing the risk of human mistake. There are several different standards and specialized automation protocols that can be used to establish communication between PLC and multiple devices, most notably Modbus. This paper emphasis on a monitoring the data of Energy meters from PLC by using RS485 MODBUS communication by taking an application based remote monitoring system for electricity theft detection. An alert will be displayed on the HMI if there has been any theft in the distribution line, indicating the set parameters has been deviated. Additionally, the Node-Red platform will keep track of the data. The PLC testing of proposed system achieved the desired result.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Approach to Detect DDoS Attacks in OpenStack-based Cloud using Entropy and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud computing involves optimizing the efficiency of data storage and processing through the use of networking, various software, and internet services. In this context, network security is of utmost importance to prevent cybercriminals from disrupting resources and impeding effective utilization. Among the primary security concerns in cloud computing are Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, which can have severe consequences for business continuity. To address this, it is crucial to develop a robust DDoS detection system that can identify suspicious activities within the cloud environment. In this study, we propose a collaborative approach that combines entropy and machine learning techniques to detect DDoS attacks specifically in an OpenStack-based cloud environment. Initially, we employ an entropy-based technique to identify vulnerable hosts, followed by a machine learning-based technique to identify attacker hosts. To train and evaluate our detection system, we utilize real-time cloud data obtained from an OpenStack-based cloud testbed. Results reveal that using logistic regression improves the accuracy of the classifier. Furthermore, the collaborative approach significantly reduces the detection time.

articleTitle: Zero Trust Architecture Using Hyperledger Fabric
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Traditional security measures focused on network perimeter protection are no longer sufficient to defend against cyber threats in the quickly changing digital environment of today. A zero-trust architecture (ZTA), which assumes that every node inside a network is untrusted, has been offered as a solution to this problem. This study suggests leveraging the permissioned blockchain technology Hyperledger to implement ZTA. The approach makes use of the transparent and immutable Hyperledger ledger to protect network transactions and improve network security. Simulations and tests are used to evaluate the proposed ZTA, and the findings reveal enhanced security and efficiency when compared to conventional security measures. Based on ZTA and Hyperledger technologies, our research aids in the creation of reliable, scalable, and effective network security solutions.

articleTitle: Tomato Leaf Disease Detection using Enhanced Weight Assignment Based Loss Calculation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Plant diseases pose a significant threat to global food production and are a major challenge for crop management. Deep learning techniques have demonstrated remarkable success in plant disease detection, but most vision-based approaches rely on datasets captured in lab environments, limiting their applicability to real field images. The lack of large-scale non-lab datasets remains a significant challenge in enabling vision-based plant disease detection. This work focuses on leveraging sufficiently available in-lab datasets to enhance the effectiveness of plant disease recognition in real-world scenarios. This work proposes a region-reweighting-based approach that utilizes in-lab images for model training and in-field images for testing. The images are first partitioned into patches, and patch features are extracted using a pre-trained convolutional neural network (CNN). The clustering of these patches is performed to assign weights based on their similarity with other disease-containing patches. These assigned weights are considered during model training on the patches. Using this approach an accuracy of up to 92% is achieved on the disease class whose accuracy otherwise resulted in less than 90% on the state-of-the-art models. The work in this paper improves the identification accuracy of an individual disease class at the same maintaining overall accuracy as well.

articleTitle: Thermal fish detection system using Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: For scholars and image processing professionals, categorization of aquatic organisms in watery imagery is a developing area of study. For fish assessment goals, such as biological auditing ratio, monitoring fish stocks, and preserving critically endangered species, categorization of species of fish in aquatic pictures is crucial. Fish categorization is difficult and time-consuming because of the poor resolution, dark images produced by ocean water's light dispersion and absorption. The excellent fish categorization provided in this work aids the biologist's knowledge of the many species of fish and their environment. For fish categorization in this new methodology, a better deep learning-based automatic encoder decoder strategy was used. Deep learning models usually struggle with the best image classification. The crucial texture featuresare what determine how accurately aquatic species of fish are categorized. The suggested approach is then contrasted with popular deep learning models including Alex-Net, Res Net, VGG Net, and CNN to demonstrate its effectiveness. By using different iterations, groups, and fully associated layers, the proposed technique is examined. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is the algorithm that is utilised because it is among the most widely used methods for picture categorization.

articleTitle: Identifying Various Change Detection Procedures and Techniques in Image Processing Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study presents a systematic study of various application areas where change detection procedures and techniques are used to study change developed due to image processing, remote sensing, biomedical application, etc. The study of change detection techniques can provide details about the arrangement of the pixels (spectral as well as spatial), change developed in the texture features by analyzing them through grey level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM), identification of various supervised and unsupervised image classification techniques, and use of the image retrieval and encryption techniques. Finally, Skysat and Planetscope data is further used to present a pre- and post-study area change detection map, followed by texture analysis and quantification.

articleTitle: Recent ViT based models for Breast Cancer Histopathology Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Breast cancer is one of the most common type of cancer affecting women worldwide, and a leading cause of cancer-related deaths. Histopathology image analysis plays a vital role in breast cancer diagnosis. Early diagnosis and accurate classification of breast cancer histopathology images can help for effective treatment. In recent years, deep learning-based image classification methods have shown promising results in automated breast cancer diagnosis. Earlier, Convolutional Neural Network(CNN) had a huge attention in image classification tasks, and also obtained a good performances in histopathology image classification. Recently, Vision Transformer (ViT) based on self-attention mechanism has shown promising results in computer vision tasks, including image classification. In this paper, we review recent ViT-based model for breast cancer histopathology image classification. Furthermore, we summarize the results obtained from our experiments with both CNN and ViT-based models in breast cancer histopathology image classification.

articleTitle: Enhanced extremely boosted neural network (EXBNet) for effective Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease is considered to be one of the major causes of deaths around the world. Hence, a reliable, accurate, and efficient approach is needed to diagnose such diseases at an early stage so as to start the relevant treatment procedure. Machine learning and Neural network plays a critical role in processing massive amount of data in the field of healthcare. Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Deep Neural Network (DNN) techniques have been used in earlier research to predict heart diseases. The proposed methodology presents an effective heart disease prediction using an Enhanced Extremely boosted neural network (EXBNet) that can assist medical professionals. The proposed method, Enhanced XBNET is a variation of XBNET where Gini Index is used to compute the feature importance of Gradient Descent trees. XBNET is an ensemble model that combines both Gradient Boost tree-based models and Feed Forward Neural networks. The experiments were conducted on the data that has been collected using Kaggle datasets. The performance of proposed methodology is compared against various state-of-art methods using different classifiers and are evaluated using the performance metrics Accuracy, Recall, Precision, and F1 score. The research methodology provides an enhanced performance with an accuracy of 100%. The proposed methodology is compared with various state of art algorithms and it has been proved that the proposed method outperforms other algorithms.

articleTitle: Optimizing Waste Management through Intelligent Machine Learning Systems: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The purpose of this research study is to examine the use of intelligent machine learning systems in the process of optimising waste management practises. Several other approaches, such as Artificial Neural Networks, K-nearest neighbours, Logistic regression, Decision Trees, Support Vector Machine, and Random Forest, are being investigated as potential ways to improve the currently utilised waste management paradigm. On the other hand, with the implementation of algorithms for machine learning, these measures saw a huge improvement. The use of these methods brought in a remarkable increase in classification accuracy, which reached 92.349%, and a recall rate of 91.04%. This significant improvement in performance demonstrates the usefulness of machine learning in the process of optimising waste management. The Random Forest classifier proved to be the strategy that offered the best results after being compared to the other approaches investigated. In particular, the use of this classifier helped to improve the accuracy of estimates for the amount of time required to empty recycling containers. In a nutshell, the purpose of this study article was to demonstrate how effective intelligent machine learning systems can be in improving existing waste management procedures.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics in Healthcare using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Predictive analytics using machine learning is transforming healthcare by providing valuable insights into patient care, operational efficiency, and cost reduction. Using machine learning algorithms, healthcare practitioners can analyse massive amounts of patient data, identify trends, and predict future health outcomes better to serve their patients through personalised care and disease management. This paper provides an overview of predictive analytics using machine learning in healthcare, including its applications in predicting patient outcomes, optimising healthcare operations, and developing new drugs and therapies. Concerns over patient data privacy and security, algorithmic bias, and the necessity for educated people to interpret results are just some of the issues the article addresses concerning the application of predictive analytics in healthcare.

articleTitle: Design Analysis of an Energy-Efficient Low-Power Dynamic Comparator Using NMOS Based Preamplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Preamplifier stage is an essential module while designing dynamic regenerative comparators for low-voltage and low-power Analog to Digital Converters (ADC) designs. In this paper, a preamplifier stage is designed using NMOS transistors which allows the comparator to have faster comparison speed and lower power dissipation of the circuit. A pass transistor (PMOS) is used in the latch stage for setting the output nodes to a level above of half the supply voltage . The proposed circuit is implemented on both 90nm and 180nm CMOS technology and compared. A supply voltage of 1V is used to power the proposed comparator with a common mode input voltage of 0.9V and modelled using the 90nm CMOS technology Cadence Virtuoso Analogue Design Environment. The proposed comparator is operated at a 1GHz clock frequency and shows a power dissipation of 16.52µW with time delay of 72.09ps. The suggested comparator has 18.14V/nsec slew rate and is found to be energy efficient with 0.297fJ/conversion. The comparator proposed can run up to the highest clock speed of 4GHz. Monte Carlo Analysis for 200 samples is performed to validate the comparator parameters on delay, power consumption and offset voltage.

articleTitle: Enhanced Food Classification System Using YOLO Models For Object Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Food classification is crucial for the food industry and has a significant impact on public health and nutrition. Deep learning techniques such as YOLOv5 and YOLOv7 have recently shown significant improvement in food categorization accuracy. The results of this study’s analysis of both models is evaluated on a manually labeled dataset, evaluating their accuracy, recall, and mAP at the different intersections over union (IoU) criteria. The accuracy, recall, and mAP of both YOLOv5 and YOLOv7 were evaluated at various IoU criteria, and the results showed that YOLOv5 outperformed YOLOv7 in all three metrics. Specifically, YOLOv5 achieved an accuracy score of 0.851 and a recall score of 0.836, whereas YOLOv7 scored 0.67 and 0.675, respectively. Furthermore, YOLOv5’s mAP score at the 0.5 IoU threshold was 0.892, while YOLOv7 scored 0.669. At the 0.5-0.95 IoU threshold, YOLOv5’s mAP was 0.644 and YOLOv7’s was 0.426. This study demonstrates that YOLOv5 is a superior deep learning model for food categorization tasks, with potential implications for improving consumer nutrition and food safety in the food industry.

articleTitle: Kullback-Leibler Divergence Based Method for Depression Diagnosis Using Video Data
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Depression affects around four per cent of the total world population. The lack of trained professionals in low and middle-income countries has led to more than three-quarters of those affected receiving no treatment. This calls for the development of automated methods for depression detection. This work proposes a model to detect pertinent frames from video data using Kullback-Leibler Divergence and the concept of outliers. The distribution of microstructures of the frames, selected using the proposed method, is fed to the Support Vector Machine to classify those affected with depression from the controls. The proposed method is validated using the data obtained from the Department of Psychiatry, Center of Excellence in Mental Health, Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Medical Sciences and Dr Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital, New Delhi. The results are encouraging and pave the way for the use of this method in developing systems for the automated detection of the disease.

articleTitle: Design and Control of Swerve Drive Robot Using Kinematic Model
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Nowadays, wheeled mobile robots is an expanding field of scientific research and growing applications in both industrial and non-industrial fields. They are extensively used in surveillance, industrial automation, and transportation task. This paper describes the design and control of the Swerve drive robot with a kinematic model. In this swerve drive, all four swerve modules are operated independently, which provides greater agility and minimal steering hysteresis over the conventional holonomic drive. In Swerve drive, each swerve module is driven by a gear-train and steered by belt drive with the help of a BLDC motor. Each motor has an in-built hall sensor and acts as a feedback element for the PID controller.

articleTitle: Development of an Augmented Reality based Joint Attention Training Platform for Autistic Children
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Joint Attention (JA) is a major deficit in children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). Providing an early intervention is crucial as a lack of JA ability affects social communication skills in adult life. With the advent of technology, there has been a lot of development in JA skill training using computers and mixed-reality devices. Augmented Reality (AR) is increasingly being used for healthcare applications due to its ability to provide an interactive and engaging user experience. Currently there has been little exploration of AR as a medium for JA skill training. To address this problem, we have developed an AR based JA training platform using Microsoft Hololens 2 Head Mounted Display (HMD) with an inbuilt eye-tracker. This platform aims to gamify the process of JA skill training. It uses only gaze fixations for interaction, allowing users to practice their gaze-sharing and visual communication abilities. The user’s performance is recorded based on the correctness of their gaze response and the duration to register a valid gaze response. To determine the effectiveness of our platform and its feasibility for delivering JA skill training, we have performed a pilot study involving 4 ASD and 4 age-matched neurotypical developing (NT) children. Observations from this feasibility study shows participants diagnosed with ASD took significantly more time to follow a JA cue and register a response as compared to their NT counterparts. This study also shows the acceptance of the AR based JA platform by both the ASD and NT participants to perform JA exercises and provides insights to further develop this platform.

articleTitle: Real Time Vehicle Tracking using YOLO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this research work, we aim to implement a real-time vehicle-detecting system using the YOLO algorithm. The system processes images and videos to identify the region of interest and detect vehicles using various techniques. The detected vehicles are then classified into different categories such as cars, trucks, and buses using DNN models. The system also tracks the movement of vehicles across consecutive frames of video to count the total number of vehicles passing through a given area. The final results are displayed in a graphical user interface, providing an easy-to-use interface for users. This research has potential applications in traffic management, surveillance, and security systems.

articleTitle: A Survey of Event Detection Techniques in Intelligent IoT System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A significant challenge for today's companies and organizations that rely on technology is detecting events in their ever-increasing complexity. The present paper discusses the various event extraction algorithms in the intelligent IoT (Internet of Things) system. The various detection problems in IoT systems have been addressed with different approaches. A systematic representation of IoT event detection models is presented in this survey as rule-based, semantic, simulation, and machine-learning based-models. This paper emphasizes the benefits of using appropriate IoT features for change detection using an event extraction approach. The main directions of current research in event detection methods are defined for single and sequenced events.

articleTitle: A Dual Band Coplanar Fed Circular Antenna for WLAN, WiMAX, and Satellite Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A novel compressed Coplanar dual-band circularly polarised antenna is presented for WLAN, WiMAX, and satellite applications. The proposed dual-band circular polarised antenna is made up of an improved coplanar ground structure with slots, strips, and an improved shape patch. An improved coplanar ground structure is used to produce circular polarization at low and high frequencies. The projected antenna design has a simulated impedance bandwidth of 81.42 % (3.16-7.5GHz) and 20.53 % (11.9-14.5 GHz), separately, and a 3-dB axial ratio bandwidth (3-dB ARBW) of 29 % (4.18-5.6 GHz) and 8.86 % (11.86-12.96 GHz). The circular polarization antenna suggested has an extreme gain of around 3.8 dBi and 5.1 dBi in individual bands, with good right-hand circular polarization. The complete dimensions of the circularly polarised antenna are 25* 25*1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Enhancing Customer Experience and Sales Performance in a Retail Store Using Association Rule Mining and Market Basket Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The retail business grows steadily year after year andemploys an abounding amounts of people globally, especially with the soaring popularity of online shopping. The competitive character of this fast-paced sector has been increasingly evident in recent years. Customers desire to blend the advantages of old purchasing habits with the ease of use of new technology. Retailers must thus guarantee that product quality is maintained when it comes to satisfying customer demands and requirements. This research paper demonstrates the potential value of advanced data analytics techniques in improving customer experience and sales performance in a retail store. Apriori, FP-Growth, and Eclat algorithms are applied in the real time transactional data to discover sociations and patterns in transactional data. Support, confidence and lift ratio parameters are used and apriori algorithm puts out several candidate item sets of increasing lengths and prunes those that fail to offer the assistance that is required threshold. We identified lift values are more when considering frozen meat, milk, and yogurt. if the customer decides to buy any of these items together, there is a chance that the customer will buy 3rd item from that group. Research arrived High confidence score is for Items like Semi Finished Bread and Milk so these products should be sold together, Followed by Packaged food and rolls. As retailers continue to face increasing competition and pressure to improve their operations, The aforementioned techniques may provide you a useful tool to comprehend consumer buying habits and tastes and for utilising that knowledge to come up with data-driven decisions that optimise product placement, enhance customer satisfaction, and attract sales.

articleTitle: Optimization of Green Computing in Data Privacy in Healthcare BCT Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A central element of blockchain networks is immutability, which enables each participant to have a precise global record of all transactions. In permissioned blockchain networks, where validators are selected from a trusted group, immutability is easier to establish. This critical blockchain property can only be realized on public platforms through decentralized economic mechanisms. Despite the rapid advancement of IoT's technology, where an increasing number of medical devices and sensors are linked to Internet, security and inadequate energy resources owing to broadcast remain major obstacles. In most situations, patients wear many medical devices that wirelessly send identified medical info to node-servers. This may result in excessive traffic on communication networks and significant energy utilizations. It can be difficult to defend against various threats of unauthorized data access during the safe data gathering and transfer in healthcare apps to centralized servers utilizing IoT's. Large-scale security measures should be implemented as a result to ensure.

articleTitle: Impact of feature selection on sEMG signal classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The sEMG signal contains both relevant and irrelevant features. In order to reduce the computational burden, time, and cost of hardware development, only the selection of relevant features is necessary. This research article reports an impact analysis of feature selection on hand gesture classification based on surface electromyography (sEMG) signals. For this purpose, the analysis of variance (ANOVA) algorithm is used to rank the features. A subject selection method is developed on the basis of ranked features, to select a generalized subject. Four classifiers, including Decision Tree (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), k-Nearest Neighbor (kNN), and Naïve Bayes (NB), have been considered to test the impact of feature selection. The performance of classifiers before and after feature selection is compared on the basis of accuracy, precision, recall, f1-score, training, and testing time. Average accuracy and time consumption improves from 70.04% and 0.13425 seconds to 89.75% and 0.03845 seconds after ANOVA based feature selection is employed. Additionally, four channels are identified to reduce complexity of acquisition device.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Video-to-Video Synthesis GAN models on Cityscapes Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Video synthesis and prediction are essential tasks in computer vision, finding diverse applications in areas such as video editing, virtual reality, and autonomous driving. This paper presents a comparative analysis of three state-of-the-art video synthesis models: Vid2Vid, Fast Vid2Vid, and Dynamic Multi-scale Voxel Flow Network (DMVFN). Vid2Vid and Fast Vid2Vid are generative models that specialize in synthesizing realistic videos based on semantic segmentation maps. In contrast, DMVFN addresses video synthesis using a voxel-based representation and adopts a multi-scale strategy, generating voxel grids at different resolutions to capture both global and local motion information. In result analysis of video synthesis models, Vid2Vid generator and discriminator generate visually captivating videos with accurate object shapes and colors, with accuracy 84.76% and 85.25%, respectively. Whereas, Fast Vid2Vid has achieved a remarkable speed while maintaining a satisfactory quality level with generator and discriminator accuracy of 88.82% and 87.68% together. Finally, DMVFN excels at capturing complex motion patterns and preserving temporal coherence, so it has achieved 86.64% generator and 86.96% discriminator accuracy, although it may have limitations in generating subtle details. Overall, this comparative analysis provides valuable insight into the strengths and limitations of each model, assisting researchers and practitioners in selecting appropriate video synthesis techniques for specific applications.

articleTitle: Algorithm for compiling an examination timetabling at a higher education institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Developing an automated examination timetabling (ET) in a higher education institution is a complex multi-criteria task. To automate this process, it is first necessary to create an algorithm for compiling the ET. When compiling a ET in a higher education institution, the organization of studies in the institution itself must be considered. In this paper, a flowchart of an algorithm for compiling an automated ET in a higher education institution is presented. Automating the process of ET compilation, based on this algorithm, will lead to a higher quality of training. If all the requirements and constraints of ET compilation are met, then one can also argue for satisfaction with ET compilation. In addition to this, finding optimal solutions in composing ET in the future can lead to a higher quality of composing ET, an increase in the quality of learning and to a higher satisfaction of the main agents (students and teachers).

articleTitle: High Gain Super Lift Luo Converter with PSO Optimized PI Controller Based EV Application
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The most enticing non-polluting energy source now is solar energy, almost limitless, and widely accessible. But low output panel voltage and an unbalanced load state are the complications related to PV systems. In order to address the aforementioned issues, the super lift Luo converter with PSO optimised PI controller is utilized by the proposed system. Super lift Luo converters enable high step-up voltage conversion with low ripples and great power density when used with a PV system. Furthermore, a PSO-optimized PI controller is used to regulate the system such that it is stable at all times. The proposed technique successfully improves power quality, and such an improvement helps with the efficient and seamless integration of the PV system. The simulations were performed using MATLAB to ensure that the planned system satisfied the design criteria. The outcomes of the simulation showed that the final output voltage was stable, indicating that constructed solar panel structure successfully increase output voltage with maintained stability. The efficiency achieved through this proposed approach is 95.8%.

articleTitle: Proposed Convolutional Neural Network for Early Pneumonia Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Pneumonia is a lung condition wherein the air sacs present in the lungs swell due to the presence of fluid or pus. Although mild in nature in earlier stages of the disease, pneumonia can quickly become life-threatening if diagnosis and treatment are delayed. Therefore, it is essential for the condition to be detected as early as possible. Traditional methods of diagnosing pneumonia involve manual classification by a medical expert but even that involves risk of error in diagnosis and can put the health of an individual in danger. Since the most vulnerable groups to pneumonia are newborns and young children, adults over 65, and immune-compromised individuals, diagnosing pneumonia as accurately and timely as possible will lead to reduction in preventable deaths and neonatal mortality. For detecting pneumonia from Chest X-Ray (CXR) Images in a precise and accurate manner, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model has been proposed in this paper. Trained and tested on an input dataset from Kaggle, the model was utilized to detect and classify CXR images into 2 classes based on whether pneumonia was detected. The model achieved a high accuracy of 92.63% for the diagnosis of pneumonia from CXR images.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Mental Health Care
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology into mental health services has emerged as a promising way to improve the quality and accessibility of mental health services. In the field of analysis, Artificial Intelligence techniques like Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning algorithms have shown great potential for the analysis of big data such as electronic medical records (EMRs) and social media posts. This technology can help identify patterns and symptoms of various mental disorders, facilitating early detection and intervention. AI also plays an important role in mental health diagnosis. Machine learning algorithms trained with extensive data enable accurate and efficient classification and diagnosis of different diseases. Additionally, AI-powered virtual assistants and chatbots are being developed to provide initial assessment, psychoeducation, and even treatment, thereby expanding access to mental health services. Healing is another area where intelligence shows promise. Intelligent algorithms can analyze patient information, past medical results, and evidence-based guidelines to recommend personalized treatments. In addition to this, techs such as VR-AR (virtual and augmented reality) and digital therapy combined with artificial intelligence are collaborating to provide treatment and improve the patient experience. AI programs continue to advance the care and management of mental health. Wearable devices equipped with sensors can collect physical and behavioural data in real-time, and this data can be analyzed by intelligent algorithms to detect early signs of relapse or flare-up. This proactive monitoring allows for timely intervention and personalized care, ultimately improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Cardiac Patient Data Classification Using Ensemble Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Heart disease is a major global health problem, and successful treatment and prevention depend greatly on early and correct diagnosis. Machine learning methods have showed promise in the medical data analysis and in helping to categorise diseases. In this article, we investigate the application of ensemble machine learning methods for the categorization of cardiac patient data. Three machine learning algorithms—XGBoost, SVM, and KNN are combined in our ensemble method. The robust gradient boosting method XGBoost is renowned for its capacity to manage intricate data connections. SVM is a flexible classifier that can detect boundaries in non-linear decisions. KNN is a straightforward yet powerful algorithm that uses the closeness of examples to classify data. We want to use the strengths of these algorithms by combining their predictions to make them stronger and improve categorization. The experimental findings show how well the suggested ensemble strategy for classifying cardiac patient data works. The ensemble classifier outperforms the individual classifiers with an accuracy of 88.52%. This proves that integrating the predictions of many algorithms results in a more reliable model and better classification performance. The results of this study provide a contribution to the categorization of medical data and give medical practitioners important information about identifying cardiac disease. The ensemble classifier can help in the prompt and accurate identification of patients who are at risk, allowing for early intervention and the development of effective treatment plans. The promise of ensemble machine learning algorithms in the categorization of cardiac patent data is shown by our research, in conclusion. The ensemble method using XGBoost, SVM, and KNN outperforms individual classifiers, producing a classification model that is more accurate and dependable. In order to improve the model's classification performance and interpretability, next research might concentrate on investigating other ensemble approaches and adding domain-specific knowledge.

articleTitle: Inception Inspired U-Net for Effective Segmentation of Microscopy Images
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Biomedical image analysis has vital role in medical diagnosis. Computerized tools for automatic analysis of biomedical images helps the radiologist for the disease identification. This work explores a custom designed deep learning architecture for automatic segmentation of microscopy images. The deep learning architecture uses Inception modules in U-Net type structure for effective segmentation. This newly designed framework is tested on different types of microscopy data to assess segmentation performance. The proposed model’s dice similarity index for the DIC-C2DH-HELA and Fluo-C2DL-MSC datasets are 0.9559 and 0.9167 respectively. Further intersection over union for the DIC-C2DH-HELA and Fluo-C2DL-MSC datasets are 0.8783 and 0.74779 respectively.

articleTitle: Relevant Feature Extraction to Enhance Aspect-Based Sentiment Classification Using Dependency and Bi-Tagged Features
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A growing demand for gleaning insights is observed from a large amount of user-generated content available on the internet. The lack of phrases and the semantic ambiguity of single words both have a negative impact on the reliability of sentiment analysis, and this is particularly true when considering the context of brief texts shared on social media. The proposed research work investigates the contextual knowledge usefulness for relevant feature extraction based on dependency and bi-tagged features (DABTF). The prominent features extracted using Information Gain (IG) value improved the classification accuracy. Based on accuracy, the comparison shows Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier gives superior performance over Naive Bayes (NB) classifier with value 79.67% for the proposed method. The improvement can be observed in the aspect category classification task for food and service categories with F-measures 92.34% and 89.78% respectively.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Learning Approach For Improved Skin Cancer Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Skin cancer is one of the most prevalent cancers in the world.. The decline in ozone levels in the atmosphere is anticipated to result in a rise in the cases of skin cancer. Early detection is essential because if it is not discovered at the primitive stage, it could be fatal. Manual identification of skin cancer might be a difficult task as many of the pigments can look similar. Development of computer-aided automated skin cancer diagnosis systems to support dermatologists has advanced significantly. In order to enhance the classification of three primary kinds of skin cancer namely basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and melanoma, this work develops an ensemble deep learning model. In this study, we created a balanced data set of three types of skin cancer images publically accessible from ISIC (International Skin Imaging Collaboration) archive to build the model. Transfer learning using pretrained models namely MobileNetv3small, Nasnet-Mobile and EfficientNetv2-B0 were used to classify the three types of skin lesions. Further these models were used to build the stacking ensemble model to improve the classification accuracy when compared to the individual models. Individually transfer learned models using pretrained MobileNetv3small, Nasnet-Mobile and EfficientNetv2-B0 gave test accuracies of 98.48%, 99.32% and 98.59% respectively. The accuracy of the ensemble model is 99.90% which is also compared with some existing studies and found promising.

articleTitle: Examining Amazon Customer Reviews using PySpark and AWS: A Data Lake Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

authors.preferredName: Maddala H S M Krishna Karthik

abstract: In the contemporary world, big data analysis with PySpark and AWS has become quite handy. Large multinational companies, including Walmart, trivago, and countless others are using big data. And with the assistance of AWS, which offers a variety of services like glue, Athena, S3, etc., becoming extremely beneficial for cloud storage purposes and also for creating data migration pipelines. Any RDBMS database server might send tens of gigabytes of data to an Amazon S3 bucket using the ETL architecture. Our primary goal in this project is to use PySpark to construct an ETL pipeline for data migration. Amazon wireless devices review analysis, Amazon watches review analysis, Amazon books review analysis, Amazon shoes review analysis, and Amazon musical instruments review analysis are the five separate datasets on which we conducted our analysis. The datasets considered for the analysis are Amazon watch reviews, book reviews, shoe reviews, wireless device reviews and musical instrument reviews . The goal of the project is to obtain the ratio of the number of trustworthy, real reviews to untrusted reviews and a comparison in done in the form of graphs.

articleTitle: Improving Skin Disease Diagnosis with Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: One of the deadliest maladies is skin disease. Despite it could be challenging to diagnose dermatological problems precisely. In the present study, deep learning will be used to pinpoint the skin problem described earlier. Such a tool would be more efficient than manual procedures, which are time-consuming and call for expert help. This paper's main goal is to provide an in-depth analysis of conceptual review of current advancements in deep learning-based skin disease identification. Although deep learning is gaining popularity, there are still many problems to be solved and much more study to be done. The present manual procedures for diagnosing skin diseases are known to be time-consuming because they rely on professional judgement.

articleTitle: Exploring Human Capital's Role in Driving Sustainable Organizational Development in the Era of the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT), a network of interconnected devices and sensors linked through the Internet, facilitates the connection between individuals, their devices, and vast amounts of data. Within companies, the human resources department plays a crucial role in managing the pressure generated by various aspects, including marketing, development, and the application of IoT in human resources. This study is motivated by the need to understand the potential of IoT in strategic human resource management practices. To explore the fundamental strategic human resource management practices and assess their mediating effects, this research gathered data from 320 respondents in the Kerala information technology sector, specifically Kochi Infopark, consisting of both lower-level executives and senior managers. The study utilizes statistical analysis to examine the relationship between sustainable human resource practices, the Internet of Things, and sustainable human resource growth. Furthermore, the study highlights the IoT's role as a mediator between strategic human resource management practices and factors contributing to sustainable HR growth, demonstrating a positive impact of independent variables on dependent variables. These findings emphasize the potential for organizations to enhance HR practices, decision-making, and innovation using IoT during crises and uncertainties. Integrating IoT with SHRM empowers organizations to effectively manage challenges and complex environments.

articleTitle: Designing a book recommendation system in library using collaborative filtering system
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The amount of data has increased, leading to the importance of data technology. The process of extracting information from a broad database is called Data Mining A recommendation system is a data filtering technique that makes suggestions to users in accordance with their requirements and areas of interest. Systems of recommendations are created to assist users in making the best product selections.It is getting harder for library patrons to select the appropriate books as the collection of books grows. A book recommendation system aids users in selecting the top book from a sizable selection. There will be many number of books on a particular subject or topic in university libraries. Students must pick the best book out of all of them. In this project, we'll create a recommendation engine based on the books that students from previous batches who received higher grades recommended. A collaborative filtering technology can be used to accomplish this. The advantage of the system is it reduces data sparsity and cold-start problems as earlier recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Implementation of Low Power and High Speed Dadda Multiplier using Xor-Xnor cell Based Hybrid Logic Full Adder
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Multipliers are one among the crucial part in all arithmetic operations in all digital design and digital signal processing units. Proposed 4*4 Dadda multiplier(DM) is designed using hybrid logic style cells as its building blocks. Hybrid logic style of cell that contains three modules among which XOR–XNOR logic module influences performance parameters of the hybrid logic based full adders while other two modules are used for the generation of Sum and Carry of the full adder cell. Performance of each full adder is evaluated, and hybrid logic-based full adder are listed then the performance parameters of each 4*4 Dadda multiplier with various hybrid full adders in terms of power, delay, and Power Delay Product (PDP) are determined. The proposed multiplier has been designed and verified in cadence virtuoso using 18nm FinFET.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality in Education: Designing and Implementing a Dedicated Application for e-Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper outlines both the framework and the steps involved in building a chat room for high school students, utilizing immersive virtual reality (IVR) technologies to bring together professors and students in a VR distance learning experience. We have created three-dimensional items that represent the world we have designed, including platforms, chairs, tables, whiteboards, and other environmental elements. This application utilizes the Unity game engine for IVR scenarios, providing students with a new resource for communication when they are unable to attend school due to challenges that do not affect their learning experience. Designing IVR environments poses various challenges, and when possible, solutions are suggested.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Effective Trusted Knowledge Algorithm for Effective Integrated Internet MANET based on Secure Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Communication between mobile and fixed nodes is made possible via the Integrated Internet MANET (IIM), which makes use of the hub that the mobile ad hoc network's operating system generates. Due to the nature of the wireless channel, integrated MANETs are susceptible to security breaches. Unreliable connection mobility in IIM, instead of hindering information sharing between mobile and stationary nodes, may instead tamper with knowledge. The certainty with which an element may select to convey data is affected by the level of trust examined. We present a Hybrid Effective Trusted Knowledge Algorithm (HETKA) that uses trust estimation to guarantee the safety of information during transmission throughout nodes. The suggested method has two components, one of which is used to identify the reliable node. After observing the promiscuous node, an efficient value of dependability was calculated utilizing a hybrid method in the subsequent phase. Extensive simulation studies led us to the conclusion that the proposed mechanism provides an efficient method for protecting data from unstable Distributed Anomaly Network (MANET) and Undependable Routers over the Internet.

articleTitle: Weapons and Related Object Classification in Digital Forensic Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The use of machine learning algorithms for the bracket of munitions and affiliated objects has come increasingly important in the field of digital forensic. This paper presents a comprehensive review of recent studies on the operation of machine learning ways (Convolutional Neural Network) to identify munitions and affiliated objects from multiple sources, including images of different of guns, cutter, vest etc. The review highlights the strengths and limitations of machine learning approaches, similar as unsupervised and pre-trained model learning. The performance of these models in terms of accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity is also estimated. The paper discusses several issues that need to be addressed in the operation of machine learning models to forensic examinations, similar as the need for large annotated datasets, robust point birth styles, and interpretability of the models. The paper concludes with a discussion of unborn exploration directions and the implicit impact of machine learning on the forensic analysis of munitions and affiliated objects.

articleTitle: Implementation of Square Root Function Using Vedic Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The importance of optimizing VLSI design and raising their efficiency is crucial in the generation. In this study, the square roots of both perfect and imperfect square numbers are calculated using Vedic sutra Vilokanam. In general, finding a number’s square root is thought to be a time-consuming task. Square roots can be found using one of two time-consuming, lengthy methods that are taught in today’s classrooms. The Vedic Sutra Vilokanam, however, can assist us in determining the square root of such numbers with a little practice. Swami Bharati Krishna Maharaja’s Vedic Mathematics is not the only system for calculating the square root of an erroneous square number. It has long been a part of mathematician’s routine work.

articleTitle: High Gain Compact Cavity Backed SIW Antenna for WBAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: An rise in interest has been noticed in recent years, for wireless components and systems. In the proposed work, a tiny multiband cavity-backed substrate integrated waveguide (SIW), and a coplanar waveguide (CPW) feed and a metamaterial antenna, are used to produce high gain for WBAN applications.[1] On the ground of the antenna, there is a radiating T-shaped stub. It is located opposite to the feed line. Substrate Integrated Waveguide and metamaterial combinations are employed. The antenna efficiency in this project is improved using Substrate Integrated Waveguide and a square split ring resonator (SRR).The suggested antenna utilizes FR4 substrate dielectric material of Ԑr = 4.4 and the antenna dimensions of 40 x 40 x 1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. This antenna design is analyzed using ANSYS HFSS software.[2] FR-4 Epoxy is used as the substrate. The suggested antenna has a return loss of -9.6735 dB, 7.568 dB, and -12.50 dB and resonates at three different frequencies, respectively 2.40 GHz, 6.70 GHz, and 7.40 GHz. The VSWR achieved is 5.9232 and gain obtained is -2.6622 dB. The antenna achieved in this project is directional radiation type antenna.

articleTitle: Analysis of Shortest Routing and Waiting Time of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) have been growing in popularity as transportation due to the rapid advancement of EV technology and their low carbon emissions and reduced noise pollution. In spite of the fact that it requires frequent and prolonged charging needs, the EVs are having their own advantages. The EVs require more charging time and waiting time at the charging station. As well as finding the nearest charging station, during long travel, is a crucial task. By selecting the proper charging station, the overall waiting time including the charging time can be reduced. Considering these facts, the work presented in this paper proposes to design algorithms to find a nearest charging station along with optimal route to reach the charging station Three algorithms, using the Dijikstra’s algorithm, Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, are designed for this study. The proposed algorithms could find efficient charging scheduling for EVs, considering the traffic condition, battery's remaining energy, and the length of the queue at charging stations. The performance comparison of the proposed algorithms revealed that the PSO based algorithm could outperform other two algorithms in terms of distance and time metrics.

articleTitle: Video Based Fashion Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The fashion industry has grown incredibly over the years giving rise to a number of varied styles. This growth in the variety has also led to a change in the choices of the customers. Customers nowadays are mostly inspired by the style statement of the characters of a movie or a web show. They want to recreate the same look for themselves but fall short of knowing the correct terminology to identify the style. Online shopping platforms deal with a lot of data, so for an efficient search, it is needed that we identify the proper keyword to initiate the search. A style comes into existence through the different combinations of the features of a dress. Thus through this paper, we explore how these features can be used in identifying a style. Further, we propose an approach to recommend clothes similar to a reference character in a video.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis for detecting Alzheimer’s by CNN and SVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Alzheimer's Detection is a dementia type affecting memory, thinking and behavior and the early detection is very critical due to the incurable nature of Alzheimer's. This literature proposes a method to contribute towards the early detection research of Alzheimer's disease. This paper introduces the fundamental theorem of Support Vector Machine algorithm and Convolution Neural Network classification ideas implemented on brain MRI images to early detect Alzheimer's disease. CNN and SVM are the types of research focuses of the classification and machine learning community. The paper uses Oasis data set consisting of cross-sectional and Longitudinal MRI data Kaggle dataset which contains brain MRI images. The paper compares SVM and the CNN model and compares the accuracy of the two algorithms. The literature can be very helpful in classification applications and studying the final prospects of SVM and CNN.

articleTitle: Full-Duplex Antenna Using Bow-Tie-shaped DGS BPF
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A novel design is introduced in this paper for the full-duplex operation in wireless communication systems using a shared square patch antenna. The duplex antenna consists of a single corner slotted square radiating patch and defected ground structures (DGSs) of bow-tie-shaped with partial ground planes. The dual-polarization and frequency diversity techniques are implemented to attain the isolation between the antenna ports. The DGS bandpass filters (BPFs) are embedded underneath the microstrip feedlines from the antenna ports. The designed dual-band antenna resonates at 2.61 GHz and 2.75 GHz, achieves the minimum interport isolation of 42 dB in both entire operative bands, attains the maximum isolation of 45 dB, and has an excellent frequency spacing ratio of r = 0.05. Also, the proposed design can operate in the entire S-band by adequately scaling the sizes of bow-tie-shaped DGSs that regulate the resonant frequency of the incorporated BPFs. Furthermore, the DGS BPFs have good cut-off characteristics, selectivity, and a channel bandwidth of about BW ≤ 820 MHz. The proposed antenna offers bidirectional radiation patterns in both E and H planes at the resonating frequency of the dual bands.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization Based Control of a Differential Drive Mobile Wheeled Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This work aims at the efficient control of a mobile robot using optimised PID controller. The two DC motors are controlled precisely which in turn regulate the movement of the robot. Numerous techniques have been developed to enhance the PID control strategy applied to linear and non-linear systems. In this work, first the actuator model of the mobile robot is simulated and then the optimal computation techniques i.e., Simulated Annealing (SA), Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) are considered to tune the gains of PID controller. ITAE is considered as the objective function for optimization. The comparative study reveals that PSO tuned PID provides the least ITAE and is thus used for the mobile robot. The velocity plots are analysed for various positions of wheels. The motion characteristics for different paths are also analysed which justify the effectiveness of the PSO-PID controller over the other considered techniques.

articleTitle: Segmentation of leaf veins using principal curvature and morphological methods
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Extracting the network of leaf veins is a crucial step in characterizing and classifying the species of plants. Researchers have categorized the plants for many years by understanding several vein features including vein density, length per unit area, vein topology, etc. To extract leaf veins, this paper presents a simple and effective approach based on image processing methods that utilized information about the curvature at each pixel of a leaf image. In the proposed system, Gaussian filtering is performed as a pre-processing step to remove the noise and area opening as post-processing for removing small undesired segments from the segmented vein network. The maximum principal curvature image is computed followed by contrast enhancement that resulted in the segmented veins image.

articleTitle: Analysis of DDoS Attacks in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The fifth generation of mobile telecommunications standard (5G) as defined by 3GPP is currently under deployment (as of 2023) and is expected to serve as the backbone for several business verticals such as mobile communications, V2X, energy, finance, health, IoT/IIoT (Industrial IoT), AR/VR, etc [1], [3], [4]. It is essential that such a network is secure and accessible as many mission-critical applications rely on it.
