This paper deals with a major security threat in 5G networks that is, its vulnerability to DDoS attacks. A literature review has been conducted on similar research articles. We have utilized TETCOS NetSim™ network simulator software to analyse the performance impact and formulate possible countermeasures. Subsequently, we have also discussed a way to provide resilience towards such attacks using advanced MIMO configurations.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Supervisory Machine Learning Algorithms for Cellular Networks Payload Enhancement in Downlink
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

authors.preferredName: K L V Sai Prakash Sakuru

abstract: Payload allocation in downlink cellular networks is vital for efficiently distributing data transmission to users/devices. The base stations (RRH + BBU) task allocates and assigns radio channels, time slots, and other resources to facilitate good data reception by users. The allocation process considers quality of service (QoS), traffic management, and scheduling algorithms. This study aims to optimize resource utilization, mitigate network congestion, and ensure fair and reliable data transmission to users with Supervisory Machine Learning approaches by considering the sizeable cellular traffic data to improve payload efficiency and network performance by dynamic resource allocation for advanced cellular technologies. This complete design is implemented in Google Colabortory (Colab), an open-source cloud platform. In this paper, XBOOST, LINEAR REGRESSION, GRADIENT BOOST, and RANDOM FOREST supervisory machine learning algorithms were compared for resource allocation and time complexity, and the results are presented.

articleTitle: ”Unlocking the Future of Stock Market Trend Prediction: Advancements with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Models”
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The stock marketplace is a complex and dynamic environment where traders attempt to make informed choices to maximize their returns. Predicting the destiny tendencies of stock prices is a difficult project due to various factors influencing marketplace conduct. In recent years, deep mastering strategies, along with long short-term memory (LSTM), have won enormous interest for their capacity to capture elaborate styles and dependencies in time-collection information. This paper aims to develop an LSTM-based stock market trend prediction model with the objective of achieving significantly higher accuracy compared to existing approaches. The goal is to generate valuable insights from the predictions, enabling investors and traders to make more informed decisions in the stock market. These insights could include identifying potential trends, forecasting market movements, or suggesting optimal trading strategies.

articleTitle: Length Measurement of Coir Rope
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A natural fiber called coir, often known as coconut fiber, is taken from the coconut husk.Typically, fibers are 10 to 30 centimeter (4 to 12) in length.The fiber extracted is measured manually. The major problems identified in manual method includes a lot of time consuming process. When the fiber is measured manually it may result in various errors. Human errors are inevitable. It will require more human resource. Manual method may cause a great loss for industries. Solution is provided using sensors which does not require human interruption. Thus, the solution provides accurate measurement in measuring the coir rope. The accurate measurement helps the industry to improve their manufacturing. It reduces the loss for the industry. The automated device built helps the industry to provide accurate measurements on their product. Thus all their products are equal in size. Human error can lead to inaccurateresults that are not very close. It ensures that the product being manufactured falls within a specific measurement range.Currently, the manual method is consuming more human source. The project is to bring actual measurements in measuring the length of coir rope.

articleTitle: Ear Drum Disease Classification using Convolutional Neural Networks and Aquila Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A deep learning approach for classification of ear drum diseases is proposed in this work. At first, several feature matrices are generated by extracting the features from various pre-trained networks using transfer learning approach. A pool of classifiers is chosen and by using a meta heuristic algorithm i.e., Aquila Optimizer, three best feature matrices and three best classifiers are selected from the pool of feature matrices and classifiers. Performance of the other models is analyzed by fixing the classifiers. Ensemble prediction is done from the selected feature matrices with majority voting strategy. Extensive validations are carried out using various train and test splits. Experiments are carried on an eardrum dataset ‘Otomatch’ which is an imbalanced dataset. Various imbalanced metrics i.e., geometric mean, balanced accuracy, index balanced accuracy and F-measure, are used to assess the merit of the proposed algorithm. Compared to an existing work on the chosen dataset, the proposed algorithm performs better in terms of mean classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Network Security for IoT Device using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study presents a summary of the use and development of blockchain in a variety of Internet of Things enablement technologies. This encompasses not only the Merkle tree itself but also its application, technique, level of complexity, and synchronization. The study provides a detailed description of the experimental setting along with a suggested research model and workflow procedure. This section examines and puts into effect two distinct scenarios regarding the development of transaction times, mining times, and chaining times. The ultimate outcome is determined using a classification method that is based on machine learning. This method makes use of logistic regression, multilayer perceptron, SGD text, SGD, basic logistic regression, SMO, and voted perceptron.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture and Audio Recognition System Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a system that combines hand gesture and audio recognition using deep learning techniques. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are used by the system to recognise hand movements, while an architecture based on CNN + RNN and the CTC Loss algorithm is used to recognise audio. The proposed system is capable of recognizing sign language gestures and individual characters in speech, which can be helpful for individuals with hearing and speech impairments. The system is trained and tested on publicly available datasets, achieving high accuracy rates in both gesture and audio recognition. This work could advance the field of human-computer interaction and increase accessibility for people with hearing or speech problems. The outcomes show how well the suggested method works and illustrate its potential for use in practical situations. The results demonstrate that our model reliably recognises audio signals at a state-of-the-art level when tested against a public dataset.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Bodo Parts of Speech Tagger
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Parts of Speech tagging is the process of sequential labeling of words in a sentence with their corresponding grammatical categories, such as noun, verb, adjective, and so on. It is one of the important steps toward Natural Language Processing, as it allows for a deeper understanding of the sentence’s structure and meaning. There are various challenges in the tagging of POS, particularly when dealing with low-resource languages like Bodo. Bodo, one of the official languages of the Indian state of Assam, is a relatively low-resource language that poses challenges for POS tagging. In this paper, we aimed to develop a POS tagger for Bodo language to promote its overall flourishment. To do this we employed deep learning techniques, specifically Recurrent Neural Network(RNN), Long Short-Term Memory(LSTM), Gated Recurrent Unit(GRU), and Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM). These models have been demonstrated as powerful tools for natural language processing tasks and have been successfully applied to POS tagging in other languages. To evaluate the performance of our models, we have collected a corpus of 9991 sentences (approximately 70000 tokens) in Bodo which is annotated with the Bureau of Indian Standard (BIS) tagset. After an extensive comparison of all models across different sizes of training, validation, and test sets, it was determined that the Bi-LSTM model gave the best performance in terms of accuracy. Specifically, the Bi-LSTM model achieved an approximate accuracy of 98%.

articleTitle: Gap Coupled Multiple Input Multiple Output MSA for 5G and WLAN Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a simple four ports gap coupled MIMO (multiple input multiple output) MSA (microstrip antenna) desirable for 5G, WLAN, and other modern wireless applications. The presented antenna exhibits very good input characteristics with proper isolation between the adjacent ports. An input impedance bandwidth of 39.10% was obtained from the measurements. The measured adjacent ports isolation coefficient are better than -15dB & other ports isolation is found to be nearly -20dB. The envelop correlation coefficient (ECC) value was found to be less than 0.03 which is well within the prescribed limit. The measured diversity gain (DG) was above 9.8dB in the band of interest Simulated results were compared with measured values and good matching was found between these two results.

articleTitle: Pashto Isolated Digits Sign Language Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Effective communication involves the ability to hear and listen without any hindrances. However, communicating with the deaf community can be challenging, even when one is making a sincere effort to do so. In such situations, sign language has proven to be the most effective means of initiating and ending a conversation. Unfortunately, members of the deaf community are often treated with less respect and may be ignored due to their inability to communicate. This leaves them feeling isolated and prevents them from accessing vital information or exercising their right to make choices. Recent technological developments in machine learning, computer vision, and sign language recognition have facilitated the bridging of communication barriers between deaf and hearing individuals. The present study endeavours to make a contribution to the field by constructing a system that employs convolutional neural networks and computer vision techniques to identify manual gestures utilised in Pashto sign language and convert them into a numerical representation.

articleTitle: An Empiric Study on Bangla Sentiment Analysis Using Hybrid Feature Extraction Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this modern technologically advanced world, Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a very important topic in every language due to its various trendy applications. But SA in Bangla language is still in a dearth level. This work focuses on examining different hybrid feature extraction techniques on Bangla SA using a new comprehensive dataset of 203,493 comments collected from various microblogging sites. In this study, we have implemented 21 different hybrid feature extraction methods including Bag of Words (BOW), N-gram, TF-IDF, TF-IDF-ICF, Word2Vec, FastText, GloVe, Bangla-BERT etc with CBOW and Skipgram mechanisms. The proposed novel method (Bangla-BERT+Skipgram) outperforms all other feature extraction techniques in machine leaning (ML), ensemble learning (EL) and deep learning (DL) approaches. The (Bangla-BERT+Skipgram) method achieved highest 92.37%, 92.55% and 95.71% accuracy in ML, EL and DL algorithms.

articleTitle: Class Room Student Attentiveness Model based on YOLO
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Online classroom discipline is a key concern for teachers now a days. The issue also attracts significant attention from the public and the media. In addition to this using mobile phone in class is one of the reasons for not paying the attention. For avoiding this issue, developed a model called "Class Room Attention Model". The proposed model collects the data using camera, and with the help of machine learning models automatically detects whether the student in the class is paying attention or not. The suggested method uses Tensor Flow to detect the mobile phone and media pipe for extracting the body features using the YOLO model. The model detects presence of mobile in the classroom in addition to the prediction of the students attentiveness. The proposed efficient and accurate model to identify the attention of a student in a class room with the random forest classifier provided an accuracy of 97.65 % for attention of student and 93.81% for mobile detection.

articleTitle: Identifying Brain Tumour from Brain MRI images by ensemble learning methods
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Brain Tumour is nothing but abnormal Growth of cell in brain which can be detected using Brain MRI and finding the information about uncontrolled growth of cell in Brain. The present research talk about detecting the Brain tumour by first transforming and MRI image into different forms using Gabor filters and then identifying an important features from them And finally by Appling different ensemble learning methods namely Decision Tree, SVM, KNN, Naive Bayes , SGD, to identify is tumour exists or not, Our results show significant differences and we can say that SVM has highest performance among KNN, Decision Tree, Naive bayes classifiers whereas SGD performs very less.so to classify the Brain MRI Images we can say SVM is the best classifier. Which will be significantly useful for Doctors and Medical practitioners to take quick decision in order to identify Brain tumour.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Multi Factor Crop Motoring and Irigation Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: We all know that plantations are one of the biggest sectors in the contemporary world. 30worldwide is accounted for by it. India is a major agricultural country, and the safety of the nation’s food supply is significantly influenced by agricultural productivity. In comparison to other wealthy countries, India has significantly less farmland per person than the world average, as well as lower production values per person and lower land yields per unit. As a result, we must find ways to enhance output using the limited natural resources that are presently available if we are to meet the difficulties of food production.

articleTitle: Exploring Low-Power Implementation Techniques for 2:1 MUX Using Conventional and CNTFET Technology: a Performance Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, implementation of 2:1 Multiplexer is done using two different technologies. Firstly, there is design of 2:1 MUX using Conventional techniques i.e. CMOS, PTL and TGL and secondly, 2:1 MUX is designed using Carbon Nano Tube Field Effect Transistor (CNTFET) based CMOS, PTL and TGL. Then, comparison of these two technologies is done based on Power Consumption, Delay and Power Delay Product (PDP). Simulation is done using HSPICE tool at 16nm technology node. After simulation, results showed that PDP is reduced by 98.38% for 2:1 MUX designed using CNTFET based CMOS, 99.75% for MUX designed using CNTFET based PTL and by 99.56% for CNTFET based TG as compared to conventional technologies. Here, least Power and PDP is shown by 2:1 MUX using CNTFET based PTL but least Delay is shown by CNTFET based CMOS. This proves that CNTFET technology has power to replace CMOS technology as its results showed better performance with respect to Power, Delay and PDP. From here, inference can be made that CNTFET is advanced and growing technology that can be used instead of CMOS for designing of low power electronic devices.

articleTitle: Decentralized Group Authentication of Devices Based on PhysicallyUnclonable Functions Using OneM2MArchitecture
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The advent of 5G networks brings significant advancements for Machine-to-machine communication as it offers high data rates, network slicing capabilities, and improved network performance. A global wave of M2M connections has brought many opportunities for industries. However, with an exponentially new number of devices connected to the internet, the security of systems has become more vulnerable. Existing schemes utilize key generation functions like Elliptic Curve Cryptography, Shamir Secret Sharing, and Message Authentication Codes. These traditional schemes are based on discrete logarithm problems and factors of large numbers, that now can be predicted with more advanced quantum computers. The keys are also stored in physical memory, making it prone to hardware security attacks. To make the current framework future-proof new optimized authentication mechanisams need to be devised. This paper presents a novel approach based on Physically Unclonable Functions that can potentially defy even quantum-based attacks. PUFs provide an alternative method of security by relying on physical characteristics as opposed to computational presumptions. PUF responses are distinct and unpredictable as it follows an event-driven approach. Moreover, the results obtained by implementing the proposed scheme show that the network performance is optimal with a significant decrease of 16% in the energy requirements as compared to other techniques. This cost-effective, robust, and reliable approach has myriad applications for the industry by generating state-of-the-art solutions and fostering trust between all stakeholders.

articleTitle: In-Depth Network Security for Docker Containers
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The continuous growth of microservices deployment as containers, exposed a wide attack surface, enabling attackers to execute several types of attacks, including network-based attacks such as Man-in-the-middle attack (MITM). The lack of isolation at network level enabled such attacks to be executed, especially in container environments, where many containers are running on the same host without proper restrictions. This is because the existing configuration of the containers’ network is poorly secured, in which one container is able to access any service running on neighboring containers or on the host. In this paper, a design is proposed that is able to attain the required level of network isolation by employing Firewall Container (FWC), which acts as a gateway for a set of related containers that are connected to a virtual bridge to protect against unauthorized access and MITM attacks. FWC is configured to filter traffic and perform port forwarding (NAT), it also has an optional DHCP server.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Farmer’s Portal for Agri-Governance
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Blockchain is a technology stores transaction confirmation in the form of crypto-currency. It develops the records of any digital asset transparent and unchangeable and works without involving any middlemen or third-party intermediary. They contribute security and set boundaries to the assets. This demonstrates how the farmer's portal uses blockchain technology to store footage of crop sales and purchases and to develop a model to maintain all the transactions between government initiatives and farmers based on farm subsidies. This farmer's portal designed on basis of blockchain helps those farmers to sell their products directly to the government and in receiving the subsidies without inclusion of any middle men or third-party sites. This helps the farmers in increasing the desired amount directly to themselves. It includes the farmers and government itself. The proposed solution designs an interface by using the python's integration with the blockchain system as a programming language will maintain the contract of trade to the advantage of vendors, farmers, and individuals. The information pertaining to farmers, the government, buying and selling an item, farm subsidies, and the total value of transactions is stored using this interface. Blockchain technology's immutability will make it easier for farmers to obtain the actual price of their harvested crops and reduce the cost of buying and selling crops, helps in receiving the subsidies compared to traditional methods and third-party involvement.

articleTitle: Surface Crack Detection Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Surface cracks are a widespread issue that affects many different businesses, including the building industry, the transportation industry, and the manufacturing industry. In order to preserve safety, minimize expensive repairs, and ensure the lifespan of buildings and equipment, it is essential to detect and identify surface cracks. The research made use of a dataset of surface cracks that is freely accessible to the public from Kaggle website. A level of accuracy of 99.62% was attained by the VGG16 model. The accuracy of the Inception model was measured at 99.89%. The Xception model was successful in achieving an accuracy of 99.76%. According to these findings, the Inception model performed far better than the other two models when it came to identifying surface cracks.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Political Party Twitter Data using Ensemble Learning Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a field that has gained a lot of popularity in the last decade. We can identify the sentiment of a user in various fields like ‘Movie Reviews’, ‘Hotel reviews’, ‘Online Product reviews’ etc. Analysis of sentiment helps the other user in decision-making. Nowadays, sentiment analysis is also being used in the political scenario to select appropriate candidates/parties. Seeing this fact, we have performed a sentiment analysis on the political Twitter dataset to find out which Indian political party is getting positive/negative reviews. Generally, researchers use Textblob which is a lexicon-based sentiment analyzer to predict sentiment. The lexicon-based technique does not provide good accuracy to predict sentiment therefore in this paper we have applied ensemble learning using boosting techniques along with basic machine learning and deep learning techniques like SVM and LSTM. The result in terms of accuracy and ROC-AUC shows that ensemble learning i.e.LSTM with SVM outperform as compared to other ML technique. The accuracy is 87% and the ROC-AUC score is 93%.

articleTitle: An Efficient Smart Gas Detecting System using MQ9 Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Gas Detection System is most important system in any buildings. Now a days in factories so many poisonous gases are emitted from reactions especially in chemical factories it will helps to detect the presence of gas particles and the amount of spreading in air. Not only in factories other institutes, buildings, colleges etc especially it will detect the presence of fire and it will give an alert. Very minor leaks and their location can be found using visual inspection or portable detectors, but the detection process takes a very long time. In this paper, we developed system with MQ9 sensor which detects the poisonous gases like carbon monoxide, LPG gas etc. This proposed technique includes a buzzer alerting system that beeps repeatedly until the gas detection module fails to detect the gas in the surroundings.

articleTitle: Image Processing Approaches To Estimate The Structural Characteristics In Nonwoven Fabric Filters For Filtration Development
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study was conducted to estimate the fabric structural characteristics like fiber diameter and fabric porosity of the needle-punched fabric air filters with the use of image processing. The fiber distribution and web properties of the needle-punched nonwoven fabric filters used for dust filtration have a substantial influence on the filtration performance. Controlling these properties during production, without physical testing, will minimize production costs and material waste. Some computerized assessments will add to the ease of selecting these parameters. Here image processing algorithms have been developed to examine the porosity and fiber diameter properties of needle-punched nonwovens. The examined samples were composed of Polyester (PET) and Polypropylene (PE) fibers with varying areal weights. It is seen that the use of computerized techniques shows comparable results for evaluating structural properties and will also help to predict filtration performance.

articleTitle: Comparison of Machine Learning Algorithms in Luflow Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Network traffic is a major target of cyberattacks, and an alert is sent to the system when potential threats are detected. A machine learning based IDS evaluation is suggested to create a dataset following the training dataset to eliminate behaviors from the dataset. The suggested approach can more accurately assess the long-term performance of ML-based IDS since the test dataset represents attack trends and modifications in network architecture over time. This study utilises the Luflow dataset to investigate the use of machine learning methods for the detection of network intrusions. A few machine-learning methods were used in the research to categorize network data into good and bad exploits. To increase the model's precision, the dataset was pre-processed, and features were chosen. The hyperparameters that were produced by enhancing the model's training and testing precision metrics were used to assess the model's performance. This work establishes a foundation for future research in the area and shows how machine learning algorithms are successful at detecting intrusions.

articleTitle: An Integrated 2.4 GHz Inductorless Power Amplifier and On-Chip Two Turn Folded Loop Antenna for biotelemetry applications
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Biotelemetry applications require RF transceivers that have small size and less interference with the instruments used. On-chip antennas help to provide the miniaturization required for biomedical applications. Inductorless circuits further helps in size reduction and also reduces interference, not only with the instrument but also with on-chip antenna. The power amplifiers (PA) at transmitter end, consume large space due to the inductors present in it and also are the major cause of interference. In this paper, a novel differential inductorless power amplifier is designed at transmitter side of an RF front-end and integrated to an on-chip antenna at 2.4 GHz. Matching networks are avoided by conjugately matching the PA to on-chip antenna. The proposed inductorless power amplifier has a driver stage connected to a push-pull amplifier and is connected to a two turn folded loop antenna. The design is done in UMC 180-nm technology. The on-chip antenna is simulated in Advanced Design System (ADS) and it has a gain of -20.8 dBi. The post-layout simulations carried out in Cadence Virtuoso tool give an output power and power added efficiency (PAE) of PA of 14.5dBm and 31.2%. Compared to reported PAs, inductorless PA with on-chip antenna occupies very small area of 1.44mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and has comparable PAE and antenna gain. The proposed design can be utilized for short range biotelemetry applications for a range of 1.2 m.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Deep Learning Algorithms in Classifying Brain Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cancer remains a significant global health concern, contributing to a substantial number of fatalities. Specifically, brain cancer (BC) entails the abnormal proliferation of cells within or near the brain. Timely detection plays a pivotal role in effective tumor treatment. Machine learning advancements have significantly aided the medical field in diagnosing brain tumors. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has emerged as a widely utilized and effective machine learning technique for image processing and medical imaging. Nonetheless, many existing classification algorithms exhibit inconsistencies. In recent years, deep learning has exhibited promising outcomes in BC classification. This study focuses on the usage of four popular deep learning algorithms, namely AlexNet, GoogLeNet, InceptionNetV3, and ResNet50, utilizing brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) slices to classify cancerous tumors into Glioma Tumor (GT), Meningioma Tumor (MT), Pituitary Tumor (PT), and No Tumor (NT) categories. The performance of these algorithms has been thoroughly assessed using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. Notably, GoogLeNet demonstrates superior results among the four models employed. Additionally, a comparative analysis against various state-of-the-art classification algorithms highlights the enhanced performance of these deep learning models.

articleTitle: Optimal Deployment of User-Defined Relays for Microgrid Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The challenges associated with the integration of distributed generators (DGs) include higher short circuit currents and bidirectional power flow, which may lead to malfunctions of relay pairs. To improve the reliability and to reduce the fault isolation time, protection coordination approaches based on dual-setting directional overcurrent relays (DS-DOCRs) was developed. However, the study found that as the number of DS-DOCRs increases, the relay operating time tends to saturate along with the increased cost of the protection scheme. To overcome the issue, this paper proposes a framework to develop a protection coordination strategy that optimizes the number of user-defined DS-DOCRs and modified DOCRs in the presence of DGs. The goal is to optimally deploy the user-defined DS-DOCRs without much affecting its overall operation time. To accomplish this, the study use a multi-objective optimization technique based on non-linear programming that is optimally solved using minimum-constrained nonlinear multi-variable function (fmincon). Additionally, a fuzzy decision-making process is employed to determine the best-compromise selection and obtain the Pareto-optimal solutions. The overall study is performed in 7-bus microgrid i.e. the low voltage section of IEEE-14 bus benchmark system.

articleTitle: Exploring advantages and difficulties of Internet of Things (IoT) in Health care
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Internet of Things, with its expanding range of use cases across disciplines, has significantly altered the way we live. One example of an application of the Internet of Things is in the healthcare industry, which links internet-connected gadgets, machinery, patients, and medical professionals. When it comes to healthcare costs, the necessity and accessibility of resources, and personal care in general, particularly for older members of society, healthcare has emerged as a key socioeconomic concern in recent years. This new trend in healthcare has made it feasible for doctors to provide remote monitoring, chronic illness management, and seniors care of patients located in remote areas, and it has even made it possible for doctors to care for patients who are institutionalized so long as they remain connected to the internet. The widespread adoption of the Internet of Things (IoT) in healthcare and other similar technologies has helped to tackle a number of problems by utilizing remote monitoring, telemedicine, sensors, and other technologies. However, it seems difficult to accomplish widespread adoption because of considerations such as the need to protect users' privacy and the security of their data, the administration of massive amounts of data, scalability, upgradeability, etc. This new trend is both efficient and clever. The advantages and difficulties of trends in healthcare, which have altered the conventional healthcare system by making health management more effective via to their applications, are discussed in this study.

articleTitle: Protection of Split Light Trail(s) in WDM Mesh Networks against Multiple Link Failures
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Light trail is an unidirectional optical bus within WDM mesh networks that can transmit data between the convener (start) and the end node, and allows the intermediate nodes to participate in data communication. Recently, it is seen that splitting the light trail can improve the networks’ performance. However, the entire communication can come to an end, if a link failure occurs. In this paper we have proposed an algorithm namely, Split Light Trail Protection (SLTP) for protection of split light trail(s) against adjacent multiple link failures as well as non-adjacent multiple link failures, within the WDM mesh networks. Our proposed algorithm works for both static and dynamic split light trail(s). Recent studies shows that no previous works has been carried out for the protection of split light trail(s). Simulations in Matlab has been performed to calculate the blocking probability and throughput generated before and after the protection of split light trail(s). The time complexity calculated for the proposed algorithm SLTP is O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>).

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Side Lobe Reduction for Smart Antenna Systems Using Genetic Algorithms (GA)
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The growing demand for wireless communications necessitates greater radio spectrum utilisation in order to achieve better coverage, more capacity, and improved transmission quality. Several adaptive algorithms may be utilised to examine the adaptive beamforming technique of smart antennas, improving the performance of wireless communication networks. This article suggests an efficient and straightforward way for creating linear array antennas. The technique tries to lower the side lobe level (SLL) and redirect the primary beam in various directions. The use of genetic algorithms (GA) is also suggested as a fresh approach to adaptive beamforming. When used to optimise the excitation levels of the elements in a linear array based on fitness values, genetic algorithms are iterative stochastic optimizers that resemble the idea of the strongest surviving the weakest. In order to create a radiation pattern with the fewest side lobe levels, the excitation levels of the elements in the linear array are optimised using the adaptive evolutionary method. To aim the main beam in a particular direction, these algorithms calculate the proper side lobe levels and phase excitations for each antenna. In this paper, the side lobe level (SLL) is reduced using a genetic algorithm for a smart antenna system. The proposed work results were evaluated by MATLAB R2013a tool.

articleTitle: A Practical Method for Identifying Brain Tumors Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Brain tumor detection in MRI scans has developed into a growing study field in medical imaging systems during the past few decades. Finding a brain tumor helps to pinpoint the tumor’s exact size and location. This study uses image augmentation and convolution neural networks to detect brain tumors. On the Br35H dataset, the Experiment’s trials are performed. The proposed model makes use of regularization techniques to lessen overfitting. With an accuracy of 98.84%, the BTD-CNN model exceeds all other cutting-edge methods.

articleTitle: Combined VMD-ANN Based Approach for Classification and Analysis of Power system faults in AC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Many typical faults in the distribution system, such as LG, LLG, LLLG, and LLL, cannot be recognized by standard protection relays because the fault impedance is too excessive. Several approaches for overcoming these issues have been described in the literature. Nevertheless, these approaches were incapable of classifying fault types or determining their severity. In this paper, a fault classification prevention approach for AC distribution systems is proposed using Variational mode decomposition (VMD) and Artificial neural network (ANN) techniques. The proposed technique has been tested against various defects such as LG, LLG, LLLG, and LLL situations. The precision is tested on an IEEE 13 bus system.

articleTitle: Real-Time Network Monitoring: A Big Data Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Real-time network monitoring is a critical requirement for tracking user activities and ensuring optimal network performance. In this paper, we propose a big data approach to real-time network monitoring that leverages the capabilities of Apache Spark, MongoDB, and Apache Kafka with Python. Our approach utilizes distributed stream processing of network data, enabling real-time analytics for user activity monitoring and network performance optimization. Our approach demonstrates the effectiveness of our system through experiments with real network traffic data, showing how it can identify and track user activities in real-time. Our system can be used by network administrators and IT professionals to optimize network performance, improve user experience, and enhance security through real-time monitoring and analysis of user activity data. This approach can also be opted as a feature in SDNs.

articleTitle: Smart Home Security System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: We are regularly dealing with security vulnerabilities on all fronts. So, we must use streamlined technology to address these problems. In this project, we'll be taking pictures of people and fingerprint impressions to compare with pictures and impressions from the database that have already been stored. Finding out who enters or leaves the property is the most crucial feature of any home security system. As a person's biometric traits, their distinctive faces and fingerprint impressions may be used to monitor that instead of using passwords or pins. We want to create a smart door that protects the entranceway based on who we are. By integrating facial detection and fingerprint impression identification, this project aims to assist users in enhancing the door security of critical locations. The essential components of the proposed system are face detection, face recognition, fingerprint sensor, and automatic door access control.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition from Electroencephalogram using Variational Mode Decomposition and optimized Fuzzy K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 14th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Emotion recognition via Electroencephalogram (EEG) has gained considerable attention in the recent years due to its objective and naturalistic response to the emotional stimulus. However, the non-stationarity of the EEG signal makes it challenging to decipher the information hidden in the raw EEG using the conventional time or frequency domain methods. To obtain the pattern information from the EEG data useful for recognition, a framework using Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) is proposed. This framework firstly uses VMD, an adaptive approach to decompose EEG into specific Intrinsic mode function representations (IMF’s). Thereafter, power in different rhythms and absolute value of wavelet coefficients is extracted from each IMF. Moreover, a BAT optimized Fuzzy K-Nearest Neighbor (FKNN) algorithm is presented to finally recognize the different emotional states. The BAT algorithm optimizes the FKNN hyper-parameters to boost the classification performance. The proposed framework is tested on EEG signals from DEAP dataset, in which the Arousal and the Valence conditions are classified as High or Low. The results indicate that the proposed framework outperforms the existing state-of-the-art works by attaining a classification accuracy of 65% for High/Low Arousal and 62% for High/Low Valence conditions.
